TEXT_TIP_BREADFRUIT.text:
Je mehr Beeren ein Held verbraucht, desto dunkler wird 
die Farbe seiner Trainingszeichen (das Maximum ist orange).

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_1.text: Heroes with mechanical bodies are weak to bugs!

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_2.text: There are rumors of a secret dungeon in the lairs of the mysterious company 'L.C,' with a very particular purpose…

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_3.text: Even the most ordinary of heroes can possess mighty power here!

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_4.text: Bugs have infested 'L.C,' the mysterious company of Hasla! Help 'L.C' get rid of them, Crusaders!

TEXT_TIP_BUGLC_5.text: Lies die Story hinter dem Verlies für das Update „Saison 2: Erbe“ auf der Frühregistrierungsseite!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ACCOUNT_1.text: Deine gesamten Spieldaten könnten verloren gehen, wenn du dein Konto nicht synchronisierst!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ACCOUNT_2.text: Google Play -Dienste wird ausschließlich für die Rangliste, Trophäen und Multi-Play genutzt, synchronisiere dein Konto also separat!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ACCOUNT_LEADER.text: Dein Hauptheld steht für dein Konto.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_BREAD.text:
Erlange im Kühlen Brotlager jeden Dienstag und Samstag Brot,
um deine Helden zu trainieren.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_BUFF_1.text: Der Buff-Gegenstand „Milch“ wirkt sich auf das ganze Team aus.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_BUFF_2.text: Wusstest du, dass du für doppelte Effekte Elixier der Göttin und Milch des Wachstums gleichzeitig einsetzen kannst?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_CHAMPION.text: Die Championwerte entsprechen der Summe der Werte deiner aktuellen Teamhelden.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_CHAMP_CUTIN.text: Du kannst deine Champion-Zwischensequenzen in den Einstellungen anpassen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_2.text: In der Seelenfestung erlangst du Zutaten, um seelengebundene Waffen zu schmieden.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FAME_1.text: Du siehst deinen Ruhm im Söldner-Informationsmenü.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FAME_2.text: Durch Trophäen erlangst du mehr Ruhm und schicke Porträtrahmen!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FAME_3.text: Entdecke die Geheimnisse Haslas und erhalte verborgene Artefakte!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FRIEND_1.text: Tausche Fleisch und ehre den Tag gemeinsam mit anderen Crusaders, nachdem du sie als Freunde hinzugefügt hast!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FRIEND_2.text: Von Freundeshelden begleitete Helden erhalten in Szenario-Levels 50 % zusätzliche EP.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_FRIEND_FAVORITE.text: Merke dir andere Crusader auf deiner Freundesliste, um sie in Gruppen zu verwalten!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GOLD.text:
Dir geht das Gold aus? Erlange jeden Sonntag im  
Geheimen Lager des Goblins neuen Reichtümer!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GROWTH_1.text: Um Helden zu trainieren, benötigst du Brot und Gold.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GROWTH_2.text: Um einen Helden zu befördern, müssen seine Stufe und sein Trainingswert auf dem Maximum sein. Zudem wird zum Befördern Ehre benötigt.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_1.text: Auch nach hundert Jahren sind die Wunden aus dem Krieg der Apostel noch nicht verheilt.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_2.text: Seit vielen Jahren beschützen die Göttinnen die Seelensteine, in denen die Apostel versiegelt sind ...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_3.text: In den dunkelsten Ecken von Hasla schlummern die Apostel, die der Versiegelung in den Seelensteinen entgehen konnten.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_4.text: Apostel sind Wesen, die das Universum wieder in die Dunkelheit tauchen wollen, aus der sie geboren wurden.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_MANACAR_2.text: Warum ist Manacar aus seinem langen Schlaf erwacht?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_PUMPKIN_1.text: In der Kürbisstadt leben Dorothys ehemalige Meisterinnen, die vier Großhexen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_PUMPKIN_2.text: In der Kürbisstadt leben Dorothys ehemalige Meisterinnen, die vier Großhexen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_1.text: Die weiße Katze, die Miu überallhin begleitet, heißt "Navi".

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_10.text: Der Held Crow sieht sich selbst nicht als Mensch ...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_11.text: Seit Spiny in einen Cyborg verwandelt wurde, altert er nicht mehr.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_12.text: Dorothy tarnt sich als Elfin, um ihre Identität zu verbergen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_13.text: Erstaunlicherweise war Lilith trotz all der Jahre noch nie in einer Beziehung.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_14.text: In der Römischen Republik wird seit Generationen die Legende vom Bestienkönigs weitergegeben, dem Herrscher der Tiere ...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_15.text: Am anderen Ufer des südlichen Meeres von Hasla liegt ein Kontinent gehüllt in Geheimnisse ...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_2.text: Die Dorfkatze vor dem Heldenpavillon heißt "Lavi".

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_4.text: Schon gewusst? Vivians Vater heißt Gordian.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_5.text: Wird sich Rocheforts Liebe jemals erfüllen?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_6.text: Weiß Maria, dass Roland Gefühle für sie hat?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_7.text: Die Maschine, die Stanya auf dem Rücken trägt, stammt aus neu entwickeltem, hoch technologischen Material, das viel leichter sein soll, als es aussieht.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_8.text: Der Club der Tierfreunde hat ein hohes Kopfgeld auf Gon ausgesetzt.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLAINFO_9.text: Uziments Verlobte ist die Tochter des Häuptlings vom Stamm der Frostelfen, sie heißt Alisha.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_INFO.text: Touch and hold your hero or icon to view more information.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_INTERACTION.text: Hast du die Helden im Ort schon mal angetippt?

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_MAXLV.text: Erreichst du die max. Stufe eines Helden, erhältst du unabhängig von Kategorie und Klasse des Helden 1 Juwel.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HONOR.text: Dir geht die Ehre aus? Verdiene welche sowie zusätzliche EP im Dungeon Alter Übungsplatz!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_HEROSTORY.text: Du möchtest mehr über die Geschichten der Helden lesen? Sieh in der Bibliothek der Zeit nach!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_HW.text: In der Bibliothek der Zeit erfährst du mehr über Helden und Waffen!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_ILLUST.text: Sieh dir in der Bibliothek der Zeit großartige Zeichnungen deiner Helden an!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIB_SCENARIO.text: Du kannst Szenario-Zwischensequenzen in der Bibliothek der Zeit erneut abspielen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LIMITED_HERO.text: Verborgene Helden erlangst du nur bei bestimmten Ereignissen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LOADING_OPTION_1.text: Du kannst in den Einstellungen festlegen, ob die Ladebildschirme nur Pixelbilder zeigen sollen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_PASSIVE.text: Tippe in der linken unteren Bildschirmecke auf deinen Namen für deine Kontoinformationen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_RING_1.text: Kläre den Turm von Manacar und wöchentliche Quests, um Ringe zu erlangen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_RUNE.text: Im Fähigkeitenlabor kannst du diverse Spezialfähigkeiten auf Helden übertragen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_SKILL_INFO.text: Im Menü für die Kampfvorbereitung siehst du die Fähigkeiten jedes Helden, wenn du sein Porträt gedrückt hältst.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_SUPPORT_HERO.text: Nachschubhelden sorgen für die Verstärkung des Korps (Champions), sie können weder trainiert noch befördert werden.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_TEAM.text: Speichere und bearbeite häufig verwendete Kombinationen im Teamformationsmenü!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_WEAPON_1.text: Schalte mit Gold höhere Waffenverbesserungsoptionen frei.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_WEAPON_2.text: Sieh dir im Waffenverwaltungsmenü deine Optionen an, bevor du deine Waffen aufwertest!

TEXT_TIP_DG_ACCEL_1.text: Im Magischen Tempodungeon kannst du keine Spezial- oder Göttinnenfähigkeiten einsetzen.

TEXT_TIP_DG_ACCEL_2.text: Im Tempodungeon werden Blöcke bei hohem Tempo erzeugt!

TEXT_TIP_DG_BREAD.text: Die Monster aus dem Kühlen Brotlager kannst du nur mit bestimmten Kombinationen treffen.

TEXT_TIP_DG_RUN_1.text: Fliege gegen eine Hexe im Hexenrennen um die Wette!

TEXT_TIP_DG_RUN_2.text: Im Hexenrennen sind manche Hinderniskürbisse immun gegen physischen magischen Schaden.

TEXT_TIP_DG_RUN_3.text: Im Hexenrennen erhält ein Held bei Einsatz von Göttinnenfähigkeiten einen Temposchub.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_1.text: It seems Pandora has made a grave mistake.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_2.text: Deemo and the Little Girl earned special powers after coming to Hasla... And so did the Masked Girl.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_3.text: The Masked Girl wishes to keep Deemo and the Little Girl from growing the tree and returning to their own world.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_4.text: The higher the tree grows, the more anxious the Masked Girl seems.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_5.text: Will the tree help the Little Girl and Deemo back to their homes?

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_CHAIN_1.text: Using higher chains will help the tree grow faster.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_CHAIN_2.text: Using higher chains will earn more coins.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_1.text: Touch blocks of the same color when Masked Children and shadows of the Masked Girl approach the line before the tree.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_2.text: Help Deemo finish playing his piece!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_3.text: It is recommended that you turn up the volume while playing the DEEMO dungeon.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_DEEMO_RULE_4.text: Listening to music in the DEEMO dungeon will surely yield better results!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_1.text: Fergus träumt davon, einen Transformroboter zu bauen, doch der lange Krieg und die Eisenknappheit verhinderten es.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_2.text: Der Entroboter entstand durch das Zusammenwirken von Fergus' Hammer und Celines Magie.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_3.text: Fergus' erster Prototyp des Entroboters war so klein, dass er nur ferngesteuert werden konnte.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_1.text: Füge dem Entroboter für 60 Sekunden so viel Schaden wie möglich zu!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_2.text: Der Entroboter ist äußerst resistent gegen neutralen Schaden.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_3.text: Der Entroboter hat nur wenig LP, dafür aber einen starken Schild.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDEALER_RULE_4.text: Champions fügen dem Entroboter keinen direkten Schaden zu.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_1.text:
Das „Gefühls“-Kriterium der Wertungsliste
ändert sich je nach Fergus‘ Stimmungslage.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_2.text: Selbst die kleinsten Faktoren können sich auf deine Endpunktzahl auswirken.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_3.text:
Die Richter mögen keine gewöhnlichen Rezepte – 
wenn sie sich langweilen, vergeben sie niedrige Multiplikatorwerte.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_HINT_4.text: Auch wenn dir Fergus zuwider ist, bitte vergifte nicht den einzigen Schmied, den wir haben.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_STORY_1.text:
Fergus sucht nach dem „Essen der Himmel“, das er während
seiner Ausbildung als Schmied gegessen hat.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_STORY_2.text:
Die Zutaten sind immer frisch;
das verdanken sie Celines Konservierungsmagie.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_TOPDISH_STORY_3.text:
Der Richtertisch war ziemlich teuer,
denn er wurde mit der besten Technologie des Reichs Neth angefertigt.

TEXT_TIP_EXCEED_4.text: Seelengebundene Waffen können nur vom entsprechenden Helden verwendet werden.

TEXT_TIP_HOUSE_2.text: Einige Dekorationsgegenstände bieten besondere Merkmale oder Interaktionen. Probier sie unbedingt aus!

TEXT_TIP_HOUSE_3.text: Versuch mal, deine Monumente in deinem Heldenhaus unterzubringen!

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_1.text: Der Dungeon Legende der Urflammen weist mehrere Wege auf.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_2.text: Bei jedem Durchgang passiert je nach Weg etwas anderes, auch die Belohnungen fallen unterschiedlich aus.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_3.text: Einige Wege führen in eine Sackgasse, gib Acht!

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_4.text: Erfülle bestimmte Bedingungen, damit sich verborgene Wege öffnen.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_5.text: Monster aus verborgenen Wellen sind stärker als Monster aus normalen Wellen.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_RULE_6.text:
Höre gut auf das, was die Göttinnen sagen: 
Sie könnten dir Hinweise auf verborgene Pfade geben!

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_2.text: Susanoo, Saiga und Oda waren in ihrer Kindheit enge Freunde.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_4.text: Zu allen Ringen aus dem Dungeon Legende der Urflammen gibt es eine Hintergrundgeschichte.

TEXT_TIP_LOADING_TIP.text: Hier findest du nützliche Tipps zu Crusaders Quest.

TEXT_TIP_LOBBY_FRUIT.text: Das Trainingszeichen verwandelt sich von weiß zu purpur, je mehr Beeren du deinem Helden gibst.

TEXT_TIP_MEDIA_1.text: Im Medien-Menü findest du weitere Neuigkeiten von Crusaders Quest!

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_1.text: Je besser die Vogelscheuche, desto robuster.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_2.text: Die Vogelscheuche wird jedes Mal zurückgesetzt, wenn du den Übungsmodus neu startest.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_3.text: Vogelscheuchen werden durch deinen Fortschritt im Szenariomodus freigeschaltet.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_4.text: Mit der modernen Technologie der Vogelscheuchen kannst du verschiedene Experimente durchführen!

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_DUMMY_5.text: Im Übungsmodus kannst du die Vogelscheuche wählen.

TEXT_TIP_PRACTICE_LOBBY_1.text: Lerne den Umgang mit Helden und erprobe deine Fähigkeiten im Übungsmodus!

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_3.text: Das Zeitlimit für jedes Kolosseumsticket liegt bei 1 Stunde.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_4.text: Das Kolosseum wird jeden Montag um 9:00 zurückgesetzt.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_5.text: Mit Ehre kannst du den Gegner in der Meisterliga des Kolosseums wechseln.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_REWARD.text: Die Statue der Ehre am Ortseingang zeigt den Haupthelden der letzten Woche auf dem Kolosseumsrang Nr. 1.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_RULE_2.text: Wenn das Duell länger dauert als 1 Minute, werden die Helden stärker, können von da an aber nicht mehr geheilt werden.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_TIME.text: Das Zeitlimit für eine Runde im Kolosseum beträgt 3 Minuten.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_TIMEUP.text: Nach 3 Minuten wird der Gewinner der Kolosseumsrunde durch die Summe der verbleibenden Helden-LP ermittelt.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_CONTENTS_1.text: Unter den Aposteln, die Destalos geschaffen hat, sind einige besonders stark und tragen einen anderen Namen.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_CONTENTS_2.text: Fenriruth war ein Segment des 13. Apostels Ouroboros, der aus fünf Sandwürmern bestand.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_META_2.text: Wenn du keinen Partner findest, erscheint ein zufälliges Team aus KI-Helden, um dir zu helfen.

TEXT_TIP_RING_1.text:
Du erlangst die Manaessenz, indem du
Fergus Ringe entziehst.

TEXT_TIP_RING_2.text:
Mit der Manaessenz kannst du die
Unteroptionen von Ringen zurücksetzen.

TEXT_TIP_RING_3.text: Mit der Flammenessenz kannst du den Ringrang umwandeln.

TEXT_TIP_RING_4.text: Zum Umwandeln eines Ringrangs benötigst du Flammenessenz, dies bringst die Ringoption aufs Maximum.

TEXT_TIP_RING_5.text: Wenn du eine Ringoption umwandelst, ändert sie sich.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_ATK_PURE.text: Neutraler Schaden dringt durch gegnerische Rüstung und Widerstand, um wahren Schaden zu bewirken.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_ATK_TYPE.text: Heldenangriffe sind in vier Kategorien eingeteilt: "Physisch", "magisch", "neutral" und "fest".

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_BOSS_GET.text: Schließe Levels mit verdorbenen Heldenbossen ab, dann schließen sie sich dir vielleicht an.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_BOSS_SP.text: Bossmonster setzen mächtige Angriffe ein, sobald ihre FP voll aufgeladen sind. Nimm dich in Acht!

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_GAMEOVER.text: Erlangte Belohnungen bleiben erhalten, auch wenn deine Helden sterben.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_LEADER.text: Bei Anführerhelden liegt die Chance auf Blocks 50 % höher als bei anderen Helden.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_PENET.text: Bei Gegnern mit starker Rüstung oder Widerstand ist die Durchdringung entscheidend, wenn du mehr Schaden bewirken willst.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_STATUS_BUFFDEBUFF.text: Did you know? In battle, your Heroes' Accuracy rate and Evasion rate cannot be lower than 5% or higher than 95%.

TEXT_TIP_SOUL_1.text: Die Heldenbosse der Seelenfestung gehören zu den Crusaders auf der Kolosseum-Rangliste der letzten Woche.

TEXT_TIP_SOUL_2.text: Jeder Held kann nur einmal täglich teilnehmen.

TEXT_TIP_SOUL_3.text: Mit Juwelen kannst du abgeschlossene Levels wiederholen und Helden zurücksetzen.

TEXT_TIP_STATISTICS_1.text: Im Schlachtergebnismenü kannst du dir detaillierte Kampfstatistiken ansehen.

TEXT_TIP_THANKYOU.text: Vielen Dank, dass du Crusaders Quest spielst.

TEXT_TIP_WEAPON_3.text: Du kannst Optionen normaler Waffen nicht umwandeln.

Resistance is meaningless
to this opponent!

TEXT_WR_ANCIENT_ANNOUNCER_HANZO.text:
You should never look down 
on the newspaper delivery boy!

TEXT_WR_ANCIENT_ANNOUNCER_KANO.text: For song and dance, love and justice!

This opponent

Length of chain that affects

TEXT_WR_DG_ACCEL_SPEED.text:
Oh no! Magic overload...!
Look out for side effects!

TEXT_WR_DG_ACCEL_SPEED_INIT.text:
The battle begins amidst
time acceleration magic!

TEXT_WR_DG_BUGLC_LOGIC_0001.text: Woohoo! Let's contaminate all the machines!

TEXT_WR_DG_BUGLC_MOVE_SPEED_DOWN_0001.text: Ugh, these bugs are so annoying… Don't stop now!

TEXT_WR_DG_BUGLC_SAVE_DEVELOPER_0001.text: Wait, that's… Let's go. This isn't the time for standing around!

TEXT_WR_DG_BUGLC_SAVE_DEVELOPER_SUCCESS.text: This guy's keen on escaping, huh? Thanks to him, your block generation speed has been increased.

TEXT_WR_DG_BUGLC_SPEED_DOWN_0001.text: Hmm, time's slowing down… Use my power. It should help.

TEXT_WR_DG_RWBY_RUN_FAIL.text: I should be leaving now. Ciao!

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_CHRONOS.text: Blizzards. Do not panic and use my power.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_DESERT.text:
Puh, noch einer!?
Nicht mit mir.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_DOG.text:
Pass auf, ein Blizzard!
Schnell, setze meine Macht ein!

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_FOREST.text:
Ein Sturm braut sich zusammen.
Benutze die Macht der Göttin!

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
A snowstorm is approaching. 
Let my powers help you.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
A snowstorm approaches. 
Let my powers help you.

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Hmpf. Ein Schneegestöber!
Setze meine Macht ein, wenn du sie brauchst!

TEXT_WR_EP5_BLIZZARD_SIS_WINTER.text:
Ein ziemlich heftiger Schneesturm.
Keine Panik, setze einfach meine Macht ein.

TEXT_WR_EP7_DIONNE_BOSS_DIONNE.text:
Kukuku... You rotting piece trash! 
Fight to your deaths! Kukuku!

TEXT_WR_EP7_DIONNE_BOSS_DIONNE_NOFACE.text: A forboding gloom enfolds the enemy.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_BOSS_ELTALOS.text: Here all light shall be quenched.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
My abilities are being repressed, 
but they shall return before long. Fear not.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_DESERT.text:
What? My powers aren't working! 
T-time out!

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_DOG.text:
I...I think I spent all my powers. 
Whew...

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_FOREST.text:
... My powers are not returning. 
Is it possible to rest a little?

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_SEA.text:
... That being... 
has swallowed my powers...

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
The void has swallowed the light... 
Yet it shall surely return.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
The void has swallowed the light... 
Yet fear not, it shall return.

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
I-I'm just a bit tired! 
Protect me in the meantime!

TEXT_WR_EP7_EL_SIS_WINTER.text:
A worthy foe, to have stolen my powers. 
Wait... they will return!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
No SP? I see.
Let us calmly see to the situation.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_DESERT.text:
Woah?! What's this?
Our SP isn't recharging!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_DOG.text:
The SP isn't recharging at all!
What's happening?!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_FOREST.text:
It is true we cannot obtain SP,
but don't be afraid.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_SEA.text:
...This darkness. It's
keeping us from gaining SP.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
We shall not be able to obtain SP
before this darkness passes.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDD.text:
We shall not be able to obtain SP
before this darkness passes.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Hmmph. The SP isn't recharging!
Maybe it's due to this darkness...

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_HARD_SIS_WINTER.text:
Oho, our SP has been sealed off, I see.
Yet we shall not fall back!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Fear not. 
1-chain and 3-chain attacks generate SP.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_DOG.text: Eh? Using 2-chains won't fill up our SP!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_FOREST.text: Only 1-chain and 3-chain attacks will generate SP.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_SEA.text:
... You can only earn SP 
through 1-chain or 3-chains here...

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
To earn SP you must use 
1- or 3-chain attacks.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
To earn SP you must use 
1- or 3-chain attacks.

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
If you want SP, 
you'll need to use 1-chain or 3-chains!

TEXT_WR_EP7_HELLAD_SIS_WINTER.text:
So 2-chains do not generate SP. 
An interesting ability indeed!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Use my powers.
This heat could be used to our advantage.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ooh, hot.
But my powers are stronger!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_DOG.text:
Ouch, hot! 
But I can block it with my powers!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_FOREST.text:
Oh, what a fiery wind.
Use my powers; I shall block it for you.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_SEA.text:
... This hot wind is uncomfortable.
Use my powers... I'll cool us down.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
This… volcanic wind…? 
Use my powers. It may come in handy.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_SILUNIS_HI.text:
This… volcanic wind…? 
Use my powers. It may come in handy.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Use my powers. I'll show you
the real goddess of the volcano!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_FIRE_WIND_SIS_WINTER.text:
Ha, what a pitiful attack with hot air!
I can just blow it away no problem.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_HIDDEN_BOSS.text:
Will cutting down that revenant give me answers?
Then I shall burn it with my flames!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_HIDDEN_START.text:
A mysterious power seeps out from the ring...
Perhaps it has something to do with the spirit we just saw.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
... Ensnared by the vines, I see.
Break free by rapidly using blocks.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ugh! I can't move anymore!
Let's escape by rapid firing blocks!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_DOG.text:
We're trapped!
Press the blocks quickly to escape!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_FOREST.text:
Oh dear, we're trapped. It is alright though;
will you try pressing your blocks?

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_SEA.text:
... We can't move...
Let's try using a bunch of blocks...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
These vines are trapping us.
Press blocks in succession to escape.

These vines are trapping us.
Press blocks in succession to escape.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
These insolent vines! Tying us up!
Quick! Use your blocks!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_3_SIS_WINTER.text:
Hahaha! We're trapped... interesting.
But there's no time for this. Press the blocks.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
These are not normal plants.
I feel something ominous about them, be careful.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ah! Something's grabbing my feet!
These vines are so gross!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_DOG.text:
Huh? There's something wriggly...
These vines are giving me the creeps...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_FOREST.text:
These are mischievous vines,
to be clutching my feet like this.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_SEA.text:
... How rude,
you should be careful of these vines...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
These vines do not mean well.
Be careful where you step.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_SILUNIS_H.text:
These vines do not mean well.
Be careful where you step.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
What are these annoying things?
Ha, they have some nerve, grabbing me!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_PLANT_SIS_WINTER.text:
Grabbing ME? These plants have nerve!
These are worth keeping an eye on!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Stop flailing about in such an disgraceful manner.
I can release you from the binds.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_DESERT.text:
Ugh, it's hard to move in this rain.
Let's get through with my powers!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_DOG.text:
It's cold and sludgy…
Use my power to shake it off!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_FOREST.text:
Rain is good for plants, but not now.
Won't you try using my powers?

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_SEA.text:
... Water is good, but this rain...
I'll make it stop with my powers...

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_SILUNIS.text:
This rain binds the feet.
It can be washed away with the power of light.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_SILUNIS_HIDDEN.text:
This rain binds the feet.
It can be washed away with the power of light.

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_VOLCANO.text:
Mere rain won't extinguish me.
I'll burn it up with my powers!

TEXT_WR_KURENAI_RAIN_SIS_WINTER.text:
Impediments, tsk.
Let me give you a hand.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
The torch might go out.
Protect the torch with my power.

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_DESERT.text:
Gee! It's icy!
Use my power to fire up!

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_DOG.text:
Oops! Such cold rain!
I will protect the torch from the rain with my power!

TEXT_WR_OLYMPIC_RAIN_SIS_FOREST.text:
Rain helps trees grow,
but puts fire out. Please use my power.

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_COLD_03_TITLE.text: Don't get cold feet for our winter hunting trip!

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_COLD_04_TITLE.text: Time for some more last-minute hunting!

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_COLD_05_TITLE.text: The best fights are snowball fights!

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_COLD_06_TITLE.text: Is it just cold, or am I getting shivers up my spine?

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_COLD_07_TITLE.text: Winter fishing is the coolest, brr!

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_COLD_08_TITLE.text: Spend a warm winter with a friend.

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_SPRING_02_TITLE.text: It's a little chilly, but I can feel spring in the air!

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_SPRING_03_TITLE.text: Even Sacred Beings need some fresh air now and then.

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_SPRING_04_TITLE.text: Let's go on a short walk!

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_SPRING_05_TITLE.text: Some exercise will warm you up!

TEXT_202002_LIMIT_QUEST_SPRING_06_TITLE.text: How about a stroll into the unknown?

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_01_TITLE.text: Did you enjoy the spring picnic?

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_02_TITLE.text: Did you remember to finish everything you needed to do?

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_03_TITLE.text: Are you ready to embark on our spring picnic?

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_04_TITLE.text: It's not a picnic without a friend by your side!

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_05_TITLE.text: Captain! Don't forget your picnic basket!

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_06_TITLE.text: Picnic? I don't mind wherever we go!

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_07_TITLE.text: Come on, we have to find the perfect picnic spot!

TEXT_202004_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_08_TITLE.text: Let's go on a treasure hunt!

TEXT_202005_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0001_TITL.text: You're now an Eto Ranger too!

TEXT_202005_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0002_GOAL.text: Clear Little Match Fire Axe Girl - 1

TEXT_202005_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0003_GOAL.text: Clear Little Match Fire Axe Girl - 2

TEXT_202005_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0003_TITL.text: My beard will burn off at this rate

TEXT_202005_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0004_TITL.text: Could this be another form of love?

TEXT_202005_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0005_TITL.text: We must stop the forces of evil.

TEXT_202005_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0006_TITL.text: Equipment maintenance is basic stuff, Nyorori

TEXT_202006_LIMIT_QUEST_CAMPING_02_TITLE.text: What lovely weather to go outside!

TEXT_202006_LIMIT_QUEST_CAMPING_04_TITLE.text: We could tell ghost stories at night!

TEXT_202006_LIMIT_QUEST_CAMPING_05_TITLE.text: Camping is more enjoyable with friends.

TEXT_202006_LIMIT_QUEST_CAMPING_06_TITLE.text: Nothing tastes better than food cooked over a campfire!

TEXT_202006_LIMIT_QUEST_CAMPING_07_TITLE.text: Do you want to play a game together?

TEXT_202006_LIMIT_QUEST_CAMPING_08_TITLE.text: Let's go on an adventure near the camping grounds!

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_01_TITLE.text: Awesome! We're ready for summer now!

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_02_TITLE.text: Don't let the heat beat you! Let's move it!

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_03_TITLE.text: Let's go look for a cool shade!

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_04_TITLE.text: Sweat out the heat and you'll feel much lighter!

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_05_TITLE.text: Stay with me, and I'll make it cooler for you...

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_06_TITLE.text: The hot weather is nothing compared to the heat of my oven!

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_07_TITLE.text: The weather is no excuse to procrastinate!

TEXT_202007_LIMIT_QUEST_HOT_08_TITLE.text: Maybe there's a place we can cool off somewhere nearby.

TEXT_202009_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0003_TITL.text: We Need to Put Out the Fire!

TEXT_202009_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0004_TITL.text: I Don't Know Why But I Hate That Guy!

TEXT_202009_LIMIT_QUEST_EVENT_Q0005_TITL.text: I'll Save You No Matter What!

TEXT_202010_LIMIT_QUEST_HALLOWEEN_01_TIT.text: How was the Pumpkin City Festival?

TEXT_202010_LIMIT_QUEST_HALLOWEEN_03_TIT.text: Have a taste of this spicy candy - hellfire for your tongue!

TEXT_202010_LIMIT_QUEST_HALLOWEEN_04_TIT.text: Let's dress up as a spooky ghost!

TEXT_202010_LIMIT_QUEST_HALLOWEEN_05_TIT.text: You sure know how to party!

TEXT_202010_LIMIT_QUEST_HALLOWEEN_06_TIT.text: Let's sneak up behind them! BOO!

TEXT_202010_LIMIT_QUEST_HALLOWEEN_07_TIT.text: Will you help me pass out these fliers for the festival?

TEXT_202012_LIMIT_QUEST_XMAS_01_TITLE.text: I wish you a merry Christmas, Captain.

TEXT_202012_LIMIT_QUEST_XMAS_04_TITLE.text: Snow fight! Oh, and don't forget your presents from Santa!

TEXT_202012_LIMIT_QUEST_XMAS_05_TITLE.text: It's the most wonderful time of the year - to be with your friends!

TEXT_202012_LIMIT_QUEST_XMAS_06_TITLE.text: No Christmas is complete without a Christmas cake!

TEXT_202012_LIMIT_QUEST_XMAS_07_TITLE.text: We mustn't let our guard down, even on holidays.

TEXT_202012_LIMIT_QUEST_XMAS_08_TITLE.text: Will Santa Claus come with presents tonight?

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_01_TITLE.text: We wish you a warm winter.

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_02_TITLE.text: Help the Heroes shovel snow from the streets!

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_03_TITLE.text: A good training session will get the blood flowing through your body.

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_04_TITLE.text: We'll help you clear all the snow and ice!

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_05_TITLE.text: Let's warm up by the fire.

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_06_TITLE.text: Someone, somewhere, will be in need of our help.

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_07_TITLE.text: We must find the cause of the avalanche!

TEXT_202101_LIMIT_QUEST_WINTER_08_TITLE.text: Will you help me collect the materials for a scarf?

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_01_TITLE.text: I wish you a happy new year, Captain. Here's to another great year.

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_02_TITLE.text:
A fresh breeze comes from the valleys to the east.
... I mean to say... May the new year bring good fortune.

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_03_TITLE.text: Some light exercise will prepare us for new beginnings!

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_04_TITLE.text: The cold won't hold us back! Let's go!

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_05_TITLE.text: It's the beginning of another year! Why don't we send our friends our greetings?

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_06_TITLE.text:
There's nothing like warm tteok on New Year.
... Huh? This isn't tteok?

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_07_TITLE.text: Let's continue growing into the new year with renewed vigor!

TEXT_202102_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_08_TITLE.text: A fitting place to train for fresh beginnings.

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_01_TITLE.text: Thank you for helping to preserve the beautiful nature of Hasla.

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_02_TITLE.text: Even in the arid desert, flowers bloom!

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_03_TITLE.text: We must always take care to protect the forest.

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_04_TITLE.text: You'll be hungry after all that hard work.

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_05_TITLE.text: Let's go plant a tree together.

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_06_TITLE.text: We need more trees if we want to protect our mountains.

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_07_TITLE.text: I want to go plant trees, too!

TEXT_202104_LIMIT_QUEST_TREE_08_TITLE.text: Plants purify the air. Take a deep breath!

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_01_TITLE.text: I hope to continue learning for many days to come.

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_02_TITLE.text: I hear Master's traces remain. Let's check them out!

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_03_TITLE.text: I sense that someone will pay me a visit soon... Hrrmph. I better get ready.

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_04_TITLE.text: One must keep diligent to provide a good example for students.

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_05_TITLE.text: How about this tasty donut gift box to show your teacher some love and appreciation?

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_06_TITLE.text: Send your friends and teachers greetings long overdue!

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_07_TITLE.text: I want to show everyone how much I've grown!

TEXT_202105_LIMIT_QUEST_TEACHER_08_TITLE.text: Let's make some preparations before visiting our mentor.

TEXT_202106_LIMIT_QUEST_SEA_03_TITLE.text: Don't forget to warm up before going in the water!

TEXT_202106_LIMIT_QUEST_SEA_04_TITLE.text: I'll take you on a tour under the sea!

TEXT_202106_LIMIT_QUEST_SEA_05_TITLE.text: A warm donut will fill you up after your swim!

TEXT_202106_LIMIT_QUEST_SEA_06_TITLE.text: This territory's under my watch - the 'Elder Sister' of the sea!

TEXT_202106_LIMIT_QUEST_SEA_07_TITLE.text: ... I actually don't know how to swim. Will you teach me?

TEXT_202106_LIMIT_QUEST_SEA_08_TITLE.text: I feel a little self-conscious in my swimsuit.

TEXT_202107_LIMIT_QUEST_RANGER_01_TITLE.text: The guardians of peace who burn their hearts for justice. Let's go, Gacha Rangers!

TEXT_202107_LIMIT_QUEST_RANGER_04_TITLE.text: Okay, okay. See you next time!

TEXT_202107_LIMIT_QUEST_RANGER_05_TITLE.text: Heh… What's so great about this donut. (Yummy!)

TEXT_202107_LIMIT_QUEST_RANGER_06_TITLE.text: Oh, there's still work to do!

TEXT_202107_LIMIT_QUEST_RANGER_08_TITLE.text: The darkness within me is about to go wild again.

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_01_TIT.text: What! They warned me it was a flowery giant, but it was only a pretty sunflower!

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_02_TIT.text: Incredible! A flower that grows to this size even without the help of magic...!

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_03_TIT.text: When I reopen my flower shop one day, I'll sell sunflowers at 1000 Gold each. They're big, so they're worth the price!

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_04_TIT.text: A flower of the sun, as the legends have it... A Hero, somewhere in Hasla, may share its powers.

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_05_TIT.text: Yellow petals like sunshine... This flower radiates a cheery warmth.

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_06_TIT.text: The golden glint of a field full of sunflowers is different from that of a wheat field.

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_07_TIT.text: 'Some of the most potent love potions are concocted with sunflower petals.' Ooh, interesting.

TEXT_202108_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNFLOWER_08_TIT.text: Filling up the orchard with sunflowers may rob other berries of their proper share of sunlight!

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_01_TI.text: Well done, especially in this hot weather.

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_02_TI.text: The sea breeze is cool on my skin...

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_03_TI.text: The late summer heat can't do much harm under the sea!

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_04_TI.text: A little bit of hot weather means nothing to me!

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_05_TI.text: Reading a book in the cool retreat of one's home sounds relaxing.

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_06_TI.text: I'll stay in my kitchen and stand the heat!

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_07_TI.text: Say hello to your friends before summer is over!

TEXT_202109_LIMIT_QUEST_LATESUMMER_08_TI.text: I want to go outside and bask in the sun!

TEXT_202110_LIMIT_QUEST_AUTUMN_01_TITLE.text: This is fine weather to go on a stroll.

TEXT_202110_LIMIT_QUEST_AUTUMN_02_TITLE.text: Let's go hiking among the autumn colors!

TEXT_202110_LIMIT_QUEST_AUTUMN_03_TITLE.text: Autumn's the best season to have your nose in a book!

TEXT_202110_LIMIT_QUEST_AUTUMN_04_TITLE.text: The leaves are red as the embers of my furnace!

TEXT_202110_LIMIT_QUEST_AUTUMN_05_TITLE.text: Here's a delicious snack to munch on under the falling leaves!

TEXT_202110_LIMIT_QUEST_AUTUMN_06_TITLE.text: I love the green of spring and summer, but fall is pretty, too!

TEXT_202110_LIMIT_QUEST_AUTUMN_08_TITLE.text: The autumn colors festival seems very popular!

TEXT_202111_LIMIT_QUEST_BEARS_01_TITLE.text: Be careful; there are bears about.

TEXT_202111_LIMIT_QUEST_BEARS_02_TITLE.text: I saw a huge bear in the mountains!

TEXT_202111_LIMIT_QUEST_BEARS_03_TITLE.text: If I could catch a bear for research...

TEXT_202111_LIMIT_QUEST_BEARS_04_TITLE.text: We can't rest now! We need to be ready for those bears!

TEXT_202111_LIMIT_QUEST_BEARS_05_TITLE.text: There are rumors of bears running rampant in the dungeons.

TEXT_202111_LIMIT_QUEST_BEARS_06_TITLE.text: I only hope that the people keep safe from those bears.

TEXT_202111_LIMIT_QUEST_BEARS_08_TITLE.text: I won't be able to make my deliveries in time with bears around!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_COLDWAVE_01_TITL.text: Hold on a little longer and spring will come!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_COLDWAVE_02_TITL.text: Warmer days will arrive very soon!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_COLDWAVE_03_TITL.text: I wish everyone a warm and cozy winter.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_COLDWAVE_04_TITL.text: It's not winter without a proper snowball fight!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_COLDWAVE_05_TITL.text: Eat well, even if - or rather, especially if the weather is cold!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_COLDWAVE_06_TITL.text: A Hero must overcome this cold, methinks.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_COLDWAVE_08_TITL.text: Soon the ice will melt, and the river will flow again.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_01_TITLE.text: Happy New Year! I wish you the best in all your endeavors.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_02_TITLE.text: May your New Year be filled with love and joy.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_03_TITLE.text: I hope everyone finds happiness this year.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_04_TITLE.text: I aspire to read different kinds of books this year.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_05_TITLE.text: I baked some bread out of tteok to celebrate the New Year!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_06_TITLE.text: Another year has already flown by! Let's train harder!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_07_TITLE.text: I hear this year is the Year of the Tiger.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_NEWYEAR_08_TITLE.text: You have to eat tteokguk on New Year's Day to get a year older!

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_01_TITLE.text: If you have a special someone, why not confess your feelings?

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_02_TITLE.text: Oh? There's love in the air this week!

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_03_TITLE.text: Do you wish to know more about that person you're interested in?

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_04_TITLE.text:
All's fair in love and war!
Defeat any competition and claim your love like a true warrior!

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_05_TITLE.text:
Eating chocolate is said to induce feelings of love.
Is that why my heart is pounding...?

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_06_TITLE.text: Keep in mind that you can't force your feelings onto another.

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_07_TITLE.text:
If you cannot forget someone, no matter how much time passes...
Was it love that I felt?

TEXT_202202_LIMIT_QUEST_GOBACK_08_TITLE.text: This gift will win her over in no time!

TEXT_202203_LIMIT_QUEST_RESTART_01_TITLE.text: Spring... The season during which deer ramble among the budding trees.

TEXT_202203_LIMIT_QUEST_RESTART_02_TITLE.text: A new season, a fresh start.

TEXT_202203_LIMIT_QUEST_RESTART_03_TITLE.text: Let's all go pick spring flowers!

TEXT_202203_LIMIT_QUEST_RESTART_04_TITLE.text: Through the pine forest the wind carries the first seeds of spring.

TEXT_202203_LIMIT_QUEST_RESTART_05_TITLE.text: Forget your problems and let's dance!

TEXT_202203_LIMIT_QUEST_RESTART_07_TITLE.text: I will redeem myself, like the blossoms that return every spring.

TEXT_202203_LIMIT_QUEST_RESTART_08_TITLE.text: These colorful flowers resemble flames reborn of embers!

TEXT_CHAMP_CHEN_DESC.text: Lu Dongbin und He Xiangu werden von Chens Meister, dem Ewigen Heiligen, ausgebildet, um selbst Ewige Heilige zu werden. He Xiangu ist die ältere von beiden und hat Lu Dongbin zu ihrem Meister gebracht, nachdem sie sein Potenzial entdeckt hatte, ein Ewiger Heiliger zu werden. Doch trotz ihrer langen Ausbildung scheitern sie immer wieder an der letzten Weisheitsprüfung und bleiben „halbe Heilige“. Der Meister der Ewigen Heiligen lehrt Lu Dongbin und He Xiangu das Go-Spiel, um sie auf ihrem Pfad anzuleiten, doch die beiden Schüler verstehen nicht, was ihr Meister meint: Lu Dongbin erträgt Niederlagen nicht, und He Xiangu kann sich nie überwinden, auch nur einen Stein zu opfern. Der Meister der Ewigen Heiligen fordert seine Schüler schließlich auf, andere Go-Meister aufzusuchen, in der Hoffnung, dass sie schließlich Erleuchtung erlangen. Im Land Chen beginnen die beide eine gnadenlose Siegessträhne, Lu Dongbin und He Xiangu gewinnen eine Go-Partie nach der anderen. In ihrem Stolz auf ihre zahllosen Siege hören sie Gerüchte über einen Experten namens Hanseung und fordern ihn sofort heraus. Die Partie zwischen den beiden Heiligen und Hanseung dauert drei Tage und drei Nächte, und doch kann keiner den Sieg erringen. Als Lu Dongbin und He Xiangu, beeindruckt, wie sie sind, Hanseung danach fragen, wie ein „gewöhnlicher Mensch“ so gut Go spielen kann, fordert der weise Krieger sie auf, in die Heldenstadt zu gehen. Dort würden sie ihre Antwort finden.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_11_DESC.text: Die ultimative Vogelscheuche. Warum soll man stillsitzen, während man Vögel verscheucht, wenn man sie genauso gut abschießen kann? … Aus offensichtlichen Gründen wurde dieses Modell nach seiner Markteinführung wieder verboten.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_12_DESC.text: A youth who was bitten by an ancient spider within the depths of the Temple of Illusions. A short time afterwards, he feels his body changing under the effect of some mysterious power. It seems that his hairstyle has gone through the most radical change.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_13_DESC.text: The Watchman works day and night for the peace and safety of Nosgard. Even on the coldest nights, he volunteers for three shifts so that he can keep monsters from invading his home.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_14_DESC.text: An industrial spy hired by Rapture Science to gain confidential information from Road Industry. He's busy trying to persuade an essential developer to join their side.

TEXT_CHA_AR_1_15_DESC.text: A golden monkey that lives in the mountains between the border of Chen and Han. He has left his home in search of a new one when it was threatened by the forest fires.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_15_DESC.text: Ein früherer Soldat, der sich als Bogenschütze selbstständig machte, nachdem er entdeckt hatte, wie streng es beim Militär zugeht. Seit einem unerklärlichen Unfall ist der von einem Geist besessen, sehr zum Ärger seines Partners.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_16_DESC.text: A rather forgettable man who volunteered for an experiment in the Temple in hopes of boosting his nonexistent charisma. Although he is initially disappointed due to being forgotten by the scientists conducting the studies, the opportunity gives him insight into the terrible truth of the experiments. For the first time in his life, he feels grateful for being unseen.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_17_DESC.text: It's taken some time, but this lumberjack has grown used to surviving in the harsh environment of Nosgard. It seems he has grown better with his bow than his axe in the process.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_18_DESC.text: A spy hired by Road Industry to steal technology from Rapture Science. Due to some errors in the paperwork, she has been sent to a completely irrelevant place and hasn't escaped ever since. She believes that an unremarkable presence is the key to good survival.

TEXT_CHA_AR_2_19_DESC.text: The pride of Han, the archers. The warriors of Han have been known historically for being talented archers. Only the top of the top elites can join the archers.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_17_DESC.text: Der ursprüngliche und grammatikalisch korrekte Name wäre „flammende Ninjas“, aber anscheinend wollte sie unbedingt den „stürmischen Ninjas“ Konkurrenz machen.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_18_DESC.text: An architect whose dream is to build the highest tower in the continent of Hasla so that he can reach the heavens.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_19_DESC.text: This soldier is considered the black sheep of the Einherjar, who deem strength and honor above all else and think range weapons rather cowardly. She still received a prestigious award from Freyja for inventing the ballista.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_20_DESC.text: A former soldier of Neth Empire discharged from service. He's used to fighting with rifles, so he was a little flustered after being assigned a bow and arrows at the recent Reserve Forces training sessions. At least he'll be let off early if he does his best.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_21_DESC.text: A dancer from the palace of Chen. She seems to admire the principal dancer, Lee. Her goal is to be the next principal dancer.

TEXT_CHA_AR_3_HANI_DESC.text: A girl come to enjoy the celebrations. Her baseball cap with the eye-catching letter 'G' was a prize she won from the annual Yut Nori games.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_22_DESC.text: Eine Hexe, die sich in einer Kirche von einem Detektiv versteckt hält, der sie wegen angeblichem Diebstahl sucht. Trotz ihres eher schlecht sitzenden Nonnenkostüm, kann sie mit ihrer überzeugenden Art das Vertrauen der Bürger gewinnen. Vielleicht war sie zu überzeugend, tatsächlich ist es Genevie nicht möglich, die Stadt zu verlassen.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_23_DESC.text: Tief in den Bergen von Chen, in die sich kein menschlicher Reisender wagt, lebt ein friedlicher Pandastamm. Trotz ihrer sanften Natur haben die Pandas ein großes Problem: Seit Jahrzehnten werden keine neuen Kinder geboren. Als es schließlich doch soweit war, feierte das gesamte Dorf. Panpan entdeckt jedoch bald, dass sein Kind unter einer Krankheit leidet, die sein Wachstum verlangsamt.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_24_DESC.text: The daughter of a hunter living near the border of the Roman Republic. After being bitten by a strange-looking spider, Arachne finds herself able to understand the spider language. Hunter by blood, Arachne quickly applies her newly discovered skills by asking spiders to create webs to use as traps or lend her spider venom for hunting. Yet Arachne discovers a downside to her gift: fine hair and spikes begin protruding all over her face and body, which she covers up in her cloak.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_25_DESC.text: Lindsey and her engineer father aren't met with too warm a welcome when they immigrate to the kingdom of Trista. Tired of the widespread prejudice towards "the outsiders," the young Lindsey vows to become the greatest sheriff to ever protect the boundaries of Trista - and break the binds of discrimination that continue to taunt her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_26_DESC.text: A young girl who lost her parents in a shipwreck. After washing up on a small, quiet beach, she is miraculously rescued by an elderly couple. The kind-hearted couple take the girl to their home and name her 'Haerang' after her hair, which has the color of the clearest ocean.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_28_DESC.text: A young girl of the Woopa Tribe. Childhood friends Malkah and Mamba had promised to get married when they grew up, and Malkah can't wait for that special day! But when the Primal Volcano erupts and threatens to consume the village, Mamba runs away and does not return. Malkah, hurt and angry that Mamba would abandon her, considers chasing after Mamba, but decides to stay and help her people.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_29_DESC.text: Born in a poor country household, Ran was sold as a young child to mercenaries and was forced to fight on the battlefield of a foreign land. It is not such a bad deal for her family, or the mercenaries themselves: if she dies, there will be one less mouth to feed, and if she returns alive, they will profit in either money or the spoils of war. The strong warriors of Nosgard may boast and laugh of glorious feats and honor in battle, but such ideals are nothing more than pure luxury for Ran, for whom war only means a grim encounter with death. Instead, Ran chooses to fight by melting into the shadows and cutting the throats of her enemies under the veil of the dark. The other warriors criticize Ran for her 'cowardice,' calling her an embarrassment, but the one who laughs last laughs the longest: Ran, decades later, remains the sole survivor of countless battles.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_30_DESC.text: The eldest daughter of a fallen noble household, Aurea must resort to selling wood chips to look after her ailing parents. Yet hope rekindles in her heart when she starts receiving donations from an anonymous benefactor. Aurea vows to become someone worthy of this immense kindness and devotes herself to her studies.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_31_DESC.text: Meleager is the son of Ares, a powerful senator of the Olympian Council in the Roman Republic. Having excelled in hunting from his childhood, Meleager anticipates an easy victory in his first competition. However, contrary to his own and everyone else’s expectations, the young hunter comes in second place for the first time in his life. The victor of the hunt is instead a common girl named Atalante. After the day of his crushing blow, Meleager continuously challenges Atalante to another game, but no matter how hard he tries, he loses every time.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_32_DESC.text: A girl living in the slums on the outskirts of Neth Empire. Miel’s nimble physique and dexterity make her an invaluable member of the Scrappy Gang. Their bleak surroundings do not stop Miel and her comrades from enjoying their days renovating broken machines and watching broadcasts from abandoned TV sets – until one day, war breaks out.

TEXT_CHA_AR_4_33_DESC.text: Born on a farm in the countryside, Iris is found to be gifted with magic and sent to the Magic Academy in Pumpkin City. As her family cannot afford the high tuition, Iris begins to work part-time at the witch’s delivery service, like many other young witches. Iris soon discovers that she has a problem, however: her awkwardness knows no bounds, and she has no physical ability whatsoever to the extent that she cannot maintain her balance on her broomstick for more than a few seconds. Despite the other witches’ mockery of her clumsiness, Iris continues to earnestly work at her job. One day, a fellow delivery witch named Arche, feeling rather sorry for the hardworking girl, advises her to pioneer a different path that can fully utilize her true talent. Iris takes the advice to heart and ruminates on her future, until a brilliant idea comes to her.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_22_DESC.text: Die friedliche, kleine Stadt erweist sich für Genevie als recht langweilig. Sie entscheidet sich als Zeitvertreib, das Bogenschießen zu erlernen. Allerdings stellt sich heraus, dass sie (Gelinde gesagt) nicht recht gut mit dem Bogen umgehen kann. Was auch den Kindern des Dorfes nicht entgangen ist, die sie deswegen schonungslos necken. Eines Tages aber, landen alle Pfeile von Genevie genau im Schwarzen, was alle überrascht. Es stellt sich heraus, dass sie ihre Pfeile mit Zauber lenken kann. Die Tage gehen lethargisch weiter, bis zu einem schicksalhaften Tag, an dem Monster die Stadt angreifen.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_23_DESC.text: In der Hoffnung, seinen Sohn zu heilen, betet Panpan Tag und Nacht im Bambuswald. Eines Tages erscheinen zwei ätherische Wesen vor ihm, die Go spielen, und von seiner Hingabe berührt sind. Sie erzählen ihm, dass aus der Leber eines Hasen gewonnene Medizin seinen Sohn heilen kann. Panpan bricht sofort auf, um einen Hasen zu erlegen.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_24_DESC.text: Arachne finds her strange bond with spiders growing stronger as time passes. The "curse" affecting her body becomes more prominent as well, and Arachne flees from the village so no one can find her. It is only after Athena, hearing the rumors of a strange hunter who can speak to spiders, summons her that Arachne hesitatingly steps out from her seclusion.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_25_DESC.text: It is with sheer determination that Lindsey finally earns the sheriff's badge amidst continuous jeers and taunts. Even after Lindsey becomes a sheriff, only a handful recognize her courage and resolve, others dismissing her as a mere foreigner. Lindsey finally gives in to despair when even her colleagues begin to ostracize her from their daily routines. Despite the dissuasions of her few friends, Lindsey turns in her sheriff's badge and heads back home.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_26_DESC.text: Under the care of the elderly couple, whom she now calls her parents, Haerang grows up into a young woman and starts picking shells and mollusks to provide for her home. One fateful day, Haerang sees in the ocean a strange shell with a bluish pearl inside. Her fingers instinctively reach out for the shell...

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_28_DESC.text: Malkah fights against the chaos that has engulfed the village to help return peace and order to her people. Chief Woopa lauds her leadership and skills and appoints her as the new Warchief of the tribe. Malkah, now burdened with new responsibilities, remains in the village and waits, polishing her weapon. One day, Mamba will return... And that's when she will have her revenge.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_29_DESC.text: Despite the other warriors' initial disapproval of her methods, it is Ran's deadly assassinations of important enemy figures that manage to turn the tide of war in every battle. The mercenary band to which the assassin belongs grows more and more famous with every victory she brings, until they increase multiple times their original size. Yet the mercenary captain, fearful that Ran's existence will bring danger to them in the end, secretly attempts to kill her. Ran only barely manages to escape. A fateful blizzard erases her tracks and Ran manages to thwart her pursuers, but her near-fatal wound hinders her steps until she finds she cannot go any further before the cold-hearted winter winds. Before she grows unconscious, the last thing she sees is a black crow with a face of ivory white approaching her with soft, gentle steps.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_30_DESC.text: After years of effort, Aurea becomes the youngest member in Elvish history to join the Golden Archers. Her talents are promptly acknowledged, and she soon becomes appointed as Magnus’s Vice Captain. Aurea worries over her new promotion as her Captain is known to discriminate those outside nobility. She quickly realizes, however, that the rumors are false, and Magnus appreciates her worth for what it is, regardless of her past.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_31_DESC.text: How can he win? As Meleager sulks over his endless series of defeats, a mysterious woman furtively approaches the young hunter. She asserts that it is against “the natural order” that a noble should lose to a lowly commoner, and passes to him ‘Salamander,’ a fire spirit. The Salamander, only visible to Meleager, infuses the hunter’s arrows with explosive flames that accelerate, strengthen, and correct his shots. Meleager signs up for the next hunt with newfound confidence.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_32_DESC.text: Even the slums could not escape the flames of war. As days of chaos and disorder continue, the members of the Scrappy Gang disband and scatter. With the whereabouts of her best friends now unknown, Miel joins the revolutionary army instead. She recalls all the TV broadcasts that she has watched with her friends and develops a type of explosive arrow with the knowledge and skills she has accumulated throughout the years. Miel’s arrows are found to be suitable for attacking the mechanical weaponry of the Neth Army, and Miel herself wins many a battle from the rear with her excellent sniping skills.

TEXT_CHA_AR_5_33_DESC.text: Iris turns her attention to the magic portals that are controlled by each nation for transport. What if people could use the portals not only for travel, but also for commerce—for delivering cargo around the world? Teleport magic, an advanced form of magic that required enormous power and so could only be activated by tapping into the ley lines of the continent, could be simplified by narrowing its target. Through inherent talent, perseverance, and – more than anything – thinking outside the box, Iris succeeds in teleporting small parcels through downsized portals. When she visits Arche to thank her for her advice, the other witch recognizes the massive potential in Iris’s magic and proposes that they start a new delivery service brand together. Shortly thereafter, Iris and Arche co-found the ‘Rainbow Delivery,’ which revolutionizes the logistics of Pumpkin City.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_22_DESC.text: Genevie erkennt im Monsterangriff ihre ultimative Gelegenheit zur Flucht und versucht, mitten im Aufruhr zu fliehen. Doch als sie den Schrei eines Kindes hört, das vor einem bösartigen Monster gefangen ist, muss sich Genevie zwischen dem Kind und dem Weg zu ihrer Freiheit entscheiden. Ein weiterer verzweifelter Schrei fällt die Entscheidung für sie und sie wendet sich von ihrem Fluchtweg ab, um schnell ihren Bogen zu ziehen. Als sie in die Stadt zurückkehrt ist, das Kind sicher in ihren Armen liegt und die Menschen sie bei jedem Schritt loben, erahnt sie die Folgen ihres Handelns. Wie kann sie jemals gehen, jetzt, wo sie der neue Held der Stadt ist?

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_23_DESC.text: Nachdem er auf seinen Wanderungen viele Bestien besiegt hat, hört Panpan von der Hasenprinzessin, die über einen kleinen Berg herrscht. Panpan fordert die Prinzessin zu einem Duell heraus, das nach einer Woche mit seiner bitteren Niederlage endet. Sich am Fuß des Berges wiederfindend, denkt Panpan an seinen geliebten Sohn und schwört, dass er nicht aufgeben wird, bis dieser geheilt ist.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_24_DESC.text: Athena understands the extent of Arachne's strength at a glance and asks the hunter to join her forces. Arachne, grateful for being accepted without prejudice, accepts the offer and swears to stay by Athena's side to the end. Having shed the fear that had held her back, Arachne fully turns into the Spider Queen: the deadly beauty and Athena's champion, vanquishing all foes that dare step into her web.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_25_DESC.text: Lindsey's father, having quietly watched Lindsey strive for her dream, finally gives his own advice to his beloved daughter: that the right to prove her own worth belongs to her and her alone, and that no form of prejudice can define her. Lindsey, her determination renewed by her father's words, receives the mechanical bow and explosive arrows that her father crafted just for her. She starts for the Desert by herself, and it is not long before wanted criminals begin to cower before the girl now called 'the Lone Wolf,' the renowned sheriff of Trista and a symbol of hope to everyone with a dream.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_26_DESC.text: The moment her fingers graze over the pearl within the shell, Haerang regains the memories of her past life and true identity: the Oracle of Water, the fabled guardian of the mythical seas of the East. After her previous death centuries ago, she had attempted to reincarnate with her memories intact - but had failed to do so due to the interference of one sinister being. After realizing the immense truth, Haerang runs back to the cottage by the sea to reveal the news to the elderly couple. Yet only the sight of an old, derelict house greets her, and the ocean quietly calls her name.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_28_DESC.text: Malkah grows up to become the best snake charmer in the Woopa Tribe. Having finally made peace with the fact that Mamba is never going to return, Malkah devotes her heart to the village... until Mamba returns with people from foreign lands. The bewildered Malkah, her heart beating furiously, attempts to greet Mamba, but her childhood sweetheart passes by without recognizing her. Malkah realizes that Mamba has forgotten her and their childhood promise, and she feels a new rage consuming her heart.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_29_DESC.text: A few days later, Ran regains consciousness in an old inn at Snorri Edda. She attempts to find her missing savior in order to thank him, only to hear from the innkeeper that a man in a white crow mask brought her in, tended to her wounds, and then disappeared. A freshly revived Ran also catches the news that her entire band of mercenaries, including the captain who attempted to murder her, was annihilated in the middle of a particularly difficult maneuver. Ran, complicated emotions running through her heart, finally comes to fully despise the Nosgardian warriors' self-destructive, violent desire for honor in battle. The assassin returns to the battlefield, intent on punishing those undeserving souls by bestowing upon them 'dishonorable' deaths. After crafting a white crow mask in the likeness of that of her savior's, Ran, now called the White Raven, disappears into the darkness of Snorri Edda.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_30_DESC.text: As she continues to assist Magnus in his duties, Aurea begins to feel herself attracted by Magnus’s elegance and celebrated competence. When she repeatedly witnesses her usually perfect Captain falling apart before Sigruna, Aurea becomes overwhelmed with jealousy. Yet by a twist of fate, she comes to discover that the unknown benefactor from her childhood was, in fact, Sigruna. Her mind in chaos, torn between her feelings towards Magnus and deep gratitude towards her rival, Aurea endlessly asks herself what she must do.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_31_DESC.text: The day of the hunt dawns over Roman, and Meleager easily shoots down his prey with Salamander’s aid. All seems to be going well – until a powerful blaze suddenly erupts from Salamander and engulfs everything in a scorching inferno. While Meleager, shocked by the abrupt chaos that he has invoked, struggles to restore order, Atalante triumphantly catches a lion and wins the hunt yet again. To make things worse, the furious Ares banishes Meleager after their family vaults are emptied to pay for reparations. Kicked out of his family home, lost, and deathly afraid of Salamander’s flames that grow stronger daily, Meleager decides that he must first and foremost track down the woman who gave him the fire spirit if he is to ever recover his honor.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_32_DESC.text: After the end of the war, Miel becomes a regular member of the Neth Empire Interim Government Army. Before the end of four years, another war led by the conglomerates of Neth Empire breaks out, and Miel returns to the battlefield. However, her explosive arrows prove to be no match against the enemy mechanized units recently improved with a new technology called ‘Magic Engineering.’ During her struggles in battle, Miel encounters a stranger who claims she has come from another dimension. The stranger, who for some unknown reason reminds Miel of her old friends in the Scrappy Gang, suggests some improvements to Miel’s arrows. The resulting ‘EMP arrows,’ which can silence the enemy with a single deadly shot from the shadows, become the weapon most feared by the Magic Engineering troops. A bounty is placed on Miel's head by Pursuit Commander Svenja.

TEXT_CHA_AR_6_33_DESC.text: Rainbow Delivery comes to dominate the tightknit sector of delivery services. As business expands, so too does the scope of decisions that must be made. Iris, an ordinary girl who knows not much outside her magic research, becomes overwhelmed by the ever-increasing workload. Arche sees Iris’s agitation and offers to fully manage the business, which would allow Iris to solely focus on her research. Iris gratefully accepts the deal. Then one day, after weeks and months of penning herself up in her laboratory, Iris witnesses a protest of other delivery witches outside. After Iris entrusted the business to Arche, Rainbow Delivery had effectively monopolized the delivery businesses of Pumpkin City, upsetting the fine ecosystem of businesses. Iris hurries to the Rainbow Delivery offices and searches for Arche to ask for an explanation but discovers that her former business partner has fled with all the money. At that moment, creditors besiege the office, clamoring for a return of their investments. The bewildered Iris runs away, holding only her bag of research data.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_BEARS_4_BERA_DESC.text: With the falling of autumn leaves begins the salmon run, the spawning season for salmon, in the upper reaches of the river near the southeastern borders of Nosgard. Not only is the salmon that migrate back to Nosgard abundant enough to feed all the hungry bears of the borderlands, but they are also full of selenium and other nutrients accumulated while traveling through the 'mystical seas'. The auspicious magic of the sea, coupled with copious amounts of vitamins and antioxidants in salmon, temporarily endows bears with unusually high intelligence. Bera... is NOT one of those bears who, while devouring fish after fish, became fully aware of her own self-consciousness.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_BEARS_5_BERA_DESC.text: Born with extremely high intelligence, Bera the bear considers it her responsibility to lead her pack to the southeastern river every autumn to feast on the migrating salmon. After creating a makeshift dam to obstruct the salmon’s journey, Bera cleverly lures the fish in the direction of her bear-kin with her bow and bait, expediting the other bears’ fishing. At times, she fights back humans from ‘stealing’ any of the bountiful salmon. Although she suffers injuries big and small in the process, Bera does not mind the arduous labor. If it means she can hold intelligent conversations with her temporarily smarter comrades every autumn, short as the blessing may last - then her pain is certainly worth it.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_BEARS_6_BERA_DESC.text: One ill-fated autumn, Bera fails to find any salmon swimming up the river. Scouting her surroundings, the perplexed bear soon discovers the reason of the shortage: a nefarious monster of a machine invented by ‘Beron,’ a loner who has always distanced himself from the rest of the pack. Bera, furious that Beron would hog all the salmon for his selfish wish of keeping his intelligence forever, charges at the other bear. Beron reveals himself to be no easy match, however, equipped as he is with the advanced technology of Neth Empire. Bera has no choice but to retreat for the time being… but she still succeeds in breaking into Beron’s warehouse and stealing piles of salmon for her bear-kin. From that day on, the two bears become sworn enemies, and it is said that they fight a bloody battle every year on the banks of the Nosgard River.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_ER_4_07_DESC.text: The seventh member of the Eto Rangers, Pakaracchi. Has a very active and tenacious personality. Whether it be by fighting off the Jyarei Monsters threatening Novel Worlds, or by giving courage to his friends who lack it, he protects the Novel Worlds with the rest of the Eto Rangers.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_ER_5_07_DESC.text: The seventh member of the Eto Rangers, Pakaracchi. Has a very active and tenacious personality. Whether it be by fighting off the Jyarei Monsters threatening Novel Worlds, or by giving courage to his friends who lack it, he protects the Novel Worlds with the rest of the Eto Rangers.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_ER_6_07_DESC.text: The seventh member of the Eto Rangers, Pakaracchi. Has a very active and tenacious personality. Whether it be by fighting off the Jyarei Monsters threatening Novel Worlds, or by giving courage to his friends who lack it, he protects the Novel Worlds with the rest of the Eto Rangers.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_4_ALMAEL_DESC.text: The ambitious Almael has always dreamt of leaving her quiet village to roam the wide world and achieving glorious feats to spread her name. The fairy elders, however, disdainfully scold Almael for her ingratitude to the Beast King, who long ago helped the fairy folk find a new home in the Peaks of Glory. One day, Almael comes across the Fairy Chieftain's daughter grumbling to herself, and hatches a plan to use her to escape the tedium of her small town life.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_5_ALMAEL_DESC.text: Almael succeeds in persuading Delrien to conquer the village Main Hall. As she predicted, Delrien storms out of the village, unable to suppress her anger. Almael announces to the fairy elders that she will return with Delrien and gleefully chases after her. However, she has no intention to return any time soon: instead, she will enjoy adventures of her own until she returns to reap in rewards for protecting the Chieftain's daughter. Yet when Almael visits a library in the capital of Roman, she comes to uncover an important secret concerning the fairy folk's history...

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_6_ALMAEL_DESC.text: Many years ago, fairies were declared a harmful species by the Roman Olympian Council, who feared them for their magical powers that far outweighed their small stature. It was only by the former Beast King's efforts that the fairy folk avoided mass extinction and safely relocated to the Peaks of Glory. What would humans think if a fairy suddenly appeared declaring that she would defeat the Beast King and conquer the human world? It doesn't seem so farfetched a possibility, Almael thinks, as she stops Delrien from attacking random human passerbys - especially considering the princess's ambitions. Luck has it that a human girl appears before them, calming Delrien and offering the two young fairies to take them to the Beast King. Almael now has a new mission at hand: stop Delrien from waging war with humans, and keep their fairy village safe once and for all!

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GS_4_06_DESC.text: A cheerful and skilled Silver Rank archer who loves adventure, the High Elf Archer accompanies Goblin Slayer, who is always obsessing over killing all Goblins, to teach him the true joys of adventuring. While helping Goblin Slayer defeat Goblins as usual, the party discovers a Goblin Lord and his horde of Goblins teleporting through a magical mirror to another dimension. Goblin Slayer chases after the Goblins without hesitation, and High Elf Archer has no choice but to follow him through the mirror.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GS_5_06_DESC.text: A cheerful and skilled Silver Rank archer who loves adventure, the High Elf Archer accompanies Goblin Slayer, who is always obsessing over killing all Goblins, to teach him the true joys of adventuring. While helping Goblin Slayer defeat Goblins as usual, the party discovers a Goblin Lord and his horde of Goblins teleporting through a magical mirror to another dimension. Goblin Slayer chases after the Goblins without hesitation, and High Elf Archer has no choice but to follow him through the mirror.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GS_6_06_DESC.text: A cheerful and skilled Silver Rank archer who loves adventure, the High Elf Archer accompanies Goblin Slayer, who is always obsessing over killing all Goblins, to teach him the true joys of adventuring. While helping Goblin Slayer defeat Goblins as usual, the party discovers a Goblin Lord and his horde of Goblins teleporting through a magical mirror to another dimension. Goblin Slayer chases after the Goblins without hesitation, and High Elf Archer has no choice but to follow him through the mirror.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_OT_4_05_DESC.text:
Age 23, female.
A dancer from the entertainment district of the town of Sunshade, located in the Sunlands.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_OT_4_08_DESC.text:
Age 26, female.
An unmatched hunter from the Woodlands.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_OT_5_05_DESC.text:
But in truth, she is a highborn daughter of the once-proud House Azelhart.
She has been pretending to be a dancer as a means to track certain people.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_OT_5_08_DESC.text:
Her master left home one year ago to hunt a beast known as "Redeye."

「The master only maken me worry, he never changeth. 」

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_OT_6_05_DESC.text:
「Three men bearing the mark of the crow. They took my father from me.」
Then, one day, she spots a certain man at the tavern.

TEXT_CHA_AR_LIMITED_OT_6_08_DESC.text: Then, one day, she is reunited with a monster.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_11_DESC.text: Eine Handwerkerin, die zum Zeitvertreib Spielzeugwaffen anfertigt. Sie ist so in ihr Hobby versunken, dass die beim Versuch, das beliebteste Waffenmodell perfekt nachzubauen, gar nicht merkte, dass sie eine richtige Pistole gebaut hatte …

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_12_DESC.text: A manager of the laboratory in the Temple of Illusions. Strangely enough, despite all her meticulous inspections she simply cannot find a last test subject on the list. Too bad her boss doesn't understand how hard she works.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_13_DESC.text: If you see a hunter wearing a Deerdog hat in the forests of Nosgard, you know that you have met the Legendary Hunter... Or that's how he introduces himself, anyway. The hunter boasts about his Deerdog hat to everyone he meets, claiming that it is made out of the fabled Deerdog that he caught, but no one has ever seen him actually hunting. There are rumors that the Deerdog hat is a mere replica.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_14_DESC.text: A soldier who has recently taken her first leave after joining the Neth Army a few months ago. She's indignant that the recent state of affairs in Edenberg has cut her vacation short.

TEXT_CHA_HU_1_15_DESC.text: A mysterious lady that is rumored to be the most beautiful in Chen. There's another rumor that says that she threatens passersby with a gun to spread rumors about her being beautiful.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_15_DESC.text: Ein begeisterter Fan von Vampirgeschichten. In Vollmondnächten verkleidet sie sich als Vampirjägerin (genau, wie es in ihren Büchern steht!) Und streift durch die Straßen, immer in der Hoffnung, einen Blick auf die sagenhafte Spezies zu erhaschen.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_16_DESC.text: A tomb raider who snuck in the Temple of Illusions with dreams of riches. He became stuck in the Temple after activating a hidden trap.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_17_DESC.text: An expert of ice fishing. He's looking for undiscovered species under the frozen lakes.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_18_DESC.text: A science fiction fan widely known in Neth Empire. She is obsessed with the idea of extraterresterial life - to the point that she has developed a special suit to fly in the atmosphere above Hasla, in an attempt to meet her beloved aliens.

TEXT_CHA_HU_2_19_DESC.text: President of the Ethereal Magic Academy. They don't have real research results, but they do like to get together for meals to watch the President show off his special talents.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_17_DESC.text: Ein Jäger, der alles jagt, was Geld bringt. Leute zu jagen, war ihm zu mulmig, deshalb beschloss er, einfach das Kopfgeld selbst zu jagen – deshalb sein Titel „Kopfgeldjäger“.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_18_DESC.text: A youth who roams the continent of Hasla to "overcome obstacles and become stronger." He received a serious leg injury during his travels, but tends to think of it only as a difficulty he must overcome.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_19_DESC.text: A poacher who hunts in the forests of Nosgard. He was captured for stealing a gun from the workshop of a certain Frost Elf and indulging in ruthless hunting sprees.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_20_DESC.text: One of Galatea's clones, specially selected for his dexterity and craftmanship to repair the Ark. He is very proud of his skills.

TEXT_CHA_HU_3_21_DESC.text: A bandit living in the deep valley of Taebaek Mountains. He dreamed of being a pirate, but he hated getting seasick so he became a bandit in the mountains.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_22_DESC.text: Ein Spion des Reichs Neth, der seit seiner Kindheit ausgebildet wurde. Da er als einer der besten Spione des Reiches gilt, erhält Zahard eine Geheimmission, den Palast von Chen zu überprüfen. Als gewöhnlicher Austauschstudent verkleidet zieht Zahard nach Osten.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_23_DESC.text: A natural marksman who was recruited by the Zodiac Army at an early age. When Bellerophon receives an assignment to hunt down a dragon near his hometown, he is elated that he is close to fulfilling his lifelong dream of returning as a glorious and renowned soldier to his hometown. One night, as he keeps watch over the camp, Bellerophon hears a low growl nearby - and discovers a dragon lurking in the darkness. Overcome with awe, he is unable to do anything but watch it fly into the night.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_24_DESC.text: A young man who has grown up in the slums of the Southwestern regions of Hasla. Despising the poverty that permeates his life, Jet tries his hand at every job he can get - but finds himself still destitute. One day, Jet receives advice from a self-proclaimed "bounty hunter" that bounty-hunting should be lucrative enough for his aspirations.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_25_DESC.text: Carol is used to being the best, and she prefers to keep it that way - especially when it comes to fighting with her sword and gun. Second to none, the proud Carol joins the Order of the Goddess to become the best Heaven's Cavalry in Hasla and put her gifts to good use.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_26_DESC.text: An infamous wizard hunter recruited by the Neth Empire for her keen aim and ruthless heart. When she receives orders from Road Industry to capture Sasquatch living in the snowy mountains of Nosgard, Lyudmilla does not ask any questions. But the snowy terrain proves a difficulty for the hunter, who gets trapped under an avalanche and then attacked by monsters. Struggling to keep her eyes open, the wounded Lyudmilla eventually loses consciousness.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_28_DESC.text: The only daughter of a nouveau riche family of Grancia Empire. The center of affection and the money to show it, Cindy becomes a spoiled and pampered child. The only person who can manage her tantrums and fits of rage is 'Jarvis,' Cindy's childhood friend-butler whom she grew up with. It is only through Jarvis's hard work and effort that Cindy manages to control her temper and grow up into a fine lady any noble family would be proud of.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_29_DESC.text: A merchant who travels through mountain villages to sell tteok, traditional rice cakes of the Eastern Kingdom Han. One day, as Malsook walks along a quiet mountain path on her route, an enormous tiger appears before her and blocks her path, roaring, “Give me a piece of tteok or I’ll eat you up!” The stunned Malsook throws the tteok in her basket into the tiger’s mouth, and the tiger retreats with a happy expression. The merchant thanks the heavens for her good luck in coming out unscathed, but when the tiger begins to come and require a piece of tteok every day afterwards, she finds herself concerned over the additional expenses. After much thought, Malsook makes up her mind to take the matter into her hands, and orders a special gun from the gun-makers of a nearby village.

TEXT_CHA_HU_4_30_DESC.text: Silver has always been known as "that introverted kid." He would like nothing more than to play "heroes and villains" with the other kids in the neighborhood, but he always shies away before managing to ask them. One day, Silver—while quietly watching the other children play as he does every day— is kidnapped by an anonymous organization. For years, his body becomes the subject of countless experiments, slowly converting into a human weapon.
