TEXT_COMMON_BETA_STONE_1_DESC.text: A parchment that contains illegible writing. Its author must have written it in great haste.

TEXT_COMMON_BETA_STONE_2_DESC.text: A slimy blob of mana that could prove fatal to those without immunity.

TEXT_COMMON_BLOODHOUND_STONE_1_DESC.text: A high-performance visor that Blood Hound upgraded with his own money. It was very expensive, but better to be safe than sorry.

TEXT_COMMON_BOUILLABAISSE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein Stein, der Mana besitzt. Bouillabaisse verwendet ihn zur Kontrolle zusätzlicher Waffen.

TEXT_COMMON_BOUILLABAISSE_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein Anhänger, in den das Bild einer armen Fischerfamilie eingraviert ist, die ihre Netze einholt.

TEXT_COMMON_CHANGGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Changgwi's dog tag. It says he's a Tiger Soldier Administrative Clerk and his military number is engraved. His men don't know about this.

TEXT_COMMON_COBRA_STONE_1_DESC.text: The venom of a cobra that has grown poisonous after decades of isolation.

TEXT_COMMON_COBRA_STONE_2_DESC.text: These fangs contain extremely toxic poison that can melt stone upon contact.

TEXT_COMMON_CODED_STONE_1_DESC.text: A laser shooter found attached to a drone. It can be used without any particular restriction inside Heaven's Ark, but it requires too much energy to be used efficiently outside.

TEXT_COMMON_CODED_STONE_2_DESC.text: An almost new Floating Stone. Steady and comfortable.

TEXT_COMMON_CODED_STONE_3_DESC.text: A hologram tablet that belonged to Code D. It is connected to Heaven’s Intranet. Upon examining the messenger records, you notice that he is on bad terms with Code M.

TEXT_COMMON_CRIT_DODGE_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht den kritischen Widerstand einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_CRIT_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die kritische Chance einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_DALGI_STONE_1_DESC.text: The body of the wire that Da Ji always carries around. It's very sharp.

TEXT_COMMON_DEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Rüstung einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_DODGE_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht das Ausweichen einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_DOMPERIGNON_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein mit dunklen Flecken übersätes Emblem des Ordens der Göttin.

TEXT_COMMON_DOMPERIGNON_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein zerbrochener Aufzeichnungsstein. Er scheint dem Mönch Dom Perignon gehört zu haben.

TEXT_COMMON_ENBYEONG_STONE_1_DESC.text: A doll made of cotton that looks like an elegant red horse. It looks like it was someone's stuffed animal.

TEXT_COMMON_GAMMA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Test Subject Gamma's artificial knee. It is designed to withstand bursts of high acceleration.

TEXT_COMMON_GAMMA_STONE_2_DESC.text: A contaminated piece of flesh scrapped from the body of Test Subject Gamma. Seemingly still alive, it convulses as if it remembers its original body.

TEXT_COMMON_GAPGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A bundle of hay that Guard Captain Gapgwi carries around for the sensitive Ochu.

TEXT_COMMON_GOBLINCHIEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein seltsamer Stein, der der Goblin-Häuptling immer am Herzen trug. Es heißt, er verleihe dem Träger Macht, und er wurde unter den Goblin-Hauptleuten von Generation zu Generation weitergegeben.

TEXT_COMMON_GOBLINCHIEF_STONE_2_DESC.text: Eine Statue aus einem undefinierbaren Mineral, die an einen Goblinkrieger erinnert. Sie gehörte einst dem Goblin-Häuptling.

TEXT_COMMON_GOBLINCHIEF_STONE_3_DESC.text: Ein glattpolierter Stein, der einst dem Goblin-Häuptling gehörte. Auf seiner Oberfläche flackern undefinierbare Runen.

TEXT_COMMON_GOBLINMASTER_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein Orden, der dem Kauernden Ochsen gehörte. Ähnliche Orden wurden bei den Körpern verschiedener Amateur-Goblin-Streiter gefunden.

TEXT_COMMON_GOBLINMASTER_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein Stück Stoff, das an den Griff der Klinge des Kauernden Ochsen gebunden war. Es stehen mehrere Worte in der Goblinsprache darauf, wahrscheinlich die Namen von Leuten oder Orten.

TEXT_COMMON_GOBLINMASTER_STONE_3_DESC.text: Einige Kieselsteine, der Kauernder Ochse in der Tasche hatte. Es sind viele bunte Kieselsteine darunter, die von Kinderhänden eingefärbt wurden.

TEXT_COMMON_GULLVEIG_STONE_1_DESC.text: A piece of Gullveig's brilliant golden armor. Yet when you touch it, it turns an ugly purple.

TEXT_COMMON_JANGPO_STONE_1_DESC.text: A book of secret arts containing some sort of martial arts. The previous Five Tiger General Zhang Fei made as a hobby, but Zhang Bu trained with it wholeheartedly.

TEXT_COMMON_JANGSANBEOUM_STONE_1_DESC.text: White powder containing the essence of Jang San Beom. Even beasts that cannot speak can transform to look like humans when they put this powder on their face.

TEXT_COMMON_KINGTIGER_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein Abzeichen, das dem Hauptmann der Katapult-Goblins gehört. Auf der Rückseite sind von grober Kinderhand ein junger Goblin und Herzen aufgemalt.

TEXT_COMMON_KINGTIGER_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein Motor, der zu einem Antriebssystem gehört, das die Goblins aufgemotzt haben. Es stehen Worte in der menschlichen Gemeinsprache darauf: „Eigentum der Himmlischen Kavallerie. Jeder, der im Besitz davon angetroffen wird, wird sofort bestraft.“

TEXT_COMMON_KINGTIGER_STONE_3_DESC.text: Insignien mit groben Zeichnungen darauf: elf Schildsymbole, fünf Hammersymbole, 33 Schwertsymbole und ein Tigersymbol.

TEXT_COMMON_LEVINLUDVICCO_STONE_1_DESC.text: Goggles that calculate the combat power of enemies by measuring their physical and magical abilities. It's useless without Levine's Intranet ID, but at least it looks cool.

TEXT_COMMON_MATAHARI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein blutrotes Juwel, das auch den größten Tänzer in Trista symbolisiert. Es scheint aus seiner eigenen Asche zu brennen.

TEXT_COMMON_MATAHARI_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein Juwel mit einzigartigem Farbton und Textur, das innerhalb der Königreichs Valencia von den Behörden geschützt wird.

TEXT_COMMON_MAX_HP_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die maximalen LP einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_MHORUS_STONE_1_DESC.text: A viscous liquid revealed to be the black blood of a mutated Horus.

TEXT_COMMON_MHORUS_STONE_2_DESC.text: Earrings that prove the status of a Priest of Horus. Even years of hardship have not robbed it from its owner.

TEXT_COMMON_NATI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Bride mask worn by Maegu. It's cute.

TEXT_COMMON_PENETRATE_DEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Rüstungsdurchdringung einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_PENETRATE_RST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Magiedurchdringung einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_PMK20A_STONE_1_DESC.text: A doll found in the damaged cockpit of PMK20A. Even its clothes have been delicately sewn on, a faithful reproduction of its original motif... You can feel the obsession of its maker.

TEXT_COMMON_QIONGQI_STONE_1_DESC.text: An eye of Qiongqi, one of the four evils. It always tries to capture the steps of an evil being, so it's pretty good for finding criminals.

TEXT_COMMON_RAVENASSASSIN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Huginn's feather that was found in the boiler room of the training grounds. The very sight of it erases all thoughts of loafing around.

TEXT_COMMON_RAVENASSASSIN_STONE_2_DESC.text: Muninn's feather that was found in the academy of the training grounds. You're reminded of the good old days when you were a newcomer freshly arrived to the army.

TEXT_COMMON_RAVENASSASSIN_STONE_3_DESC.text: A matte ebony cloak that can hardly been seen in the shadows of the night, but doesn't do much good in the dazzling white snow of the tundra at daytime.

TEXT_COMMON_RECEIVE_DMG_RATE_STONE_1_DES.text: Erhöht die Schadensreduzierungsrate einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_REGINLEIF_STONE_1_DESC.text: No matter how much you gnaw away, this serving of pork never seems to decrease in size. Judging from its taste, it's sirloin.

TEXT_COMMON_RI_DELTASQUAD_STONE_1_DESC.text: A holographic site purchased by one of the Delta Squad when they joined Road Industry. Turns out they didn't need the device so much: they soon discovered they had been placed in a troop that did not use guns.

TEXT_COMMON_RI_DELTASQUAD_STONE_2_DESC.text: Delta Squad's uniform equipment. Its vibrating wheels allow the wearer to travel at fast speeds by reducing friction. For some reason, they are immensely popular among the scientists of Road Industry.

TEXT_COMMON_RSFLAMETANK_STONE_1_DESC.text: A synthetic flame spirit created by the scientists of Rapture Science, who claim that the spirit is sentient and will recognize its owner if trained.

TEXT_COMMON_RSFLAMETANK_STONE_2_DESC.text: A glass tube with drastically improved heat resistance... Or so they claim. It's actually the same tube used in Neth flame tanks, with only the top eliminated.

TEXT_COMMON_RST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht den Widerstand einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_COMMON_SCARAB_STONE_1_DESC.text: A majestically curved horn that is unfortunately cracked in the center.

TEXT_COMMON_SCARAB_STONE_2_DESC.text: An elegant shell. Its golden patterns are naturally formed.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_DEFFENCE_STONE_2_DESC.text: Konzentriert das Licht auf einen einzelnen, glänzenden Punkt, mächtig genug, um selbst Stein zu schmelzen.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: A part of Logi's armor. It moves on its own, as if trying to return to its owner.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: An icicle that used to form Hugi's body. It is surprisingly light due to its insides being hollow.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_3_DESC.text: A flexible steel plate that once supported Logi's icy body.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_4_DESC.text: The horn that decorated Bjorn's helmet. It is said to have come from an animal long extinct.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_EP1_HEAL_1_DESC.text:
Heilt verbündete LP mit 500 pro Sekunde
(Dieser Effekt kann nicht gestapelt werden.)

TEXT_COMMON_SET_EP1_HEAL_2_DESC.text:
gesamte Teamrüstung und Widerstand +100
(Dieser Effekt kann nicht gestapelt werden.)

TEXT_COMMON_SET_EP2_MAGIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 5 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, resistance penetration is increased by 775 for 1 second

TEXT_COMMON_SET_EP2_PHYSIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 5 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, armor penetration is increased by 775 for 1 second

TEXT_COMMON_SET_EP3_AIR_1_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 15 seconds)

TEXT_COMMON_SET_EP3_AIR_2_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 15 seconds)

TEXT_COMMON_SET_HEAL_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein Bolzen aus Djers Körper, der im Laufe der Zeit verwittert ist.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_HEAL_STONE_2_DESC.text: Der gelbe Schnabel eines Adlers. Er wird beim Volk der Wüste für gewöhnlich als Talisman genutzt.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAGIC_STONE_1_DESC.text: Schakalklaue. Gib acht, sie ist sehr scharf.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAGIC_STONE_2_DESC.text: Eine von Djer abgeschossene Kugel. Gib acht, sie könnte explodieren, wenn du nicht acht gibst.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A state-of-the-art particle accelerator, miniaturized through Rapture Science technology. There is a rumor, however, that an ancient relic with similar properties has been recently discovered.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A mushroom native to the metal coverings of Battleloids. Unlike ordinary mushrooms, it is composed of the very metal from which it grows.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A species of coral found in the deep waters of the mythical sea. It grows on the thermal energy of submarine volcanoes.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: The teacup of an obscure ancient civilization. It holds a strange liquid that mutates the drinker's body into that of an alien race.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: The magnum opus of quite a few Rapture Science engineers: a durable gear made of special alloy, produced through bafflingly advanced technology.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A script used by people of ancient Hasla to record the 'Deepest Abyss' they observed in their darkest dreams.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: A snowflake from the highest peak of the Utgard Mountains. Even the passing of the ages has failed to taint its original purity.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: Legends of old say these chains cannot be broken. Yet, they have been broken.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: The remaining waste of crystallized mana. It has lost all properties of the wizard from which it originated, and thus is more suitable for experimentation.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_MAG_SP_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A type of deep-sea coral that resembles arthropod antennae. It seems there are some real antannae hiding here and there.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_1_DESC.text: Dieser felsenfeste Backenzahn vernichtet selbst, nun ja, Felsen.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_2_DESC.text: Narmers kaputte Klaue. Sie scheint aus unbekanntem Material gefertigt zu sein.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A shield generator that runs on the mana flowing through Battleloids. Depending on how you use it, it can even knock enemies into the air!

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: While this magazine may seem like the Neth Army standard, it is actually loaded with mana bullets.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A part of a tentacle of the 'Deepest Abyss.' Once it grabs ahold of its target, it won't let go. It does not suction - rather, it integrates itself with its prey.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: A tooth found piercing the skin of the 'Deepest Abyss.' It belongs to the otherworldly being 'Dhole,' whose sharp bite is said to pierce the hardest metal.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A carnation carefully folded from a sheet of metal. Judging by the depth of the fingerprints, whoever made it must have great grip strength!

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A type of sea snail found in the deep waters of the mythical sea. It can be easily recognized by the metal shell on its back.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: An axe head that proves the status of the Royal Guards of Nosgard. On it are inscribed the words "Third Generation of the Royal Guards.'

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: These gigantic shackles are engraved with a single word of a language lost in time: 'Utgard.'

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A small doll found hidden within Nemesis's core. It seems to resemble a certain someone... Hugging it warms your heart.

TEXT_COMMON_SET_PHY_SP_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: The luminescent lure of an anglerfish found in the deep waters of the mythical sea.

TEXT_COMMON_SKIRIMIROFWRATH_STONE_1_DESC.text: A molar formed out of compressed cold air. It crushes everything it bites, aiding the Incarnate's digestion.

TEXT_COMMON_SONOFGEB_STONE_2_DESC.text: Judging from its size, this shinbone couldn't have possibly belonged to a human being.

TEXT_COMMON_SVENJA_STONE_1_DESC.text: The baton used by Svenja to command her troops. It may look ordinary, but it is made out of special carbon and will hit to hurt.

TEXT_COMMON_SWORDEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: A jade ring of Police Chief B. Sworden. It's rough, but it's made of good-quality jade.

TEXT_COMMON_TAOIST_STONE_1_DESC.text: An amulet with a curse that the imperial Taoist wrote for his disciples. It has the order to stop the enemies of the imperial family until their death.

TEXT_COMMON_TRUEGULLVEIG_STONE_1_DESC.text: A potion of oblivion that helps you forget the pain and regrets of the previous night.

TEXT_COMMON_VAJRAPANI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Clothing of Deva King. It bends softly, but it breaks like stone when hit.

TEXT_COMMON_VESSELOFGALATEA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Galatea's strong talons. As it could not be carved with any tool known to humans, it was sculpted with her bone.

TEXT_COMMON_WAITINGMAN_STONE_1_DESC.text: A stick of blue snow that had been attached to the face of the Waiting One. You are strangely drawn to lick it and discover that it tastes like... blueberry soda!

TEXT_COMMON_WAITINGMAN_STONE_2_DESC.text: Whose hat can it be? The snowman waits and waits, but the owner does not return. After a long time, it begins to move on its own in order to return the hat to its owner.

TEXT_COMMON_WAITINGMAN_STONE_3_DESC.text: A glove made of snow. It looks soft and fluffy as a cloud, but it turns out quite heavy when you hold it.

TEXT_COMMON_WINDWALKER_STONE_1_DESC.text: Das Relikt eines Goblinstammes aus der alten Wüste, der schon lange ausgestorben ist. Auf einem blutroten Stein, der in der Wüste weit verbreitet ist, scheinen die Überreste eines spitzen Dornes, der Zahn eines Hundes, Zeichen, die einem „V“ ähneln, und eine Drachenschuppe eingraviert zu sein.

TEXT_COMMON_WINDWALKER_STONE_2_DESC.text: Eine Pfeilspitze, die durch verlorene Zaubersprüche geschärft wurde. Sie fügt eine Schwefelvergiftung zu, wie man sie sich oft auch in der Nähe der Oase holt.

TEXT_COMMON_WINDWALKER_STONE_3_DESC.text: Eine Baumwurzel, in die mythische Symbole geschnitzt sind ... und auch Gekritzel, das offenbar von einem sehr jungen Goblin stammt und an Makronen und Krapfen erinnert.

TEXT_CONFIRM_SELL_ADVENTURER_HERO_DESC_I.text: When a Normal hero is promoted, the hero becomes a random hero of the next rank. Class does not change.

TEXT_CONFIRM_SELL_HERO_LEGEND.text:

als gewöhnliche Helden.

TEXT_CONFIRM_SELL_LAGENDARY_HERO_INFO.text: When a Normal Hero is promoted to ★4, the Hero becomes a Promotion Hero that can be promoted up to ★6.

TEXT_DECO_BOSSRUSH_LION_HEAD_DESC.text: A helm that glints with hard-earned valiance.

TEXT_DECO_BOSSRUSH_RAEL_HEAD_DESC.text: Once worn by Rael, it resounds with eerie echoes. It is said that those who come across this helmet are overwhelmed with an inexplicable desire to put it on...

TEXT_DECO_BOSSRUSH_SOLTAR_HEAD_DESC.text: Once worn by Soltar, it emits an odious aura. It is said that those who come across this helmet are overwhelmed with a powerful urge to put it on...

TEXT_DECO_BOSSRUSH_VV_BACK_DESC.text: Wings of victory that sharply slice the air.

TEXT_DECO_DETECTIVE_TOP_FAN_01_DESC.text: Turn on this refined ceiling fan to cool your office and let out the stuffy air.

TEXT_DECO_GOLDEN_CARRIAGE_01_DESC.text: Eine Kutsche, die Glück bringt. Der Anblick dieser Kutsche lässt keine Seele in Hasla kalt.

TEXT_DECO_HW1_BOTTOM_HEAD_01_DESC.text: An adorable potted plant gifted by Jack to the Captain who defeated Gargantua. Its name is 'Bo.'

TEXT_DECO_HW1_BOTTOM_LEFTHAND_01_DESC.text: An adorable potted plant gifted by Jack to the Captain who defeated Gargantua. Its name is 'Beanie.'

TEXT_DECO_HW1_BOTTOM_RIGHTHAND_01_DESC.text: An adorable potted plant gifted by Jack to the Captain who defeated Gargantua. Its name is 'Sweet Pea.'

TEXT_DECO_HW1_BOTTOM_ROOT_01_DESC.text: A potted plant gifted by Jack to the Captain who defeated Gargantua.

TEXT_DECO_HW2_BOTTOM_FLOOR_01_DESC.text: A token of Ozma's gratitude for defeating Mecha-Toto. Rest assured, it has been thoroughly tested for potential explosions.

TEXT_DECO_HW2_BOTTOM_FLOOR_02_DESC.text: A token of Ozma's gratitude for defeating Mecha-Toto. It can generate enough energy for one battery every day.

TEXT_DECO_HW2_BOTTOM_FLOOR_03_DESC.text: A token of Ozma's gratitude for defeating Mecha-Toto. The key lies in your finesse of controlling the claw.

TEXT_DECO_HW2_BOTTOM_FLOOR_04_DESC.text: A token of Ozma's gratitude for defeating Mecha-Toto. It seemingly works only as a toaster.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_BURNINGTREE_01_DESC.text: Ein Baum, der nahe des Urvulkans wächst. Bella besteht darauf, dass er lebt, doch viele Helden, die ihn sahen, zweifeln daran. Begrenzte Ereignisquest-Belohnung im April 2018.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_CACTUS_01_DESC.text: Eine Kaktuspflanze mit einer schönen Blüte. Begrenzte Ereignisquest-Belohnung im April 2018.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_CHERRYTREE_01_DESC.text: Ein ewig blühender Kirschbaum. Seine Blätter fallen sanft im Wind. Begrenzte Ereignisquest-Belohnung im April 2018.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_02_DESC.text: The Princess and defender of Mugen. She enlisted the help of the Twelve Warrior Explosive Eto Rangers to fight off the forces of evil.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_03_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Bakumaru from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_04_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Hols from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_05_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Gao from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_06_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Cream from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_07_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Drago from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_08_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Nyorori from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_09_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Nyanma from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_10_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Pakaracchi from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_11_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Souffle from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_12_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Monk from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_13_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Tart from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_14_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Pochiro from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_ER_BOTTOM_15_DESC.text: A doll made to look like Urii from Eto Rangers.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_FOOTBALL_01_DESC.text: Did you know that soccer balls are made of 12 black pentagon patches and 20 white hexagon patches? Limited Quest reward for July 2018.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_GOSL_BOTTOM_COWGIRL_01_D.text: Goblin Slayer's childhood friend. She's a lot stronger than she looks.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_GOSL_BOTTOM_DESK_01_DESC.text: These Guild receptionists are responsible for registering and giving quests, paying out bounties, and administering adventurer ranking tests.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_GOSL_BOTTOM_DESK_01_NAME.text: Adventurer's Guild Reception Desk and Guild Girls

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_PUMPKIN_CANDY_01_DESC.text: Filled with all kinds of candy for little trick-or-treaters.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_PUMPKIN_CATHOUSE_01_DESC.text: A perfect home for the spooky feline.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_PUMPKIN_CHAIR_01_DESC.text: Who knew that pumpkins could make great chairs?

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_PUMPKIN_GRAVESTONE_01_DE.text: This spooky gravestone decoration comes with extra pumpkins!

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_SH_BOTTOM_01_DESC.text: An egg that Filo is about to hatch from. Look at it shake! It seems to be seconds before Filo shows her face.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_SH_BOTTOM_02_DESC.text: A blacksmith and weapon shop owner in Castle Town of Melromarc. His reputation precedes and his clients never leave the shop disappointed.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_SH_BOTTOM_03_DESC.text: The Second Princess and heir to the Melromarc throne. She's quite skilled in water and healing magic.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_SOCCERBENCH_01_DESC.text: A bench for managers, coaches, and players - well, on the bench. Limited Quest reward for July 2018.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_SOCCERTROPHY_01_DESC.text: A golden trophy given to the victorious team. It symbolizes 'victory' (obviously). Limited Quest reward for July 2018.

TEXT_DECO_LIMIT_WATERPLANT_01_DESC.text: Ein Fischglas, das nach Meer duftet. Begrenzte Ereignisquest-Belohnung im April 2018.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_BASKETBALLNET_01.text: Ein äußerst robuster Basketballkorb, um Körbe zu werfen. Wirf einfach drauflos.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_BOOKSHELF_01_DES.text: Ein Bücherregal mit Büchern und anderem Lesestoff.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_CHEERSTAGE_01_DE.text: Eine Bühne, auf der Cheerleader tanzen. Los Team!

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_CLEANING_01_DESC.text: Damit wischt man den Boden auf. Drücke den Mopp im Eimer aus.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_DOOR_01_DESC.text: Eine Tür, die man zur Seite schiebt. So lassen sich alle möglichen Streiche spielen.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_FILESHELF_01_DES.text: Ein Bücherregal mit Akten und Dokumenten.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_LECTURE_DESK_01_.text: Dient zum Ablegen von Vortrags- und anderem Lehrmaterial. Jemand hat ihn mit einer kleinen Vase dekoriert.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_LOCKER_01_DESC.text: Darin kannst du alles lagern. Zahlenschloss separat erhältlich.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_POT_01_DESC.text: Wirkt extrem gepflegt. Jemand muss davon sehr angetan sein.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_STAND_01_DESC.text: Sieh dir von dieser Tribüne aus die Partien an.

TEXT_DECO_SCHOOL_BOTTOM_STAND_02_DESC.text: Sieh dir von dieser Tribüne aus die Partien an.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_CHAIR_01_DESC.text: A chair made of brown leather. It's very comfortable, so sit down at your own risk.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_DESK_01_DESC.text: Judging from the disarray, a detective seems to have spent long hours at this desk, pondering over a difficult case.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_DISPLAYCASE_01_DES.text: A wooden display case where you can store all your miscellanea. The sophisticated design catches one's eye.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_DOOR_01_DESC.text: A wooden hinged door that usually remains closed, but will occasionally let in an interesting visitor.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_HANDRAIL_01_DESC.text: This wooden banister adds elegance to any room as well as prevent people from falling from the stairs.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_HANGER_01_DESC.text: A coat stand that lets you - despite its misleading name - also hang other pieces of clothing.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_RADIATOR_01_DESC.text: A radiator that provides heat to an otherwise cold office.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_BOTTOM_STAIR_01_DESC.text: Every step down these sturdy wooden stairs resonates with a satisfying clunk.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_CENTER_COCKROACH_01_DESC.text: An ancient insect species armed with the adaptability to live in all kinds of environments and the vitality to survive catastrophes that wipe out less hardy species. We only hope it doesn't multiply once it enters your Hero Home...

TEXT_DETECTIVE_CENTER_FRAME_01_DESC.text: A hectic collection of various picture frames.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_CENTER_MAP_01_DESC.text: A detective spent long hours mulling over this board. Hang it on your wall, and - voila! - you too will feel like a real private eye at work!

TEXT_DETECTIVE_CENTER_WINDOW_01_DESC.text: A window with broken blinds that come only halfway down and cannot be raised or lowered.

TEXT_DETECTIVE_CENTER_WINDOW_02_DESC.text: A window with broken blinds that can't be raised, but still let in the sunlight through its moth holes.

TEXT_DG_HERO_GROUP_DESC.text: Save Legendary Heroes from the darkness to recruit them as allies.

TEXT_DG_MONEY_GROUP_DESC.text: Earn resources and items required to train your Heroes.

TEXT_DG_OLYMPICS_DESC.text: Hüte die Fackel bis zum Ende des Rennens und mach dem endlosen Schnee, der auf die Kürbisstadt fällt, ein Ende.

TEXT_DG_OLYMPICS_START.text: Brandaktuelle Neuigkeiten! Wenn du dich mit Streiter Lia zusammentust, kommst du schneller über die Ziellinie!

TEXT_DG_RUN_DESC.text: Tritt beim Kürbiskarneval-Rennen gegen Remi an, die Hexe aus der Kürbisstadt!

TEXT_DG_WEAPON_GROUP_DESC.text: Defeat Apostles throughout the continent to earn Old Weapons and Iron.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_MAZE_SHOP_01.text:
Here you can trade Maze Coins you gathered
from the Event for prizes of your choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_S2_EP2_1.text:
I never knew the Desert was so full of shiny stuff!
We got a great haul today, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_S2_EP2_2.text:
Welcome, meow! What do you think about my headdress? 
Hee hee, it's made out of pretty stones!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DISCOUNT_S2_EP2_1.text: Jewels?! I love pretty stones, but jewels are the best, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_HELP_ALL_1.text:
You can only refresh once a day, nya!
If you give me shiny things, I'll give you a discount on everything, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_OUT_S2_EP2_1.text:
I need to go search for more shiny stuff!
See you later, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_OUT_S2_EP2_2.text:
I'll bring back the treasure of your dreams, meow!
Just wait and see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HASLAWARS1_EXSHOP.text:
Heh heh... I snuck out some treasure from the castle.
Maybe you could purchase something? I'll give you a good price!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HASLAWARS1_EXSHOPBUY.text:
Th-thank you! Oh, erm, could you do me a favor and 
keep this a secret from Princess Vivian...? Please...!

TEXT_DOUBLEUP_PACK_DESC.text:
Twice the Jewels and Bridget Points!
A One-Time Offer!

TEXT_DOUBLEUP_PACK_DESC2.text:
The package of every Captain's dreams!
Purchase to receive 110 Jewels, a ★4 Hero Selection Ticket, and a ★4 Soulbound Weapon Ticket, as well as double the Bridget Points for this purchase!
This package can be purchased only once per account.

TEXT_DOUBLEUP_PACK_MAIL_CONTENT.text: Here is your purchase of the Limited Double Up Package.

TEXT_DUNGEON_ACCEL_SPEED_DESC.text: Trink den Trank der Zeit, erreiche dadurch übermenschliches Tempo und kämpfe gegen die Hexen und Golems der Kürbisstadt!

TEXT_DUNGEON_AF_DESC.text: Defeat the Divine Beast and collect eggs!

TEXT_DUNGEON_BREAD_DESC.text: Verdiene Brot aus dem Brotlager, um deine Helden auszubilden!

TEXT_DUNGEON_CRITICAL_DESC.text: Einem gewissen Wissenschaftler ist es gelungen, Androiden nach dem Vorbild der großen Helden von Hasla zu erschaffen. Erprobe deine Stärke gegen die zusammengeschraubte Version deiner Lieblingshelden!

TEXT_DUNGEON_DRAGON_DESC.text: Magnax‘ markerschütternes Brüllen hallt zwischen den Bergen wider. Halte den Apostel davon ab, das Ende der Welt herbeizuführen.

TEXT_DUNGEON_ERROR_KEY_DESC.text:
Nicht genug Schlüssel zum Betreten!
Ein Schlüssel wird alle 20 Min. aufgeladen. 
Oder du kannst sie von der reisenden Händlerin Pepe kaufen!

TEXT_DUNGEON_EVENT_BREAD_DESC.text: Find food hidden by the revived Rabbit Army!

TEXT_DUNGEON_EVENT_WORLDCUP_DESC.text: Protect the Hasla League from the evil Ball Kickers, who seeks victory through treacherous means!

TEXT_DUNGEON_FUGUROID_DESC.text: Take care of Fergus's sneaky request and receive various rewards!

TEXT_DUNGEON_GOLD_DESC.text: Es gibt Gerüchte über große Reichtümer, die von Goblins in diesen Verliesen versteckt wurden.

TEXT_DUNGEON_GOLEM_DESC.text: Die Erde bebt mit jedem Schritt des Schwarzen Golems des Waldes. Halte ihn auf bevor er das Dorf und seine Bewohner vernichtet.

TEXT_DUNGEON_HONOR_DESC.text: Earn Hero EXP and Honor at the Ancient Training Grounds!

TEXT_DUNGEON_KEY_DESC.text: Alle Schlüssel werden täglich nach Mitternacht wieder aufgefüllt.

TEXT_DUNGEON_KOF_FIGHT_DESC.text: Challenge formidable champions in the world tournament to distinguish the true king of fighters.

TEXT_DUNGEON_KRAKEN_DESC.text: Sende den Apostel Kranus, die Geißel des Meeres, zurück in die Tiefe, aus der er kam.

TEXT_DUNGEON_RAID_DARKOFTHEDEEPSEA_DESC.text: The patron of the mythical seas lies slumbering in their dreams, their Oracle of Water forgotten by all. Protect them from the voracious darkness of the Deep Sea.

TEXT_DUNGEON_RAID_GUARDIANOFRUINS_DESC.text: Lorelei hat endlich den Tempel der Illusionen entdeckt, der tief in der Wüste verborgen liegt. Decke das Geheimnis des Alten Wächters auf, der den Tempel schützt.4

TEXT_DUNGEON_RAID_MANACAR_DESC.text: Der im Turm von Manacar eingeschlossene Apostel hat sich schließlich zu erkennen gegeben. Schließe dich mit den römischen Helden zusammen, um den Herrscher des Mana zu besiegen.

TEXT_DUNGEON_RAID_RAPTURE2NDLAB_DESC.text: The Neth Empire has been conducting human experiments on abducted wizards. Save Sasquatch from the Rapture Science Secret Laboratory before it's too late!

TEXT_DUNGEON_RAID_SEALOFSANCTUARY_DESC.text:
A sinister jester seeks to break the Seal of the Sanctuary.
Help Lakias and the Guardians protect Nosgard from his clutches.

TEXT_DUNGEON_RWBY_RUN_DESC.text: Join forces with the Huntresses of Remnant to arrest the interdimensional criminal Roman.

TEXT_DUNGEON_SANDWORM_DESC.text: Bezwinge den Apostel Fenriruth, bevor der Gestank seines Giftes die Welt erstickt.

TEXT_DUNGEON_SCHEDULE_WEEK_INFO_MOVING_D.text: Alle Verliese öffnen täglich um {0} Uhr. Nur Verliese, die regelmäßig öffnen, werden in diesem Zeitplan aufgeführt.

TEXT_DUNGEON_STORY_FURY_DESC.text: Die Straße des Zorns ist im Turm von Manacar erschienen ...

TEXT_DUNGEON_STORY_RUIN_DESC.text: Die Straße zum Ruin ist im Turm von Manacar erschienen ...

TEXT_DUNGEON_STORY_VOID_DESC.text: Die Straße zur Leere ist im Turm von Manacar erschienen ...

TEXT_DUNGEON_TOPDEALER_1_DESC.text: Nimm an dem Wettbewerb teil, der von Fergus, dem beliebten Schmied der Stadt, veranstaltet wird!

TEXT_DUNGEON_TRIAL_PAAR_DESC.text: Schwere Hämmer und schnelle Pfeile müssen sich der Schwerkraft dieses Verlieses beugen.

TEXT_DUNGEON_TRIAL_SWHU_DESC.text: Klingen und Pistolen sind hier nutzlos.

TEXT_DUNGEON_TRIAL_WIPR_DESC.text: In diesem Verlies braucht man andere Waffen, und keine Magie durchdringt seine Wände.

TEXT_DUNGEON_UNSEAL_DESC.text:
Wenn ein Verlies entsiegelt wird, kann man für
1 Stunde hinein. Verlies entsiegeln? (1 Schlüssel benutzen.)

TEXT_DUNGEON_WEAPON_ARCHER_DESC.text: Schätze warten am Ende der Prüfung des Bogens.

TEXT_DUNGEON_WEAPON_HUNTER_DESC.text: Schätze warten am Ende der Prüfung der Pistole.

TEXT_DUNGEON_WEAPON_PALADIN_DESC.text: Schätze warten am Ende der Prüfung des Hammers.

TEXT_DUNGEON_WEAPON_PRIEST_DESC.text: Schätze warten am Ende der Prüfung der Kugel.

TEXT_DUNGEON_WEAPON_WARRIOR_DESC.text: Schätze warten am Ende der Prüfung des Schwertes.

TEXT_DUNGEON_WEAPON_WIZARD_DESC.text: Schätze warten am Ende der Prüfung des Stabes.

TEXT_DUNGEON_XMAS_DESC.text: Süße Freunde sind gekommen, um für die Feiertage zu singen.

TEXT_DUNGEON_XMAS_HARD_DESC.text: Gruselige Freunde sind gekommen, um für die Feiertage zu singen.

TEXT_EAST_QUEST_MAIL_CONTENT.text: Reward for the Every Captain's Jumping Quest.

TEXT_EMPTY_RANKING.text: No ranks have been registered yet.

TEXT_EPIC_3G_STONE_1_DESC.text: Feuersteine, die Grease immer mit sich herumtrug. Ein edles Produkt der östlichen Königreiche, mit der Zeichnung einer weißen Axt dekoriert.

TEXT_EPIC_ACCURACY_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Genauigkeit einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_AMMUT_STONE_1_DESC.text: A red fragment taken from the Ammut's eye. It is unclear whether it is a teardrop or blood-drop.

TEXT_EPIC_ANCIENREGIME_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein Fragment des Bösen, das in den Tiefen von Trista schwebend gefunden wurde.

TEXT_EPIC_ANCIENREGIME_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein exotisches Erz, das einen Pfad zum Geheimnis der Welt beleuchtet.

TEXT_EPIC_ANCIENREGIME_STONE_3_DESC.text: Ein besessener Gegenstand, der seinem Betrachter Macht verleiht, wer es auch ist ...

TEXT_EPIC_ANUBISIS_H_STONE_1_DESC.text: A blade allegedly forged from material bestowed by the heavens. Enemies cut by this blade become hostages in death.

TEXT_EPIC_ANUBISIS_H_STONE_2_DESC.text: A decoration depicting the golden Uraeus of three heads. It symbolizes the majesty of the Three Kings.

TEXT_EPIC_ANUBISIS_STONE_1_DESC.text: White blood gathered from Anubisis's wound. Its properties seem to change in accordance to the surrounding ambiance.

TEXT_EPIC_ATK_POWER_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Angriffsmacht einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_AVENIR_STONE_1_DESC.text: Der Manastein, mit dem Avenir ihren Manafluss steuert.

TEXT_EPIC_AVENIR_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein grob gefertigter Ring. Er scheint ein Geschenk von jemandem zu sein.

TEXT_EPIC_AZATHOTH_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein Fragment, finsterer als die finsterste Nacht. Es ist wie ein Reiskorn geformt.

TEXT_EPIC_AZATHOTH_STONE_2_DESC.text: Ein sanft pulsierendes Fragment, das wie ein menschliches Herz geformt ist.

TEXT_EPIC_AZATHOTH_STONE_3_DESC.text: Ein Stein mit schwach eingravierten Buchstaben, von denen nur folgende lesbar sind: „Ma…j…s“

TEXT_EPIC_BLOODHOUND_STONE_1_DESC.text: An optical camouflage device developed by remodeling the Blood Hound's old machine with Road Industry technology. If you can't be seen, you can't be targeted.

TEXT_EPIC_CHANGGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A necklace that is said to have been made by Changgwi with the fangs of the legendary 'Taekbaek' he gained after fighting him. No one knows the truth behind, but the extraordinary energy from the necklace gives some weight to the story.

TEXT_EPIC_CHOSSEO_STONE_1_DESC.text:
Hello Captains,

At the end of seven good years of service, I regret to say that this is my last present to you as the PD of Crusaders Quest. Crusaders Quest means more than a game to me, and I will remember my time here with fondness for the rest of my life. I hope that you continue to find the fun and comfort that the developers strive to create in this game. I will continue to cheer on Crusaders Quest, no longer as its Director but as another Hero Captain of Hasla. As a game developer, I have learned a lot from you, dear Captains. I hope to see you again one day, and I wish everyone happiness and good health in these confusing times.

Sincerely,
Sungmin Cho

TEXT_EPIC_CODEVV_STONE_1_DESC.text: VV's power source, made out of magic engineering technology. To prevent overheating, it has been wrapped with a defensive magic circle of many layers that cancels out interception of other magic.

TEXT_EPIC_CRIT_DODGE_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht den kritischen Widerstand einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_CRIT_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die kritische Chance einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_DALGI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A melody of a country's ruination composed by a nameless composer of Chen a long time ago. It breaks the spirits of those who listen to it and makes them incapable of doing anything.

TEXT_EPIC_DEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Rüstung einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_DODGE_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht das Ausweichen einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_ENBYEONG_STONE_1_DESC.text: It is said that a blue dragon appeared in front of the emperor a long time ago and offered the orb. It clears the mind of the holder.

TEXT_EPIC_EVE606_STONE_1_DESC.text: Some supporting equipment that further enhances the sensory nervous systems of sensitive test subjects. It is not recommended for the average human being, as they will not be able to endure the heightened sensations and faint.

TEXT_EPIC_FREYJA_STONE_1_DESC.text: An orb of ice inscribed with Freyja's magic runes. It is said that you must be of the Vana bloodline to use it properly, but even the mere act of holding it bestows energy and strength.

TEXT_EPIC_GAPGWI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Bell to control Guard Captain Gapgwi's cow, 'Ochu'. Ochu's movements are unpredictable as it moves according to the sound of the bell.

TEXT_EPIC_GENERALWINTER_STONE_1_DESC.text: General Winter's source of energy. Take a bite and you'll see a clown teasing you before your eyes... Can it be that you're hallucinating?

TEXT_EPIC_GG_STONE_1_DESC.text: Ein Halsband, das etwas Schutz gegen Kontamination bietet. Die rechte Seite seiner Dreiecksform ist zur Mitte hin gefaltet.

TEXT_EPIC_GULLVEIG_STONE_1_DESC.text: How strange, this jewel from Gullveig's tiara seems to be one color and shape at a certain angle of light... And yet another color and shape at another... You find it difficult to discern its true form.

TEXT_EPIC_GULLVEIG_STONE_2_DESC.text: The fragment of a curse summoned forth from another dimension. It emits a different aura from the darkness of the Apostles.

TEXT_EPIC_JANGPO_STONE_1_DESC.text: It is said that a red dragon appeared in front of the emperor a long time ago and offered the legendary decorative art. But it is said that a bellflower of the same name is more well-known.

TEXT_EPIC_JANGSANBEOUM_STONE_1_DESC.text: Part of Jang San Beom, a monster that appeared in the border between this world and the otherworld. It looks like a person, so amongst Shimmanis, they say to not follow a red-faced person that asks for help from the mountains.

TEXT_EPIC_JERAPHIM_H_STONE_1_DESC.text: These letters may be written in an unknown language, but oddly enough, you understand their meaning. Gazing upon them fills you with a strange power.

TEXT_EPIC_JERAPHIM_H_STONE_2_DESC.text: A luminescent stone. Its light is brilliant, but does not hurt your eyes.

TEXT_EPIC_JERAPHIM_STONE_1_DESC.text: The wings of the Kalard Jeraphim. Its white glow remains untarnished.

TEXT_EPIC_LEESIN_STONE_1_DESC.text: Eine zerbrochene Klinge, die Ratoichi gehört. Du kannst spüren, wie sie vor stählerner Entschlossenheit vibriert.

TEXT_EPIC_LEVINLUDVICCO_STONE_1_DESC.text: A particle invented by Levine’s younger brother, the former Chief Engineer of A.M.K. It is said to collapse atomic structure and can soften even the most durable of substances. Levine has been attempting to mass-produce the particle to no avail.

TEXT_EPIC_LEVINLUDVICCO_STONE_2_DESC.text: A magic-particle focused beam launching device invented by Levine herself. It is tremendously efficient—but must run on the lifeblood and mana of living wizards.

TEXT_EPIC_MAX_HP_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die maximalen LP einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_NATI_STONE_1_DESC.text: Part of the gallbladder of the bear patron saint 'Nati' that lives in the border. It's like any bear gallbladder so it doesn't have any special healing effects.

TEXT_EPIC_OMEGA_STONE_1_DESC.text: Machinery taken from Test Subject Omega's chest. It continues to beat in an eerie, familiar rhythm...

TEXT_EPIC_PANDEMONIUM_STONE_1_DESC.text: A metal frame surrounding the Pandemonium's head of surprising durability. On the inside, there is a mysterious engraving in small letters that praises the machine's "demonic performance."

TEXT_EPIC_PENETRATE_DEF_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Rüstungsdurchdringung einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_PENETRATE_RST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Magiedurchdringung einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_PMK20A_STONE_1_DESC.text: PMK20A's flight control system. In low flying mode, it also acts as an intercept avoidance and fire control system. Before the development of this equipment, wizards captured by the Empire were forced to calculate the control tactics instead.

TEXT_EPIC_PMK20A_STONE_2_DESC.text: The armor plate of PMK20A. It is filled with a new material invented in the developing process. In an emergency, it can also be disassembled, cooked, and eaten.

TEXT_EPIC_QIONGQI_STONE_1_DESC.text: A condensed orb containing the power of Qiongqi, one of the four evils. The energy is ominous, but appealing. It is said that when it goes into the hands of an evil being, it has the power to make those evil thoughts come true.

TEXT_EPIC_RAVENLEADERRAN_STONE_1_DESC.text: A flag passed down from the time of King Snorri, the first sovereign of Nosgard. The embroidered sign of the raven is the symbol of the Night Raven assassins.

TEXT_EPIC_REBOUILLABAISSE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Die Erkennungsmarke eines Soldaten der Himmlischen Kavallerie. Ein unentzifferbarer Code steht darauf.

TEXT_EPIC_REBOUILLABAISSE_STONE_2_DESC.text: Die Erkennungsmarke eines Sergeanten der Himmlischen Kavallerie. Die Leutnants und höhere Offiziere scheinen aus dem Orden gesäubert worden zu sein.

TEXT_EPIC_REBOUILLABAISSE_STONE_3_DESC.text: Ein unkenntlicher Manastein. Bouillabaisse verwendet ihn zur Kontrolle zusätzlicher Waffen.

TEXT_EPIC_RECEIVE_DMG_RATE_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht die Schadensreduzierungsrate einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_REDOMPERIGNON_STONE_1_DESC.text: Eine Scherbe einer Träne, die auf Dom Perignons Wangen fiel. Wenn man sie in die Hand nimmt, sieht man ein Bild eines Schattendämons, der die Slums und die Leute darin vernichtet.

TEXT_EPIC_REDOMPERIGNON_STONE_2_DESC.text: Es scheint ein Zeichen der Dankbarkeit von den Bürgern zu sein: „Für Dom Perignon, den Freund der Armen und Kranken.“

TEXT_EPIC_REDOMPERIGNON_STONE_3_DESC.text: Zur Herstellung von Bier und anderen Alkoholsorten verwendet. Es riecht immer noch süßlich.

TEXT_EPIC_REGINLEIF_STONE_1_DESC.text: The shield of a goddess that can be worn only by the truest warriors who know the glory of war... Or its replica.

TEXT_EPIC_REGINLEIF_STONE_2_DESC.text: Throughout Nosgard can be discovered stones naturally charged with lightening. Some people, few and far between, are innately born with this magic flowing through their veins.

TEXT_EPIC_RESIDUALLION_STONE_1_DESC.text: Die Insignien eines Ritters, der es bis in die Legenden geschafft hat. Darauf stehen die Worte „Meister des Langschwerts“ geschrieben.

TEXT_EPIC_RESIDUALLION_STONE_2_DESC.text: In dieser leeren Rüstung eines lange toten Ritters schimmern nur die unsterblichen Worte der Treue zum Orden der Göttin.

TEXT_EPIC_RESIDUALLION_STONE_3_DESC.text: Ein Juwel, das in den Knauf des Langschwerts eingelassen ist. Es hat seine ursprüngliche Strahlkraft eingebüßt und ist jetzt von einer schwarzen, zähen Flüssigkeit bedeckt.

TEXT_EPIC_RST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Erhöht den Widerstand einer seelengebundenen Waffe.

TEXT_EPIC_RUDERAT_STONE_1_DESC.text: Eins von den Kopfgeldern Rudrats, die er aus der Menschenwelt plünderte, während er in einer Diebesbande tätig war. Die ursprüngliche Form ist nicht genau bekannt.

TEXT_EPIC_SEKHMET_H_STONE_1_DESC.text: An essence of flame created by Sekhmet with magic. It shall continue to burn until everything before it turns to ash.

TEXT_EPIC_SEKHMET_H_STONE_2_DESC.text: The symbol of Queen Sekhmet. Made of glowing hot gold, it cannot be worn by anyone other than the Queen.

TEXT_EPIC_SEKHMET_STONE_1_DESC.text: A papyrus containing a warning to enemies of the Kingdom. One of Sekhmet's favorite objects used to make a point, thank you.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_DEFFENCE_STONE_1_DESC.text: „Kein Hieb könnte die Oberfläche von Narmer durchbrechen.“ - ‚Set‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_DEFFENCE_STONE_2_DESC.text: „Ihre glänzende Halskette schien nicht nur andere zu blenden, sondern auch ihren Verstand und ihr Herz ...“ - ‚Isis‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: Only this metal sphere was found where Logi's heart should have been. On it are inscribed the old Haslan words of a magical contract with an elemental spirit.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: A 'megingjord,' a part of the uniform once worn by the Royal Guards of Ancient Nosgard. Its technology has been lost to time, and only Thor's 'megingjord' remains intact to this day. It greatly increases the strength of the wearer.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_3_DESC.text: A circular disc that fell from Bjorn's broken shield. It appears to have been crafted out of 'Svalinn,' a magical substance that freezes everything upon contact.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_DEF_EP2_STONE_4_DESC.text: A fragment of the Seal of the Sanctuary that materialized after being frozen by the Incarnate's powers. It may have weakened with time, but its powers are still a force to be reckoned with.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP1_HEAL_1_DESC.text:
Heilt verbündete LP mit 2000 pro Sekunde
(Dieser Effekt kann nicht gestapelt werden.)

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP1_HEAL_2_DESC.text:
gesamte Teamrüstung und Widerstand +300
(Dieser Effekt kann nicht gestapelt werden.)

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP2_MAGIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 30 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, resistance penetration is increased by 2000 for 1 second

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP2_PHYSIC_2_DESC.text:
Upon using 1-chain, accuracy is increased by 30 for 1 second
Upon using 3-chain, armor penetration is increased by 2000 for 1 second

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP3_AIR_1_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 7 seconds)

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP3_AIR_2_DESC.text: Upon using own 3-chain, knocks all enemies into the air. (Cooltime: 7 seconds)

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP4_MAGIC_1_NAME.text: Brilliant Intuition of the Ancient God

TEXT_EPIC_SET_EP4_PHYSIC_1_NAME.text: Brilliant Fragment of the Ancient God

TEXT_EPIC_SET_HEAL_STONE_1_DESC.text: „Nur in der Reflexion von Banoubs Augen konnten wir eine Spur von Emotionen entdecken – nämlich unsere eigenen, Furcht und Verzweiflung.“ - ‚Isis‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_HEAL_STONE_2_DESC.text: „Wir hatten kaum Djer besiegt, als wir schonungslos erkannten, dass wir ihn im Grunde genommen nicht besiegt hatten.“ - ‚Osiris‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAGIC_STONE_1_DESC.text: „Und das Licht von Djers Dorn durchstach die Erde und reinigte sie vollständig.“ - ‚Lorelei‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAGIC_STONE_2_DESC.text: „Khasekhemwys Wut war der reine Terror, losgerissen vom Reich der Albträume.“ - ‚Set‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A magically engineered weapon designed after a mysterious labyrinth located somewhere in Hasla. It generates small gravity fields to decrease pressure from the limbs of Battleloids, allowing actions previously deemed physically impossible.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A black cube that glitters as if containing all the stars of the night sky. It is said to have mysteriously appeared behind the Battleloid's mask one day.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A piece of tentacle that fell from the 'Deepest Abyss.' It is said that an ordinary human being only has to look at it to lose their composure and quiver in inexplicable fear. However, when the right one falls asleep with it in their hand, they will catch a glimpse of the dreams of the 'Deepest Abyss,' filled with the forgotten past.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_TITLE.text: Caress of the Forgotten Old God

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: A piece of the body of the 'Deepest Abyss.' The fragment itself does not seem to contain any will of its own, but it will occasionally form eyes and peer at its surroundings. It is rumored that those caught in its eerie gaze suffer misfortunes, big and small.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: Mana essence of the first Witch of the Forest, gradually accumulated and condensed over several decades. It dyes everything green on contact.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A tome of magic known to have been cited by the Lunatic Delet in his books. The ominous stain on the cover seems to resemble a human face... However, it was recently discovered to be an ordinary cooking book, and the stain spilled coffee.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: The cold winds of Nosgard that have materialized into the shape of a fang. It freezes and demolishes its victims with biting fury.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: A particle of the first snow to ever envelop the northern lands, long before the memory of the Great Cold and all that would come with it.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A module assembled in the likeness of wizards' internal mana circuits. Among its many versions, the SP Charge Module is special for its ability to generate protective magical barriers.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_MAG_SP_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A sculpture carved in the form of an unknown yet sinister ancient god. While it is made out of ordinary stone, the shape itself seems to contain an undefinable curse - simply looking at it unnerves one's soul.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_1_DESC.text: „Narmers wütender Schwanz brachte einen Sturm der Verzweiflung.“ - ‚Osiris‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHYSIC_STONE_2_DESC.text: „Eine reine, primitive Kraft steckte in Khasekhemwys Faust: Eine starke und fatale Kraft, der keiner widerstehen konnte.“ - ‚Osiris‘

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_AIR_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A magically engineered weapon designed after a mysterious labyrinth located somewhere in Hasla. It changes the direction of forces, applying increased pressure to the limbs of Battleloids and so maximizing their physical strength.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_ATK_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: Nemesis's core unit, constructed from an alloy that is not naturally found in Hasla. Scientists think it draws energy from another unknown dimension.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A device once used in rituals to summon Great Old Beings. It now lies broken and devoid of its true strength, but if you look at it closely in the dark, you can see emanating from its center an ominous red aura.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_ATK_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: An unidentified particle found by archeologist Doctor Shaver in the deep sea. Surprisingly, it is said to possess similar qualities to the IC particle created by Neth's latest technology. Rumor has it that the Shaver Particle gained its particular hue when Doctor Shaver, turned mad from researching the material too long and too far, committed suicide by chopping himself up in a grinder.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_DEF_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: The materialized dream of a witch who has been asleep for many long years. Gazing at it brings to your mind dusty memories of a golden-haired girl - and her tears.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_DEF_EP4_STONE_1_DESC.text: A talisman engraved with information on the lost island 'Lemuria,' discovered in the deep waters of the mystical sea. It is made out of unidentified metal not found in Hasla - perhaps it has been carried from another dimension along with the 'Deepest Abyss'...

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_1_DESC.text: The gauntlet 'Jarngreipr' contains within it the essence of the cold of the northern lands. Upon gripping its victim, it freezes them into helplessness.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_EP2_STONE_2_DESC.text: The essence of an ever-raging storm. It reacts to the surrounding air currents by changing in size.

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_SP_EP3_STONE_1_DESC.text: A module assembled in the likeness of wizards' internal mana circuits. Ever since a scientist accidentally dropped it, it tends to become durable whenever it stores enough mana. How curious!

TEXT_EPIC_SET_PHY_SP_EP4_STONE_2_DESC.text: The eye of the 'Deepest Abyss.' When the dimension whence they were born perished, they engraved its final moments into their retina to remain there for all eternity. Even now, when they have lost all memory of their past, the familiar landscape still evokes within them a deep and mournful longing.

TEXT_EPIC_SKIRIMIROFWRATH_STONE_1_DESC.text: A petal that was found nestled away amidst Skrymir's mane, fresh and undamaged even before the frigid winds.

TEXT_EPIC_SKIRIMIROFWRATH_STONE_2_DESC.text: A rune letter that appeared after the patterns of Skrymir's fur changed shape. The people of Ancient Nosgard believed that power dwelled in language itself. There are not much left today who can decipher the meanings of these runes.

TEXT_EPIC_SKIRIMIR_STONE_1_DESC.text: A prism that incidentally formed where Skrymir tread. Light that passes through this prism seems to take on magical properties.

TEXT_EPIC_SVENJA_STONE_1_DESC.text: The main armament of Svenja’s commander tank. It is a cannonball that contains multiple stacks of lightning magic within a mana shield. Three wizards must work all day to make just one Mana Bomb.

TEXT_EPIC_SWORDEN_STONE_1_DESC.text: A bead containing the essence of the Black Shade-Tiger Blade that B. Sworden obtained after grueling training. Hold it in your hand and close your eyes to hear B. Sworden's voice reciting a decree. It's probably good for insomnia.

TEXT_EPIC_TAOIST_STONE_1_DESC.text: Chen's top-quality makeup in red. It has a spell that makes the user appear even more beautiful.

TEXT_EPIC_THIALFI_STONE_1_DESC.text: You can hardly make out the childish, shaky letters of this worn letter, most of them erased beyond recognition, but these words still clearly remain: "brother" and "thank you."

TEXT_EPIC_TOMBKING_STONE_1_DESC.text: A whip woven with tendons of a lion. It is saturated in the blood and sweat of the Temple laborers.

TEXT_EPIC_TRUEGULLVEIG_STONE_1_DESC.text: Truthful Kalard Gullveig, a crystal of that power. It has the power to twist the fate of the holder and take them closer to the 'truth' that they want subconsciously.

TEXT_EPIC_TYRANT_STONE_1_DESC.text: Unfortunately, there only was enough of the newly discovered substance to make one of these. It will not burn in fire or tear before bullets.

TEXT_EPIC_VAJRAPANI_STONE_1_DESC.text: An ornament that represents one of the letters that symbolize the beginning and end of Hasla.

TEXT_EPIC_VALKYRIESTONESTATUS_STONE_1_DE.text: Anyone pierced by the Svefnthorn falls into eternal slumber. Its form can be found engraved here and there on the ancient stone statues of Nosgard.

TEXT_EPIC_VESSELOFGALATEA_STONE_1_DESC.text: A beautiful feather from the Sacred Being’s wings, glittering in a multitude of different colors depending on the viewer’s angle. Each barb is comprised of molecular wire that can cut anything on contact.

TEXT_EPIC_VESSELOFGALATEA_STONE_2_DESC.text: An artificial spinal cord modeled after Galatea's powerful body. It heightens the user's physical abilities and bestows them supernatural insight.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BAD_REVIEW_1.text: Do you expect me to pay for this?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BAD_REVIEW_2.text: This is the worst thing I've ever eaten. I want a refund.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BAD_REVIEW_3.text: This isn't bread; it's food waste!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_01_ORDER_1.text: Please give me a cream bun.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_01_ORDER_2.text: I want bread with only cream in it.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_02_ORDER_1.text:
I want sausage bread,
but I'm craving chestnuts as well...

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_02_ORDER_3.text: Do sausages and chestnuts taste good together?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_03_ORDER_1.text:
Sausage bread, please.
And maybe some veggies on it for nutrition.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_03_ORDER_2.text: Could you bake mine with vegetables and sausage?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_03_ORDER_3.text: Sausage and vegetables make a great combination!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_04_ORDER_2.text: I'll have a veggie bread, please.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_04_ORDER_3.text: Can I have cream and vegetables in my bread?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_05_ORDER_1.text: Let's top that with vegetables, sausage, and chestnuts!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_05_ORDER_2.text: I'd like to order vegetables, chestnuts, and meat.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_05_ORDER_3.text: I like sausage, vegetables, AND chestnuts on my bread.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_06_ORDER_1.text:
Don't you think chestnuts would be a
great addition to veggie bread?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_06_ORDER_2.text: Vegetables and roasted chestnuts should make a healthy diet!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_06_ORDER_3.text: Could you put some chestnuts with the veggies?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_07_ORDER_1.text:
Put in chestnuts and vegetables, please.
And could you also smear it in cream?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_07_ORDER_2.text:
I'd like something fresh,
topped with chestnuts.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_07_ORDER_3.text:
Veggie bread, please -
topped with chestnuts!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_08_ORDER_2.text: Please give me a cream cheese bun!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_08_ORDER_3.text: I want a load of cheese and cream in my loaf of bread!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_09_ORDER_2.text:
Sausage, cheese,
and vegetables, in that order!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_09_ORDER_3.text: Vegetables, sausage, and cheese are the perfect combination!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_10_ORDER_1.text: Please add chestnuts and cheese to my vegetable loaf.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_10_ORDER_2.text: Can you think of a recipe that uses chestnuts, vegetables, and cheese?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_10_ORDER_3.text: Top that with veggies, chestnuts, and cheese, please?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_11_ORDER_1.text: Can I have a red bean cream bun?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_11_ORDER_2.text: What should I get if I want to eat both a red bean bun and a cream bun?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_11_ORDER_3.text: Cream and red bean go very well together!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_12_ORDER_1.text:
Could you add something to a red bean cream bun
to make it nuttier and sweeter?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_12_ORDER_2.text: I'd like cream, red bean, and chestnuts in mine?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_12_ORDER_3.text: Chestnut red bean cream buns are all the rage right now!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_13_ORDER_1.text: Hmm. Red bean, chestnuts, and cheese sound nice.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_13_ORDER_2.text: Please top my chestnut red bean bread with cheese.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_13_ORDER_3.text: Chestnuts... Red bean... And cheese. How does that sound?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_14_ORDER_1.text: I like my food made from ingredients of the same color.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_14_ORDER_2.text: A chestnut red bean bun with sausages, please!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_14_ORDER_3.text:
Hmm, I wonder what sausages and red bean taste like together?
And let's put some chestnuts in there!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_15_ORDER_1.text: I want walnuts ground into my red bean bun!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_15_ORDER_2.text:
A red bean bun, please,
but I want it chewy.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_15_ORDER_3.text: Do you have any walnut cookies?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_16_ORDER_1.text: Please add sausage, cheese, walnuts, and chestnuts to my order.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_16_ORDER_2.text:
Toppings? Sausage, cheese...
Oh, and walnuts and chestnuts for some texture.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_16_ORDER_3.text: I want a cheese sausage! Please grind in some walnuts and chestnuts, too!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_17_ORDER_1.text:
I'd like to eat a veggie bun, but I also want a red bean bun.
I'd like walnuts however you make it.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_17_ORDER_2.text: Red bean, walnuts, and maybe some vegetables for nutrition?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_17_ORDER_3.text:
Mixing red beans with walnuts make for a delicious dessert.
Will you add some healthy vegetables as well?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_18_ORDER_1.text: I like everything except sausage, veggies, red bean, and olives.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_18_ORDER_2.text: Can you sprinkle some chestnuts and walnuts on my cream cheese bread?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_18_ORDER_3.text:
Sweet cream, flavorful cheese,
savory walnuts, roasted chestnuts...

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_19_ORDER_1.text: I'll have one loaf of ciabatta bread, please.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_19_ORDER_2.text: I just want olives and cheese in my order.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_19_ORDER_3.text:
Do you know why pizza is topped with cheese and olives?
Because it's delicious, that's why!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_20_ORDER_1.text:
I want pizza,
but without the cheese.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_20_ORDER_2.text: Could you put olives and vegetables in that sausage roll?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_20_ORDER_3.text:
I'd like my order to have
vegetables, olives, and sausage.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_21_ORDER_1.text: Please top my cream cheese bread with olives and walnuts.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_21_ORDER_2.text:
I'd like to order olives and walnuts.
Oh, and cream and cheese as well!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_22_ORDER_1.text: I want pizza with ALL the toppings!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_BREAD_22_ORDER_2.text:
I have a craving for a hot dog...
topped with cheese, vegetables, and olives.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_CHEESE_DESC.text:
Well fermented cheese.
Not recommended for people who do not like food high in fat.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_CHESTNUT_DESC.text:
Roasted golden over the fire.
Chew slowly and you can taste the deep sweet flavor much better.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_CREAM_DESC.text:
Thick, rich cream.
Sweet but high in fat.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_GOOD_REVIEW_1.text: This is the best slice of bread I've eaten in my life! Keep it up!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_GOOD_REVIEW_2.text: That was delicious. I'll make sure to come again soon!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_GOOD_REVIEW_3.text: Thank you for the delicious meal!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_LOBBY_TRAINER_01.text: Hmm? Why is he still here?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_LOBBY_TRAINER_02.text: Excuse me! Could you hurry it up a bit?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_LOBBY_TRAINER_03.text:
I said the same thing five minutes ago!
Now, let's pick up the pace!
One, two! One, two!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_OLIVE_DESC.text:
Ripe olives.
They go well with cheese.
