TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_831_1.text: But... But black beans are good for you! You should eat more vegetables, Princess Vivian...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_831_2.text: Stop secretly putting black beans in the rice! You're not my mom!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_832_1.text: Oh, erm... I... I didn't mean to offend you... I just wasn't used to it; I'll be more careful in the future...! I'm so sorry!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_832_2.text: Jack, why do you always call me 'lady'? Do you not want to admit that I'm a Princess of Hell Island?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_833_1.text: I-I think so too... Some people can be very rude...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_833_2.text: Kids these days. They have no respect for their elders. Everything was better when Queen Demona ruled with an iron fist...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_834_1.text: I-I'm a completely normal age for a Dryad! You're the one who should be embarrassed, introducing yourself as twelve-years-old!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_834_2.text: Hey there, grandma. Do people know how old you really are?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_835_1.text: Hmm? Your smell is so addictive...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_836_1.text: I am not so sure. I only had a couple of drinks with them to ease the tension between us, but...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_836_2.text: The other Tiger Generals seem to be avoiding you. Can you think of a reason why?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_837_1.text: Mengqi. Have I done something wrong? I noticed that you only talk with General Hansheng.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_838_1.text: Oh, General Shuwen? Can you hear me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_838_2.text:
... ....
(Zilong... He is a nice enough lad and I am always grateful that he's patient enough to listen to everything I have to say, but he doesn't have to ruminate over his answers to my questions and return with them days after, when I can't remember half of the things I asked him. Diligence is good but too much of a good thing, and you have a lad like Zilong. Perhaps that's the reason why I find him a little difficult to talk to these days... Well, you can't have everything... I wonder if I pushed him too far in our training sessions when he was younger. Maybe a wrong blow to the wrong vein changed his personality and made him like this... Is he still talking? ... Hmm, I heard that they're serving ginseng chicken stew at the Imperial Palace kitchens today... General Hansheng would appreciate a good meal. Yes, that's what I'll do, I'll go and ask if he'll have lunch with me. This year's summer's especially hot and we veterans need to take care of ourselves with good food and plenty of rest. Now, how to get rid of the lad and break into the Palace... Hmm...)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_839_1.text: I usually tend to domestic affairs.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_839_2.text: Zilong, one of the Five Tiger Generals of Chen. Long have I heard of your prowess in battle, but I was never so fortunate to see your feats for myself.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_840_1.text: How are you doing these days, our double agent? I hope you are not thinking of returning to Neth.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_840_2.text: Ugh... Stop teasing me, Zilong. I thought you'd become more serious after becoming a General.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_841_1.text: Hmm... What a magnificent array of glittering gold.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_841_2.text: Ah, Master Ares! Welcome to the 'Golden Full Armor Social Club'!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_841_3.text: A crimson plume set against gold that shines more brightly for the contrast... That man knows a thing or two about fashion.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_843_1.text: Lady Kriemhild, if I could have a word with you...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_843_2.text: I came here to rest, child. Bother me with work some other time, will you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_844_1.text: I won't allow even a single drop of rain to fall on Jarvis's fur!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_844_2.text: Doesn't that umbrella on the top of your head render your raincoat entirely meaningless?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_845_1.text: No matter how much I eat... I'm always hungry...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_845_2.text: What's that, Bo? You smell... a friend?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_846_1.text: Everyone calls this a lion mask, for some reason... when in truth it is an abstract expression of the darkness within the human soul.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_846_2.text: Oh, I haven't seen this type of lion mask before.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_847_1.text: Aye, clothes make the man! I'll be the new Pirate King in no time!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_847_2.text: Harharr! I be likin' yer pluck. Where do ye come from, lad?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_848_1.text: It's not every day you see a man carrying a coffin on his back.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_849_1.text: ... Th-three hours? Wouldn't it be more efficient to learn how to operate a tank than train your body...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_849_2.text: Welcome to Hero Town, Svenja. I will guide you on your basic schedule until you grow familiar with our routine. As you are still new to the job, I would recommend you train three hours before you attempt anything more difficult...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_850_1.text: Of course, Bridget. Whatever other people may say... Nothing changes the fact that you saved my life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_850_2.text: I know you're busy with your new position as a Hero of Hero Town, but you have to visit me at my store whenever you're free, okay?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_851_1.text: I can't wait. I'll come visit whenever you call me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_851_2.text: Svenja! When will we have our next tasting session? I tried out new donut topping combinations. Please come and try them!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_852_1.text: Miel! Let's settle things for good, woman to woman!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_852_2.text: Then come down and face me properly! Hiding behind that big tank of yours... You have no conscience.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_853_1.text: T-that's unfair! You two are ganging up on me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_853_2.text: I don't exactly know what's going on, but you can't be a good person if you're bothering my friend! Hyah!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_853_3.text: You were the one who refused to get down from your tank! We have no other choice. Let's go, Fireaxe!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_854_1.text: Oh, you're that rebel-wannabe from the streets. What goes on between her and me is none of your business.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_854_2.text: Looks like you got away with your crimes, but you better watch out. Miel's out to get you, and she doesn't forget easily.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_855_1.text: You're... a Rapture Science android. Your face seems familiar... Have we met before?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_855_2.text: I'm not an android, I'm a cyborg! Hmm, I've never been on a mission with you before... Oh, Commander Spyro~!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_856_1.text: I remember now... You're that farmer's daughter; I didn't recognize you before... Well, at least you seem happy.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_856_2.text: It's strange how nostalgic I get when I put on these clothes...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_857_1.text: C-critic? I don't think I can do something so professional...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_857_2.text: It's you, isn't it? Chocolat's new favorite customer who tries out all her new recipes? I thought there was a reason her bread was tasting better. Come here, Ms. Critic, try mine too!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_858_1.text: C-Commander Yuria of the Interim Government? M-must hide!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_858_2.text: Oh, I better pretend I didn't see her.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_859_1.text: W-what are you? Why do you have blue skin? Wait, get your hands off my tank!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_859_2.text: Ooh, isn't this the newest model from the Neth Empire? This is neat! And it'll help me with upgrades to my babies, too! Hey, mind if I take a look?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_860_1.text: Someday... I will surpass you, Woompa!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_860_2.text: My name is Woopa, not Woompa. I wanted to make that clear.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_861_1.text: What a charming girl. I might have proposed to her if she didn't come from the Woopa tribe...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_861_2.text: Mamba! You finally - ... Wait, you're not Mamba. Stop hitting on me, jerk.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_862_1.text: Does this look like one of those blasphemous weapons that taints the earth? This is a runway for the insects who fight for me. It’s much better than any gun of any civilization.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_862_2.text: That's a strange gun you have there-woompa.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_863_1.text: I feel from you the divine aura of the all-powerful Quaxolotl. Are you their disciple as well?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_863_2.text: Quaxol-what? Nope, never heard of such a thing in my whole life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_864_1.text: I have no patience for the doubt of foreigners. ... And why is that white-haired man breathing so heavily?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_864_2.text: Ask yourself if the voice you follow… is truly that of a god.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_864_3.text: Pant... Pant... Whew... Huh? Oh, don't mind me. It's just a little habit of mine.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_865_1.text: Sob... Professor... I think I've been scammed...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_865_2.text: Iris, I invested in Rainbow Delivery as well. ... Where's my money?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_866_1.text: D-did you make an investment as well, Principal Wolfram?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_866_2.text: Limited as it may be, the ability to cast teleport magic on an individual level indeed bespeaks astonishing talent. However, as for my investment...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_867_1.text: W-well... The manager in charge of your order has gone missing...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_867_2.text: Hey! It's been days since I ordered my book! Why haven't I received any news of it yet?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_868_1.text: Oh? I think you're mistaking me for someone else!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_868_2.text: Yes, yes... You wanted me to buy one hundred thousand Gold's worth of Pumpkin Cards from you, didn't you~?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_869_1.text: Come to think of it, you've been blacklisted by the Earth Magic Research Facility, haven't you? Of course it's possible!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_869_2.text: Is it possible to... send a letter anonymously?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_870_1.text: It's my duty to inherit the will of Hera and shine your path!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_870_2.text: You don't understand the gravity of your situation. Then again, why do I bother to explain when you refuse to listen?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_871_1.text: Maca-... I mean, Lady Hades. Are you alright? You don't look so good.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_871_2.text: ... Pay it no mind, Hera. I wish to keep to myself.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_872_1.text: Achilles! You'll only tire yourself out if you keep being so angry! Come on, smile for me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_872_2.text: Hrrmph, all your notions of peace and love and whatnot... All child's talk. You are a Senator of Olympus, so act like one!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_873_1.text: Oh, no! I'm sorry for making you worry. I'm alright now, but thank you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_873_2.text: Hera... I heard you were very ill last night. Shall I call for a healer?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_874_1.text: It's hard to face your own stupid mistakes, so what you're doing is amazing! I'll continue to cheer you on!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_874_2.text: Your blindly good intentions and lack of tact remind me of your predecessor.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_875_1.text: Hoho... I am now not much more than the wandering spirit of an old man, but I thank you for your kind welcome.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_875_2.text: Y-Your Majesty, King Snorri the Great, the first king and founder of Nosgard! Your greats feats have been recorded in the annals of history, and they shall be passed down from generation to generation as legends of our strong lineage! I-it is an honor to stand before your mighty presence and work together to rebuild Elder Edda... An honor I had never expected and indeed far overreaches my humble lot! I shall obey your every command, mighty lord of the North! You hold my unworthy life in your hands, Your Majesty!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_876_1.text: It is rewarding indeed to see such magnificient descendants ruling these lands.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_876_2.text: For the first king of Nosgard to help rebuild the lost city of Elder Edda... Nosgard shall rise to greatness before long!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_877_1.text: That is not so. I am not yet ready for eternal slumber, for I have things I must do for the sake of this kingdom. All that wandering was for this second chance at repentance.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_877_2.text: King Snorri, Your Majesty... I beg your forgiveness. It was the sins of the Tribe of the Winter Wind that led you, the great king, to your untimely demise.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_878_1.text: If not for you, I would still be roaming the wintry plains, my memories forever lost. Our friendship remains unchanged, so treat me thus.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_878_2.text: Y-Your Majesty, King Snorri. Shucks, I should have recognized you sooner. Forgive me if I was ever rude to you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_879_1.text: Hoho. So you are the youth who inherited the Winter Wind. A bright young lad you are!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_879_2.text: Ooh, a shining suit of armor... Huh, it's empty!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_880_1.text: You have fine equipment for a mere bird. You shall give it to me-uwuh!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_881_1.text: What an obstinate human-uwuh. Give up. I, like the force of nature itself, cannot be moved-grr!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_881_2.text: Found you at last, you thief of a bear! Give me back my equipment from last year!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_882_1.text: Silence! My research is far too important for you to--growl.... Ah, the effects are... grr... al-grrr-eady wearing off-uwuh....

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_882_2.text: My foolish friend, you cannot reach nirvana through avarice and contempt.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_883_1.text: What good shall feeding those brainless idiots do me? I will not let this fine salmon go to waste-uwuh!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_884_1.text: You have done a fine job this year as well. Here is your promised payment-uwuh.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_884_2.text: Thank you, meow! See you next year, meow!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_885_2.text: Look here, I hear the salmon around these parts is of exceptional quality. Would you be so kind as to spare me a few for my ailing son?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_887_2.text: All those rumors of a bear having great equipment can't lead to nothing. Where can it be? ... Huh, I hear something... behind me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_888_2.text: Whew! That was a long trip. Now, if I can just get my hands on all that fresh salmon, my next potion could be a mast-- AHH!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_889_2.text: Oh! Why are there so many bears around here? It seems dangerous... A-and there's even a talking bear!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_889_3.text: Don't worry. I'll keep you from harm.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_890_1.text: Look more closely. This is a hat, not a hood.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_890_2.text: There can't be two 'little red riding hoods' in this world, you fraud!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_891_1.text: Hrrmph. You should know at least the habitat of the insects you're trying to catch. Go to that oak forest.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_891_2.text: Woah, that's a big beetle! Where'd you find it?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_892_1.text: Make way for Iris, the messenger of love!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_892_2.text: A messenger? Could you deliver my words of utter devotion to my lady-love as well?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_894_1.text: Finally, someone appreciates my graffiti art! Here's a present for my number one fan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_894_2.text: This painting... It is full of such strange energy! I cannot describe it! Très bien! Très beau! Truly your art is magnifique!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_895_1.text: Huh, you have an eye for fashion... Your style isn't half bad, either.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_895_2.text: What a marvelous outfit. The details of that monocle frame are especially splendid.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_896_1.text: Do not wander too far, for the waters are deeper than they seem, my child.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_896_2.text: It's okay! Mew has her dolphin tub- ooh! Are you a fairy of the river, nya?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_897_1.text: Think you can see through my tricks?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_897_2.text: Let me take you down the rabbit hole.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_898_1.text: Hey, what are you guys doing?! Pfft - why did you just dump water on my head?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_898_2.text: C-Commander Spyro! Emergency! A girl's head is on fire!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_898_3.text: Kssh... We act on the count of three... Kssh... One, two...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_899_1.text: T-that looks delicious... P-please... Spare me one...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_899_2.text: W-wait! Stop! I planted these little ones only yesterday!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_900_1.text: Why the long face, Wolfgang? It is not too late to swear fealty to Lord Odin, you and I together!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_900_2.text: You were an innocent man when we first met... You have changed, old friend, and I fear that the fault lies with me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_901_1.text: Odin Snorrison! Long have I wished to throw in my lot with a mighty man like you! I implore you to take me on your next adventure!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_901_2.text: Ah, Captain Hrolf. Your reputation precedes you. Yet the revival of Elder Edda is more urgent, and I require your assistance there.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_902_1.text: Immature ideals of diplomacy and peace only turn Nosgardians weak and submissive. It is time to reawaken the mighty spirit of these lands!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_902_2.text: Hrolf, I had expected much more of you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_903_1.text: Your majestic aura tells me that you are no ordinary warrior! Come, I challenge you to a duel!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_903_2.text: Fervor without discretion hews all in its path - including oneself. I shall help you find your way.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_904_1.text: The soul of Nosgard lies with the honor of its mighty warriors, and who better to lead the future of this kingdom than me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_904_2.text: (You hypocrite. Thousands of innocent Nosgardians died due to your intentional retreat. One day, I shall deal with you - and impart to you a most unfitting death, an eternal nightmare from where there shall be no escape.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_905_1.text: Why defend those fools of the Council, Zeus?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_905_2.text: Think of your family's sacrifice, Medea! You should be ashamed!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_906_1.text: My poor child... Wait a little longer, and I shall save you from the wheel of ill fate that binds you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_906_2.text: Hee hee, the plants seem happy today as well. I'll take good care of you - I'll water you every day and give you lots and lots of love!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_907_1.text: Huhu... That time has not yet arrived, dear. In the meantime, won't you deliver this flower pot?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_907_2.text: Lady Medea! I safely delivered your latest parcel! S-so... Will you finally tell me where Arche is?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_908_1.text: The young witch had some remarkably interesting research data on her. I suppose I must thank you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_908_2.text: Sigh... I knew this would be a waste of my time.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_909_1.text: Oh, the family resemblance is stronger than when I first saw you. You survived longer than my expectations.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_909_2.text: I-I found you at last! It was you, wasn't it? The one who shackled me to this spirit! I don't need it anymore - take it back!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_910_1.text: Mew of the Revolutionary Army... I always wanted to investigate the strange mechanism of your energy source 'Mew waves.'

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_910_2.text: Fly with what? 'Mew waves,' nya? I've never heard of such nonsense, nya.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_911_1.text: The blue demon of the Revolutionary Army... R-0! Don't you dare block my path again!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_911_2.text: Confirmed dimensional fissure energy waves from subject. Hypothesizing existence of parallel universes... Am I known by such a name in your version of the universe?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_912_1.text: I see you've grown up. The last time... or dimension I saw you, you were still a bratty little kid who had a tendency for tantrums.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_912_2.text: I don't know who you are, but you'd better be on your way. Or else!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_913_1.text: Aren't you curious of Spyro's appearance? I've seen him without his mask before, you know.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_913_2.text: I-I am... But I can be patient and wait until he trusts me enough to show me himself, ma'am!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_914_1.text: Hmm? Where did your cute vice commander run off to, Yuria?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_914_2.text: Levine Ludovico. I never had a vice commander. ... But I have to ask: what are you wearing...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_915_1.text: Oh, I am essentially superior to that weakling.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_915_2.text: Caroline... I thought I defeated you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_916_1.text: Oh, this little cat recognizes me, doesn't she?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_916_2.text: Nya-ack! C-Caroline! What are you doing in this dimension?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_917_1.text: Demeter, is it true that there were many diverse types of rye flour, depending on the degree of refinement? What ratio of rye and wheat do you use for your flour? Also, I'm curious about your recipes! What inspires you? Oh, we can talk about so many things together!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_917_2.text: Do you really think I'm going to impart company secrets to you, my competitor? Pant, pant... I'm glad - pant - that you finally realized the superiority of rye bread, but... Pant, pant... How much longer do we have to run?! Pant, pant... I think I'm going to pass out...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_918_1.text: Don't worry! I've become stronger, so this is nothing to me now! Hee hee, carrying all those sacks of flour every day sure helped!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_918_2.text: Chocolat, let me give you a hand. Those packages look heavy.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_919_1.text: Sweet Pea? I don't remember any customer with such an adorable name... I'm sorry, but we're sold out for the day! Please come back another day, thank you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_919_2.text: E-excuse me, is this Chocolat's Bakery? My friend Sweet Pea - I-I mean, my friends purchased some bread here and have been praising it ever since. Erm, could I also buy one...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_920_1.text: Really? I'm happy that you think so, Lednas! But I know that I can still do more! Can we start my new training right away, today?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_920_2.text: You are quick to learn, Chocolat. I have never had a Hero recruit adapt so quickly to our schedule, especially the morning sessions. Starting this week, we'll readjust the intensity of your schedule and train together.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_921_1.text: Bridget, I don't think I've ever thanked you for your advice! I'd never have realized the importance of muscular health and training if it hadn't been for you. That being said, I think I still have a long way to go ahead of me. I'll reconsider your offer once I'm satisfied with myself and my bread!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_921_2.text: I heard your bakery was a tremendous success, Chocolat! Hee hee, I hope my advice helped. When do you expect to hold your next event? If we combine our forces together, I'm sure we can make a profitable deal and boost our revenue!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_922_1.text: Penqueen Olga! Stop brainwashing my people and using them as transportation!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_922_2.text: Bears are good for riding! Bears are really good for riding! Bears are so much fun!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_922_3.text: Let's see what they have to say...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_923_1.text: Grr... Idiots! These salmon are meant for genius bears like me! You'll never get your hands on them!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_923_2.text: Stop hogging all the salmon for yourself, you selfish brute! Can't you hear the young cubs of our tribe crying in hunger?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_923_3.text: Let's see what they're fighting over...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_924_1.text: Huh, you have some good equipment for a birdbrain. Hand them over, growl!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_924_2.text: A funny-looking bear! A funny-looking bear! I want it! I want it for my collection!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_924_3.text: Here, let me temporarily translate their roars and squawks into a language you understand.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_925_1.text: I... found myself trapped inside an iceberg when I woke up, but I don't know the reason why-woompa...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_925_2.text: You, too?! Rex, look! People seem to get stuck in icebergs much more often than we thought!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_925_3.text: They should have much more in common than they expect. Let's help them out a little...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_926_1.text: Burn, fires of Hell! Burn everything down into a frenzy of flames!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_926_3.text: You do know that she won't listen to any of us, right?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_927_1.text: Hee hee, behold my ferocious flames!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_927_2.text: Eek! T-take your flames out of my pumpkin patch! RIGHT THIS INSTANT!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_928_1.text: Hmm. Going without armor might make for a nice change.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_929_1.text: Do I look cooler with or without my armor? It's so hard to decide.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_929_2.text: Hmm... I hold that you can't be a superhero without a proper costume!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_930_1.text: Harpya... Is that a new expression of your frustration and hatred of me? Or if you are being forced to wear that atrocity against your will, say one word, so that I may avenge your dignity and atone for my sins.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_930_2.text: ... I like wearing this. I feel like I have been reborn and freed from my painful past...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_931_2.text: I hope you are together with your loved ones...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_932_1.text: If it wasn't for you, Miel, I'd still be a noisy, badmouthing loner stuck in the Junkyard. So - thanks.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_932_2.text: Oh, Tess! What's gotten into you today? You're embarrassing me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_933_1.text: Hey there STOP and gimme a beat! Shut up and LISTEN, 'cuz you know you missin' out on Tess's game with your claim that I ain't worth a pretty coin! But here's my point: I'm much more than what you say, so better raise your pay and let TESS color you impressed.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_933_2.text: No, this bounty is large enough for a petty criminal. If you think otherwise, I advise you to raise your standards.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_934_1.text: HEY Fireaxe! XO CREW TESS ON THE BEAT! Without your flames things got dark; girl, missed you when we were apart! But I kept fighting by your side, you know that's the truth inside. Far or near we stand together, that's how it's gonna be forever. XO CREW TESS ON THE BEAT my name and yours we march on!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_934_2.text: Tess... You're the same as ever. Just like the old days.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_935_1.text: HEY! Basquiat! We're different but the same, like peanut butter and jelly; with our RAP & GRAFFITI we make the world cry out our name! WE'RE ARTISTS! That's where my heart is!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_935_2.text: We're ARTISTS! Make the world cry out our name! You rock, Tess!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_936_1.text: W-what is this ridiculously fast rap...? Can he be... the fabled 'king of rap'?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_936_2.text: You remind me of myself in my youth. I too was once a young man with a heart full of ambition and passion hot enough to roast chestnuts with. I don't mean that figuratively - Uncle Wang, the chestnut merchant at the village crossroads, once hired me as a part-timer for that very ability! Ah, those were the good ol' days... I was foolhardy enough to challenge many obstacles that lay before me, growing disappointed once I found out that some things are too corrupt or too absurd to change for the better. For some time I even shunned food and became mute; so angry I'd become after realizing the way of the world! But you must remember that in life there are more blessings in disguise than you think. For people who stayed by my side, dear companions, helped me back to my feet so that I could continue on my path. The most memorable among them was a particular friend who served me an unforgettable meal of shark fin soup that permanently left a warm feeling in my emptied stomach...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_937_1.text: What beautiful hair you have, the color of the ocean. You remind me of a girl I knew a long time ago. Had she lived, I feel that you would have shared a close resemblance...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_937_2.text: And your hair, it is the color of the rainbow... I feel that we have met somewhere, before.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_938_1.text: A desperate desire to protect a precious memory, I suppose.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_938_2.text: While the other patron saints of these lands lost their power, only you managed to protect your river. Whence flow your strength and courage?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_939_1.text: Ah, a tiger patron saint of the mountains. Perhaps you know where Hanee Baram is?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_939_2.text: Huh? You're the Guardian of the River! What are you doing here? Did you lose your home to humans, too?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_940_1.text: I envy your powers of communicating with beings of the underworld. Perhaps you could tell me... news of a certain girl I once knew?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_940_2.text: Do not let your thoughts dwell on those who have left the realm of the living.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_941_1.text: He must be to you as the one who gifted me this pebble is to me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_941_2.text: Oh, your feathers are so pretty! A good friend of mine could do with some colors in his life... Could you give me one of your feathers, if you don't mind? I owe him my life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_942_1.text: I recognize you, old man... You saved my life, once.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_942_2.text: Ah! Of course I remember you: the son of the kind-hearted gentleman who treated me to a delicious pie when I was starving in the streets of Edenberg. I tried not to show my hunger, but that meat pie smelled so good that I couldn't help myself lingering in front of the bakery window. Ah, I can still remember the taste of the meat pie on my tongue: a wondrous harmony of rich gravy and crispy crust. I'd been confident until then that my favorite food in this wide world was dumplings, but that first bite destroyed any prejudice against Western cuisine I had. But after gulping down the whole pie, my stomach began to hurt... Turns out that my body can't handle gluten! I ran faster than the wind to the nearby lavatory, unaware of the disaster that would soon strike the feast. Although I managed to save you from further harm... I still regret not having been able to save everyone. Had I come out more quickly, or not eaten the pie, or was born with a more gluten-tolerant body, the disaster could have been averted... But then again, if I hadn't caught a whiff of that delicious pie and lingered long enough until meeting your father, I might have met you, so I 'spose I must say that the world works in mysterious ways. But what happened to your arm? Your prosthetic arm reminds me of another person whom I met on my travels -

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_943_1.text: Why... Why me? Why did you have to ruin my life?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_944_1.text: What have you done to my body?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_944_2.text: Did you truly believe that you could defeat Pandemonium with brute force alone? With a mere human's physique? Oh, what fun experiments we'll do on you...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_945_1.text: What did you just call this junk attached to my arm? Speak!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_945_2.text: Analyzing prosthetic arm... Confirmed to be an isolated section of a more advanced mainframe.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_946_1.text: 'Trademark design'? You speak as if this - this deformity was an artwork! If I could, I'd rip it out right this second!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_946_2.text: Oh, that left arm of yours... Yes, I recognize the trademark design. Why don't you let me upgrade your right one, and see which you prefer? Haha!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_947_1.text: Ooh, you're so cute! Do you want to be my little brother? I've always wanted one!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_947_2.text: Do you... not recognize me? All things considered, I would be your elder brother, not younger.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_948_1.text: Where have you been? We worried about you! Come on, let's go see Hanee Baram!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_948_2.text: I do not feel up to the task. And... I advise you both not to put too much faith in humans.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_949_1.text: Hey there, Malsook! I hear you're Halla's friend! That makes us friends, too!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_949_2.text: Guardian Spirits... Heaven knows why they require so much attention.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_950_1.text: Sniff, sniff! You smell like the ocean breeze! I like you, would you like to be friends?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_950_2.text: If you are Eungaram's companion, then of course you are welcome.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_951_1.text: Huh? That's a nice hammer you have there, perfect for a powerful beat! Come play a duet with me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_951_2.text: This is a weapon, not a musical instrument.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_952_1.text: For aeons have I wandered through countless dimensions before fate stopped my journey here. I have no recollection of what I once called home.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_952_2.text: The sample I took from the medical wards... was an unidentified element not found anywhere in Hasla. Where do you come from?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_953_1.text: The one whose presence you sense is not me, but my friend. Dare to harm her, and you shall have to answer to me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_953_2.text: You reek of magic... Dragon magic. Are you the one sworn to be my enemy?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_954_1.text: I have no memories, but I know all whom I once called kin are now dead and gone.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_954_2.text: Oh, a fellow Frost Elf! I've never met another of our kind before in the city!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_955_1.text: My memories reverberate... but with what? Are you one of the few who know my past? I must see your face under that mask.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_955_2.text: Ksssh... You should be... still unconscious.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_956_1.text: You have a familiar face. I have seen you before, somewhere - but where, and when?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_957_1.text: Huh~! Are you the little man's daughter? I can see the family resemblance!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_957_2.text: DAD!!! Hey! What do you think you are, destroying our home like this?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_958_1.text: Oh, you're much smarter than the other little girl. That tiny queen of yours will live to see another day, thanks to you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_958_2.text: T-that human is dangerous... I can't move...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_959_1.text: Oh, so people of these lands make wishes on falling stars? Hmm, if you ask nicely, I could help you with that...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_959_2.text: Ooh, a shooting star! Wait! Oh, no. I forgot to make my wish again...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_960_1.text: Erm, old lady? Can you get off my back?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_960_2.text: Let those tiny humans be, Devran. They too are people of Roman, under my protection!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_961_1.text: What~? You're searching for - snort! - 'strong ones to challenge'? Hahaha! Well, I can tell you that it won't be difficult!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_961_2.text: Argh... Graviton shouldn't exist in this dimension...! You... What are you...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_962_1.text: I hate you, Pius! You're ALWAYS nagging at me! You probably WERE always nagging at me before we lost our memories! I came here to have a good time and I'm honestly feeling so attacked right now!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_962_2.text: Schild... Those little beings are not your playthings. You must remember that we too are now bound by the laws of this dimension.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GG4_0_1.text: Are humans from another world rare?

TEXT_INTERACTION_GG4_2_1.text: Hmm~? What's up? I'm a bit busy right now.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GG4_3_1.text: This world may have a completely different history from mine but it has a common culture. For example... Well, it doesn't really matter.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GG4_4_1.text: If you want to get a check-up, fill out the form and wait a bit.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GG4_5_1.text: It's all just for entertainment. Your loss if you don't enjoy it.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_2_1.text:
Just buy me a drink later.
A silver-ranked adventurer is saying that he'll slay some goblins for you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_3_1.text:
I'm going to slay some goblins, too!
But only if you'll come with us again on a real adventure!

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_4_1.text: You'll need to buy me more than one drink, Beardcutter. I'm going to need a whole barrel.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_4_2.text: Understood. I'll get one for you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_5_1.text:
How could I refuse a request from a friend?
But if I were to ask for a reward...

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_5_2.text: Cheese, is it... and Ice Cream?

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_6_1.text:
A horde of goblins, huh?
How shall we fight them?

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_6_2.text:
I have a strategy.
But I have a favor to ask of you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_7_2.text:
No.
But if any more goblins appear, call for me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_GOSL_8_1.text: A good Goblin? I guess there might be one if you looked really hard. But in the end, the only good Goblins are the ones who never come out of their holes.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_RZ_01.text: I entrust Rem to your care, Barusu.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_RZ_03.text: Should I grant your strange request, I wonder?

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_RZ_04.text: Thank you, Subaru. For saving me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_02.text: Als Kapitän des Schiffes möchte ich mich entschuldigen.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_03.text: Ich könnte mehr Proviant gebrauchen, aber es wird schon reichen.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_04.text: Ich tue mein Bestes, um deine Wunden zu heilen.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_05.text: Für unseren Schmied zu Hause wäre das hier eine Kleinigkeit.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_06.text: Manche Flüchtlinge haben eine Geschichte, die nicht so schnell zu erzählen ist, mein rothaariger Freund.

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_07.text: (Schiffbruch gleich nach dem ersten Aufbruch … Ich bin hier das Wrack.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_09.text: (Wir sollten jetzt die andere Seite der Insel absuchen …)

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_10.text: (Das Dorf der Schiffbrüchigen ist ganz schön voll geworden.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_11.text: (Wir müssten hier wegkommen, sobald wir das Boot fertig haben.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_12.text: (Das wird nicht leicht … Aber immerhin haben wir Hoffnung.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_13.text: (Der Bau des Schiffs scheint gute Fortschritte zu machen.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_LOBBY_YS8_14.text: (Großartig! Es wird Zeit, diese Insel zu verlassen!)

TEXT_INTERACTION_OT_1_1.text: May the Sacred Flame light your path...

TEXT_INTERACTION_OT_5_1.text: Hehe, this isn't a bad stage.

TEXT_INTERACTION_OT_8_1.text: Standest thou against me? Then be hunted.

TEXT_ITEM_FISHING_FLOAT_EVENT_LONELY_BOK.text: A float designed in the shape of a pufferfish, also known as a bubblefish. It fills you up with a warm and bubbly feeling, reminding you of the warm memories shared with the Lonely Pufferfish.

TEXT_ITEM_GOLD_HELP.text: Ein Goldmünze. Wird in Hasla häufig benutzt.

TEXT_ITEM_HERO_HELP.text: Bosse haben eine feste Chance, dein Gefährte zu werden.

TEXT_ITEM_HONOR_HELP.text: Ein Zeichen der Ehre. Nutze es, um Aufgaben für Helden durchzuführen.

TEXT_ITEM_JEWEL_HELP.text: Ein fein gearbeitetes Juwel. Es ist sehr wertvoll, also setze es klug ein.

TEXT_ITEM_POINT_HELP.text: Punkte, die du für wertvolle Käufe erhältst. Damit kannst du seltene Schätze im Shop kaufen oder wichtige Aufgaben durchführen.

TEXT_ITEM_TICKET_HELP.text: Ein Ticket zum Eintritt in das Kolosseum.

TEXT_ITEM_TICKET_KURENAI_HELP.text: Eine Platte mit einem eingravierten roten Lotus. Damit kannst du die Dungeons von Legende der Urflammen betreten.

TEXT_ITEM_TICKET_RHYTHM_HELP.text: A ticket used to play songs at the Hasla Music Festival. One ticket is required to play one song.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_BINGO_DESC.text: A quill pen made out of a magical golden feather. It is used in the Bingo Event.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_BOSSRUSH_DESC.text: You can trade Ordeal Tokens for various rewards.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_CHOCOLA_DESC.text: Special currency for the Chocolat Event.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_HEROPASS_HELP.text: The symbol of one's heart, required to gain a Hero's trust.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_MAZE_DESC.text: Required to make progress in the Maze.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_RHYTHM_HELP.text: A token acquired by playing a song at the Hasla Music Festival. It can be used to purchase various prizes at the Music Festival Shop.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_SEASONAL_EVENT_DESC.text: A special token used to participate in seasonal events.

TEXT_ITEM_TOKEN_STOCK_DESC.text: A special token issued by Bridget for the Hero Town Captain's Choice Poll.

TEXT_ITEM_WALL_HELP.text: Ein Hintergrund für das Zuhause deines Helden.

TEXT_ITEM_WEAPON_03_HELP.text: A chest containing a random 5-Star Normal Weapon.

TEXT_MATERIAL_FIFTH_BB_1_DESC.text: Debris of an unidentifiable mineral. The use of it is also a mystery. With a cryptic message written on it, there is a lengthy script: “Now I know why I was needed - because I’ve seen a type of mineral just like this before. Ever since that experience, I could somewhat understand these fragments and to explain HOW I understand them I have to go back and tell you about the time when I was one of the Five Tiger Generals. You see, I was having a real hard time watching my fellow soldiers fall and didn’t even like the job, to be honest. And this guy tells me that he has to make some stone? And to make the stone, he needs to spiritually complete himself so he needs to work on that... I mean, I couldn’t believe what I was hearing. You’re sitting on a huge pile of money and telling me this nonsense? Seriously, people are dying? Anyway, so, he shows me this stone saying that it is pretty much indestructible, and it is of Heaven. And… I broke it, like, right there. I’m not bragging or anything but I didn’t even try that hard. And, oh boy, here comes the waterworks – he starts screaming and bawling… By the way, the message here says [DOTMAGNUMOPUSCQ], just so you know. Where was I? Yeah, the waterworks, yeesh…” (There seems to be limited space for further story...)

TEXT_MONUMENT_BUGLC_03_DESC.text:
Grüße, Crusader! 
 Glückwünsche zum Auffinden dieses geheimen Briefes.
 Wir bereiten momentan das Update „Saison 2: Erbe“ vor, du kannst dich also auf viele neue Inhalte freuen. Wir hoffen, dich bald wieder zu sehen!
 Herzliche Grüße, Crusaders Quest PD Sungmin

TEXT_MONUMENT_BUGLC_05_DESC.text: Hello, Captains! CQ has already met its fourth anniversary. We thank each and every one of you for your love and support, and promise to make a better CQ for all Captains. We love you!!

TEXT_MONUMENT_BUGLC_06_DESC.text:
Hello, Captains! It's an honor to be celebrating the fifth anniversary of Crusaders Quest with you. Thank you for all your love and support for these five years, and we hope to see you for many more years to come. We love you! 
- Team CQ -

TEXT_MONUMENT_BUGLC_07_DESC.text: Greetings, Crusaders! Six years have gone by so fast! Thank you for staying with us for all this time. We hope to bring you many more happy memories in Hasla for years to come. Best regards, CQ Devs

TEXT_MONUMENT_BUGLC_08_DESC.text: Thank you for celebrating the 7th Anniversary of Crusaders Quest! These past seven years have been an invaluable, exciting adventure for us - an adventure that wouldn't have been possible without your love and support. We hope that we continue to bring you much joy and fun through the world of Crusaders Quest for years to come. We love you! - CQ Devs

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_01_DESC.text: A rooster with white feathers and a fancy comb. It was clearly named with a certain fate in mind.

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_02_DESC.text: A cow of the Holstein dairy breed that retains a dignity befitting its name. When asked where she found such a superior creature, Lenny only grins for an answer. How suspicious!

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_03_DESC.text: A sheep with fluffy fur that reminds you of a certain sweet and cloudlike candy. It is smarter than it looks and eats only wild grass that can damage your farm.

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_04_DESC.text: A duck with white feathers. As a duckling it was thought to be an oddly colored swan, but it ended up being a duck after all. So much for fairy tales.

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_05_DESC.text: A cat rescued from Neth Empire labs. It's rumored that secret experiments gave Schrodinger powers, but if he doesn't use it, does it exist? Hmm...

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_PREMIER_01_DESC.text: A camel trained for battle in Southwestern Hasla's warzones. A certain merchant purchased the entire battle camel herd, took the guns off, and attached sprinklers to their humps.

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_PREMIER_02_DESC.text: The captain of wild alpacas that are native to the wildlands of Nosgard. It seems to resemble a certain someone.

TEXT_ORCHARD_ANIMAL_PREMIER_03_DESC.text: A descendant of the royal canine family of Grancia: adorable, intelligent, and well-behaved, if a little shy. Before being adopted into the royal line, these dogs were raised to herd sheep and cattle.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_01_DESC.text: A raggedy old scarecrow made out of tattered cloth and wood. Lenny found it abandoned by its previous owner and patched it up.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_02_DESC.text: The scarecrow captain of Lenny's Orchard. Its bird-chasing abilities are superb.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_03_DESC.text: A scarecrow that resembles a tin woodcutter. Someone seems to have put some red cloth inside its body, although nobody knows the reason why.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_04_DESC.text: The top scarecrow of Demeter's wheat fields. It was sent by Demeter herself to commemorate her first successful trade with Lenny.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_05_DESC.text: This catcher is quite a catch! Once used by Demeter to cultivate her famous golden fields, it is now sold cheaply to all farmers looking for a good bargain.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_PREMIER_01_DESC.text: A scarecrow crafted in the likeness of Grim Reaper. It was meant to come across as frightening, but its unwittingly endearing appearance has led to an increase in popular demand among households.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_PREMIER_02_DESC.text: A scarecrow with a burning pumpkin head, rumored to be actually Dullahan in disguise. When confronted with such questions, the scarecrow remains silent. Maybe they were just rumors... maybe.

TEXT_ORCHARD_SCARECROW_PREMIER_03_DESC.text: An inflatable balloon that "dances" on its own. Its flailing arms and wild movements prove surprisingly efficient at chasing away birds.

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_01_DESC.text: This part-time worker is trading in his hours for valuable experience that will help towards owning his own orchard in the future!

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_02_DESC.text: An apprentice who applied for a job at Lenny's farm after failing her civil service exams for Grancia Empire. She's finding the working environment a lot more comfortable.

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_03_DESC.text: A mysterious man who arrived at Lenny's Orchard one day, asking for a job. Since then he has proven his worth and has been hired as a full-time employee.

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_04_DESC.text: An old man whose love for trees provides great help around Lenny's Orchard. He often talks about 'the Giving Ent,' an Ent that loved him and gave him everything it could in his youth.

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_05_DESC.text: A Ratman diplomat from Trista's underground sewers. Rumors have it that that he was picked after an intense rock-paper-scissors match.

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_PREMIER_01_DESC.text: Always the dutiful daughter, Sim Cheong has come to Lenny's Orchard to obtain fruit for her blind father. However, Lenny refuses to go near her, as Sim Cheong's conqueror's aura knocks everyone out around her.

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_PREMIER_02_DESC.text: The outdated prototype of a mass-produced line of Neth Empire battle androids. Lenny bought these right before they got junked and refurbished them into workers for her Orchard.

TEXT_ORCHARD_STAFF_PREMIER_03_DESC.text: The traveling merchants Popo and Toto came to Lenny's Orchard in search of new merchandise to sell. They are now working part-time at the Orchard to take advantage of the employee discount.

TEXT_PROFILE_CONDITION.text: This information is unlocked on recruiting the ★6 Hero.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_1.text: Her stumble into a nearly abandoned foxhole yielded no game for her fruitless hunt, but a chance meeting with a trembling cub who waited for parents that would not return. Gon, in a striking moment of sympathy - for she too was a young girl with no family - took the baby fox with her, and gave him the name "Foxy." The two have been inseparable ever since, but Gon has noticed that Foxy seems to find her bothersome as of late.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_10.text: Tradition decreed that Magnus be betrothed to noble blood from childhood. Political complications surrounding the throne, however, nullified the engagement. Even so, Magnus cannot understand how an Elf of lowly cache could have stolen her way in the meantime into his guarded heart, like spring sunshine that softens the frozen ground. Never has the conceited Elf been so full of chagrin at his own foolishness. He cannot possibly pursue this infatuation… and yet, another thought continues to pull at him: can this be love, that noble sentiment, sung and embellished so beautifully in minstrel’s song and poet’s verse? Magnus will admit, at least, that these new emotions arouse in him excitement that he has not known before, an anticipation for the morning when he sets out to find Sigruna. Perhaps he will realize one day that difference in rank matters not before love. He must listen to what his heart tells him.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_11.text: Perhaps it is the consequence of her child’s body that does not grow, but Demona is strongly affected by any intake of alcohol. Once, when she accidentally took a bite of whiskey-infused chocolate, she became hyper to the extent that Melissa had to restrain her from attacking passersby for several arduous days. Although Demona asserts that she does not like her status or title as the first queen of Hell, the land of demons, inebriation unveils her usually hidden sympathy and sense of responsibility towards her people.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_12.text: To balance his studies, archery practice, and relationship with Rebecca, twenty-four hours a day is simply not enough for Altair. If only, he sighs, there was some kind of magic that allowed him to turn back time and relive the bygone hours... But that is wishful thinking. He must do what he can do: complete all his tasks with the utmost efficiency, then dash off to see – at last! – Rebecca’s lovely, beaming smile.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_13.text: Anyone who looks into Atalante's innocent, almost child-like eyes can't help but tell her the truth and accept whatever she says as the truth. The charms of the archer's sweet smile disguise the sharpness of her tongue, and belatedly do her admirers realize that she is not all ray of sunshine.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_14.text: Advanced technology he has never dreamt the likes of, mechanized weapons, astonishing skyscrapers, elegant army uniforms... His wonder at his new life with Viper in the Neth Empire does not fade with passing time. It matters little now that he had to make sacrifices, for he would have made the same decision anyway. If there is one aspect of the city life that bothers him greatly, then it is the abundance of androids everywhere. Although androids have become inseparable to the everyday life of the people of Neth, Mamba will have nothing to do with “those afflictions to nature-woompapa” if he can help it.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_15.text: What prevented the numerous assassination attempts on the life of the Emperor was not any calculated feat of loyalty, but the dancer naturally acting on her keen intuition. When the courtiers of Chen praise her for her virtuous fidelity and courage, Lee becomes incredibly sheepish and awkward.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_16.text: Just as Rahima deems Yumir her family, so too does she love Yumir’s offspring as her own. When Yumir’s first eggs hatched, Rahima provided what comfort she could to both her beloved hawk and Yumir’s new chicks. The tiny hatchlings rapidly grew under Rahima and Yumir’s care, until time came for them to take their first flight. Nature took its course - the runt of the family broke his wings in his effort, and Yumir prepared to abandon him, following the natural law of the survival of the fittest. Rahima, for the first time since meeting Yumir, disagreed with her hawk. She would not give up on anyone. She would ensure that all of them survived. After all, wasn’t she herself alive only because Yumir hadn’t given up on her? With Rahima’s help, all of Yumir’s fledglings safely reached adulthood. Today they await their mothers’ call not too far away, always ready to help Rahima and Yumir on their journey.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_17.text: When is the last time she managed a good night's sleep? Viola spends up every night helping stray ghosts, and therefore lacks both the energy and the motivation to socialize with living people. Most human beings shun her anyway, complaining that a chill runs up their spine whenever they stumble upon the gloomy girl: an unfortunate consequence of the specters that surround her. Cold even in summer due to her unconventional condition, Viola can always be found wearing a thick cape, to the added confusion of others.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_18.text: Kaguya is merely the daughter of a provincial noble, but she seems, to the imagination of the people of her country, a princess, like the one lost long ago with the abolishment of the monarchy. And she is treated like one. No one can refuse Kaguya when, with a sweet, gentle voice like the delicate cherry blossoms of her garden, she asks those around her for a "small" favor. Only one person sees through the girl and her smile: Himiko, the Priestess of Ryu. But even Himiko cannot help but give in to Kaguya's requests when the latter puts her mind to it. It is fortunate for the kingdom of Ryu that their blithe princess has not a sliver of malice in her sunny heart.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_19.text: To Chiron, Hess is more than a teacher. It was Hess who rescued him, a helpless orphan crying on the ravaged battlefield, and raised him as his own. It was Hess who taught him everything he knows today. His instructor – his father – his savior, is what Hess means to him. Yet his sincere respect doesn’t seem to carry across for some strange and unknown reason. When Chiron shaved his hair completely bald to “emulate” his great teacher, he experienced the full brunt of Hess’s unrestrained rage for the first time in his life.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_2.text: There should be no faster man in Hasla than him, Hanzo believes. He continues to diligently train with the faith that his only worthy rival must be himself of yesterday. But the convolutions of business are another matter, and Hanzo sometimes thinks that he could have - and should have - developed his newspaper delivery service much further than what it is now. How did those witches of Pumpkin City do it, he wonders?

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_20.text: Before losing his vision, Hansung was a man of great vanity whose desire for advancement overshadowed his skill in combat. Yet after a stray arrow interrupted his campaign for influence, Hansung saw, for the first time, what his own blindness had hidden from him. For the loss of his sight granted Hansung greater insight into not only the hollowness of his own heart but also the deficiencies in his own ability; the blind man thus became a greater man and a greater archer than he ever had been. Hansung has learned to rely on his other senses to navigate the world; such is the reason he does not appreciate the rather frequent visits of Shuwen, who always smells of grass, dirt, and sweat.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_21.text: His laid-back personality and sharp tongue belie Set's fondness for Osiris and Isis, whom he has clothed, fed, taught, and protected from their childhood. Now that "the kids are all grown up," Set frequently grumbles that he will someday leave them for a long-coveted life of his own, but everyone knows he doesn't have the heart to abandon his own and only family. The three of them will always be together, come what may. It is no wonder that the overprotective Set has been suspicious of a certain archeologist from foreign lands, the newest addition to their group.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_22.text: Genevie's memories of her deceased parents, who had been devout followers of the Order of the Goddess, greatly helped her polish her act as a nun. What jewelry she manages to steal, the thief hides under a marked podium in the church. Not that she manages her treasure wisely: whenever trouble brews in the village, Genevie retrieves her spoils and, in effect, returns them to the people from whom she had stolen. Not surprisingly, her treasure trove is now completely empty. Genevie does not mind, however. She admits that she has grown to appreciate the villagers' love and affection, perhaps the true treasure she has found in this little town.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_23.text: When his wife was pregnant with their child, Panpan dreamt of picking a luscious peach in the Peaks of Glory and taking an exquisite bite. His wife was convinced that the child would be a daughter and, predicting that she would be an adventurous child who would have many adventures in foreign lands, she insisted on giving their unborn cub the exotic name of 'Elizabeth.' The couple predicted wrong, however: a boy was born not too long afterwards. But Panpan's wife tragically passed away in childbirth, and, deep in sorrow, the panda decided that his newborn son would be named Elizabeth anyway, in her memory.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_24.text: She is the queen of spiders. She is a fearless soldier who fights by Athena’s side. She is also a teenage girl who has a healthy interest in boys. Arachne has never been in a romantic relationship before; the only present she wants for her twentieth birthday is a date. But she also worries that she won’t be able to find anyone who can see her for whom she truly is, as opposed to a “freak” or a “monster.” Oh, if only everyone in the world was more like Athena!

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_25.text: The immigrant population of Trista are recognized for their relatively darker skin and distinct culture and language. Once, long ago, they were a proud people who ruled over their beautiful, prospering kingdom in the desert. Yet ruin found them, and they wandered through the wildlands, their former glory lost. Many found their way to the nearby kingdom of Trista, and there they stayed, for they had no home of their own. Lindsey knows the history of her people - and too well the deep antagonism directed towards them. Even today she fights the lonely war for the dignity and justice her people deserve.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_26.text: As the Oracle of Water, her memories and nightmares fuse as one. There are times when they wash over her and she is once more lost and afraid, and she looks for anything that will anchor her to her present. Grandfather's tea, what only remains of him, pierces her tongue - but not her dreams that last eternal.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_28.text: After breaking up with Mamba, Malkah declared herself the official relationship counselor of her tribe. Putting aside the fact that Malkah has never actually been in a meaningful relationship, her advisees find her therapies cathartic; seeing their self-appointed therapist passionately attacking the shortcomings of their ex-lovers, they say, somehow soothes away the agonies of failed love.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_29.text: There is a saying in Nosgard that white crows are the heralds of death. It originated from the testimonies of those who repeatedly witnessed Ran standing atop a pile of mutilated corpses, a lone figure amidst settling dust. Ran too has heard of the proverb but does not think much of it, save for the possibility that her reputation may reach the ears of the 'real' crow of the battlefield. If – or when – Crow returns to find her, she will make her gratitude be known to her savior at last.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_3.text: Elves are a withdrawn race who prefer to keep their distance from the other peoples of Hasla. Sigruna's attachment to her house is especially strong as a consequence of her destitute past; if she can help it, she won't venture too far away from her dwellings. A true homebody who grumbles "let's get this over with quickly so that I can return to the comforts of my cottage" every time the Chrona Heroes assemble.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_30.text: To her chagrin, Aurea knows better than anyone Magnus's feelings for Sigruna. While she is relieved that they remain unrequited, she is upset that her usually proud captain would deign to depreciate himself in such a manner. Aurea is aware that she must use Sigruna's utter indifference to her advantage, but try as she might, she cannot catch Magnus's eye. What if she tried on glasses? What if she changed her uniform to that of the Grancia Empire? Nothing seems to work!

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_31.text: Meleager and his father Ares, the exemplar of fortitude and a model for all Roman warriors, seem to have nothing in common. Some even express their disbelief that the slender, self-indulgent young man could be the Senator's own offspring. But according to the elders of the Republic, Meleager is the spitting image of Ares as he was before he sharpened his physique through diligent exercise.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_32.text: Huh, she had expected her bounty to be higher, considering her fame and influence in the Empire. But that meager sum only serves to show what a tightwad that Svenja is. With the help of the recently reunited Tess and her extensive vocabulary, Miel has completed a passionate manifesto that protests against insufficient recognition and economic disparities. She is currently focused on circulating copies of her masterpiece all throughout the capital.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_33.text: Iris never did finish her thesis, but Wolfram, in consideration of her extraordinary circumstances and the significant breakthrough of her delivery magic, allowed her her diploma. When people ask her whether she has any regrets concerning her academic career, Iris shakes her head and smiles. Her heart may still ache when she thinks of Arche's betrayal, but she loves the bustle, the excitement, the innovative nature of her business. She wouldn't give it up for the world.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_4.text: Despite his humble roots, Robin has been receiving quite a few proposals of marriage from nobles who suspect his titles to be a product of nepotism. The archer refuses every one of them, claiming that he has no intentions of marrying - and is he not already married to his job? He would never make a good husband. His subordinates, the Green Apple Archers, contend otherwise. They remain silent on the real reasons why they so desperately want their captain married, however.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_5.text: How frail and delicate this mystery called soul, awakened in its mechanized cage. What she had perceived to be a mere error does not fade but grows stronger with time. If the time, the space, the people she encounters form the boundaries of the soul - if the world that she saves within her database become, in the end, echoes of that enigma called ego - then does this not mean that her existence is justified, that she must become whom she guides herself to become?

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_6.text: Giparang first met Yeowoodong when a government minister dragged him to the entertainment district for "pleasure." Rumors soon spread like wildfire of "that once proud and haughty noble, charmed by a lowly courtesan" - detestable, if somewhat true, rumors that Giparang duly ignored in favor of dedicating all his free time to Yeowoodong. Yet he has realized since then that the woman he loves does not age with time. Giparang, in the fear that he would one day lose his beloved's affections, dresses himself extravagantly to charm her eye. For her, he feels he can do anything and everything: pick the moon off its heavenly pedestal, or live in poverty for the rest of his days, or turn his back to the entire world – if it means he can hold Yeowoodong’s hand in his.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_7.text: The perceptive Hikari sees everything in her midst. Her keen judgement detects not only her own but everyone’s else’s mistakes. She has learned through experience, however, that most people do not appreciate criticism – no matter how justified or sympathetic – and so she keeps her comments to herself, hidden under a polite smile. The only person who has never been subject to her scrutiny is her beloved sister Kaori.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_8.text: Unrelated by blood, yet sworn by sacred oath to be as sisters, Niven and Alisha knew happiness in each other’s companionship… until the latter fell in love with the chief of the detested Wolf Tribe. Niven has never regretted killing Alisha. She has never regretted feeling the cold body slump, lifeless, in her bloodied hands. If tears fell from her eyes, they were for her failed cause, not for the dirty traitor of her people. She believes it so. She must believe it so.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_9.text: Arona carries her cherished silver dagger, a gift from Hyangdan long ago, wherever she goes. She does not use the dagger to "protect her chastity," as ladies in the kingdom are expected when entrusted with such deadly weapons; instead, she has discovered it quite useful in picking locks and fending off unwanted admirers. Whenever she discovers Arona undertaking another bold venture or planning some dangerous scheme, Hyangdan sighs in exasperation and grumbles that she should have given Arona something more "ladylike,” all those years ago. But Arona knows that under her eyerolls and reprimands, Hyangdan loves her like a sister, and is delighted that the daughter of her respected old master has grown into a strong and beautiful woman.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_LIMITED_6_1.text: Upon arriving in this strange new dimension, Hong-Ran was shocked to see her fireworks, strictly regulated and used only for aesthetic purposes in her old world, cause such massive destruction to her enemies. A secret, sadistic satisfaction has been wriggling within her ever since, tempting her to produce increasingly dangerous explosions... But first, she needs to find Jin-Kyung, her old-world companion who has recently gone missing.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_LIMITED_BEARS_6_.text: A child left to die in the harsh forests of Nosgard without so much as a single note. Had it not been for the bear pack traveling to the nearby riverbend, death would have found her; Bera still remembers with much trepidation, if a little vaguely, the doom that had approached her. As the years pass, Bera must face the glaring truth that she does not resemble her family at all. But family is family, no matter what you look like. All bears know that.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_6_A.text: It was only too easy to set alight Delrien's ambitions. It is much more difficult, Almael has discovered, to put them out. No book seems to instruct her on persuading that stubborn, spoiled princess to listen to her rational advice. She should have done more research on the Beast King and the Peaks of Glory before weaving her fanciful tale of adventure and aspiration, but all she can do now is to hold on for the ride.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_1.text: Neither in her destined path as the Goddess's chosen nor in her chosen one as the soldier of a doomed kingdom can D'Artagnan find peace. Her reflections and desires go unsaid before the terrible responsibilities that burden her. She would sacrifice herself if she could save all the lost and ailing - what soldier would not? It is not a tragedy, then, that she herself is not worth saving. And yet - when she looks into Rochefort’s remaining eye, a confused rage awakens deep within her. She does not understand why he would so freely give his flesh and blood to keep her own, why he insists on embracing that sorrow.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_10.text: Intending to wreak vengeance on Vane, Wilhelm undertook several body modifications… that converted only a part of him into a cyborg. He started cooking at home to save up money for the rest of his surgeries, only to discover that he possessed culinary talents that he hadn’t known he had. Wilhelm’s recipes and cooking videos on Neth Web have gathered something of a fanbase, generating much more revenue than he had expected. He’s planning to purchase a new prosthetic arm soon.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_11.text: Long solitude has imbued Teresa with insatiable hunger for love and affection. Dependent and indecisive, she blindly followed only what her superiors of the Order told her - until Melissa's disappearance. For the first time in her life, Teresa decided for herself that she would chase after Demona and her company. She couldn't give up on Melissa, one of the few people to whom she had opened her heart.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_12.text: There are not many men who are more cynical than Saiga. But Saiga’s pessimism derives from his many disappointments and failures, abortive products of his once lofty ideals. Only after meeting Oda did Saiga gain hope that he had found a loyal friend and partner with whom he could successfully pave a road to a brighter future. Such is why Saiga could not abandon the tarnished Oda to darkness. Now, the world may have found peace. But what does he have left?

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_13.text: Tia would never admit, not even to herself, that her current disguise as Victoria’s maid genuinely suits her. The high wages and insurance coverage are more than satisfactory, and the many sweet delicacies that Victoria frequently orders are an unexpected perk she cannot bear to forgo. In fact, she would not mind extending her contract a little longer, until she is absolutely, positively sure that she can assassinate Victoria. She'll reconsider her future plans after the next afternoon tea... Or perhaps the next... Or the next...

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_14.text: No longer does Spiny age, nor does she experience the five senses. After the operation that transformed her into a cyborg, Spiny feels as she is only witnessing the events of her life from behind a veil. Sometimes, life seems to have no meaning at all, and all seems to be in vain. The only spark of emotion that drives away the stifling ennui is her boundless love for Spyro, her savior. Romantic love, respect, friendship, or simple allegiance to one’s commander – Spiny cannot and does not define her feelings. It doesn’t matter, as long as she is together with Spyro.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_15.text: To be more specific, Dox is a ‘beagle human.’ The detective doesn’t mind his new ears, but he did have to pierce earholes in his cherished deerstalker hat, and that he regrets profoundly. Contrary to popular opinion, Dox shares an almost amiable relationship with his “nemesis” Lupeow, with whom he has been through thick and thin (most of which either of them caused in the first place). Their arrest-then-escape routine has become so familiar to the duo that, if a week goes by without Dox seeing that cat burglar, he becomes more miserable than he likes to admit. If there is one aspect in which Dox is not quite proficient, it might be his self-awareness; for instance, he is still unaware of his new speaking habit of barking at the end of his sentences-“woof.”

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_16.text:
As the desert trio found out over time, there are a few rules to keep concerning the archeologist:
1. DO call Lorelei by her new epithet, "the Seeker of Truth," which at once flatters and mortifies her. But DON'T push it.
2. DON'T take her coffee away from her. As her research keeps her up most nights, she survives on caffeine.
3. DON'T bother her with any trivial problems when she is drafting her thesis.
When left to her own devices, Lorelei will happily continue her research. Break any of the above rules and face the consequences of her terrible rage, which she WILL unleash without inhibition, her sharp wit and tongue attacking all those unfortunate to fall in her line of sight.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_17.text: The heir to a noble house held in highest esteem in Valencia, Hasla’s most powerful maritime nation, for bearing generations of distinguished navy officers. In her childhood, Scarlet loved to go sailing together with her younger twin sister. This pastime came to an abrupt halt with an unfortunate boating accident and the tragic death of Scarlet's twin. Even decades later, the death of her twin casts on the admiral's heart a shadow darker than the deepest ocean trench. That gloom seemed to recede, a little, when she first saw Seiren. For Seiren reminded Scarlet of her sister, dreaming eternally at the bottom of the sea.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_18.text: At the end of the day, you live and die alone - that is Raven's motto in life. To the other Frost Elves, she's a mixed-blood freak with a human father. To the other humans, she's a blue-skinned monster. To survive by herself in the wilderness, Raven had to fabricate a vivacious visage of geniality and good humor; she had never known a friend or a smile to be genuine. That's why she's happy to have gotten into this mess of events, during which she tore down her old walls and made precious, real new friends. She won't admit it for the world, of course!

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_19.text: Little Kuishinbo was a newly orphaned oni who followed Momotaro home when the boy gave him a dango. The young oni used to be only as big as Momotaro's animal friends; now, after receiving the care, affection, and plenty of dango that every growing oni needs, he has grown strong and mighty! Momotaro is relieved that the treasure he found on his adventure lets him afford Kuishinbo's food budget, which continues to increase over time.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_2.text: The hottest cowgirl in Hasla! ... who has a deep fear of horses. Maxi's trauma stems from an unfortunate riding accident in her childhood. She tries to compensate for it with her prized horse head statue, which she carries around everywhere as if it were her own broken-in bronco.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_20.text: Luicilla's alter ego tends to solve – albeit violently - whatever problem that her original personality had been reluctant to face. Piles and piles of dirty dishes? Gone. Recyclable waste accidentally thrown into the trash bag? Retrieved and recycled. Cockroaches that disappeared behind the cabinet but haven't come out yet, so that you know they’re still in there? Sprayed and confirmed to be dead. Luicilla finds her alter ego convenient, but she does wish that her other self would stop shooting wild bullets into the walls and dishes.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_21.text: Athos’s motives for enlisting may seem dubious to some and almost comical to others. Yet the youngest Musketeer’s keen marksmanship and innate agility are genuine. His unpolished genius has not gone unnoticed: Rochefort has been trying to persuade Athos to begin training more systematically. The latter has repeatedly refused the offer, either out of satisfaction with the current state of affairs or wariness against the certain hardships looming on the horizon. It must be noted that Athos is the youngest son of a prestigious family that wields indisputable influence over Trista’s culture; his parents and siblings still do not understand why Athos would ever volunteer for unnecessary military service and are clamoring for him to return home as soon as possible.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_22.text: A recent report has accused Zahard of having borrowed books of “questionable content” while studying abroad in Chen. Already disgraced by suspicions of double espionage, the indignant spy is currently pleading not guilty. He claims that he had been framed – once again – by hackers, but only he himself knows the truth.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_23.text: The warrior's symbolic green armor was designed by Bellerophon himself, inspired the scales of the dragons he has sworn to fight for the rest of his life. Every day he spends some time admiring it, the product of a famous blacksmith. However, ever since he heard that people from the Eastern Kingdoms are comparing his precious armor to a certain vegetable, he has had trouble falling asleep. He lies on his back, replaying the comment over and over again in his head, wondering if he should have done things differently…

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_24.text: Fortune favors the willing, it is said. Jet is by no means a modest man, but he does pride himself on his diligence. Why would he resort to dishonest methods like lotteries and gambling? Every single penny of Jet's large fortune has been earned through an honest day's work. Where caprice and idleness and pride invade, fortune changes her mind all too easily.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_25.text: Carol hates that she comes in second place for everything. Naturally, she loathes the number two.
