After ending 'Crouching Dragon,' the Hero uses 'Dragon Thrash' to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of their attack power to nearby enemies.
If the Hero as 'Crouching Dragon' is knocked into the air, the Hero ends 'Crouching Dragon' and enters 'Anatta' for 3 seconds. In 'Anatta,' the Hero receives 30% more damage.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_PUMPQUEEN_DESC.text: The Hero charges forward and deals #physical damage# equal to [200/280/320]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_PUMPQUEEN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: The Hero additionally deals 3 hits of #physical damage# equal to 200% of their attack power per hit to enemies hit by their block skill. If the enemy hit by the Hero's block skill dies, the Hero stacks 1 'Halloween Massacre.' (Maximum 4 stacks; stacks cannot be decreased) Each stack of 'Halloween Massacre' increases the Hero's critical damage by 10% and attack power by 5% for 4 seconds after using the Hero's block skill twice.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_PUMPQUEEN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: The Hero additionally deals 3 hits of #physical damage# equal to 200% of their attack power per hit to enemies hit by their block skill. If the enemy hit by the Hero's block skill dies, the Hero stacks 1 'Halloween Massacre.' (Maximum 4 stacks; stacks cannot be decreased) Each stack of 'Halloween Massacre' increases the Hero's critical damage by 50% and attack power by 10% for 4 seconds after using the Hero's block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RAEL_DESC.text: The Hero deals #physical damage# equal to [180/260/340]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used, and becomes resistant to knockbacks for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RAEL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using their block skill, the Hero receives all damage targeted at the entire team for 5 seconds. This effect cannot be dispelled. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RAEL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using their block skill, the Hero receives all damage targeted at the entire team and becomes resistant to stuns for 5 seconds. This effect cannot be dispelled. (Cooltime: 1 second) Additionally, the Hero's armor is increased by 150% for 5 seconds, and the Hero becomes resistant to 15 hits of physical damage. (Cooltime: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RANDGRID_DESC.text: Randgrid immediately leaps towards the nearest enemy and deals #physical damage# equal to [200/350/500]% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RANDGRID_DESC_S2EP3.text: The Hero immediately leaps towards the nearest enemy and deals #physical damage# equal to [200/350/500]% of the Hero's attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RANDGRID_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using the Hero's 3-chain, 'Piercing Obliteration' deals additional #physical damage# equal to 300% of the Hero's attack power. The Hero increases their own critical chance by 15% and becomes resistant to knockbacks for 6 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RANDGRID_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using the Hero's 3-chain, 'Piercing Obliteration' deals additional #physical damage# equal to 500% of the Hero's attack power. The Hero increases their own critical chance by 25% and becomes resistant to knockbacks for 6 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RANNO_DESC.text:
Ranno uses meat bait to lure Rex into using 'Munch' or 'Whoosh,' depending on the enemy's distance.
Munch: If the enemy is within Ranno and Rex's range, Rex deals #physical damage# equal to [150/250/400]% of Ranno's attack power, according to the chain number used.
Whoosh: If no enemy is within Ranno and Rex's range, Rex jumps forward and deals #physical damage# equal to 400% of Ranno's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RANNO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Ranno mounts Rex the Dinosaur on entering battle. Upon using a 3-chain, Ranno additionally uses 'Thud!' to deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of her attack power. Ranno and Rex's Special Skills are changed to 'Primitive Instinct.'
Primitive Instinct: Ranno's attack power is increased by 150% for 10 seconds. Reusing the skill before its termination will reset its duration.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RANNO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Ranno mounts Rex the Dinosaur on entering battle. Upon using a 3-chain, Ranno additionally uses 'Thud!' to deal #physical damage# equal to 2000% of her attack power. Additionally, upon receiving 5 hits, Rex uses 'Rawr!' to decrease enemy evasion by 30 for 5 seconds and stun the enemy for 2 seconds. (Cooltime: 8 seconds) Ranno and Rex's Special Skills are changed to 'Primitive Instinct.'
Primitive Instinct: Ranno's attack power is increased by 175% and armor penetration and critical chance by 30% for 10 seconds. Reusing the skill before its termination will reset its duration.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_WEISS_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using another ally's 3-chain, Weiss pierces the enemy twice, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 1500% of her attack power every time. Upon using 'Barrage,' Weiss's evasion is increased by 100 for 1 second, and she cannot be pushed back for the duration of the attack. Pressing Weiss's block during the attack will increase the entire team's attack power by 100% of Weiss's attack power and make them immune to 2 hits.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_REDNAS_DESC.text: Lednas charges forward to deal #physical damage# equal to [100/150/250]% of her attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_REDNAS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using her own block skill, Lednas raises her shield and stands in the position of 'Grancian Shield Combat' for 10 seconds. (Cooltime: 12 seconds) During 'Grancian Shield Combat,' Lednas gets 10% damage reduction and cannot be pushed back, but her movement speed is reduced by 30%. Additionally, her block skill is changed to 'Shield Blow' during 'Grancian Shield Combat':
<Shield Blow>
Upon using her block skill during 'Grancian Shield Combat,' Lednas charges forth and deals #physical damage# equal to 150% of her attack power to 1 enemy within her range. Hit enemies are knocked back and immobilized for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_REDNAS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using her own block skill, Lednas raises her shield and stands in the position of 'Grancian Shield Combat' for 10 seconds. (Cooltime: 12 seconds) During 'Grancian Shield Combat,' Lednas gets 20% damage reduction and cannot be pushed back, but her movement speed is reduced by 20%. Additionally, her block skill is changed to 'Shield Blow' during 'Grancian Shield Combat':
<Shield Blow>
Upon using her block skill during 'Grancian Shield Combat,' Lednas charges forth and deals #physical damage# equal to 150% of her attack power to 1 enemy within her range. Hit enemies are knocked back and immobilized for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_REJECT_THORN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Während der Aktivierung des Dorns der Weigerung verursacht dieser, wenn Feinde von außerhalb der Auto-Angriffsreichweite her angreifen, bei jedem Treffer @Magieschaden@ in Höhe von 200 % der Angriffsmacht des Helden. Die Angriffsmacht und Rüstung von Feinden innerhalb der Reichweite des Dorns der Schmerzen sinken um 75 % der Rüstung des Helden. (Einmal alle 1,5 Sekunden)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ROSKVA_DESC.text: The Hero dashes forward with their blade, dealing 3 hits of #physical damage# equal to [80/200/320]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ROSKVA_DESC_S2EP3.text: The Hero dashes forward with their blade, attacking 3 times to deal #physical damage# equal to [45/60/80]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ROSKVA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Roskva's block skill accurately hits, Roskva becomes 'exalted' for 5 seconds. 'Exaltation' increases accuracy by 20.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_ROSKVA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: If the Hero's block skill accurately hits the enemy, the Hero becomes 'exalted' for 5 seconds. The 'exalted' Hero's accuracy is increased by 30. Upon using the 'exalted' Hero's 3-chain, the Hero additionally uses 'Glacial Blade' to deal 3 hits of physical damage equal to 1500% of their attack power to all enemies within range. Enemies hit by 'Glacial Blade' lose evasion by 10 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RZ_01_DESC.text: Upon using his block, Subaru deals #physical damage# equal to [100/150/250]% of his attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RZ_01_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon receiving damage that would be otherwise fatal, Subaru uses 'Return by Death.' Activating 'Return by Death' heals Subaru's HP by 100% and grants him invincibility for 2 seconds. This skill activates once, and is reset after re-entering the battle after actual death.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RZ_02_DESC.text: Upon using her block, Crusch Karsten unleashes her 'Blade of Wind,' dealing #physical damage# equal to [150/300/500]% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RZ_02_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing another ally's block 2 times, Crusch Karsten activates 'Divine Protection of Wind Indication' for 5 seconds. This skill increases 'Crusch's attack power by 75% and alters the form of 'Blade of Wind,' increasing its range.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RZ_02_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing another ally's block 2 times, Crusch Karsten activates 'Divine Protection of Wind Indication' for 5 seconds. This skill increases 'Crusch's attack power by 100%, critical chance by 10%, and accuracy by 20, and alters the form of 'Blade of Wind,' increasing its range.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHASHA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: The Hero summons globes of fire that deal @magical damage@ equal to 5% of the Hero's attack power to nearby allies and 100% of the Hero's attack power to enemies per second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHASHA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: The Hero summons globes of fire that deal @magical damage@ equal to 5% of the Hero's attack power to nearby allies and 100% of the Hero's attack power to enemies per second. The Hero's 3-chain skills become resistant to knockbacks and mark enemies with burns that deal @magical damage@ equal to 1500% of the Hero's attack power per second for 5 seconds. The Hero's 3-chain skills additionally deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of the Hero's attack power to marked enemies.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SIMHAKGYU_DESC.text: Sim Hak-Gyu falls over while swinging his blade around, dealing #physical damage# equal to [80/140/220]% of his attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SIMHAKGYU_DESC_S2EP4.text: The Hero falls over while swinging his blade, dealing #physical damage# equal to [80/140/220]% of their attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SIMHAKGYU_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon entering battle, the Hero summons 'Sim Cheong.' Sim Cheong's stats are set to the Hero's own at the time of the summon. Upon pressing another ally's block, 'Sim Cheong' uses 'Rush of Filial Piety' to deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of her attack power per hit.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SIMHAKGYU_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon entering battle, the Hero summons 'Sim Cheong.' Sim Cheong's stats are set to 125% of the Hero's at the time of the summon. Upon pressing another ally's block, 'Sim Cheong' uses 'Rush of Filial Piety' to deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of her attack power per hit. Upon pressing the Hero's 3-chain, 'Sim Cheong' uses 'Punch of the Indang Waters' to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of her attack power. 'Sim Cheong' receives all damage targeted at the Hero.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SOLTAR_SLASH_LV3_SUBDESC.text: With every 4 hits received, the Hero summons a 'Sphere of Evil' that deals #physical damage# equal to 250% of the Hero's attack power per hit, and the Hero's attack power is increased by 15% for 10 seconds (maximum 10 stacks). Using the Hero's block afterwards will additionally summon a 'Pillar of Evil' that deals #physical damage# equal to 800% of the Hero's attack power to the enemy with the highest HP.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPEARMAN_DESC.text: Spearman deals #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of his attack power to the enemy in the front, according to the chain number used. During his block skill, Spearman gains knockback resistance.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPEARMAN_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing another ally's block within 5 seconds of using his own block skill, Spearman deals area #physical damage# equal to 500% of his attack power and generates 1 ally leader block. During 'Spearman's Strike,' Spearman gains knockback resistance.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPEARMAN_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon pressing another ally's block within 5 seconds of using his own block skill, Spearman deals area #physical damage# equal to 800% of his attack power and generates 1 ally leader block. During 'Spearman's Strike,' Spearman gains knockback resistance.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SUSANOO_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using 'Sword Shot,' Susanoo's auto attack is changed to 'Downward Strike' for 7 seconds. 'Downward Strike' deals #physical damage# equal to 200% of Susanoo's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SUSANOO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 'Sword Shot,' Susanoo's auto attack is changed to 'Downward Strike' for 7 seconds. 'Downward Strike' deals #physical damage# equal to 200% of Susanoo's attack power.
Additionally, Susanoo becomes immune for 5 hits from all types of damage for 5 seconds. (Cooltime: 7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE2_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 2 ally leader blocks, the Hero activates 'Extreme Wind Blade.' (Cooltime: 2 seconds)
Extreme Wind Blade: The Hero deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of their attack power and decreases hit enemies' SP by 10. This attack ignores all enemy effects that take damage in place of others.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SWORDWAVE2_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using 3 ally leader blocks, the Hero activates 'Extreme Wind Blade' and increases their own armor penetration by 50% of their attack power for 3 seconds. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)
Extreme Wind Blade: The Hero deals #physical damage# equal to 2000% of their attack power and decreases hit enemies' SP by 20. This attack ignores all enemy effects that take damage in place of others.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TWILLY_DESC.text:
Twillie uses [Shield of Glory / Fortress of Victory / Strike of Faith] according to the chain number pressed.
 Shield of Glory: Twillie's armor is increased by 400. (Maximum 4000)
 Fortress of Victory: Twillie's resistance is increased by 400. (Maximum 4000)
 Strike of Faith: Twillie impales her greatsword to deal #physical damage# equal to 2000% of her attack power.
 After 'Strike of Faith,' Twillie lunges forward and uses 'Earth Divider' to deal #physical damage# equal to 600% of her attack power per hit.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TWILLY_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Activating 'Earth Divider' will change Twillie's block skills to [Enhanced Leg / Enhanced Blade / Last Stand], according to the chain number pressed.
 Enhanced Leg: Twillie's speed is increased by 25%. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Enhanced Blade: Twillie deals 12% more damage. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Last Stand: Twillie thrusts her greatsword to deal #physical damage# equal to 700% of her attack power. All block skill effects are reset with this attack. After 15 seconds, Twillie uses her 3-chain.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TWILLY_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Activating 'Earth Divider' will change Twillie's block skills to [Enhanced Leg / Enhanced Blade / Last Stand], according to the chain number pressed.
 Enhanced Leg: Twillie's speed is increased by 25%. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Enhanced Blade: Twillie deals 12% more damage. (Maximum 5 stacks)
 Last Stand: Twillie thrusts her greatsword to deal #physical damage# equal to 4800% of her attack power. All block skill effects are reset with this attack. After 15 seconds, Twillie uses her 3-chain.
 Activating 'Earth Shaker' will grant Twillie immunity to all debuffs. Upon using another ally's 3-chain, Twillie will recover HP equal to 200% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_VICTORY_RUSH_DESC.text: Der Held verursacht #physischen Schaden# in Höhe von (150/235/442) % der Angriffsmacht des Helden entsprechend der Kettennummer.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_VICTORY_RUSH_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Wenn ein Block eingesetzt wird, wird einmal alle 10 Sekunden die Siegesflagge 7 Sekunden lang in der ersten Reihe des Verbündeten beschworen. Alle Verbündeten in der Nähe der beschworenen Flagge ignorieren Schaden in Höhe von 50 % von Victorias Rüstung.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WATER_SWORD_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using his block, Koxinga increases the entire team's evasion by 40 and decreases all enemies' accuracy by 40 for 5 seconds. If he succeeds in evading an attack during this time, Koxinga summons a 'Sea Dragon' that deals @magical damage@ equal to 35% of his maximum HP. (Activates every 1 second.) Evading 2 hits will summon a second 'Sea Dragon.' (Activates every 1 second.)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WHIRLWIND_DESC.text: The caster spins forward, dealing #physical damage# equal to 300% of their attack power and knocking back all enemies in their path. This skill cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WHIRLWIND_LV2_DESC.text: The caster spins forward, dealing #physical damage# equal to 375% of their attack power and knocking back all enemies in their path. This skill cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WHIRLWIND_LV3_DESC.text: The caster spins forward, dealing #physical damage# equal to 450% of their attack power and knocking back all enemies in their path. For the duration of this skill, the caster reflects 50% of all damage they receive from enemies. This skill cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WHIRLWIND_LV4_DESC.text: The caster spins forward, dealing #physical damage# equal to 525% of their attack power and knocking back all enemies in their path. For the duration of this skill, the caster reflects 50% of all damage they receive from enemies. This skill cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WHIRLWIND_LV5_DESC.text: The caster spins forward, dealing #physical damage# equal to 750% of their attack power and knocking back all enemies in their path. For the duration of this skill, the caster reflects 50% of all damage they receive from enemies. The last spin of the attack stuns hit enemies for 1 second. This skill cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WILD_NATURE_DESC.text: The Hero rapidly brandishes their sword to deal #physical damage# equal to [150/300/450]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WILD_NATURE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: With every 3 attacks that are not Special Skills, the Hero uses 'Double Slash' to deal 2 hits of #physical damage# equal to 500% of their attack power. Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero increases their attack speed by 40% for 5 seconds. (Duration renewed with reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WILD_NATURE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: With every 3 attacks that are not Special Skills, the Hero uses 'Double Slash' to deal 2 hits of #physical damage# equal to 1000% of their attack power. Upon using their 3-chain, the Hero increases their attack speed by 80% for 7 seconds, and all of their attacks except Special Skills deal additional $neutral damage$ equal to 250% of the Hero's attack power for 7 seconds. (Duration renewed with reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_LV3_DESC.text: Führt 3 schnelle Angriffe aus, verursacht #physischen Schaden# von 396 % des Angriffswerts und zieht den Gegner an.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_LV4_DESC.text: Führt 3 schnelle Angriffe aus, verursacht #physischen Schaden# von 504 % des Angriffswerts und zieht den Gegner an.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_WIND_CLEAVE_LV5_DESC.text: Führt 3 schnelle Angriffe aus, verursacht #physischen Schaden# von 798 % des Angriffswerts und zieht den Gegner an.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_ADOL_DESC.text: Adol stürzt nach vorn gegen seine Feinde und verursacht [1/2/3] Mal #physischen Schaden# in Höhe von 100 % seiner Angriffsmacht entsprechend der eingesetzten Kettennummer.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_ADOL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Adol's block is pressed immediately before being hit, he activates 'Flash Guard' that increases his critical chance by 10% and decreases the damage he receives by 20% for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_ADOL_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If Adol's block is pressed immediately before being hit, he activates 'Flash Guard' that increases his critical chance by 10% and decreases the damage he receives by 20% for 3 seconds.
 Upon using 'Flash Guard' or 'Sonic Slide' 3 times, Adol enhances his 'Sonic Slide' to 'Force Edge' for 5 seconds. 'Force Edge' deals #physical damage# equal to 200% of Adol's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_DANA_DESC.text: Dana schwingt ihre Halbmondklingen und verursacht @Magieschaden@ in Höhe von (100/200/300) % ihrer Angriffsmacht.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_DANA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: If Dana's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_DANA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If Dana's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds. Additionally, she activates 'Dragon Spirit.'
 Dragon Spirit (Cooltime: 3 seconds. Cannot be canceled.)
 For 15 seconds, Dana becomes resistant to knockbacks, and her attack power and resistance penetration are increased by 400. During this effect, she uses [Mistrel Blow / Twin Moon Blade / Spiel Round Steps] according to the chain number she uses.
 Mistrel Blow: Dana spins as smoothly as the wind to deal @magical damage@ equal to 400% of her attack power.
 Twin Moon Blade: Dana flashes her crescent moon blades to deal @magical damage@ equal to 600% of her attack power.
 Spiel Round Steps: Dana gracefully dances around the enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to 1800% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_LAXIA_DESC.text: Laxia durchbohrt ihre Feinde [2/4/6] Mal, wodurch #physischer Schaden# in Höhe von 50 % ihrer Angriffsmacht verursacht wird.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_LAXIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
If Laxia's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds.
 After using 'Flash Move,' Laxia additionally uses 'Break Needle' that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 100% of her attack power and stuns the frontmost enemy for 1 second. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_YS8_LAXIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
If Laxia's block is pressed immediately before being hit, she activates 'Flash Move' that increases her motion speed by 10% and decreases the damage she receives by 20% for 3 seconds.
 After using 'Flash Move,' Laxia additionally uses 'Break Needle' that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 100% of her attack power and stuns the frontmost enemy for 1.5 seconds. (Cooltime: 2 seconds)
 The block skill Laxia uses immediately after 'Break Needle' is changed to 'Blitz Charge,' through which Laxia charges forward with her blade and deals #physical damage# equal to 400% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANESIDORA_DESC.text: Anesidora shoots gravity spheres to deal @magical damage@ equal to [120/230/350]% of her attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANESIDORA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her chain 2 times, Anesidora generates a 'Graviton Rift' that lasts 3 seconds and deals @magical damage@ equal to 15% of her attack power and #physical damage# equal to 25% of her attack power every 0.2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANESIDORA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her chain 2 times, Anesidora generates a 'Graviton Rift' that lasts 3 seconds and deals @magical damage@ equal to 15% of her attack power and #physical damage# equal to 25% of her attack power every 0.2 seconds. Additionally, her armor penetration increases by 100% of her resistance penetration and her resistance penetration increases by 100% of her armor penetration upon entering the stage. This effect does not activate as a buff and thus cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANNA_DESC.text: Ana feuerte ihre Waffe per Telekinese ab und fügt so #physischen Schaden# zu, der [120/240/400]% ihrer Angriffskraft entspricht. Sie wechselt für [3/4/5] Sekunden ebenfalls in den Modus 'Feuerwaffenkontrolle', wodurch ihre Genauigkeit um 20 steigt.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANNA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Im Modus 'Feuerwaffenkontrolle' nutzt Ana 'Ehrenwachenmuskete', um #physischen Schaden# zuzufügen, der 300% ihrer Angriffskraft pro 1,5 Sekunden entspricht. Setzt sie währenddessen ihren Block ein, die Dauer dieses Modus um 2 Sekunden verlängert.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANNA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Im Modus 'Feuerwaffenkontrolle' nutzt Ana 'Ehrenwachenmuskete', um #physischen Schaden# zuzufügen, der 300% ihrer Angriffskraft pro 1,5 Sekunden entspricht. Setzt sie währenddessen ihren Block ein, wird 'Feuerwaffenkontrolle' zu 'Verstärkte Feuerwaffenkontrolle'. Zusätzlich wird die Dauer dieses Modus um 2 Sekunden verlängert. Während 'Verstärkte Feuerwaffenkontrolle' setzt Ana 'Ehrenwachenmuskete' ein, um zusätzlich #physischen Schaden# zuzufügen, der 540% ihrer Angriffskraft pro 1,5 Sekunden entspricht.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANZU_DESC.text: Anzu casts ginkgo leaves at the enemy to deal @magical damage@ equal to [100/200/300]% of her attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANZU_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every time she uses her block skill, Anzu casts 'Protection of the Wind Blade' on herself for 5 seconds. The effects of 'Protection of the Wind Blade' can be stacked a maximum of 5 times, and increases attack power by 3%, critical chance by 3%, and accuracy by 3 with every stack, with critical chance being limited to a 15% increase and accuracy to 15. This effect cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_ANZU_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Every time she uses her block skill, Anzu casts 'Protection of the Wind Blade' on herself for 5 seconds. The effects of 'Protection of the Wind Blade' can be stacked a maximum of 5 times, and increases attack power by 5%, critical chance by 5%, and accuracy by 5 with every stack, with critical chance being limited to a 25% increase and accuracy to 25. This effect cannot be canceled. Upon using her 3-chain, Anzu additionally uses 'Wind Blade' to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of her attack power to enemies within her range.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_DESC.text: Bihwa uses the strength of her spirits to throw an enormous divine knife to deal @magical damage@ equal to [150/250/350]% of her attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_DESC_S2EP4.text: The Hero uses the strength of spirits to throw an enormous divine knife to deal @magical damage@ equal to [150/250/350]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every second block skill used by Bihwa summons forth the dokkaebi 'Gildal,' who becomes embodied through Bihwa and swings their club to deal @magical damage@ equal to 500% of Bihwa's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BIHWA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Every second block skill used by Bihwa summons forth the dokkaebi 'Gildal,' who becomes embodied by Bihwa and swings their club to deal @magical damage@ equal to 800% of Bihwa's attack power. Upon using her own or another ally's 3-chain, Bihwa embodies the spirit 'Gseundae' for 3 seconds, who attacks enemies with their divine branch to deal @magical damage@ equal to 100% of Bihwa's attack power every 0.1 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BLIZZARD_DESC_S2EP3.text: The Hero drops [8/12/20] icicles that each deal @magical damage@ equal to [5/13/22]% of the Hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BRIDGET_DESC.text: The Hero summons lucky meteors that deal @magical damage@ equal to [100/150/360]% of the Hero's attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_BRIDGET_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using every sixth block skill, the Hero drops Bridget Points that deal $neutral damage$ equal to 5000.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CALL_IFRIT_DESC.text: Der Held beschwört sofort einen „Feuergeist“, der den Helden 10 Sekunden lang unterstützt. TEXT_STAGE_DG_APFOOL_HYW_DESC.text: Set out to uncover hidden memories!

TEXT_STAGE_DG_APFOOL_HYW_STORY.text: Since the beginning of time, light and darkness have warred against each other in endless struggle. The first three ‘Apostles’ who invade Hasla and the three ‘Daughters of Cora’ who have followed them prepare for the final battle that will put an end to the eternal war. The Daughters of Cora create a new generation of Goddesses, the ‘Elard,’ by bestowing them the Daughters’ own powers, as well as human soldiers who will help them fight in the battle: the ‘Chrona Heroes.’ The Apostles besiege the continent with unrelenting forces of darkness, controlling monsters as pawns against the warriors of light. In the face of a seemingly hopeless war, the Chrona Heroes forge a contract with the Goddess Chronos. They relinquish the eternal rest that comes with death and instead sacrifice their souls for the greater good, vowing to be reincarnated again and again as need calls them. After much strife and struggle – with Dionne disappearing from the battlefield, deceived by Nemesis’s trickery – the persevering two Goddesses and Heroes fight the last remaining Apostle, Destalos, and succeed in binding their soul. The war is finally over, and the victorious battle comes to be known as the ‘Apostles War.’ All praise the courage of the Goddess and her Heroes. Yet as the years pass by in idle peace, dust settles on the scars of the war, and the glorious feats of old are forgotten…

The popularity of Glint of the Anvil is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_FUGUS_MAINTAIN_5.text:
Fergus will be presiding as judge at the next cooking competition!
... But he does always judge the competition.
The popularity of Glint of the Anvil is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

I have some good information to offer!

Please come back later~

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_DECREASE_1.text:
A new type of tree disease is spreading across Grancia. Lenny has declared that the Guild will take time to focus on preventive measures against the epidemic.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

Due to the recent hurricane, the Orchard suffered some damage to their crop.
According to Lenny, more than half the trees have lost all their fruit.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_DECREASE_3.text:
Breaking news: Lenny's Orchard is found to have broken Grancian labor laws!
Harvest season always calls for an extra pair of hands, but this time, they may have gone too far...
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_DECREASE_4.text:
Breaking news: a worker resentful at being overworked set fire to the orchard warehouse!
The fire was put out in ten minutes, but criticism of the Guild will be inevitable.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_DECREASE_5.text:
According to Lenny of the Orchard Guild, the Orchard recently suffered much pest damage.
This will have much impact on the quality of this year's harvest... 
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_INCREASE_1.text:
The Orchard Guild has recently purchased a state-of-the-art combine! Harvests are expected to double in quantity.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_INCREASE_2.text:
The Orchard Guild has announced that they are expecting a major bumper crop this year.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_INCREASE_3.text:
The Orchard Guild has just received the Annual Grancia Ministry of Labor and Employment Grand Prize.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_INCREASE_4.text:
The Orchard Guild just announced that they've successfully crossbred a new variety of Berry!
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_INCREASE_5.text:
The Orchard Guild's apt preparations have resulted in almost no pest damage this season.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_MAINTAIN_1.text:
...No special news has come in concerning the Orchard Guild.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_MAINTAIN_2.text:
The Orchard Guild plan to open a new public space where you can enjoy eco-friendly activities.
... It isn't very special news.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_MAINTAIN_3.text:
The Orchard Guild is recruiting new workers in preparation for harvest.
... It isn't very special news.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_MAINTAIN_4.text:
All is peaceful at the Orchard Guild.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.
Don't forget your daily dose of vitamins - a berry a day keeps the doctor away!

TEXT_STOCK_LENI_MAINTAIN_5.text:
According to Lenny, head of the Orchard Guild, this year's harvest is about the same as last year.
The popularity of Orchard Guild is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_DECREASE_1.text:
A member of Hero Town Youth Association was spotted littering the streets!
Lednas will soon be holding a press conference regarding the issue.
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_DECREASE_2.text:
Breaking news: an official of Hero Town Youth Association was caught with their hand in the till!
Lednas declared that the Association would be holding a private internal investigation with no outside parties, invoking much public criticism.
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_DECREASE_3.text:
Cases of embezzlement have been reported in multiple events held by Hero Town Youth Association!
Rumor has it that a large stock of Saintess Maria's merchandise has gone missing.
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_DECREASE_4.text:
The Council of Nobles at Impalis have officially declared that "all rumors claiming Lednas as the next Galahad are preposterous and certainly untrue."
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_DECREASE_5.text:
Rumor has it that the Hero Town Youth Association is suffering from slight financial difficulties... and has been sued for failing to pay the town janitor on time!
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to fall by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_INCREASE_1.text:
The Youth Association will be doing some winter cleaning before the cold season strikes!
Don't you love it when the town becomes nice and tidy?
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_INCREASE_2.text:
Hero Town has been nominated as one of the safest towns in Grancia!
There's no doubt that the Youth Association had much to do with this.
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_INCREASE_3.text:
The Youth Association will start providing more welfare benefits for Heroes of Hero Town!
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_INCREASE_4.text:
Rumor has it that Captain Lednas of the Youth Association will be the next Galahad!
Will another legendary hero of Grancia be born in Hero Town?
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_INCREASE_5.text:
The Youth Association has been chosen as Grancia's Hero Association of the Year!
I'm sure recruiting {PLAYER_NAME} tipped the scales in their favor!
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to rise by approximately {1} for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_MAINTAIN_1.text:
'Firewood 101: How to Prepare for Winter' classes will be held by the Youth Association this year as well.
Not very breaking news material, is it?
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_MAINTAIN_2.text:
All is quiet in Hero Town today.
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_MAINTAIN_3.text:
The Heroes of the Youth Association will be having a staff dinner tonight...
Not the most interesting tidbit of information.
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_MAINTAIN_4.text:
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.
Rumor has it that Galahad and Emperor Alexander are considering Captain Lednas of Hero Town as the knight's successor! Oh, did you already know?

TEXT_STOCK_REDNAS_MAINTAIN_5.text:
Hero Town Youth Association is recruiting new members.
Not the most breaking news in town, but a necessary one nonetheless.
The popularity of Hero Town Youth Association is expected to remain stable for Turn {0}.

TEXT_SUPPORT_HERO_GET_ALL_HELP.text: Die Prämie für das Max.-Training deines 6-Sterne-Helden wurde in deinen Posteingang geliefert.

TEXT_SUPPORT_PACK_DESC2.text:
The best choice for leveling up your Champions!
Purchase to immediately receive 200 Jewels and recruit 10 ★6 Battleloid S-6s that can reinforce all factions!
Supply Heroes are special units used to reinforce factions (Champions). They cannot be trained or promoted.

TEXT_TEAM_MOVE_ERROR.text: You can no longer move your team.

TEXT_TEAM_RANKING_DESC.text: Listed are the teams that have dealt the most damage in one round, and their Captains.

TEXT_TIP_AD.text: Enable [Settings > Enable Ads] to utilize the Mysterious Oven, Discounts with Popo, and Reviving during stages!

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_1.text: You can battle other Captains real-time in the Arena.

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_2.text: The Arena goes under maintenance every Monday from 9 to 10 AM. You cannot enter during this time.

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_3.text: After the Arena Maintenance, your Arena Rank will be adjusted to the final Tier of the previous Rank.

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_4.text: There are four Ranks in the Arena: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Master.

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_5.text: There are no Tiers in Master Rank. Only your points will increase or decrease in accordance with your wins and losses.

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_6.text: Check for related quests after playing the Arena!

TEXT_TIP_ARENA_9.text: Your Arena Rank cannot be downgraded. Losses will only result in the decrease of your Arena Tier.

TEXT_TIP_AUTO_1.text: Stages that have been cleared once can be played again with Battle Delegation.

TEXT_TIP_AUTO_2.text: During Battle Delegation, main Heroes use 3-chains, and support Heroes use 1-chain block skills.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_1.text: Illustrations of your team Heroes will be shown when entering battle.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_2.text: Hero illustrations in the battle screen can be toggled ON/OFF from Settings > Game.

TEXT_TIP_BATTLE_ENTRY_ILLUST_3.text: Hero illustrations in the battle screen can be toggled ON/OFF from the battle Settings menu.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_1.text: Play Ordeals to get special Sticker rewards!

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_2.text: Ordeals are a difficult Adventure mode that open every 3 weeks for a week at a time.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_3.text: Defeat powerful Bosses from the twisted dimension of an alternate Hasla!

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_4.text: Freely experiment with different teams in the Practice Mode.

TEXT_TIP_BOSSRUSH_5.text: The Boss's stats increase according to the stage difficulty. Harder levels will activate even more harmful debuffs to Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_1.text: Add [Slots] and [Sigils] to Soulbound Weapons to strengthen your Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_2.text: Adding Slots requires other ★4~6 Soulbound Weapons and Fergus Points as materials.

TEXT_TIP_CARVE_3.text: In order to add a Sigil to a Soulbound Weapon, you must first upgrade it to ★6 and add a Slot.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_1.text: Bezwinge Streiter-Monster im Herausforderungsmodus, um Bücher des Erbes und mächtige Siegel zu erringen!

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_10.text: Buff-Tränke können im Herausforderungsmodus nicht benutzt werden.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_2.text: Achte auf die einzigartigen Angriffe der Streiter-Monster! Jedes Monster muss mit einer speziellen Methode besiegt werden.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_3.text: Es heißt, dass die Siegel, die man durch Streiter-Monster bekommt, alle ein Stück Weisheit enthalten ...

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_4.text: Es gibt Gerüchte von einem schrecklichen Wesen, dass in der tiefsten Kammer der unterirdischen Abwasserkanäle schlummert.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_5.text: Der Palast wird derzeit von den Überbleibseln des Ordens des Löwen bewacht, die nicht zum Schlachtfeld der Heiligen Stadt gegangen waren.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_6.text: Wenn du im Herausforderungsmodus stirbst, erhältst du keine Prämien. Überlege gut, und verschwinde lieber, wenn es sein muss!

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_7.text: Du kannst dich entscheiden, weiterzugehen oder zu flüchten, nachdem du jeweils ein Streiter-Monster besiegt hast. Wenn du entkommst, kannst du die gefundenen Prämien behalten.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_8.text: Angriffe auf Streiter-Monster können bei jedem Treffer nicht mehr als 20 % ihrer maximalen LP Schaden zufügen.

TEXT_TIP_CHALLENGE_9.text: Du kannst im Herausforderungsmodus nicht mit Hilfe von Werbung weiterspielen.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_ADVANCE_HERO.text: Promotion Heroes can be randomly recruited through promoting ★3 Heroes of the same class.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_COLLABO_HERO.text: Otherworld Heroes come from other dimensions, drawn by a strange power to Hasla.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_COMMON_HERO.text: Normal Heroes range from ★1 to ★3 and promote to a random Hero of the same class upon promotion.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_1.text: Use Danan's Fragments, Iron, and Gold to forge Soulbound Weapons and unlock the true power of your Heroes!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_EXCEED_3.text: Ist ein Held mit einer seelengebunden 6-Sterne-Waffe ausgerüstet, blitzt sein Klassensymbol auf.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GACHA_HERO.text: Contract Heroes can be recruited through Premium Contracts.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_GROWTH_3.text: ★6 Heroes can eat Berries to gain additional stats.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_EP_5.text: Cora, the first goddess, is known to have dispersed powers to fight against the darkness across the whole universe.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_MANACAR_1.text: Manacar is a mass of greed that devours whatever contains the faintest trace of magic.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HASLACHRONICLE_SOUL_1.text: The bloodline of Soltar, the Apostle who once drove the southern lands of Hasla into deathly terror, still remains standing...

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HELP.text:
Having trouble? Go to [Town] > [Menu] to access the Help Guide,
or touch the [?] button in each screen to get more information!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_RANKING.text: See which Heroes participated the most in Raid dungeons before you try it yourself!

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_HERO_VALUE.text: Heroes of Crusaders Quest are divided into seven categories: Legendary, Contract, Promotion, Normal, Hidden, Otherworld, and Supply.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_LEGENDARY_HERO.text: Legendary Heroes are fixed in their promotion from ★1 to ★6. Their stats are higher on average than other Heroes of the same grade.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_POPO.text: Successfully bargain with Popo to get deals on all items.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_STAGE_1.text: In the Scenario Selection Menu, you can touch the book icon on Hero Bosses' portraits to check whether you have recruited the Hero.

TEXT_TIP_COMMON_TEAM_RECORD.text: Go to the [Record] menu in the Scenario selection screen to look up team combinations of other Captains!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_1.text: Hilf Adol und seinen Gefährten, Schiffbrüchige zu retten und ein Boot zu bauen, um der einsamen Insel zu entkommen!

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_2.text: Eine geheimnisvolle Macht brachte Adol und seine Gefährten nach Hasla, während sie gerade unterwegs waren, um Danas Gedächtnis wiederherzustellen.

TEXT_TIP_EVENT_YS8_3.text: Das Passagierschiff aus Hasla wurde von einer Krake angegriffen und zerstört, die plötzlich auftauchte.

TEXT_TIP_FAVORITE_1.text: Du kannst deine Lieblingsmenüpunkte mit Lesezeichen versehen!

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_1.text: Fischermiau ist nach Hasla gekommen, um die Freude über das Angeln zu verbreiten.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_2.text: Angelmünzen können durch Angeln erworben und beim Handelsposten gegen verschiedene Gegenstände eingetauscht werden.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_3.text: Beim Angeln wird 1 Köder pro Runde genutzt.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_4.text: Der absolute Rekord für jeden Fisch im Album der Fischsammlung wird einmal täglich zurückgesetzt.

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_5.text: Beende deine Angelsammlung für alle Angelplätze und verdiene wertvolle Belohnungen!

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_6.text: Das Angeln erhöht zwar nicht den Kontolevel, aber er erhöht deinen Angelrang (AR).

TEXT_TIP_FISHING_7.text: The 'Big Fish Chance' of your Fishing Equipment increases your chances of catching bigger fish while Auto-Fishing!

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_1.text: Deal damage to Giant Bosses and receive rewards!

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_2.text: A Hero can fight only one battle a day.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_3.text: You can receive additional rewards by defeating the Boss within the event period.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_4.text: Devilish Coins can be acquired through Hasla Wars events and traded for rewards.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_5.text: The longer you survive, the more Devilish Coins you receive.

TEXT_TIP_HASLAWARS_6.text: 'Bloody Rose Jack' is one of the Elite Four, the most loyal subordinates of Gordian, the Devil King of Hell Island.

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_1.text: 6-Sterne-helden, die ihren höchsten Level erreicht haben, können durch Erben stärker werden.

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_2.text: Bücher des Erbes können durch Streiter-Prämien, Verträge, Herausforderungsmodus und auf andere Weise erworben werden!

TEXT_TIP_INHERITANCE_3.text: Die Level von Erb-Helden werden violett markiert.

TEXT_TIP_ITEM_INFO_LONG_PRESS.text: Press and hold an item in your Inventory to check its information.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_1.text: The house of Tsukino is one of the three founding clans of the Ryu Kingdom.

TEXT_TIP_KURENAI_STORY_3.text: The peak of the Primal Volcano has been devastated by heat, but the Woopa Tribe lives in the jungle at the foot of the mountain.

TEXT_TIP_LIBRARY_RECORD_1.text: Pandora is looking for a competent Captain who will help her manage records in the Library of Dimensions.

TEXT_TIP_LIBRARY_RECORD_2.text: You must enter your record into the Library of Dimensions in order to receive its reward.

TEXT_TIP_LOW_INHERITANCE_1.text: Inherit to a certain extent ★6 Heroes who have reached maximum level and training.

TEXT_TIP_ORCHARD_1.text: Heroes working in the Orchard are marked with a round tree icon.

TEXT_TIP_PASSIVE_DESC.text: Heroes over grade 4 have additional $passive skills$. They are either #main# or %support% types.

TEXT_TIP_PROMOTION_EXCEPTION.text: Certain★3 Secret Heroes cannot be promoted.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_PVP_2.text: In the Colosseum, you will fight against other Captains' A.I. Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_PVP_RULE_3.text: Heroes receive reduced healing during matches.

TEXT_TIP_QUEST_1.text: Complete Rank Quests to increase your Quest Rank (QR)! The higher your QR is, the more appearances of quests with better rewards!

TEXT_TIP_QUEST_2.text: You can reject a Rank Quest to replace with a new quest. There is a set limit of times you can reject a quest per day.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_META_1.text: Der Apostel des Überfall wechselt jeden Montag.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_1.text: Tippe mehrmals auf den Bildschirm, um die Betäubung deiner Helden aufzuheben!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_2.text: Die Stammesleute der Alten Wüste waren Meister der Felsen und Steine – die Schöpfer einer Technologie, die im Laufe der Zeit verloren ging.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_3.text: Der Wächter des Verlorenen Königreichs, der durch vergessene alte Technologie erschaffen wurde, wird nach seiner Niederlage in verschiedenen Formen weiter wiederbelebt.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_4.text: Entsprechend der Prophezeiung des Rosettasteins liegt das Geheimnis eines verlorenen Königreichs in den Tiefen des Tempels der Illusionen verborgen.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP1_5.text: Du kannst spezielle Siegel mit festgelegten Optionen bei den Angriffen „Wächter der Ruinen“ verdienen.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_1.text: The current capital of Nosgard is Snorri Edda, named after the first Great King of Nosgard.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_2.text: Only the silent ruins beyond the Crossing of Frost Wolves remain of Elder Edda, the old capital of Nosgard.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_3.text: Any true Nosgardian would be proud of their heritage. There are many who disapprove of Thor's attempts to unite the diverse traditional tribes of Nosgard into a single, central nation.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_4.text: Be careful not to let your screen freeze over in battle! Use Goddess Skills to prevent the oncoming frost.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_5.text: Quickly cut through frozen shackles to destroy the summoned chains!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP2_6.text: Bosses of the Sanctuary regularly cast buffs on themselves while canceling Hero buffs. Make sure to cancel Boss buffs!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_1.text: In the Laboratory, Heroes will not be able to generate shields due to a powerful electromagnetic field!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_2.text: Shields generated by Boss Monsters will absorb all damage targeted at them.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to neutralize Boss Monsters' laser beams!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_4.text: When Battleloid NS000 attempts to self-destruct, tap on the screen repeatedly to help Stanya deactivate the attack.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_5.text: The science companies that lead the Neth Empire are currently being dominated by the country's House of Nobles.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP3_6.text: Levine, the former Chief Research Officer of Rapture Science, is the granddaughter of the legendary scientist Ludvico, Hasla's greatest expert on Battleloids.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_1.text: Heroes who gaze into the Eye of the Abyss will be temporarily weakened.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_2.text: All buffs and debuffs cast by the Boss can be dispelled.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to block the Boss's giant tentacles!

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_4.text: There are old legends that in the depths of the mystical sea dwells an ancient monster that feeds on light.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_5.text: All experienced sailors know that one must not anger the 'Elder Sister of the Sea" if one values one's life.

TEXT_TIP_RAID_S2_EP4_6.text: Due to her responsibility and toil of having protected the ocean for decades, Maré, "Elder Sister of the Sea," is seldom found content.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_1.text: Tap the notes in time with the music as they approach the center from both sides of the screen!

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_2.text: Different notes require different modes of tapping, such as tapping in succession or holding down the screen.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_3.text: Go to 'Calibration Settings' to manually synchronize the music and input.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_4.text: You can customize the speed of the notes before starting a song.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_5.text: If you succeed in consecutively hitting notes in a combo, you will enter Fever Mode and earn bonus points.

TEXT_TIP_RHYTHM_6.text: You can continue the stage even if you reach Game Over, but your record will not be registered.

TEXT_TIP_RZ_1.text: Clear Stages to fill the progress bar and receive rewards!

TEXT_TIP_RZ_2.text: Entry tickets refill every day at 4PM PST.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER1_1.text: Einige Monster müssen mit Monsterbomben bekämpft werden. Setze sie klug ein!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER1_2.text: Der Hyro-Wald befindet sich in der Nähe der Heldenstadt.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER2_1.text: Entwaffne Feinde mit Rauchgranaten, die du in Truhen findest!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER2_2.text: Trista leidet unter der Tyrannei des Ordens der Schattenrose, der eines Tages auf geheimnisvolle Weise auftauchte und die Macht im Königreich ergriff.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER3_1.text: Leuchtgranaten beleuchten nicht nur den Weg, sie fügen Feinden auch Schaden zu!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER3_2.text: Die Rattenmenschen leben schon sehr lange in den Abwasserkanälen im Verborgenen.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER4_1.text: Nutze Mana, das um den Palast herum treibt, um Feinden mehr Schaden zuzufügen!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP1_CHAPTER4_2.text: Der Palast wurde einst vom früheren König von Trista und seiner Konkubine für heimliche Treffen genutzt, steht seit ihrem Tod aber leer.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_1.text: In order to improve the worsening conditions of Nosgard, King Thor formed an alliance with Emperor Alexander of Grancia.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_2.text: The capital of Nosgard, 'Snorri Edda,' is named after its first king.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_3.text: The 'Einherjar' are an elite troop of warriors with a long tradition. They deem strength and glory in battle the highest values in life.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP3_4.text: Many stories lay buried underneath the pure snow of the northern lands.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_1.text: Not only is Levine Ludvico the current head of Road Industry, she is also the designer of Neth's magical engineering troops: soldiers who annihilated Trista's Falcon No.9 Brigade in the previous war.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_2.text: Arart is the Goddess of Judgement and the former Goddess of the Volcano - as well as Bella's former teacher.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_3.text: Use Goddess Skills to neutralize Bosses' powerful attacks!

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP4_4.text: Attacking from outside the range of the Boss's shield will decrease the damage you deal.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_1.text: Use the goddess' power to escape from the influence of the corrupted veins.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_2.text: If you are not able to escape after the wanted list is out, the amount of damage you receive will get stronger.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_3.text: Use a focus block to cancel the shadow of phantasm.

TEXT_TIP_S2_EP5_4.text: Collect 3 focus blocks and delete them to cancel the shadow of phantasm for all Heroes.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_1.text: Arart's, the Goddess of Judgment, was the one who fought and sealed the corrupted Sylunis one hundred years ago.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_2.text: After Camilla Banoub was defeated, many raiders have snuck into the Temple in hopes of stealing some treasure.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_3.text: Although the descendants of the Desert Tribe are scattered across the land, they firmly believe that the legendary Three Kings will someday return to lead them once more.

TEXT_TIP_SCENARIO_S2_EP2_4.text: Elise and Arart's are the former Goddesses of the Desert and the Volcano, respectively.

TEXT_TRAIN_BOTTOM_KETTLE_01_DESC.text: Full of hot tea for the journey ahead.

TEXT_TRAIN_CENTER_WINDOW_03_DESC.text: A window looking out at the cold, bleak tundra in a state of eternal winter. When will spring arrive?

TEXT_TROPICAL_FISHING_DESC.text:
The jungle between the country of Ryu and the Primal Volcano
is wild territory, scarcely trodden by human feet.
There should be many strange species inhabiting its waters.

TEXT_TUTO_BOX_SIS_SKILL_1.text: Drück die Sera-Taste auf dem Bildschirm!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_01.text: Ich werde dir die Grundlagen des Angelns beibringen, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_02.text:
Das ist das Angelmenü, miau.
Du kannst einen Angelplatz suchen oder deine Ausrüstung oder Sammlung überprüfen.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_03.text:
This is your Fisher Rank, nya. It's the official standard set by
the Hasla Fishing Association to judge your fishing skills, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_04.text:
Je höher dein Rang ist, desto besser ist die Ausrüstung, die du bekommst, 
und desto besser sind die Angelplätze, an denen du fischen kannst, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_05.text: Catch fish to increase your Fisher Rank, nya!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_06.text:
Übung macht schließlich den Meister! 
Fang mehr Fische, um ein besserer Fischer zu werden, miau!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_07.text:
Hier kannst du deine Angelausrüstung und dein
Angelsammelalbum überprüfen, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_08.text: Im Kleidungsmenü kannst du Angelausrüstung kaufen und ausrüsten, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_09.text:
Im Angelsammelalbum kannst du alle Fische überprüfen, 
die du bei jedem Angelplatz fangen kannst, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_10.text: HFA gibt dir eine spezielle Belohnung, wenn du deine Sammlung beendest!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_11.text: Hier kannst du deinen Angelplatz auswählen, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_12.text:
Es ist für dich ein wenig früh, jetzt mit dem Angeln zu beginnen.
Lass uns zuerst hierher gehen, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_13.text:
Hier ist dein erster Angelplatz, miau!
Dies ist der Ort, an dem du nach Herzenslust fischen kannst.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_14.text:
Gut, ich denke, dass du zuerst
eine Angelrute, einen Schwimmer und einen Köder zum Angeln brauchst, miau ...

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_15.text:
Denk daran, einen Köder für eine Angelrunde, miau. 
Ohne Beute wirst du keinen Fisch fangen!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_16.text: Du kannst zum Kleidungsmenü gehen, indem du deine Angelausrüstung berührst, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_17.text:
Probieren wir es jetzt mal mit echtem Angeln, miau!
Drücke auf den Angelrolle-Button, um die Rute auszuwerfen.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_18.text:
Du hast eben deine Rute ausgeworfen, miau!
Tippe ein weiteres Mal auf den Angelrolle-Button, um die Bewegungsleiste anzuhalten.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_19.text:
Du hast eine bessere Chance, größeren Fisch zu angeln,
je näher du der Mitte der Auswerfen-Leiste kommst.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_21.text: Das ist ein toller Erfolg, miau!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_22.text:
Nachdem du jetzt deine Rute ausgeworfen hast, 
müssen wir warten, bis der Fisch anbeißt, miau!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_23.text:
Etwas hat angebissen!
Tippe auf den Angelrolle-Button und zeig dem Fisch, wer hier das Sagen hat, miau!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_24.text:
Jetzt kommt der lustige Teil: das eigentliche Angeln, miau!
Ich gebe dir ein paar wichtige Tipps, bevor du es selbst probieren kannst.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_25.text: Hier siehst du die Spannung deiner Angelschnur, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_26.text:
Wenn die Spannung deiner Schnur zu hoch ist, 
kann sie abreißen und der Fisch wird entkommen, miau!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_27.text:
Wenn andererseits die Spannung zu gering ist, 
wird der Fisch freigelassen und einfacher entkommen.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_28.text:
Durch Halten des Angelrollen-Buttons wird deine Schnur eingeholt
und die Spannung erhöht,

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_29.text: während eine Freigabe der Schnur die Spannung verringert, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_30.text:
Einfach gesagt musst du eine feine Balance finden 
und den Fisch langsam anlocken, miau! Angeln ist ein heikles Unternehmen!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_31.text:
Die Spannung der Schnur ist hoch, miau. Du kannst den Fisch so schneller einholen,
aber wenn du das maximale Limit erreichst, wird die Schnur reißen!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_32.text:
Die Spannung der Schnur ist niedrig. Der Fisch ist entkommen!
Hier, lass mich dir helfen, miau!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_33.text:
Wenn die Spannung der Schnur „grün“ ist, 
kommt der Fisch zu dir.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_34.text:
Du musst jetzt die Schnur ein wenig lockerer lassen, miau.
Lass mich dir helfen.

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_35.text: Der Fisch ist aus dem Wasser gesprungen! Bewege die Schnur rasch nach links!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_36.text:
Dieser Fisch bietet einen tollen Kampf.
Drücke auf die Blöcke, um sie zu schwächen!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_37.text:
Starker Fisch wird manchmal spezielle Fähigkeiten nutzen, um seinem Fang zu widerstehen.
Lass sie nicht gewinnen, miau!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_38.text: Du hast einen Fisch gefangen! Ich sage, das ist das MIAUEN der Katze!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_39.text:
Ich kann dir wohl nichts mehr beibringen, miau!
Hoffentlich kennst du jetzt die Freude des Angelns. Viel Glück, Kollege!

TEXT_TUTO_FISH_40.text: Jetzt kannst du versuchen, alleine zu fischen. Hier ist eine Rute, miau.

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_1.text: This is where Heroes' Block Skills are generated.

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_2.text: Tap the generated block to use a @1-chain@ Block Skill!

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_3.text:
Three @1-chain@ blocks belonging to the same Hero
combine to make one #3-chain# block.

TEXT_TUTO_GAME_PLAY_4.text: Tap the #3-chain block# to use a stronger skill!

TEXT_TUTO_GOBLIN_CHAMP_1.text:
Es wirkt sehr agil.
Glaubst du, wir könnten es angreifen?

TEXT_TUTO_GOBLIN_CHAMP_2.text:
Jetzt ist die Chance da!
Setze die Bombe ein!

TEXT_TUTO_GOBLIN_CHIEF.text:
Wir müssen uns um die anderen kümmern,
bevor wir den Anführer angreifen.

TEXT_TUTO_MAGIC_BALL_2.text:
Wir müssen Vorsichtsmaßnahmen treffen,
bevor wir es niederstrecken.

TEXT_TUTO_OGER_MINI.text:
Das ist ein kleines, aber zähes Monster.
Wie können wir seine Verteidigung durchdringen?

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_BIG.text:
Diese kleine Ratte 
verhält sich sehr verdächtig.

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_BOMB.text:
Diese Ratte mit der Bombe …
Glaubst du, Flammen können ihr etwas anhaben?

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_DECAY_SPORE_1.text:
Was sind das für Sporen …?
Wir sollten uns vor ihnen hüten!

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_DECAY_SPORE_2.text:
Sie werden explodieren!
Schnell, benutze eine Leuchtgranate!

TEXT_TUTO_RAT_GIANT.text:
Dieser Rattenmensch wirkt stark …
Sei vorsichtig!

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWDEVIL_CONFUSE.text:
Das ist dämonische Macht.
Wir wollen ihn gemeinsam aufhalten!

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWDEVIL_FINAL.text:
Dieses Monster setzt dämonische Kräfte ein …!
Nutze meine Göttinnen-Fähigkeiten!

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWROSE_GUN.text:
Hmm … Warum verwenden wir nicht die Granate,
wenn der Kerl da seine Bombe bereit macht?

TEXT_TUTO_SHADOWROSE_RIDER.text:
Wenn wir die Rauchgranate nicht benutzen,
wird dieser Hund da Alarm auslösen …!

TEXT_TUTO_SIS_1.text: Using a Hero's block will charge the Goddess's powers!

TEXT_TUTO_SIS_2.text:
Using a 3-chain block generates more Goddess power

TEXT_TUTO_SIS_3.text:

Have you heard the news? Fish were discovered to be living
in the lava lakes of the Primal Crater!
Whoever would have thought that fish could live in lava?
Let's take a look ourselves, nya!

TEXT_WALL_2000SEA_NIGHT_01_DESC.text: A dreamy wall depicting a beach at sunset.

TEXT_WALL_AMUSEMENT_SEA_01_DESC.text: A wall depicting a clear blue sky and the glittering sea beyond.

TEXT_WALL_CAMPING_FALL_01_DESC.text: A wall with falling cherry blossom petals.

TEXT_WALL_CHEN_SKY_01_DESC.text: Enter a room adorned with these walls, and you'll feel as if you've been teleported under the clear blue skies of Chen. Can that be a gentle breeze caressing your neck?

TEXT_WALL_DETECTIVE_GRAYBROWN_01_DESC.text: This time-worn Detective's Office wall may not be the cleanest, but its stains do kindle memories of a bygone era.

TEXT_WALL_FISHERY_MOUNTAIN_01_DESC.text: A realistic wallpaper that makes you feel like you're outdoors.

TEXT_WALL_GHOST_MANSION_01_DESC.text: You remember now - you've seen this place before, in a nightmare.

TEXT_WALL_GODDESS_CHURCH_01_DESC.text: Within these walls shines a divine light.

TEXT_WALL_LC_BOARD_01_DESC.text: Made from slim wooden boards joined together, this wall is surprisingly stronger than it looks. It also gives off a warm vibe.

TEXT_WALL_LC_SECRET_01_DESC.text: Black is the new pink. Welcome to the world of modernism.

TEXT_WALL_LC_STRAIGHT_01_DESC.text: Stripes go with everything, including your walls.

TEXT_WALL_MANSION_DIAPER_01_DESC.text: A classy wall with a diamond pattern and square frame panels.

TEXT_WALL_MINORITY_FOREST_01_DESC.text: The walls of a magical forest that is home to the Minor Tribes Confederation.

TEXT_WALL_NETH_IRON_01_DESC.text: Created from the most durable steel panel adhered side-by-side.

TEXT_WALL_NOS_AURA_01_DESC.text: This wall will give you the impression of gazing upon a beautiful aurora, often called "Nosern Lights," usually only seen in the northern skies of the Kingdom of Nosgard.

TEXT_WALL_NOS_WINTER_01_DESC.text: Stars are brightly shining in this winter nighttime sky - or in fact, surprisingly convincing wallpaper.

TEXT_WALL_ROMAN_COLOSSEUM_01_DESC.text: A town looking out over the sapphire-blue sea.

TEXT_WALL_RYU_SPA_01_DESC.text: Few things in life are more relaxing than the hot springs of Ryu.

TEXT_WALL_SCHOOL_BLUE_01_DESC.text: Eine weiße Mauer mit blauer Fußleiste.

TEXT_WALL_SCHOOL_WOOD_01_DESC.text: Eine feste weiße Mauer mit Holzverzierungen auf der Unterseite.

TEXT_WALL_SEA_WAVE_01_DESC.text: It's better down where it's wetter.

TEXT_WALL_SHOW_STUDIO_01_DESC.text: The carefully designed walls of this brodcasting studio focus viewers' attention on the hosts of the show.

TEXT_WALL_SOUTHWEST_WILDERNESS_01_DESC.text: A wall portraying the arid, clear sky of the Desert.

TEXT_WALL_WEDDING_PINK_01_DESC.text: A pink wall specially ordered for the perfect pink wedding.

TEXT_WISH_REWARD_DESC_1.text: The game begins once you select your desired reward.

TEXT_WISH_REWARD_DESC_2.text:
#[How to Acquire Golden Quill Pens]#

- Enter the Bingo Event after 00:00 UTC every day to receive 5 Gold Quill Pens.

- Complete Rank Quests.

- You can purchase up to 10 Golden Quill Pens per day from the menu on the upper right.

- Purchase the Bingo Pass to receive 10 additional Golden Quill Pens per day for the duration of the Event. (The Golden Quill Pens acquired through the Bingo Pass accumulate daily and can be immediately received upon purchase.)

#※ Golden Quill Pens can be stored. However, you cannot acquire or use Golden Quill Pens after the end of the Bingo Event. Any Golden Quill Pens remaining in your Inventory will be reset after the Event period.#

TEXT_WISH_REWARD_SELECT_DESC.text:
Select the reward you wish to receive before searching for Bingo!
When you find Bingo, you will receive the reward and your Bingo Card will be reset.

TEXT_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_BOX.text:
Dunkelheit senkt deine Genauigkeit um 50.
Dieser Effekt kann durch den Einsatz einer Leuchtgranate aufgehoben werden.

TEXT_WR_BLIND_GUIDE_BOX_2.text:
The intense light radiated by flash bombs deals additional damage.
Burn away charging enemies!

TEXT_WR_BLIND_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Es ist, wie ich erwartet habe.
Warte geduldig ab.

TEXT_WR_BLIND_SIS_FOREST.text:
Benutze Leuchtgranaten,
um in der Dunkelheit für Licht zu sorgen.

TEXT_WR_BOMB_CHANGE_SKILL_BELLA.text:
You can change your Special Skills in this place.
Choose wisely!

TEXT_WR_BOMB_CHARGE_SIS_FOREST.text:
Die Verwendung einer Monsterbombe
mcht den Kampf einfacher.

TEXT_WR_BOMB_EMPTY_SIS_FOREST.text:
Uns sind die Bomben ausgegangen.
Ich hole Nachschub.

TEXT_WR_BOMB_GUIDE_BOX.text: Versuche einen Block mit einer Monsterbombe.

TEXT_WR_BS_FUGUS_AERIAL_NOTICE.text:
This Fergusroid needs to be knocked high up into the air
if you want to shut down its power.

TEXT_WR_BS_FUGUS_DEBUFF_IMMNUE.text:
This Ent Robot is equipped with an impenetrable defense system.
It'll be a million years before you can sabotage it!

TEXT_WR_EP1_WORLDBOSS_TOUCHSKILL_CAMILLA.text:
...! D-das ist ...!
Wir sind in Gefahr. LAUF!!

Das sieht sehr gefährlich aus.
Wir müssen aufhören, bevor es zu spät ist!

TEXT_WR_EP1_WORLDBOSS_TOUCHSKILL_DJER.text:
Hör damit auf!
Ich helfe dir, lass uns gehen!

TEXT_WR_EP1_WORLDBOSS_TOUCHSKILL_KHASEKH.text:
Ein Schlag wird uns zu Staub zerschmettern.
Ich halte es zurück, geh hinter mich!

Hör damit auf!! Das ist unsere Chance!
Ich helfe dir, lass uns gehen!

TEXT_WR_EP1_WORLDBOSS_TOUCHSKILL_NARMER.text:
Steh JETZT auf!!
Ich halte es zurück, geh hinter mich!

TEXT_WR_EP2_WORLDBOSS_ICE.text:
Take care not to freeze.
I shall deal with the rest!

TEXT_WR_FLARE_RECHARGE_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Sind keine Granaten mehr da?
Nun, hier sind noch welche. Setze sie klug ein.

TEXT_WR_FLARE_RECHARGE_SIS_FOREST.text:
Ich habe die Leuchtgranaten
wieder aufgeladen!

TEXT_WR_FLARE_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Wir können die Ratten Menschen jetzt
klarer erkennen.

TEXT_WR_FLARE_SIS_FOREST.text:
Besiege den Feind,
während es noch hell ist!

TEXT_WR_FUGUROID_START.text:
Defeat the robotsand you can take
whatever you want from my storage!

TEXT_WR_GAUGE_MAX_MONSTER_1.text:
Was soll der Krawall?
Du stehst unter Arrest!

TEXT_WR_GAUGE_MAX_MONSTER_1_COUNT5.text:
Kreise den Feind ein
und bereite dich auf völlige Vernichtung vor!

TEXT_WR_GAUGE_MAX_SIS_FOREST.text:
O nein! Wir haben
zu viel Lärm gemacht!

TEXT_WR_GAUGE_MAX_SIS_FOREST_COUNT5.text:
Der Kampf dauert schon zu lange.
Wir können es nicht länger aufhalten …

TEXT_WR_GAUGE_SIS_FOREST.text:
Sei leise, wenn 
du sie angreifst.

TEXT_WR_GAUGE_START_ROCHEFORT.text:
Kümmere dich darum,
und zwar so leise wie möglich.

TEXT_WR_MANA_BLOCK_1_GUIDE_BOX.text:
Die geheimnisvolle Kraft stellt Mana wieder her
und erhöht dann die Angriffsmacht des Helden.

TEXT_WR_MANA_BLOCK_1_GUIDE_BOX_2.text:
Wenn die Mama-Anzeige voll ist, fügt die Fähigkeit [Überfließendes Mana] 
Feinden mächtigen Schaden zu und die Anzeige leert sich.

TEXT_WR_MANA_BLOCK_2_GUIDE_BOX.text:
Nutze den Manastrom, um dich zu heilen
und deine Angriffsmacht zu erhöhen.

TEXT_WR_MANA_BLOCK_3_GUIDE_BOX.text: Nutze den Manastrom, um Avenir anzugreifen.

TEXT_WR_MANA_BLOCK_NPC_ELLIE.text:
Rata und ich werden versuchen, 
die Maschine zu aktivieren!

TEXT_WR_MANA_BLOCK_NPC_RATA.text:
Quietsch? Eine seltsame Kraft
geht von dieser Maschine aus!

TEXT_WR_MANA_BLOCK_SIS_FOREST.text:
Eine seltsame Kraft
erfüllt diesen Palast …

TEXT_WR_REBLIND_SIS_CHRONOS.text:
Wieder senkt sich die Finsternis.
Benutze die Leuchtgranate.

TEXT_WR_S2EP2CH1_PUZZLE_01.text:
It's a trap!
We have to disarm it!

TEXT_WR_S2EP2CH1_PUZZLE_02.text:
Pull the rope until
the mural is correctly assembled!

TEXT_WR_S2EP2CH2_UFO_01.text:
What's that?
It's flying toward us!

TEXT_WR_S2EP2_CH3_BOMB_01.text:
The pulse of mana is speeding up.
Let's hurry.

TEXT_WR_S2_EP3_CH1_01.text:
The storm grows stronger.
Use the strength of the Goddess!

TEXT_WR_S2_EP3_CH2_02.text: A shadow nearby is after you.

TEXT_WR_S2_EP3_CH3_01.text: The cold cuts through the bone...

TEXT_WR_S2_EP4_CH1_01.text: Huh? What's that in the sky? ... I-it's a missile!

TEXT_WR_S2_EP4_CH2_01.text: This laser device... It's reacting to my Goddess powers.

TEXT_WR_S2_EP4_CH3_01.text: Be careful of those balls! Don't get hit!

TEXT_WR_S2_EP5_CH1_01.text:
Eek… I'm losing power…
Please help!

TEXT_WR_S2_EP5_CH3_01.text:
I feel the essence of a foreign energy
somewhere deep inside this palace…

TEXT_WR_S2_EP5_CH3_02.text:
When you feel a corrupted energy,
try to focus in one spot.

TEXT_WR_SMOKE_BLUE_SIS_FOREST.text:
Das Monster mit der blauen Aura
scheint schwächer geworden zu sein.

TEXT_WR_SMOKE_EMPTY_ROCHEFORT.text:
Hast du schon keine mehr?
Tss, warte mal eben.

TEXT_WR_SMOKE_EMPTY_SIS_FOREST.text:
Ich hole noch eine
Rauchgranate heraus.

TEXT_WR_SMOKE_GUIDE_BOX.text: Verwende den Rauchgranaten-Block, um den Feind zu entwaffnen.

TEXT_WR_SMOKE_RED_SIS_FOREST.text:
Das Monster mit der roten Aura
scheint schwächer geworden zu sein.

TEXT_WR_SMOKE_ROCHEFORT.text:
Ich bin sicher, wir haben den Feind geschwächt.
Jetzt holen wir zum letzten Schlag aus.

TEXT_WR_SMOKE_YELLOW_SIS_FOREST.text:
Das Monster mit der gelben Aura
scheint schwächer geworden zu sein.

TEXT_WR_WORLDBOSS_SANDSTORM.text:
Was ist das für ein Sandsturm?
Wir können unsere Göttinnenkräfte nicht nutzen!

TEXT_YS8_DUNGEON_LOCK_DESC.text: Du musst noch mehr Schiffbrüchige retten, bevor du das Verlies betreten kannst.

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_02_T.text: Let’s hang our stockings on the tree!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_04_T.text: Good to see everyone looking happy!

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_05_T.text: Shall we bake some Christmas cake?

TEXT_202201_LIMIT_QUEST_2022NEWYEAR_06_T.text: Always so excited... during this time of the year.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_01_TITLE.text: I smile when I see children playing happily.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_02_TITLE.text: Well! Why don't you try something? Smile like me!

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_03_TITLE.text: If everyone can smile together, of course I will join them.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_04_TITLE.text: What did the mama cow say to the baby now? It's pasture bedtime! Hahaha!

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_05_TITLE.text: I give the pitiful people who chase me my happy mocking smile.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_06_TITLE.text: Maria's smile is so precious that it must be protected at all costs.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_07_TITLE.text: I cannot stop smiling when people fight each other out of hatred.

TEXT_202204_LIMIT_QUEST_LAUGH_08_TITLE.text: *Chuckles* Oh, this isn't actually a smile?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_01_TITLE.text: Ah... Family... Marriage... I should start...

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_02_TITLE.text: We are all in a family! Let's be a good one!

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_03_TITLE.text: My sister's sins are mine to bear as well.

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_04_TITLE.text: Perhaps one day, I could patch things up with Odin and have a pint or two as well?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_05_TITLE.text: I'm worried every day that my younger sister might get into trouble.

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_06_TITLE.text: Anzu! We are family forever! Right!?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_07_TITLE.text: Can providence of artifice make a family too...?

TEXT_202205_LIMIT_QUEST_FAMILY_08_TITLE.text: What is a family indeed? I don’t know what a family should look like just by looking at others.

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_01_TITLE.text: Such a fine weather to go on a picnic.

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_02_TITLE.text: A picnic full of pleasant events!

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_03_TITLE.text: I hope everyone enjoys the picnic...

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_04_TITLE.text: A picnic... Well, a musical motif comes to my mind

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_05_TITLE.text: I will pack lunch for everyone!

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_06_TITLE.text: A picnic? I will join with my younger sibling.

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_07_TITLE.text: I want to go on a treasure hunt!

TEXT_202206_LIMIT_QUEST_PICNIC_08_TITLE.text: What about a picnic with your friend?

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_01_TITLE.text: Listening to the sound of rain soothes me.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_03_TITLE.text: The rain is becoming more acidic.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_04_TITLE.text: The rain is a blessing to the forest.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_05_TITLE.text: It’s too dangerous to set sail.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_06_TITLE.text: I don't like rain since it melts beautiful snowflakes.

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_07_TITLE.text: Ahh! My boots are completely soaked!

TEXT_202207_LIMIT_QUEST_RAINY_08_TITLE.text: It’s a good day to clean up the blood spilt from the game.

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_01_TI.text: You did a good job this summer as always.

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_02_TI.text: Don’t procrastinate and then blame the hot weather!

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_03_TI.text: Where water is, Death always awaits.

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_04_TI.text: Water activities are the best in hot summer!

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_05_TI.text: Enjoy the hot oven as hot as summer heat!

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_06_TI.text: Only if I had a friend to enjoy water activities together...

TEXT_202208_LIMIT_QUEST_SUNGLASSES_07_TI.text: (Water activities? No way, those are for little kids.)

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_01_TITLE.text: It would be nice to take some time off training to get some reading done.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_02_TITLE.text: Picture books are quite fun too!

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_03_TITLE.text: Reading? I don’t need to read. I can get all the answers online.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_04_TITLE.text:
The smell of trees seeping through the pages, and the refreshing wind.
Autumn is here at last.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_06_TITLE.text: It’s never too late to learn. Try to make reading into a habit.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_07_TITLE.text: I acquainted books to learn about love, but here I am, in love with books themselves.

TEXT_202210_LIMIT_QUEST_READ_08_TITLE.text: It is nice to flip through the pages on a street bench covered in fallen leaves.

TEXT_202211_LIMIT_QUEST_HW_07_TITLE.text: Don’t be lazy just because it’s Halloween.

TEXT_202211_LIMIT_QUEST_HW_08_TITLE.text: Excuse me... Can I get some... c-candy?

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022SNOWFLOWER_0.text: Shall we go outside to enjoy cherry blossoms together when spring comes?
It is still cold out there. Be careful not to catch a cold.
Butterflies will usher in the spring.
Let's focus on developing a new menu for the spring, shall we?
Seeds of life began to sprout.
I wish spring would come faster so that flowers can bloom...
I can't wait to have a party with my friends!

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_01_TI.text: It must be really cold outside.

TEXT_202212_LIMIT_QUEST_2022WINTER_02_TI.text: Cold weather is also a part of nature.
