TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_35.text: He grew up as a wealthy boy in a huge castle. Nottingham’s hobby was exploring every nook and cranny of his castle. One day, he stumbled upon a hidden place that led to a basement cellar. There, he found prisoners and smuggled properties. Shocked at the discovery of the unjust ways with which his family had been gaining wealth, he felt ashamed of the privileges and luxuries that he had been unknowingly enjoying.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_36.text: Xiaohui Tang hit the road to find and return the favor to her benefactor, but her story is distorted into a false rumor that says “the next leader of House Tang is coming to take revenge on a herbalist who tried to assassinate her,” so Lazie is doing his best to stay out of her sight.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_37.text: She is officially the teacher in charge of the Chick Class at an orphanage run by the Order of the Goddess, but in reality, she teaches the little children how to become inquisitors who interrogate and assassinate targets. Aside from her teaching skills, the people around her are worried about her lack of basic life and social skills. Her one and only friend is Luicilla, who went through the training with her. They do not openly express their urgency, but both are struggling to find a spouse before their prime begins waning.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_6_39.text: Hina was born with extraordinary spiritual potential, but her true talent lies in her brain; she is a genius. Hina’s math teacher at Neth Academy took notice of how smart Hina was and ran a test in secret to measure her intelligence - and the test result displayed that Hina is in the top 1% of the population in intelligence. Ever since the test results came in, the Neth Academy is trying to persuade Hina into attending the academy’s ‘Gifted Education Program’.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_AR_LIMITED_EQUIP_6_.text: Djura was an AI that replaces one of the four auxiliary AIs every 200 years, but after an incident, it ended up drifting in the dimensional rift alone. It took Djura only five minutes to return to the reality, but her calculated experience amounted to 20,000 years in time in the course of the drift. Because of this time disparity, Djura's forebrain became insane.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_35.text: Although the paradise of cats she created near Pumpkin City has now become a target for both Pumpkin City and Animal Loving Adventurers, there isn’t much that could be done because it is impossible to conquer the place without hurting the cats who fiercely protect Anima.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_37.text:
Born weak, Anne spent her whole life in bed. She only interacted with her family and homeschool teacher. She had never seen the world outside, having no experience with friendship nor love. Everything she knew came from the books she read or the stories she heard. Anne spent every day imagining her being surrounded by her peers and what her first love would be like. Sadly, she perished on the bed before experiencing any of these things she had imagined. She was only 19 when she passed away. It would be too pitiful for someone to die at 19.

She used to hear that her aesthetic senses were peculiar. Maybe she was influenced by her mother, who was a cubism artist. Thanks to her mother, Anne learned how to see things from a different perspective.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_39.text: Nene can virtually go to any place in the universe at will using her Deer-dog, Vivi’s dimensional traveling ability. While traveling areas outside of Hasla, Nene learned a lot of valuable information that can’t be found in Hasla. However, she never shares outside information with the people back home, as it can “do more harm than good” if they know.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_6_40.text: Lime speaks like a human and acts like a normal person “most of the time”, but she is simply following Lilith, her master’s instructions; she does not fully understand human behavior. And although she looks at ease, she is constantly using magic inside her body to replicate her cells to prolong her life. Lime’s biggest fear is ‘death’.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_HU_LIMITED_AUCTION_.text: Milady lives by a code. No matter how big of a mistake her subordinates make, she forgives them, once. But if one of them happen to repeat the same mistake twice, Milady shows no mercy. When Milady took over her grandfather’s organization, she saw countless men that betrayed her grandfather, begging for forgiveness, while secretly planning other ways to betray the organization. She swore to never forgive those who do not deserve it.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_34.text: As the inventor of ‘Ogrenology,’ Ozma made some other handy inventions as well, but she couldn’t explain the exact mechanism behind them. After a few miraculous inventions like the infinite power generator or the wireless shower head, which would have flabbergasted any engineer of Neth, the Devil Island now turned into a bizarrely good place to live...

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_37.text:
On the first day of recording her album, Uzume sang her heart and soul out. Thankfully, her singing was well-arranged and edited by the skilled record producers. The staffs worked day and night for 17 days, and took a long vacation afterwards.

On the first day of Uzume's concert, some of the audience tried to escape, but strangely all the exits were locked, so they were forced to listen to all of her songs. Later on, Uzume shocked everyone once again by claiming that she saw the audience crying because of her moving performance.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_39.text:
Drinking enough energy drinks to recover from fatigue properly can help her exercise a tremendous amount of power. On the other hand, energy drink shortage can cause instant fatigue and sleep on her. This is because the energy drink sold in Neth is the same as the nectar from Life Support System Device in Heaven but diluted to suit the taste of people in Neth.
She always wants to repay her favor to Affogato, who has been taking care of her like a real father, but her innate laziness is delaying this payback.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_6_40.text:
Since this elemental was born out of human prayers, she loves humans a lot. That is why her emotion gets mixed up with feelings of anger, sadness, and naughtiness whenever she is disliked by humans. The weather reflects Kumori's emotions. When she feels depressed, the sky is covered with rain clouds, and it starts raining if she feels like crying. 

She's still a little child who can't properly control her own feelings.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_6.text: Since ancient times, the gaze sent by something within the Sea of Stars has terrified countless mortals. One day, a wizard claiming that fear comes from ignorance started his own research to uncover the mystery behind the gaze. He finally crossed the mental horizon and arrived at the Sea of Stars, after defeating the ‘Death’ he had created, but there was nothing found there. The wizard later titled himself the Owner of the Void and ascended to the position of Transcendent to become one of the Eight Great Dragon Kings, but he never managed to uncover the truth behind the identity of the gaze.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PA_LIMITED_ENT_6_EV.text: Evgenia believes that elves are superior over every other race - and is why she hates the fact that the Elven Realm is currently under Grancia’s control. Evgenia is planning to overthrow the Grancia Empire with her Elven followers.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_36.text:
He uses the iron maiden that he carries on his back as a sleeping bag when he sleeps in the open.
Many frown upon Baharha and his bizarre behaviors, but some consider him a living inspiration or even an archbishop. The high echelon of the faithful of the Goddess branded him a heretic and tortured him to convert him to the right path, but they soon gave up after seeing him enjoying the torture.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_37.text:
She falls asleep when she listens to gentle and soothing music.
She can turn anything she gets her hands on into a drum set. Whatever she finds around her, she taps it with hands.
It is difficult to say if she is serious about succeeding her family legacy since she is a party animal. Still, her positive and energetic attitude tend to help her solve complicated problems so easily with the best result. Some consider her a grand strategist while others discount her as a spoiled child in a string of luck.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_39.text:
The most recent accident occurred when she attended the grand banquet in Grancia as she made her debut at the social gathering. She accidentally stepped on Victoria’s foot with a pointed heel while dancing, then tripped over Tia’s leg who came to check on Victoria, which caused the champagne glass tower to collapse, shattering all the glasses and ruining the banquet for good. Paying damages for the custom-made champagne glasses with blue jewels was quite costly, and so were the hospital charges for Victoria and Tia's injury. Let’s not forget about the look on devastated Lednas’ face, who poured her heart and soul into the banquet.
Nonetheless, being the lovable person that she is, Ashley was neither overly criticized nor hated by people around her. Sometimes, people who know of her difficult situation refuse the compensation she’s willing to offer, but Ashley, who doesn’t like being an inconvenience to others, goes out of her way to pay for her mistakes and offer an apology, even if it means taking out a loan.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_40.text:
She's always thankful to the savior who saved her from danger when she was a little child. She is determined to return a favor if she happens to meet the person again while traveling in Hasla. 

 One day, some people began to taste the beverage offered by Ranee and soon they fell in love with the drink and its resultant euphoria effect. They eventually lost a sense of reality after overdrinking it without stopping. They got addicted to Ranee's drink, and did nothing but drink it all day. Being afraid of the unintended side effects of the drink, Ranee stopped serving the drinks. But the drink addicts resolved to violence and began to attack Ranee. Shocked by their violence, Ranee declared that she would serve only one sip a day for each customer.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_6_41.text: When Anton was on his journey around Hasla, he was a renowned epicure with many who read his food reviews. His reviews were always objectively written, and his descriptions on the food he tasted were detailed and well thought out. That is until all of his reviews began to only praise a certain dish called ‘Seonji Stew.’

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_PR_LIMITED_TRADE_6_.text: Lacrimoso always acts to help others and gives his all to help those in need. Lacrimoso's followers worry that he might be taken advantage of by those with ill intentions, but even the shadiest people eventually reform themselves and do Lacrimoso's "smallest" favors to the best of their abilities after spending some time with him.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_37.text: He is a nobody if he removes his balloon accessories and/or makeup. What he most often hears is, 'Uhm... Do I know you?' and 'Oh, you look like someone I know'.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_38.text: Her fan club, the Red Cape Squad, got its name after the Red Cape Squad, a Demon unit under her command when she was one of the Elite Four.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_39.text:
Born and raised in a laboratory, she is approximately one year old, but due to the power of scientific technology, has the intellectual maturity of a 15-year-old.

She has five senses that are several times more sensitive than the others due to the influence of the Artificial Goddess experiment. For this reason, a normal voice may sound loud like a roaring thunder and the human body smell may be perceived too disgusting to bear for her, which explains her edginess and acute sensitivity.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_40.text:
Briseis is from a seemingly distinguished Roman family. However, the truth is her family is actually a house of assassins that has been secretly growing power over generations.

Briseis was spoiled by her shameless grampa when growing up. People regarded her as a prodigy when she managed to get on her grampa's shoulder without anybody knowing about it when she was just a baby. She can be a bit rude because everybody used to praise her even when she tried to pull pranks on them, such as plucking the beard of adults or ticking them. However, people well accept her as a cute rascal because she's easygoing and has no ill intentions. 

Her transforming skills are flawless. However, her peculiar laughs and gestures soon give her away. Most people are aware of her disguise, but they just go along with her play not to embarrass her.

She was very happy when she was engaged to Achilles. She was determined to become the perfect fiance to match his nobleness, but the rose-colored glasses came off as he began to expose his weaknesses. Nonetheless, she decided to bear with him in benevolence because she thought only she could embrace his kind.

Her grampa betrothed her to Achilles because he did not want her to succeed his assassination business. Therefore, upon finding out that Achilles had been using her as an assassin, he was enraged and tried to break off the engagement and assassinate Achilles. However, he had to give up on that plan upon hearing her saying that she was truly in love with Achilles.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_6_41.text: The quick delivery service QuickDash that Tramontana works for is currently drowning under waves of copyright and misdelivery lawsuits from both individuals and organizations. From delivering unreleased products to rival companies, thus allowing them to file a patent first, to delivering food that hadn’t been ordered to poor customers on diets, thus making them ruin all their hard work, QuickDash is facing a lot of heat. Tramontana had the CEO of the company sweating bullets, living in terror, because she kept hacking into their system to run deliveries even though they revoked her delivery license.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_LIMITED_AUCTION_.text: In her(?) previous life, Tian Mo was a well-esteemed martial arts master who was feared by the people of his land. As such, Tian Mo felt utterly devastated when he was reincarnated as a girl. However, Tian Mo didn’t fret for too long; she immediately started shaping her body and spirit to once again climb the hierarchy of the martial arts world. However, not too long after, Tian Mo had an unfortunate accident during an intensive meditation session. Tian Mo’s fragile body couldn’t bear her powerful spirit and went out of control. The accident permanently damaged her mind and spirit - she can no longer bear the urge to call those who are older than her, losers♡.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_LIMITED_EIGHTH_6.text: The place where Leonia had obtained the ‘Heart of the Star’ that later became the material for Caliburn was a forgotten temple in the northern remote area, now blocked by the ‘Insurmountable Mountains’. According to the inscription next to the Heart of the Star enshrined in the center of the temple, Hasla was originally part of a certain planet. It was torn apart in the aftermath of an experiment conducted by the ancients, which was how it came to wander through the crevice of dimensions. Another inscription next to it said that Hasla was a mobile fortress that had invaded another planet to steal the Heart of the Star, and next to it said Hasla was just a stage in a virtual space that did not exist. It made Leonia stop thinking no more.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WA_LIMITED_TRADE_6_.text: Knowing only that he looks much younger than her and is interested in magical girls, she jumped to a hasty conclusion and became a ☆magical☆ ☆girl☆ out of the blue. Her goal is to familiarize herself with the culture of the current Demon youths and hold uninterrupted conversations with the youthful boy. However, her long years of reclusion without correspondence made it extremely difficult for her to stay up to others’ conversational tempo and comprehend the pop culture of the latest generation, making her spout cringeworthy, out-of-context slangs and putting the listeners at unease.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_37.text:
He had a complex about his curly hair, so he used to hide it under the hood when he was young. Now, after learning what makes a Nosgardian warrior stand out from the crowd, he feels comfortable with his wild curly hair.
He loves exercise but has gained not much muscle since he has a poor appetite and is naturally born weak.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_39.text:
An inactive brain due to coma or fainting will cause an immediate state of suspended animation. Her body can keep itself active instead of her brain until the caffeine in the body runs out, but if the body is not supplied with enough caffeine in time, the brain will stop working and die.
The relationship with Niko began as he helped Nico, who was then being chased by Neth, hide inside his coffee shop.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_40.text:
During her years in the Pumpkin City, she kept failing in the classes. She wasn't interested in the four elements of magic, which were the main subjects of the school. Classmates thought she was a weirdo because she was always interested in other magics which had nothing to do with school grades. But she caught Estelle's attention and they began to study the bubble amplifying magic together. Fascinated with the magic, Thalia dug into it even further. Thalia was only interested in bubble magics, and she was stressed out from unnecessary tips and advices about how to raise school grades or maintain good friendship. Having decided that bubbles were the only thing Thalia needed, she dropped out of school and returned home to focus her research on bubble magics.

Ever since figuring out how to use bubble magics as weapon, she has been studying how to make it more powerful. She's currently working on developing 'Eye Stinging Bubble' where capsaicin and black peppers are added to irritate enemy eyes. Also, she is developing 'Slippery Bubble!' mixed with ogre extract, which feels obnoxiously offensive when stepping on it.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_6_41.text: Even though he appears to be a young man on the outside, on the inside he’s an ornery, grumpy old man. The lecturing he constantly spouts based on outdated values will literally eat away at your soul. Even in life, he valued seniority above all else, so his attitude towards Jack -- who he wasn’t sure whether was older or younger than him -- was a bit ambiguous. But on the other hand, seeing Deokpal truly respect and even follow Gordian, who was younger than him, made it a little unclear whether he had any flexibility or not. Luckily for him, having been a skilled gat-maker, there were lots of demon folk who liked to wear black gats as fashion pieces. Those who complimented his gats saw a much softer side of him.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_ENT_6_GO.text: When Gordian lost his wife, Rebecca, the mother of Vivian, he took in Nia as his concubine and gave birth to Rachel. The nobles of his realm deemed Nia and Rachel unworthy of royal treatment, as Nia was a demon born of lowly status. But Gordian loved his family all the same. Whatever it took, whether through ‘peaceful methods’ or ‘violence,’ Gordian made sure his followers respected every member of his family.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EQUIP_6_.text: Nebula seems devoid of any emotion, but it’s just awkward to express emotion after spending 20,000 years all alone. It tries to find the fittest words for any given situation, but fails to articulate the final expression and goes silent. Due to its poker-faced behavior, no one realizes the changes happened to Nebula.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_LIMITED_TRADE_6_.text: Despite having lost most of her memories, Livea is still aware of herself as a proudly solitary and absolute being. Holding immeasurable powers, the sturdy bones summoned by Livea from beyond the void are actually her own bones. However, Livea's current body separated from her primary body is as fragile as an ordinary human body, so it easily gets hurt from tripping and hitting objects.

Nothing “triggered” her obsession with money. She has loved money for as long as she can remember. She was just born that way. Poor childhood? The fact that she didn’t know where her parents were and where her hometown was didn't bother her much. Rather, she used it as a way to make people pity her so that she could make more money. 

The part-time delivery job at Pumpkin City was a means to finance the sale of pumpkin stakes. When she witnessed the talent of her colleague ‘Iris’, she saw that as a way to make larger profits, and of course she didn’t miss the chance. The success of ‘Rainbow Delivery’ led to a series of huge investments, and she finally got her hands on the money she wanted. ‘Goodbye Pumpkin City.’ She took everything and left for ‘Devil Island’, a secluded island in Hasla. There, she would be called by her third alias, ‘Mammon’.

She came to Devil Island for one reason: to find out where her roots were. She could infer, by things only she could know, that her roots belonged to Devil Island. Her magical power that lures others - it must be a magical ability unique to the Demons. The ability grew much stronger in her hometown than when she was in Pumpkin City.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_PRYDWEN.text: At a glance, you might assume that Prydwen is just throwing in random ingredients for her bombs. But in actuality, Prydwen is very precise and calculative when crafting her wild creations. Her talent goes beyond just crafting bombs. By cooking with the perfect temperature, Prydwen’s Chen-styled skewered chicken is known to taste better than the ones you can find locally in Chen. But despite her fantastic cooking skills, she often eats alone as she has no real friends.

TEXT_PROFILE_ETC_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_YAMA.text: One of the titles of 'Chantico,' the ancient guardian goddess that protects the Primal Volcano. She shows herself in different forms depending on who sees her, and supposedly, the soul of the viewer that perceives the world seem to determine her appearance. For this reason, she was called by hundreds or even thousands of names in the ancient times, but ever since the mankind of Hasla built civilization and agreed on a unified sense of the world, this number was reduced to a dozen or so.

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_35.text: Conceit and pretense, pride and prejudice, bull’s eye betting, trying to read Robin Hood’s mind, drunkard’s nuisance, and sarcastic remarks

TEXT_PROFILE_HATES_CHA_AR_6_37.text: Genevie, wedding stories, holidays, alumni meeting

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_1_001_2.text: I think you sent this to the wrong person.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_2_001_2.text: It’s good to see you working so hard.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_2_002_1.text: Yeah that’s right. What a pity...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_3_001_1.text: If it’s Vivi... it could be possible.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_3_001_2.text: How could a deerdog send a message.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_4_001_1.text: Never mind, let’s just forget about it.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_4_001_2.text: Then I’ll just go ahead and ask, too.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_5_002_1.text: Don’t throw it away. I’ll use it.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_001_5_002_2.text: I was kidding. Give it to me. Where do I have go to?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_002_2_001_2.text: If that’s what you wanna think.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_002_2_002_1.text: I told you, it’s not like that.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_002_3_001_2.text:
Oh my gosh, what are you gonna say this time
I’ll hear you out, least.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_002_3_002_2.text: You’re not gonna believe me even if I say it’s not.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_002_4_001_1.text: No... No... I’m telling you, it’s really not...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_002_5_001_1.text: You don’t listen even though I tell you...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_003_3_001_1.text: It’s not ok to inconvenience other people.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_003_4_001_2.text: Just get out of the house first!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_003_4_002_1.text: Why on Hasla did you do that?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_004_1_001_2.text: What’s this, out of nowhere? Are you tryna fight?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_004_1_002_1.text: I dunno what to say... you’re right.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_004_2_001_1.text: I’m gonna eat the instant noodles Ashley left.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_004_2_001_2.text: I’m gonna eat the cake Kumori gave me...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_004_2_002_1.text: Not a single mistake... You’re right.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_004_2_002_2.text: Arrgh, telling me to not eat it just makes me want to eat it even more.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_004_4_002_1.text: Ugh, you’re so strict. I bet you have no friends!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_005_1_002_1.text: You mean to say it’s that sturdy?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_005_3_002_1.text: Flaming Hot Fried Noodles? Is that really spicy?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_005_3_002_2.text: Yeah? If I go now, can I eat some?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_005_4_001_2.text: He’s always in some emergen... never mind.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_005_5_002_2.text: I see, well, seeing as how everything turned out OK, it’s fine.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_1_002_1.text: I’ll stop by soon to eat some stew.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_1_002_2.text: Haha, you can simply stop selling.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_2_001_1.text: You’re really serious about stew, aren’t you?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_2_001_2.text: The warmth is quite yummy indeed.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_2_002_1.text: While my will is as strong as an oak, I’m a little too busy right now.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_3_001_2.text: Even though the broth tastes the same?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_4_001_2.text: Pff, please, your exaggeration is exaggerating.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_4_002_2.text: I’m not familiar with such things.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_006_5_001_2.text: That’s not enough to kill you.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_1_002_2.text: About 6 P.M. the day after tomorrow?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_3_001_1.text: Now? What’s the occasion? It’s the middle of the day.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_3_001_2.text: What is it? Is it... Malsook’s Place?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_3_002_2.text: The stew is probably still fresh.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_3_003_1.text: It’s not really to my taste.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_4_002_1.text: If that’s the case, I don’t wanna eat it.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_4_002_2.text: So you broke the pot? Really?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_4_003_1.text: Am I... the one at fault here?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_5_001_2.text: That’s a good look for you, heh...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_007_5_002_1.text: I’m just gonna have some instant noodles.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_008_2_002_1.text: After hearing about it, that does seem to be the case.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_008_2_002_2.text: Yeah, but the improved rice cakes and stew were yummy.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_008_3_001_2.text: So what’re you gonna do about it?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_008_3_002_2.text: So you’re not even gonna call each other by name anymore?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_008_4_001_2.text: What a surprise. I thought you wouldn’t ever contact me again.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_008_5_002_1.text: Yeah, exactly. I’m not like that.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_009_3_003_2.text: Is this the new script for the performance? It’s fun~

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_009_4_001_2.text: Do you want me to go visit you in the hospital?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_010_1_001_2.text: I guess I’m a little like that.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_010_2_001_1.text: Huh? You guys went to the event together?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_010_2_002_2.text: Calm down. There’s still time. Wait it out a little.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_010_3_003_2.text: What this?! They’re exactly the same.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_010_4_002_2.text: Hehe, it’ll take more than that to kill me~

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_010_5_002_1.text: I’m not sure what’s happening but congratulations.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_010_5_003_1.text: So there’s another thing you like.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_011_1_002_2.text: Are you... using me as a memo pad?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_011_2_001_1.text: What on Hasla are you doing now?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_011_3_001_1.text: Oh, the way you do that is...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_011_3_001_2.text: Want me to do it instead?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_011_3_002_2.text: Even though there’ll be more uses for it soon?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_011_5_002_2.text: Something tasty? Good! I was getting really hungry.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_012_2_003_1.text: Are you talking about the talent show?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_012_5_001_2.text: I see you’re finally contacting me?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_1_001_1.text: Is mankind inherently good or evil?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_1_002_1.text: I’ll help you no matter what.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_1_002_2.text: Shouldn’t I be the one getting paid to do it?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_2_001_1.text: Ogre technology is the best in the world.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_3_001_1.text: I wanna see a picture of your face.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_3_001_2.text: If that’s how you’re gonna be, I’m not gonna help you anymore.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_5_001_1.text: Ooh, is your social anxiety showing?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_014_5_001_2.text: Of course it’s OK, I’ll go anywhere.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_1_001_2.text: Your taste can change as you grow older.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_2_001_1.text: What kind of psychological test is it?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_2_001_2.text: Do I have to answer seriously?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_2_002_1.text:
Just because you’re an adult doesn’t mean you’re a
grown-up. You need to be mature as well to be a grown-up.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_3_001_2.text: By any chance... are the flames in your hair the reason?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_3_002_1.text: Let’s calm down and talk this out, how about that?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_3_002_2.text: Is there no way to expel it from the body?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_4_001_1.text: How are you supposed to fight against something that’s possessed your body?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_4_001_2.text: So are you losing right now?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_4_002_1.text: Will you be OK? You seem mentally drained.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_4_002_2.text: Are you sure the situation’s not just getting worse?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_5_001_1.text: I’m going to celebrate your victory.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_015_5_001_2.text: I’m going to see that rascal bunny’s fate.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_1_001_1.text: That is a big deal... yes... hmm...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_1_002_1.text: Who’s the guy you’ve talked to the most recently?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_1_002_2.text: Who comes to mind when I say “a guy?”

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_2_001_1.text: I saw him try to pick up a sock Victoria took off.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_2_001_2.text: I saw him try to pick up a tissue Victoria blew her nose in.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_3_001_2.text: You confessed your feelings, didn’t you?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_3_002_1.text: I see it’s not the kids you’re worried about.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_3_002_2.text: Why are children carrying around something as dangerous as that?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_4_002_1.text: Did you get any birthday presents?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_016_4_002_2.text: Is your heart feeling a little better?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_017_1_001_1.text: What if you hid your ears and tail?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_017_2_001_2.text: Weren’t you... I dunno... a little embarrassed?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_017_3_001_1.text: Sing her a lullaby so she can sleep well.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_017_3_001_2.text: Put your hand on her forehead to see how warm it is.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_017_4_001_2.text: Can you sing while wearing that?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_1_001_1.text: You can take a picture and send it right away.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_1_001_2.text: You can talk to someone even from really far away.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_1_002_1.text: I’m gonna have to thank the old guy.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_1_002_2.text: I’m gonna have to thank Echidna.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_2_001_1.text: From a purely “making me gain weight” perspective, you really are a demon.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_2_001_2.text: Looks like you’re really into Neth desserts.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_2_002_1.text: I’m happy cuz you look so happy.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_2_002_2.text: I’ll forgive you if you give me some dessert.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_3_001_1.text: You’ve just committed a heinous crime.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_3_002_1.text: Are you worried about your sister?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_3_002_2.text: If you worry first, you lose!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_4_001_1.text: I don’t know if you don’t say it with your words.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_4_001_2.text: Let’s show it with our actions, and not just our words.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_018_5_001_2.text: If it makes you uncomfortable, of course I have to go to you right away.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_019_1_001_2.text: I see you’re the same on Oztalk.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_019_2_001_1.text: I agree completely with everything you say.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_019_2_001_2.text: Perhaps they also want to live free lives?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_019_3_001_1.text: Thank you for viewing me so favorably.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_019_3_001_2.text: You’re saying I’m still lacking in a few areas, right?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_019_5_001_1.text: So are you going to be a changed man from here on out?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_019_5_001_2.text: You wouldnt be you if you were too soft, Mr. Deokpal.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_020_2_001_1.text: Please leave it in front of the door.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_020_4_003_1.text: Three. I knew I should’ve gotten pizza.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_020_5_001_1.text: I mean, I still haven’t ordered.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_020_5_001_2.text: It’s very unusual... Has something happened?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_1_001_1.text: Yeah, I did. Did you text me to thank me?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_1_001_2.text: It looked like the elves could use my help.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_1_005_1.text: I did give you my reply. Did you not understand me?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_2_001_2.text: I thought you said to never talk to you again.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_2_003_2.text: Is it okay to speak about your father like that?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_2_004_2.text: ...so you are trying to judge me?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_2_005_1.text: What is this, a job interview?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_2_005_2.text: Can you please be kinder to me?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_2_006_1.text: I don’t know what you are talking about!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_2_006_2.text: If that’s true, I guess you are inferior to me.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_3_001_2.text: What chance? Let me hear it.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_4_001_1.text: What are you trying to figure out?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_4_002_2.text: Okay, what did you want me to figure out?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_4_006_2.text: Let me give you an advice

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_5_003_1.text: Let me tell you about it

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_021_5_003_2.text: I have to show you in person.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_022_2_001_2.text: I have a phobia of letters...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_022_3_001_1.text: That kind of feature doesn’t exist!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_022_3_001_2.text: Just saw your message, I was busy

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_022_3_002_1.text: I’ve seen that skin tone before...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_022_4_001_2.text: I was fighting in the arena...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_022_4_002_1.text: Gordian, you enjoy stuff like that?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_1_004_2.text: I’m glad I was of help

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_1_005_2.text: You are really serious about this, aren’t you?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_2_004_2.text: Riding the wind to your location!★

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_2_005_1.text: You just don’t want to buy me jelly, do you?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_3_005_1.text: Let’s take a step back and not doubt anyone just yet

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_4_002_1.text: Who are you curious about? Yuna?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_4_002_2.text: Yeah I know a lot of people.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_4_003_2.text: What do you want to know?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_4_004_1.text: What? How does Seimei eat people?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_4_004_2.text: No Seimei does not have those features

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_4_005_2.text: Really? I’ve never seen that happen

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_4_006_2.text: Hmm... there might be a good reason for that

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_5_003_1.text: Where are you trying to go?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_023_5_005_2.text: It’ll be better for me to accompany you, I suppose...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_1_001_1.text: Ah! What are you sending me?!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_2_001_1.text: W-why are you doing this to me...?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_2_002_1.text: I don’t remember any of that

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_2_003_1.text: I can’t just watch innocent people die

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_2_003_2.text: I didn’t want other people touching you

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_2_004_2.text: You are the one that seduced them!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_2_006_1.text: It depends on the type of your research

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_2_006_2.text: I’ll put my life on the line to stop you

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_3_001_2.text: You called me a grumpy old nagger...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_3_002_1.text: Grumpy old nagger does not know.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_3_004_2.text: You are a strong believer of existentialism

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_4_002_2.text: You are much cuter than your clone

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_4_003_1.text: So that’s what your name meant?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_4_003_2.text: I thought you were Lime because you’re always so fresh

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_4_004_1.text: I’m very good at naming things

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_4_004_2.text: Look at my merc. group’s name. Reconsider.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_024_5_001_2.text: Are you playing a prank on me again?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_1_001_2.text: Did the sunset remind you of me?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_1_002_1.text: I’ll be there in time. Don’t worry

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_1_002_2.text: You don’t have to tell me that

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_1_003_1.text: Yeah, you want to come? Let’s have tea

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_1_003_2.text: Yeah I dropped by to say hi

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_2_001_1.text: Let’s have a feast to celebrate

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_3_002_1.text:
The value of a queen
is different to that of a masked vigilante

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_3_002_2.text:
Would you say so?
She’s still the same person

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_3_003_1.text:
In terms of just talent and ability,
I think you’re an equal match

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_3_003_2.text:
If I help you,
I think you can beat her

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_5_001_1.text: Maybe I do have an appointment.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_5_002_2.text: I have a countless number of friends.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_5_003_1.text:
Door... lock?
I have a key under the doormat.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_025_5_003_2.text:
Of course I do.
The password is 0314!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_026_1_002_1.text: Yeah! I’ll kiss your shoe if I have to!

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_026_1_003_1.text: Are you trying to kill someone?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_026_1_003_2.text: Why not include “listen to Uzume sing?”

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_026_3_002_2.text: I’m not falling for it. I’m mad.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_026_3_003_1.text: You said you are an old man.

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_026_4_002_1.text: Why not give up on your revenge?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_026_5_002_1.text: Are you really okay, Hwang Bo?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_027_2_002_1.text: Why is my input so important...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_027_2_002_2.text: I guess I share the responsibility...

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_027_3_002_2.text: Was Meri that kind of idol?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_027_4_002_1.text: Am I allowed to open this?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_1_004_2.text: So you were able to pay last month’s

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_3_004_2.text: I can’t see you suffer anymore

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_4_001_2.text: Maybe... correct me if I’m wrong

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_4_002_1.text: What was so good about it?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_4_002_2.text: You don’t have to lie to me

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_5_001_2.text: Maybe you should just not talk

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_5_003_1.text: Did you really think that’d work?

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_5_003_2.text: There are some things that can’t be changed

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_5_004_1.text: But you’re a plant too, Jack

TEXT_SELECT_TALK_028_5_004_2.text: You don’t have any water at home?

TEXT_SKILLGET_INFO_DESC.text: You have unlocked a new Special Skill.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DANGSOHYE_DESC.text: Throws [1/2/3] hairpin(s) according to the number of chains and inflicts #physical damage# equal to [150/250/400]% of attack power per hairpin.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DANGSOHYE_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
When Xiaohui Tang pushes a block, she eats [1/2/3] toxic herb(s) to take damage equal to 5% of her max HP per toxic herb becoming Poisoned by Herb.
 Poisoned by Herb: Increases her critical damage by 20%.
 When Xiaohui Tang eats 5 toxic herbs, the Poisoned by Herb state is removed and she gains Absolute Poison Immunity for 5 seconds.
 Absolute Poison Immunity: Increases her critical damage by 50% and takes no damage from eating toxic herbs. When the state ends, the toxic herb stack is reset and Xiaohui Tang takes a fixed damage equal to 50% of her max HP. Her critical resistance is reduced by 50% until she gains Absolute Poison Immunity again. (Cannot be dispelled or blocked)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DANGSOHYE_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When Xiaohui Tang pushes a block, she eats [1/2/3] toxic herb(s) to take damage equal to 5% of her max HP per toxic herb becoming Poisoned by Herb.
 Poisoned by Herb: Increases her critical damage by 20%.
 When Xiaohui Tang eats 5 toxic herbs, the Poisoned by Herb state is removed and she gains Absolute Poison Immunity for 5 seconds.
 Absolute Poison Immunity: Increases her critical damage by 50% and takes no damage from eating toxic herbs. Duration is reset upon skill re trigger.When the state ends, the toxic herb stack is reset and Xiaohui Tang takes a fixed damage equal to 50% of her max HP. Her critical resistance is reduced by 50% until she gains Absolute Poison Immunity again. (Cannot be dispelled or blocked)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DJURA_DESC.text: Uses Pulse Laser to deal #physical damage# equal to [100/300/500]% of its attack power, according to chain number used, to the frontmost nearby enemy.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DJURA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Grants the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect to the allied leader other than itself at the start of combat. This effect lasts throughout the combat.
The Analytical Engine - Galaxy grants a buff to the target and self according to the block skills used by the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect and the caster.

Dawn: Whenever the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect uses a block skill, it uses Dawn which increases attack power by 10% and critical damage by 5% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)
Dim Light: Whenever the caster uses a block skill, it uses Dim Light, increasing critical chance by 10%, penetration by 10%, and resistance penetration by 10% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_DJURA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Grants the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect to the allied leader other than itself at the start of combat. This effect lasts throughout the combat.
The Analytical Engine - Galaxy grants a buff to the target and self according to the block skills used by the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect and the caster.

Dawn: Whenever the target of the Analytical Engine - Galaxy effect uses a block skill, it uses Dawn which increases attack power by 20% and critical damage by 15% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)
Dim Light: Whenever the caster uses a block skill, it uses Dim Light, increasing critical chance by 15%, penetration by 20%, and resistance penetration by 20% for 10 seconds. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_GENEVIE_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Genevie leaves a ‘Mark’ on an enemy target struck by ‘Dagger Throw’ for 5 seconds. The target afflicted with the mark has their evasion reduced by 20, and they take 50% additional damage from Genevie. Only one enemy unit can be marked at a time.
Additionally, if another ally uses a 3-chain block skill, Genevie shoots a volley of ‘Chaser Arrows’ that deals @magical damage@ equal to 1000% of the hero’s attack power to the 3 frontmost enemy units. ‘Chaser Arrows’ prioritize the marked targets. The last unit struck by Chaser Arrows become marked for the next 5 seconds. (Cooldown: 0.1 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HINA_DESC.text: Throws a paper airplane to deal #physical damage# equal to [300/600/900]% of the hero’s attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HINA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill after another ally’s, the hero deals #physical damage# equal to 1000% of her attack power 4 times. This attack penetrates enemy units and ignores hero effects that tank damage for the team.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_HINA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill after another ally’s, the hero deals #physical damage# equal to 1500% of her attack power 4 times. This attack penetrates enemy units and ignores hero effects that tank damage for the team.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_07_DESC.text: Deals #physical damage# equal to [100/200/500]% of their attack power to the nearest enemy according to the chain number used by throwing stones.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_07_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Every time an ally presses 3 blocks, he shoots Explosive Grenade dealing #physical damage# equal to 500% of attack power.
 When Isidro evades the enemy's attack, Roll is activated. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)
Roll: Increases evasion by 30 and critical chance by 30 for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_BRSK_07_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Every time an ally presses 3 blocks, he shoots Explosive Bullet dealing #physical damage# equal to 1,000% of attack power.
 When Isidro evades the enemy's attack, Roll is activated. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)
Roll: Increases evasion by 50 and critical chance by 70 for 2 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_RB2_01_DESC.text: Throws [1/2/3] fire sword(s), each dealing @magic damage@ equal to 150% of attack power per hit.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_RB2_01_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The special skill is changed to 'Maiden Awakening.'
Maiden Awakening: Reduces SP of the enemy with the highest attack power by 10, and increases her own SP by 10. Shoots 'Dust: Fire Arrow' that deals @magic damage@ equal to 800% of the attack power towards the front.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_LIMITED_RB2_01_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The special skill is changed to 'Maiden Awakening.'
Maiden Awakening: Reduces SP of the enemy with the highest attack power by 25, and increases her own SP by 25. Shoots 'Dust: Fire Arrow' that deals @magic damage@ equal to 1600% of the attack power towards the front.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_NOTTINGHAM_DESC.text: Fires a bolt that pierces the enemy, dealing #physical damage# equal to [100/125/175]% of attack power depending on the number of chains. ‘Piercing Bolt’ ignores the enemy’s armor by 20%.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_NOTTINGHAM_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using one’s block skill, normal attack is changed to 1-chain block skill for 10 seconds, and attack power increases by 75% of one’s attack speed. For this effect, the value before the increase of attack speed is applied, and the Djuration is reset if reused while already in effect.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_NOTTINGHAM_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using one’s block skill, normal attack is changed to 1-chain block skill for 10 seconds, and attack power is increased by 100% of one’s attack speed. For this effect, the value before the increase of attack speed is applied, and the Djuration is reset if reused while already in effect.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_TEHIS_DESC.text: Shoots an arrow forward. The Hero deals #physical damage# equal to [200/300/500]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_TEHIS_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The targets of 3-chain Ranged Shot take additional #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power for 15 seconds when they are hit by Thehyss’ block skill.
When the Hero's block skill is triggered 5 times, the Hero summons a shadow that deals #physical damage# equal to 4444% of attack power and applies Hit and Run to the target (Cooldown: 1 second)
Hit and Run: Changes the block skill into Flash Assault, which deals #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power 3 times for 8 seconds. This effect cannot be dispelled or interrupted.

TEXT_SKILL_AR_TEHIS_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The targets of 3-chain Ranged Shot take additional #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power for 15 seconds when they are hit by Thehyss’ block skill.
When the Hero's block skill is triggered 3 times, the Hero summons a shadow that deals #physical damage# equal to 4444% of attack power and applies Hit and Run to the target (Cooldown: 1 second)
Hit and Run: Changes the block skill into Flash Assault, which deals #physical damage# equal to 444% of attack power 3 times for 8 seconds. This effect cannot be dispelled or interrupted.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANIMA_DESC.text: Throw [1/2/3] fish that inflict #physical damage# equal to 150% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANIMA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The aggressive cat, ‘Siro,’ clings to the enemy who has been damaged by ‘Today's Treats!’
Siro: Deals sustained #physical damage# equal to 400% of Anima’s attack power for 8 seconds. Djuration is reset if reactivated while in effect, and can be stacked up to 3 times. This effect cannot be dispelled or blocked.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANIMA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The aggressive cat, ‘Siro,’ clings to the enemy who has been damaged by ‘Today's Treats!’ 
The lethargic cat, ‘Nero,’ also clings to the enemy.
Siro: Deals sustained #physical damage# equal to 400% of Anima’s attack power for 8 seconds. Djuration is reset if reactivated while in effect, and can be stacked up to 3 times. This effect cannot be dispelled or blocked.
Nero: Reduces armor by 500 and critical resistance by 10% for 8 seconds. Djuration is reset if reactivated while in effect, and can be stacked up to 3 times.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANNE_DESC.text: Shoots a soul bullet to deal @magic damage@ equal to [100/200/400]% of the hero's attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANNE_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using an ally block skill 2 times, the Hero becomes Soul Linked for 5 seconds. The duration of this effect is refreshed whenever it is triggered.
Soul Link: Increases the Hero's critical chance by 15% and resistance penetration by 15%. Applies Cursed Brand to the victims of Soul Bullet. Cursed Brand deals @magic damage@ equal to 2500% of attack power and disappears when Anne uses her 3-chain skill or receives damage from the 3-chain. Every time an ally presses 2 blocks, Anne's next Block skill is used as her 3-chain skill power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ANNE_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Upon using an ally block skill 2 times, the Hero becomes Soul Linked for 5 seconds. The duration of this effect is refreshed whenever it is triggered.
Soul Link: Increases the Hero's critical chance by 30% and resistance penetration by 30%. Applies Cursed Brand to the victims of Soul Bullet. Cursed Brand deals @magic damage@ equal to 5000% of attack power and disappears when Anne uses her 3-chain skill or receives damage from the 3-chain. Every time an ally presses 3 blocks, Anne's next Block skill is used as her 3-chain skill power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ATHOS_DESC.text: Athos rolls forwards and loads and shoots his gun to deal #physical damage# equal to [300/150/50]% of his attack power in accordance to his range. Athos' evasion is increased by 50 when he rolls.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ATHOS_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Athos' movement speed is increased by 25%. Upon pressing his own block, he generates 1 ally leader block (activated once per 3 sec)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_ATHOS_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Athos' movement speed is increased by 25%. Upon pressing his own block, he generates 1 ally leader block (activated once per 3 sec) When using Shot Gun on an enemy in the melee range, Athos attacks one more time to deal #physical damage# equal to [7,000/4,000/1,500]% of his attack power and knock back the hit enemy.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_JET_LV3_SUBDESC.text: The enemies hit by a block skill enter into the Wanted state for 5 seconds. The enemies in the Wanted state receive 50% more damage for the duration of this skill. The enemies in the Wanted state inflict AoE $neutral damage$ equal to 5000% of Jet’s attack power when they die.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIME_DESC.text: A slime appears to deal #physical damage# equal to [240/340/440]% of the hero’s attack power to the enemy unit with the highest HP in range.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIME_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Enemies damaged by ‘Boing’ become ‘Soaked’. Soaked enemies have their evasion reduced by 50 for 4 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIME_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Enemies damaged by ‘Boing’ become ‘Soaked.’ Soaked enemies have their evasion reduced by 50 for 4 seconds. Whenever the hero attacks a ‘Soaked’ enemy with ‘Boing,’ she heals 20% of her maximum HP.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_08_DESC.text: Throws Vacuum Blade dealing @magical damage@ equal to [200/400/800]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_08_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Activates Sylph’s Blessing when his block skill is activated 5 times, and moves by flying to the front when no enemy is within range.
 
 Sylph’s Blessing: Increases his motion speed by 20% and resistance penetration by 500 for 5 seconds, and becomes immune to all damages 2 times. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LIMITED_BRSK_08_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Activates Sylph’s Blessing when his block skill is activated 3 times, and moves by flying to the front when no enemy is within range.
 
 Sylph’s Blessing: Increases his motion speed by 20% and resistance penetration by 500 for 7 seconds, and becomes immune to all damages 2 times. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_LUCA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon shooting 2 ‘Liquid Bullets,’ the hero summons a swarm of insects that penetrates enemy units 3 times, dealing #physical damage# equal to 1000% of the hero’s attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_MILADY_DESC.text: A member of the Mafia fires a bullet that deals #physical damage# equal to [280/340/420]% of the hero’s attack power at the enemy with the highest armor penetration.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_MILADY_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill, members of the Mafia arrive at the scene, dealing #physical damage# equal to 3500% of the hero’s attack power per hit. (Cooldown: 3 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_MILADY_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the hero uses her block skill, members of the Mafia arrive at the scene, dealing #physical damage# equal to 3500% of the hero’s attack power per hit. (Cooldown: 3 seconds) When ‘Vendetta’ is activated, place a bounty on the enemy with the highest armor penetration. The target with the bounty will take damage in place of their allies. Every second, or whenever the hero activates her block skill, ‘Bounty’ gains a stack. Bounty can stack up to 10 times, and each stack increases the target’s damage taken by 6%. If the afflicted target is a boss monster or a leader hero, they are immediately given max stacks.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_NENE_DESC.text: Nene draws and fires her weapon, dealing #physical damage# equal to [300/600/900]% of her attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_NENE_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block skill, Nene summons her deerdog, Vivi, for 5 seconds. Once summoned, Vivi swings its bat every second to deal #physical damage# equal to 400% of Nene’s attack power. (Cooldown: 6 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_NENE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using her block skill, Nene summons her deerdog, Vivi, for 5 seconds. Once summoned, Vivi swings its bat every second to deal #physical damage# equal to 800% of Nene’s attack power. (Cooldown: 6 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_HU_RB_NORA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Fires 'Heart Grenade' to deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of attack power up to 3 times upon using her own 3-chain after using another ally's block.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_RB_NORA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Increases accuracy by 60 for 5 sec upon using her own 3-chain. Afterwards, she fires 'Heart Grenade' to deal #physical damage# equal to 1000% of attack power up to 3 times upon using another ally's block.

TEXT_SKILL_HU_SILVER_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill changes to Ultimate Weapon.
Ultimate Weapon: Silver transforms into a giant cannon for 10 seconds. In this state, his attack power and critical damage are increased by 125%, his resistance penetration is increased by 100, and he becomes immune to stuns. TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Guide of Starlight: When pushing the Hero’s block within 5 seconds after an ally pushes a block, inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of the Hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. (Cooldown: 1 second)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LEONIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Guide of Starlight: When pushing the Hero’s block within 5 seconds after an ally pushes a block, inflicts $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of the Hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. (Cooldown: 1 second)
When using Guide of Starlight, transforms to ‘Avatar of Ananda’ by fusing with Dragon Jade - Nanda. (Cannot be canceled) Takes damage for allies after the transformation, receives 10% more damage, and becomes immune to stuns.
Avatar of Ananda: Cannot receive the heal effect because the law of the world does not apply, and receives #physical damage# equal to 5% of attack power per second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_DESC.text: Charges to the enemy in the front and deals $neutral damage$ equal to [200/300/650]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_LV2_SUBDES.text: When receiving a debuff, the debuff is disabled and the damage received is decreased by 20% for 3 seconds. When activated, deals $neutral damage$ equal to 1,000% of attack power, and the target of the damage is stunned for 1 second. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_01_LV3_SUBDES.text:
When receiving a debuff, the debuff is disabled and the damage received is decreased by 20% for 3 seconds. When activated, deals $neutral damage$ equal to 3,000% of attack power, and the target of the damage is stunned for 1 second. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)
Whenever Guts uses his normal attack and block skills, his attack power increases by 7% every 5 seconds. Can be stacked up to 10 times. This effect cannot be dispelled or interrupted.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_DESC.text: Charges forward and thrust down the sword to deal #physical damage# equal to [3,200/3,300/3,400]% of their attack power, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Mounts on the White Horse upon entering combat. His movement speed increases by 50% while on the White Horse.
His special skill changes to Soul. When Soul is activated, his critical resistance increases by 25% for 5 seconds. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_02_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Mounts on the White Horse upon entering combat. His movement speed increases by 80% when on the white horse, and does not retreat.
His special skill changes to Soul. When Soul is activated, critical resistance increases by 25%, attack power by 40%, and damage received decreases by 25%, all for 10 seconds. (Duration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_DESC.text: Deals #physical damage# equal to [5,00/1,000/1,500]% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_LV2_SUBDES.text:
Mounts the warhorse when entering combat. 
The Knight of Skeleton's special skill is changed to Sword of Actuation.
Sword of Actuation: The weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation. The Knight of Skeleton's attack power increases by 100%, and the block skill is changed to $neutral damage$.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_BRSK_04_LV3_SUBDES.text:
Mounts the warhorse when entering combat. 
The Knight of Skeleton's special skill is changed to Sword of Actuation.
Sword of Actuation: The weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation. The Knight of Skeleton's attack power increases by 150%, and the block skill is changed to $neutral damage$. 
When Sword of Actuation is reactivated, he cuts the space and deals $neutral damage$ equal to 200% of attack power every 0.1 seconds. (Lasts 1.7 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_DESC.text: Raven teleports to the front and swings the Black blade to deal #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of attack power.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Iaido Stance' state for 5 seconds when activating the block skill. (Cooldown: 5 seconds) 

The following abilities are added during the 'Iaido Stance' state:
Swings the Red blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 1500% of attack power when using the goddess. This attack ignores the effect of taking damage on behalf of allies.
Swings the Green blade to deal $neutral damage$ equal to 1500% of attack power when the Hero is healed (Life Steal is excluded). (Cooldown: 1 second)
Swings the Yellow blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 1500% of attack power and stuns for 1 second when the target evades an attack. This attack ignores the target's evasion. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_LIMITED_RB2_02_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Enters 'Iaido Stance' state for 5 seconds when activating the block skill. (Cooldown: 5 seconds) 

The following abilities are added during the 'Iaido Stance' state:
Swings the Red blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of attack power when using the goddess. This attack ignores the effect of taking damage on behalf of allies.
Swings the Green blade to deal $neutral damage$ equal to 3000% of attack power when the Hero is healed (Life Steal is excluded). (Cooldown: 1 second)
Swings the Yellow blade to deal #physical damage# equal to 3000% of attack power and stuns for 1 second when the target evades an attack. This attack ignores the target's evasion. (Cooldown: 2 seconds)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_RB_BLAKE_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon receiving fatal damage, Blake uses 'Shadow Clone.' (Activates once every 15 seconds). Upon activating 'Shadow Clone,' Blake retreats, leaving behind a shadow of herself and heals 100% of her HP. She becomes invulnerable for 2 seconds afterwards. Additionally, Blake's attack power and evasion increase by 150% and 150 respectively for 10 seconds after the skill's activation.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_DESC.text: The next two auto attacks will inflict additional #physical damage# equal to [100/200/500]% of attack power according to the number of chains, and the motion speed of the attacked enemy is reduced by 75% for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
The auto attacks ignore evasion and the enemies' abilities of receiving all damage dealt to their party. The weapon is enhanced when two ally blocks are used. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled.
Weapon Upgrade: Increases one’s attack power by 50% and slightly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 25%.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SEO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The auto attacks ignore evasion and the enemies' abilities of receiving all damage dealt to their party. The weapon is enhanced when two ally blocks are used. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled. (Max. upgrade: +2)
Weapon Upgrade 1: Increases one’s attack power by 100% and slightly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 25%.
Weapon Upgrade 2: Increases one’s attack power by 250% and significantly increases the range. Reduces one’s attack speed by 50%.
The damage received by the entire ally is reduced by 50% while the weapon is being upgraded.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_DESC.text: Charlotte quickly claws the front with her fingernails 2 times, each inflicting #physical damage# equal to [500/700/1000]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Every time she uses her block skill, Charlotte gains the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect that increases critical damage by 3% and attack power by 500 for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times and the duration is reset when reused.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SHALLOT_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Every time she uses her block skill, Charlotte gains the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect that increases critical damage by 5% and attack power by 1000 for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 10 times and the duration is reset when reused.
In addition, when the 'Little Red Riding Hood Squad' effect is stacked 5 or more times, the motion speed increases by 30%.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPAWN_MANTEAU_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Reflects all damage taken within 1 second after using a block by 100% and then reflects 50% of all damage taken as $neutral damage$ to the target for 2 seconds. When this attack is successful, the caster recovers 2% of their max HP. Reflection cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPAWN_MANTEAU_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When a block skill is used, for the next 2 seconds, Abel reflects 150% of the damage taken as $neutral damage$ to the target, and reflects 75% of the damage taken for the next 3 seconds as $neutral damage$ to the target. When a block skill hits the target, Abel recovers 15% of his max HP and decreases the amount of damage taken by 30% for 5 seconds. Reflection cannot be canceled.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPECIAL_LIMITED_BRSK_02_SP.text: Increases his critical resistance and attack power and decreases damage received.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_SPECIAL_LIMITED_BRSK_04_SP.text: The Knight of Skeleton's weapon is changed to the Sword of Actuation.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TRAMONTANA_DESC.text: Take off quickly and deal #physical damage# equal to [100/200/400]% of attack power depending on the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TRAMONTANA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: The Special Skill is changed to ‘Wheel Spin.’ Wheel Spin deals #physical damage# equal to 100% of the hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second.

TEXT_SKILL_WA_TRAMONTANA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
The Special Skill is changed to ‘Wheel Spin.’ Wheel Spin deals #physical damage# equal to 300% of the hero’s attack power every 0.1 seconds for 1 second. Upon activating her own 3-chain block skill, Tramontana gains a stack of ‘RPM.’ Upon activating her Special Skill, Tramontana gains 3 stacks of ‘RPM.’
RPM: For 10 seconds, the hero’s movement speed is increased by 100%, attack power by 40%, and armor penetration by 100%. This effect cannot be blocked or dispelled but is removed if stunned. (Stacks up to 5 times; duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_WA_VICTORY_RUSH_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When a block is used, the Ensign of Victory is summoned at the front line of the ally for 7 seconds once every 10 seconds. All allies near the summoned flag ignore amount of damage equal to 1000% of Victoria's armor. During the Djuration of the effect, her auto attack changes to Empire Swordsmanship that deals $neutral damage$ equal to 1280% of her armor.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_AFFOGATO_DESC.text: Affogato shoots Latte Art that deals @magic damage@ equal to [300/600/900]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_AFFOGATO_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Drinks coffee whenever he uses a special skill. Generates 1 block for himself whenever drinking coffee.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_AFFOGATO_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Drinks coffee whenever he uses a special skill. Generates 1 block for himself whenever drinking coffee.
Also, obtains the following effect when drinking coffee a certain number of times. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled.

1 time: Increases critical chance by 20% and resistance penetration by 1500.
3 times: Increases motion speed by 30%
5 times: Increases the number of ‘Latte Art’ to 2, which is unleashed upon using a block.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CHOIDEOKPAL_DESC.text: Binds the first 3 enemies with shadows and deals @magical damage@ equal to [1000/1500/1800]% of attack power per chain, roots them for 3 seconds. (Duration is reset on reuse)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CHOIDEOKPAL_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block skill, ‘Back In My Day’ will activate for 5 seconds at the location of the 5 frontmost enemies. (Cooldown: 6 seconds) Enemies within the range of the skill will receive @magical damage@ equal to 250% of Deokpal Choi’s attack power every 0.2 seconds. When the duration of ‘Back In My Day’ is over, enemies within range will receive @magical damage@ equal to 2000% of attack power. This attack ignores enemy effects that take damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_CHOIDEOKPAL_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Upon using a block skill, ‘Back In My Day’ will activate for 5 seconds at the location of the 5 frontmost enemies. (Cooldown: 6 seconds) Enemies within the range of the skill will receive @magical damage@ equal to 500% of Deokpal Choi’s attack power every 0.2 seconds, and have their resistance reduced by 50%. When the duration of ‘Back In My Day’ is over, enemies within range will receive @magical damage@ equal to 6000% of attack power. This attack ignores enemy effects that take damage in place of their allies.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEEMO_LV2_SUBDESC.text: After using the 3-chain 'I hate to tell you & Entrance', the following 1-chain and 2-chain's block skill damages increase by 50% for 10 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_DEEMO_LV3_SUBDESC.text: After using the 3-chain 'I hate to tell you & Entrance', the following 1-chain and 2-chain's block skill damages increase by 100% for 10 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GORDIAN_DESC.text: Deal $neutral damage$ equal to [1000/1100/1200%] of the hero’s attack power to the frontmost enemy.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GORDIAN_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
At the start of battle, the hero sits on his throne. The hero’s special skill is changed to ‘Lord’s Pledge’.
Lord’s Pledge: The hero’s damage is increased by 30% for 7 seconds. (Duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_GORDIAN_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
At the start of battle, the hero sits on his throne. The hero’s special skill is changed to ‘Lord’s Pledge’.
Lord’s Pledge: The hero’s damage is increased by 50% and critical chance by 30% for 7 seconds. Ally heroes with the same armor and resistance values also receive the effects of ‘Lord’s Pledge’. (Duration is refreshed on repeated use)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_03_DESC.text: Summons [1/2/3] waves that deal @magical damage@ equal to 300% of attack power according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_03_LV2_SUBDES.text:
When using chains, she enters the Spirit Possession for 4 seconds. She cannot move when in the Spirit Possession state. This state cannot be blocked or disabled, and duration is reset upon reactivation.
Spirit Possession: Decreases damage received by 15% and becomes immune to debuffs.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIMITED_BRSK_03_LV3_SUBDES.text:
When using chains, she enters the Spirit Possession for 4 seconds. She cannot move when in the Spirit Possession state. This state cannot be blocked or disabled, and duration is reset upon reactivation.

Spirit Possession: Decreases damage received by 30% and becomes immune to debuffs.
In addition, she deals @magical damage@ equal to 150% of attack power to enemies in the front every 0.1 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIVEA_DESC.text: Uses sharp bones to deal @magical damage@ equal to [220/310/390]% of the Hero's resistance per hit, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIVEA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: The Hero's Special Skill changes to 'Dragon Fang'. 'Dragon Fang' lasts for 15 seconds, and if the leader block is skill is activated while  'Dragon Fang' is active, activates 'Dragon Ribs' with the power of a 1-chain.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LIVEA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: The Hero's Special Skill changes to 'Dragon Fang'. 'Dragon Fang' lasts for 15 seconds, and if the leader block is skill is activated while  'Dragon Fang' is active, activates 'Dragon Ribs' with the power of a 1-chain. When activating 'Dragon Ribs' while 'Dragon Fang' is acive, enemies who have a lower Max HP than Livea will be put in the 'Gap in the Subspace' state, where they will @magical damage@ equal to 500% of Livea's resistance for 3 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LOVE_IMPACT_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Whenever allies use a block chain 4 times, the hero shoots out a ‘Love Beam’ for each ‘Charmed’ enemy unit, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 200% of the hero’s attack power per beam.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_LOVE_IMPACT_LV3_SUBDESC.text: All 3-chain skills penetrate enemy units. Whenever an ally uses a block chain, the hero shoots out a ‘Love Beam’ for each ‘Charmed’ enemy unit, dealing @magical damage@ equal to 2000% of the hero’s attack power per beam. The Accuracy and Evasion of units struck by ‘Love Beam’ are reduced by 50 for 5 seconds.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAMMON_DESC.text: Unleashes betting chips that inflict @magic damage@ equal to [200/300/400]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAMMON_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
When using one’s block skill, creates a ‘Lawless Area’ that cannot be canceled in front of the ally for 15 seconds. Up to 1 ‘Lawless Area’ can be created in a battle. (Cooldown: 15 seconds)
Lawless Area: Decreases the moving speed of the enemy within range by 20%

TEXT_SKILL_WI_MAMMON_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
When using one’s block skill, creates a ‘Lawless Area’ that cannot be canceled in front of the ally for 15 seconds. Up to 1 ‘Lawless Area’ can be created in a battle. (Cooldown: 15 seconds)
Lawless Area: Decreases the moving speed of the enemy within range by 30% while inflicting 50% more damage.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_NEBULA_DESC.text: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to 500% of resistance penetration every 0.1 seconds for [1/2.5/5] second(s) according to the number of chains with a breath weapon. Increases resistance penetration by 4000 while using the breath weapon. This effect cannot be silenced or disabled.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_NEBULA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: When the caster uses 3 of their own blocks, Genesis creates a Constellation in the current spot for 5 seconds. (Duration Reset) Constellation: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to 250% of resistance penetration for every second.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_NEBULA_LV3_SUBDESC.text: When the caster uses 3 of their own blocks, Genesis creates a Constellation in the current spot for 10 seconds. (Duration Reset) Constellation: Inflicts @magic damage@ equal to 500% of resistance penetration for every second.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PRYDWEN_DESC.text: Create and throw a bomb that deals @magical damage@ equal to [10/30/60]% of the hero’s attack power 12 times, based on the chain number.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PRYDWEN_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Whenever Prydwen uses her Special Skill, ‘Bomber’ is activated for 10 seconds.
- Bomber: Prydwen’s Critical Chance is increased by 15% and her accuracy is increased by 15.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_PRYDWEN_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Whenever Prydwen uses her Special Skill, ‘Bomber’ is activated for 10 seconds.
- Bomber: Prydwen’s Critical Chance is increased by 30% and her accuracy is increased by 30.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TALIA_DESC.text: Fires bubble to deal @magic damage@ equal to [300/600/900]% of her attack power according to the chain number used. This attack is done 3 times.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TALIA_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Uses 'Passionate Handling' to increase critical damage by 100% for 5 seconds every time the caster presses the Block. The effect is stacked up to 3 times, and the duration is renewed upon reactivating the skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_TALIA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Uses 'Passionate Handling' to increase critical damage by 100% for 5 seconds every time the caster presses the Block. The effect is stacked up to 3 times, and the duration is renewed upon reactivating the skill.
Additionally, her @magic damage@ increases by 150% when the 'Passionate Handling' effect is in full stacks.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WINSTON_DESC.text: Winston inflicts @magical damage@ equal to [200/300/600]% of his Attack Power to enemies in the front.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WINSTON_LV2_SUBDESC.text: Winston's Critical Chance is increased by 20% for 3 seconds when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_WINSTON_LV3_SUBDESC.text: Winston's Critical Chance is increased by 20% and maximum HP by 100% for 3 seconds when using the block skill.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YAMA_DESC.text: Sets off fire that inflicts @magical damage@ equal to [350/400/450]% of attack power according to the number of chains.

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YAMA_LV2_SUBDESC.text:
Special skill is changed to ‘Moment of Justice.’
Moment of Justice: Increases the hero’s critical damage by 50% and resistance penetration by 1000 for 7 seconds. (Djuration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SKILL_WI_YAMA_LV3_SUBDESC.text:
Special skill is changed to ‘Moment of Justice.’
Moment of Justice: Increases the hero’s critical damage by 75% and resistance penetration by 2000 for 7 seconds. Inflicts @magical damage@ equal to 450% of Yama’s attack power every 0.1 second on the front-most enemy. (Djuration reset upon reactivation)

TEXT_SPACE_BOTTOM_BASE2_07_DESC.text: The main building of the space station. This is where space travelers do research.

TEXT_SPACE_BOTTOM_BASE3_08_DESC.text: The annexed building of the space station. This is where space travelers rest.

TEXT_SPACE_BOTTOM_ROBOT2_03_DESC.text: An aviator robot that guards that space station. Welcomes space travelers who occasionally stop by.

TEXT_SPACE_BOTTOM_ROBOT_02_DESC.text: A robot that guides around the space station. Helps space travelers who occasionally stop by.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_BLACKHOLE_09_DESC.text: This Black Hole swallows a portion of the universe. Turn your steering wheel the other way as soon as you see this while traveling the space.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_MILKYWAY_08_DESC.text: This Milky Way traverses darkness in the universe. It’s often called a magical gift from the space.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_NEBULA_01_DESC.text: A giant nebula with a vast amount of stars.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_PLANET_02_DESC.text: A planet with a blue hue.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_SATELLITE_05_DESC.text: A telescope for observing the space. It wanders about the space by itself for a long time.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_SHOOTINGSTAR2_07_DESC.text: A blue-color shooting star. Make a wish before it disappears.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_SHOOTINGSTAR_06_DESC.text: A gold-color shooting star. Make a wish before it disappears.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_SHUTTLE2_04_DESC.text: A space shuttle that was abandoned because its days had expired. It has since become a welcoming home to other beings.

TEXT_SPCAE_CENTER_SHUTTLE_03_DESC.text: A space shuttle for a single person. Beware of the capacity limit for exceeding the limit will result in a fine.

TEXT_TW_ACC_BARRIER_ATK_1_BUFF_OPTION_DE.text: Generates a shield for self-protection equal to 100% of their attack power when the battle begins. Subsequently generates a shield for self-protection equal to 100% of their attack power every 5 seconds. This effect cannot overlap with another option of the same effect regardless of the grade.

TEXT_USER_MESSAGE_2079.text: 不知不觉间CQ竟陪我走了7年之久，因此在停更前我想说一下我的CQ之旅，我还深刻记得我是在2017年首次接触到了CQ。当时在小米手机的应用市场中，他的像素画风一下子就吸引住了我，下载下来也没让我失望：新颖的消块玩法、虽然是像素表情却十分丰富的小人、让我眼前一亮的特效、和女神的故事也让我记忆尤新。虽然在玩CQ的早期处于懵懵懂懂的状态，但正好赶上了联动DEEMO，免费送的小女孩让我无压力推完了第一季的雪原。17年年底第二季出现，但我打不过使徒，后面又因为要高考，就弃坑了一段时间。之后回坑的大学日子中我和CQ经历过很多事情：第一次因为泉奈开始关注勇士的强度、四周年邀请我跳舞表明心意的蕾德那斯、见证了白发小女孩艾丽的故事、6周年第一次因为赛博炒股熬到凌晨4点、因为中国服务器的关闭而失落、因为成功了解注册谷歌可以又玩到这游戏感到欣喜、7周年看到了面包师巧克力的故事...这7年的时间里我和CQ的故事很多很多，他仿佛像我的老朋友一样，因此听到CQ即将到达尾声時我也非常难过。但是就像我现在的名字一样我爱CQ这个游戏，因此我也会陪他这位老朋友走到最后一刻！

TEXT_USER_MESSAGE_2182.text: 长夏永远不会凋落，我们的故事会延续的。我能够遇到你，实在太好了

TEXT_USER_MESSAGE_2183.text: All good things comes to an end. May all the good memories will never be forgotten.

TEXT_USER_MESSAGE_2188.text: CQ是我人生第一款玩了六年之久的遊戲，也是讓我打破絕對不花錢玩任何手遊的第一個，這六年有你的陪伴讓我度過很多空白的時間，很遺憾要走入歷史了，我會永遠記得你的！謝謝製作團隊這些年的努力，謝謝你們讓我享受到這款遊戲。

TEXT_USER_MESSAGE_2191.text: CQ已经陪了我从初中到大学，是我唯一一款玩这么久的游戏，CQ的游戏做的很符合我的审美，我非常喜欢CQ，希望能越来越好吧

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0002.text:
Ich bin Noa.
Ich komme vom Orden der Göttin.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0003.text:
Ich fürchte, ich habe eure Zeit vergeudet,
da ihr meine Ankunft erwartet habt.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0004.text:
Ich bitte um eure Vergebung,
Ritterin.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0005.text:
Ah ... Oh, nein, nein!
Es gibt nichts zu vergeben, Noa.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0006.text:
Ich bin Lednas,
Ritterin und zuständig für die örtliche Sicherheit.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0007.text:
Dies ist {PLAYER_NAME},
der Söldneranführer dieses Ortes.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0008.text:
Es ist eine Ehre, euch kennenzulernen.
Wo befindet sich das Tal des Heldendorfes?

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0009.text:
Ich bin gespannt auf
euer Zuhause.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0010.text:
Ah, richtig. Geh einfach in diese Richtung.
Äh, Noa.

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0012.text:
Würdest du vor dem Betreten vielleicht ...
ähem ... deine Flügel verbergen?

DIALOGUES_CHAMP_GODDESS_1_0014.text:
Marie warnte mich davor,
