TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0001.text:
He! Endlich!
Ich sagte es ja. Wir sehen uns bald.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0003.text:
Was ist passiert?
Warum hat das Luftschiff in unserem Dorf angehalten?

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0004.text:
Erinnerst du dich an die Gemeinschaft? 
Sie ist jetzt offiziell gegründet. Machst du mit?

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0006.text:
Du musst bloß Beeren sammeln, indem du 
mit meinem Luftschiff durch die Welt fliegst.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0007.text:
Findest du die Beere, um meinen Fluch
zu heilen, zahle ich einen hohen Preis dafür.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0008.text:
Wenn nicht, behalte die anderen Beeren und
Belohnungen. Klingt das gut?

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0010.text:
Dann hör mir gut zu.
Wähle zuerst das Ziel.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0011.text:
Mein Assistent Leni hat die möglichen 
Orte auf der Karte markiert.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0012.text:
Wähle den Ort auf der Karte selbst aus,
Leni hat Informationen dazu gesammelt, also sieh ruhig nach.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0013.text:
Ah. Die Zeit und die erforderte Anzahl an Gefährten unterscheidet sich je nach Ort,
als sie es dir vorher an.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0014.text:
Wähle jetzt, welchen Helden du entsendest. 
Ah, richtig. Soll ich dir einen Hinweis geben?

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0015.text:
Hast du einen Helden aus einer bestimmten Region in der Gruppe,
wird die Erkundung um einiges einfacher.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0016.text:
Es gibt ebenfalls Bedingungen für bessere Belohnungen,
also sieh sie dir an.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_0017.text:
Ich freue mich auf die Erkundung mit dir, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Beginnen wir mit der Suche nach Beeren, um meinen Fluch aufzuheben!

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0001.text:
He du! Stopp!
Gib mir die Beere in deiner Hand.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0003.text:
Mal sehen ... eine mysteriöse Beere, 
aber nicht das, wonach ich suche. Nimm sie.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0004.text: Ich? Ich bin Arjuna. Jung, schön und reich ...

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0006.text: Still! Ich wandere einsam umher auf der Suche nach Beeren!

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0007.text:
Es gibt eine Beere mit einer speziellen Kraft,
die von Forschern im Geheimen gehandelt wird.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0008.text:
Was ist das in deiner Hand, Freundin?
Sieht aus wie eine mysteriöse Beere.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0010.text:
Ja. Es heißt, wer die Beere isst, der wird stärker 
als ein normaler Mensch, aber sie ist schwer zu finden.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0011.text:
Ich möchte Forscher versammeln, um eine Gemeinschaft der
Beere zu gründen. Ich suche nach einer speziellen Beere.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0013.text:
Du scheinst übrigens talentiert zu sein.
Wie willst du an diese Beere gelangen, wenn du nicht weißt wie sie aussieht?

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0015.text:
Oh, du. 
Du wirkst stark und schwach zugleich. Perfekt.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0017.text:
Nun, sie ist schwer zu finden,
aber man wird ganz leicht stark dadurch.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0018.text:
Jede Beere hat einen anderen Effekt.
Prüfe also, welche Beere welche Fähigkeit verbessert.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0019.text:
Nachdem du die Beere gegessen hast, siehst du hier, 
wie stark du geworden bist!

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0021.text:
H-Halt!
Ich kann diese kostbare Beere nicht essen.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0023.text:
Wenn diese Beere so kostbar ist, sollte
{PLAYER_NAME} sie haben.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0024.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} ist derjenige, 
der unser Dorf beschützt.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0025.text:
So ist das also.
Hmm, wie langweilig.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0027.text:
Gern geschehen.
Ihr werdet mir sicher bald helfen können.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_1_0029.text:
Haha. Ich werde bald etwas sehr Kostbares mitbringen.
Bis dann!

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0003.text:
Nicht du, du!
Du gehörst zur Gemeinschaft der Beere, oder?

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0004.text:
Zeig mir, was du hast.
Wenn es das ist, wonach ich suche, zahle ich dir jeden Betrag dafür.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0005.text:
Wie? Du weißt nicht, wovon ich spreche. Hmm. Ich dachte, 
ein ordentlicher Forscher wie du würde sich der Gemeinschaft anschließen.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0006.text:
Ah, ich bin Arjuna. 
Jung, hübsch und reich ...

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0008.text:
Ruhe! Ich wandere einsam umher 
auf der Suche nach Beeren!

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0009.text:
Du! Du wärst ein guter Gefährte.
Hier, nimm das.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0010.text:
Oh, du. 
Du wirkst stark und schwach zugleich. Perfekt.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0012.text:
Es gibt eine Beere mit einer speziellen Kraft,
die von Forschern im Geheimen gehandelt wird.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0013.text:
Was ist das in deiner Hand, Freundin.
Sieht aus wie eine mysteriöse Beere.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0015.text:
Ja. Es heißt, wer die Beere isst, der wird stärker, 
als ein normaler Mensch, aber sie ist schwer zu finden.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0016.text:
Ich möchte Forscher versammeln, um eine Gemeinschaft der
Beere zu gründen. Ich suche nach einer speziellen Beere.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0017.text:
Möchtest du der Gemeinschaft beitreten? Was meinst du?
Probier einmal.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0018.text:
Nun, sie ist schwer zu finden,
aber man wird ganz leicht stark dadurch.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0019.text:
Jede Beere hat einen anderen Effekt.
Prüfe also, welche Beere welche Fähigkeit verbessert.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0020.text:
Nachdem du die Beere gegessen hast, siehst du hier, 
wie stark du geworden bist!

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0022.text:
H-Halt!
Ich kann diese kostbare Beere nicht essen.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0024.text:
Wenn diese Beere so kostbar ist, sollte
{PLAYER_NAME} sie haben.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0025.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} ist derjenige, 
der unser Dorf beschützt.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0026.text:
Ist das so.
Hmm, wie langweilig.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0028.text: Dann schließe dich meiner Gemeinschaft an.

TEXT_TUTO_EXPLORE_FRUIT_ROOT_2_0029.text:
Ähm. Ich kann hier nicht weg.
Was ist mit {PLAYER_NAME}?

삭제.text: ... mit dem Licht der Göttin werden die Menschen siegreich sein!

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ2_CHOICE_1.text: 1. No problem, you look like you had a good time. Welcome back.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ2_CHOICE_2.text: 2. Why are you so late? You've kept me waiting!

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_CHOICE_2.text: 2. I don't know how to dance.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_LOOP_2_CHOICE_1.text: You tell Lednas that you do not know how to dance.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ4_CHOICE_2.text: 2. You should go for it, Lednas.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ4_LOOP_2_CHOICE_1.text: You tell Lednas to take some time to make up her mind.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ5_CHOICE_1.text: 1. Who's going to stop Saintess Maria? Let's go.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ5_CHOICE_2.text: 2. It's too late. It's going to be dangerous if we go.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_CHOICE_2.text: 2. I really want this to be a surprise for Lednas!

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_CHOICE_1.text: 1. Nothing lasts forever. Beginnings must have ends.

EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_LOOP_2_CHOICE_1.text:
But you think to yourself - 
that deep in your heart, you also don't want Lednas to leave.

TEXT-DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_START_01.text:
E-erm, hello.
I didn't expect to meet another person so deep in the mountains.

TEXT-DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_START_02.text:
Regardless of what you're doing here,
you’d do well to descend the mountain as quickly as you can.

TEXT-DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_START_03.text:
My captain is carrying out a secret mission hereabouts,
and you wouldn't want to get involved.

TEXT-DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_START_04.text:
That is... if I can find him in time.
Or 'as soon as possible,' as the letter insisted.

TEXT-DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_START_05.text:
Sigh...  Is it even possible to track down a person
in these mountains near the borders?

TEXT-DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_START_06.text:
This is not the life that I dreamed of
when I first applied for this position...

TEXT-DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_130_START_07.text:
Huh? Are you sure you have the time to help me?
You're too kind.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_02.text:
If aristocratic titles required intelligence to maintain,
those idiots would have been banished from the Empire.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_03.text:
They denied MY request? ME, The youngest Chief Research
Officer EVER, a genius, the head of the noble council?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_04.text:
Sigh... At least the Third Secret Underground Laboratory
hasn't been discovered.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_05.text:
Doctor Gunther's hopeless negligence in keeping the
official records seems to have worked in my favor.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_06.text:
The prototype of the #teleporter# is perfect in every way,
standby generators have been acquired...

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_07.text:
Everyone derided my theories as complete hogwash,
but I never doubted them for a second.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_09.text:
They just required a high degree of technology that
wasn't present anywhere in Hasla... except Heaven, that is.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_10.text:
Huhuhu... {PLAYER_NAME}.
Enjoy your undeserved victory while it lasts!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_11.text:
With my powers of science, I will summon an alternate
future in which I have defeated you and your Heroes!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_12.text: Good, now to input the dimensional coordinates...

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_17.text:
Considering this dimension's significance as the 'original'
Hasla, teleporters seem to have been invented rather late.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_18.text:
Er, who are you, and why did you appear from my teleporter
- which is not supposed to pop out random strangers?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_19.text:
I should be asking you the same question.
Where's Colonel #Caroline#?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_20.text: The one who should have created this device.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_21.text: What Caroline? I'm the mastermind genius who made this!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_22.text:
Or as you may know me by my preceding reputation:
the brightest mind of this millennia, Levine Ludovico!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_24.text:
Well, hello there, 'me.'
I didn't expect to meet myself so soon in this dimension.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_25.text:
Me'? 'Myself in this dimension'?
... You can't be. You're -

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_26.text:
Yes, hullo. I'm Lieutenant Colonel Caroline Ludovico,
but you, my dear self, can call me Caroline.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_27.text: You must have been named after our grandmother.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_28.text:
Grandpa must have been
a hopeless romantic in your universe.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_29.text:
Yes, well...
We have more important matters to discuss.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_30.text:
Judging from this energy, the field of magical engineering
seems to have developed further in your dimension.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_31.text:
I was planning to absorb you immediately,
but it seems you'll have your uses.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_1_1_33.text:
Oh, never mind - half of what I say is utter nonsense.
Now, show me around, will you♡?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_02.text:
That tune's...
eerie, to say the least.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_03.text:
Huhu... As expected of one
who shares my DNA.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_04.text:
Most people don't survive listening to this song,
much less brush it off as simply 'eerie.'

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_05.text:
Look outside the laboratory.
The soldiers have been knocked unconscious.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_07.text:
#D-CAT#. A cursed song that is said
to have been composed by an angel and sung by a devil,

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_08.text:
and will destroy the soul
of anyone who listens to it.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_09.text:
World domination will be a piece of cake with this little tune.
And that's exactly what I'm planning to do.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_10.text:
For that, I need a powerful ultrasonic weapon that can
transmit sound waves to all corners of the continent.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_11.text:
And that's where you come in. Make me an ultrasonic
weapon, and you could receive an empire of your choice.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_12.text:
... Haha... Hahaha... Hahahaha!
I accept your offer!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_13.text:
Leave it to me. There's no better expert than me at magical
engineering. I'll build a weapon to dominate entire worlds!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_14.text: Good. Then I'll entrust that part of the plan to you.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_15.text:
And... does your world
hold #Hasla Music Festivals# as well?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_16.text:
Of course, it's my favorite event and program.
The Third Festival was held quite recently.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_17.text:
A musician named Jeomrye became the champion.
Why do you ask?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_18.text: Because we're going to be using that competition.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_19.text:
Nobody will think it strange if a 'contestant'
wants to sing a song of her choice at a music festival.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_20.text:
Understood.
That's quite the evil plan that you hatched up!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_21.text:
Then Levine, stay here at the lab and concentrate on
your research. I'm heading off to #Hero Town#.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_23.text:
'This' Hasla is plagued by a Hero Captain named {PLAYER_NAME}.
Hero Town serves as their headquarters. I wouldn't go there.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_24.text:
I know about {PLAYER_NAME}. I wanted to see them for
myself - see if they measure up to my standards.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_25.text:
... Caroline.
Your world doesn't have the #Hero Captain#, does it?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_26.text:
You don't know of the risks of facing that monster. They
can force you to divulge masterplans with a single look.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_27.text:
Ha! I expected more backbone from you, Levine.
Nobody in this dimension knows of my true identity.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_2_1_28.text:
I'll take a quick look and return before anyone finds out
that I'm not the good girl I'll pretend to be.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! There you are!
I've been looking everywhere for you.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_02.text: You have guests back at the town.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_03.text:
They say they came all the way from the Neth Empire
to see you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_05.text:
There you are, {PLAYER_NAME}.
It's been so long since I saw you last.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_07.text:
I STILL don't understand how a puny human like you could
have beaten the battleloid coded with my superior data.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_08.text:
Stand up straight and try to look fierce. Maybe you will look
the part of someone who defeated the world's greatest android.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_09.text:
V. Your current behavior
does not pertain to the rules of human etiquette.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_10.text:
Human etiquette dictates that one must not vocalize
all messages that generate on your cognitive engine.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_11.text:
Hrrmph. You think you can order me around, huh?
Come at me if you dare!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_12.text:
'Come at [subject].' Idiom. Definition: to approach in
an aggressive manner or with intention to harm.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_13.text:
By definition, you are closer to 'coming at me,'
and not the other way around, V.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_14.text: Oh, now you've started it! I'm going to beat your -

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_15.text:
Everyone, please calm down.
I fear we're making a bad impression on our hosts.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_16.text:
Commander, did I not say we were better off
without those tin cans?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_17.text:
This just shows how inferior androids are compared to
humans. Or cyborgs, who are still technically human.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_18.text:
We can hear you! Every inch of your body has been
replaced with machine parts. What are you then?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_19.text:
Just like an android - except worse, since you still have a
human brain and you could do with a well-needed update!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_20.text: What! Apologize, you rusty piece of junk -

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_22.text:
But I remember you saying that you had business
with {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_23.text:
Oh, it's nothing. I wanted to say hello...
and I had a few paid vacation days left.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_24.text:
Everyone insisted on tagging along when they heard I
would be visiting you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_25.text:
It's only natural that we'd want to come
and thank our liberator!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_26.text:
Commander Spyro was too busy to come,
but he also sends his greetings, sir!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_27.text:
I bear a similar message, {PLAYER_NAME},
from Benjamin...

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_28.text:
... who did not actually vocalize his gratitude,
but I sensed the nonverbal signals.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_29.text:
That cold-hearted fiend can feel gratitude?
Yeah, right.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_31.text:
Don't be embarrassed. You have saved countless lives.
You deserve the love and respect, {PLAYER_NAME}

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_33.text:
Now, let's take this conversation
somewhere else - perhaps over dinner?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_34.text:
As it's my first visit to Hero Town.
I'll take your recommendation for a good restaurant.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_36.text:
... That can't be!
Why are they here, of all places?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_37.text:
Dammit, even though I'm aware that they're completely
different people from their #parallel selves#...

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_38.text:
'Our' memories... are turning unstable.
I better head back.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_39.text: Nya? There is a pink-haired woman hiding in the bushes.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_43.text:
Huh? Hey, you there! Pink-hair girl!
Were you spying on us?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_44.text:
Oh... Haha...
E-erm. Well... I can explain.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_45.text:
Uh... T-the champion! Yes, I was admiring
{PLAYER_NAME} from afar!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_46.text:
The last Hasla Music Festival champion!
I never expected to see you here!

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_47.text:
I-I'm an aspiring musician!
I'm planning to enter the next HMF.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_48.text:
I couldn't help but stare in admiration and respect when I,
erm, coincidentally met THE HMF champion.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_49.text:
... Is that so? But that uniform suspiciously resembles
that of a high-ranking commander...

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_50.text:
Sniff... Yes, ma'am. It's the unmistakable scent
of Neth Army-order laundry detergent.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_51.text:
But I can't access her files in the army records.
Who are you?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_53.text:
Lednas, our code of law dictates that all persons of
suspicious activity must undergo interrogation.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_54.text:
This is no way to treat a passionate fan of {PLAYER_NAME}
who came all the way from the Grancian borderlands.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_55.text:
And may I remind you that Hero Town 
does not fall under your jurisdiction?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_56.text:
Well... We are technically on vacation.
I suppose we could look over this particular episode.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_57.text:
Hrrmph. I have my eye on you.
AND all my other visual sensors, so watch out.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_60.text:
Forgive us. We usually treat our guests much better.
Would you like to introduce yourself?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_62.text:
We were on our way to lunch, and if it's alright with you,
we'd like to invite you as well - as a sign of apology.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_3_1_65.text:
... ...
What have I gotten myself into?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_01.text:
Sigh... How did things come to this...
The last few days feel almost surreal.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_02.text:
I still can't come up with a single valid hypothesis that can
explain why that Hero captain likes me so much.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_03.text:
I do like having the rare opportunity
to observe {PLAYER_NAME} from up close, but...

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_04.text:
Ugh. There's no helping things. I'll find a way out soon
enough. I'll just have to careful until then.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_06.text:
I need to send Levine my report, but apparently, I'm
not getting any reception. Just my luck.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_07.text: Are you attempting to use a transmitter, Caroline?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_09.text:
Please wait
while I amplify the signals.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_11.text:
Oh, yes. Much better, in fact.
And... sent. Thank you.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_14.text: I apologize for my comrade's misbehavior.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_15.text:
Memories of the war are still fresh on everybody's minds.
It is difficult for many to forget the enemies of yesterday.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_16.text:
I do not yet fully comprehend
the human concepts of 'dreams' and 'passion'...

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_17.text:
... but I know they are precious values.
You have my support.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_20.text:
R-0... That was odd.
Was it programmed to say things like that?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_21.text:
Then again, I wouldn't know...
We were too busy fighting all the time to have a proper conversation.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_23.text:
Tsk, it doesn't matter.
No need to think when I'll be wiping them out soon.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_24.text:
Oh, Caroline.
I noticed that you've been gone for a long time.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_25.text:
Hey there, Hero Captain. How are you doing?
What's with all that luggage you're hauling around?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_26.text:
I am delivering the items
the Neth guests ordered from Bridget's Shop.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_27.text: Don't you have other people who can do that for you?

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_28.text:
I don't mind - peacetime makes for slow days among
the troops, and it gives me something to do.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_31.text:
Look here - it does have your name
as the recipient.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_34.text:
'I don't know what humans take to loosen their vocal
cords, so I send you both these items. "Break a leg." -V'

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_35.text: Ah, it seems to be a gift of reconciliation from V.

TEXT_ DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WI_34_4_1_37.text: Guess people... I mean, androids can change.

TEXT_CHRISTMAS_FISHERY_DESC.text:
The Christmas Market is open, nya! There's a fishing spot!
Oddly enough, the Lonely Pufferfish seems angry, nya.
When I gave him our postcard, he smashed his cake, nya!
Could you go and investigate? And tell him, happy holidays!

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_1.text:
Well done. Yet I find it strange that
Goblins and Ogres are cooperating...

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_10.text: It would be good to get some useful information about the Cardinal.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_11.text:
As I thought... They were innocent. 
Then what could the Shadow Rose be planning?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_12.text:
Demons! They were demons! What's the Heaven's Cavalry
doing, letting demons roam the streets like this?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_13.text:
Thank you. It was only with your help that
we could lead the citizens to safety without a single casualty.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_14.text: Thank you. This is good information.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_15.text:
You helped us save the lives of many people, but...
It seems we could not save their homes from ruin.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_16.text: Thank you. I only hope this clears up the problem.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_17.text:
So it was a new demon, after all.
More demons may have infiltrated the city than we had thought.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_18.text:
They look very different from the Ratmen of my memories.
And their hatred for humans... What could have happened?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_19.text:
I apologize! I did not know that it would explode so brightly.
Perhaps there was a mistake in the recipe...

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_2.text:
A catapult that throws Goblins instead of rocks?
How monstrous! And rather inhumane, I must say.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_20.text:
It wasn't one of the Cardinal's men, thank Cora.
But why would he be lingering here, of all places?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_21.text:
So the Ratmen appeared large due to the tumors on their backs...
They seem painful.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_22.text:
The mutated Ratmen had even been hunting down their own kin.
We must find the reason behind their transformations.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_23.text:
Why do we all fight while living our lives?
Is there no way we can all just get along?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_24.text:
Has it become the latest fashion for humans
to come down to the sewers, squeak?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_25.text:
Sniff... He had such nice eyes.
I thought I could talk to him...

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_26.text: Thank you *squeak*. Our colleagues will be able to live a little easier now.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_27.text:
What a relief, squeak! You stopped the sewers
from being covered with mana filth, squeak...

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_28.text: I don't have a good feeling about this, squeak. There could be another sewer in the depths that even we Ratmen don't know about...

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_29.text:
I didn't notice anything like this when I escaped...
I'm scared.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_3.text:
Goblins deem expertise in a variety of weapons an important virtue
of warriors. Perhaps that is why their Champion carries so many weapons.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_30.text:
Perhaps it was this place that they had been conducting
experiments on turning human beings into demons.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_31.text:
It is a relief that you seem unscathed from the battle.
...What? Traces of another person?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_32.text:
Thank you. We do not know yet what the Cardinal is planning,
but this should buy us some time to stop him once and for all.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_33.text:
Whew! That was dangerous. And this place...
It emits a strong aura of magic. How strange...

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_34.text:
… Something like that happened? Thank you. We should send some people 
over to the Palace now to keep this information from spreading outside.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_35.text:
Hmm... I wished to survey the palace grounds longer,
but it does seem wiser to seal off the area for the time being.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_4.text: The scholar is safe and sound, thank Cora!

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_5.text:
Well done. The Goblins will be unable to 
harm any more innocent souls for the time being.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_6.text:
For them to pick a new leader so soon...
Could there have been a rebellion among the Goblins' ranks?

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_7.text: The Order of the Shadow Rose… this can't be good.

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_8.text:
Good riddance! Thank you for your help.
My position puts me in a place with many restrictions, you see...

TEXT_COMPLETEA218_MAIN_Q_S2_9.text:
Whoa… You literally knocked down every single one of them...
Well, at the very least, that should teach them a true lesson.

Du scheinst dich an die Wüste

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_176_1.text: Now this is the cat's meow! Store the fish you caught in here!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_180_1.text:
Phew! That was close.
By the way, great work!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_182_1.text:
What? Yeah! 
Thank you so much, {PLAYER_NAME}

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_182_3.text:
That should have been all of it.
Thank you for always helping out, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_2.text:
You have done well.
Good job!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_3.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Please be careful - she may appear again at any time.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_5.text:
We still have a long way to go, but at least it's
stable now. Thank you for the help, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_184_6.text:
Thank you for helping out, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I hope things calm down in the palace soon.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_185_1.text:
It's really over, right...?
Thank you for helping me, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_185_2.text:
H-hrrmph! I could have done that by myself!
But seeing all the effort you put in, I'll admit that you weren't so bad.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_185_3_01.text:
…Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I can take a breather now.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_188_1.text:
Phew! That was close.
By the way, great work!

Thank you for helping me, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_190_2.text:

But seeing all the effort you put in, I'll admit that you weren't so bad.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_195_2.text:

But seeing all the effort you put in, I'll admit that you weren't so bad.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_199_1.text: All this sudden moving about... is making me sleepy again...

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_199_2.text:
H-hrrmph! I could have done that by myself!
But seeing all the effort you put in, I'll admit that you weren't so bad.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_47_1.text: Thank you. No more poor souls shall perish in vain.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_53_1.text:
How amazing!
Please take me with you next time again!

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_86_1.text: Thank you. No more poor souls shall perish in vain.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_92_1.text: Thank you. No more poor souls shall perish in vain.

TEXT_COMPLETE_RQ_R_98_1.text:
How did she acquire the power of Soltar?
... We cannot let another Lord of Souls be born.

TEXT_COMPLETE_S2_EP1WB_REPEAT_01_0001.text: You've done well. Until next time.

TEXT_COMPLETE_S2_GROUP_REPEAT_1_001.text: That was a request well carried out.

TEXT_COMPLETE_S2_REPEAT_WEEK_1_001.text:
Well done, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Thank you for your help.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0038_1.text: Lorelei sagte, es war für die Geschichte von Hasla eine große Entdeckung, aber ...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0038_2.text: Vielleicht wäre es besser gewesen, wenn ich gar nicht entdeckt worden wäre.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0039_1.text:
Hihi, genau wie ich gesagt habe, oder? 
Das ist für die Göttin der Wüste etwas Grundlegendes, ähm!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0039_2.text:
Hm, aber ... Er wird die Form nicht verändern 
JEDES Mal, wenn wir ihn besiegen, richtig ...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0040_1.text: Toll! Der Kampf sollte jetzt endlich beendet sein!

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0041_1.text:
Etwas stimmt hier nicht, aber ...
Ende gut, alles gut, oder ...?

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0067_0002.text:
Making a pact with multiple Ice Spirits at once
to move all joints of the body...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0067_0003.text: Have you seen anything like this before?

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0068_0002.text:
Upon closer inspection, these suits of armor
seem like antiques hundreds of years old...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0068_0003.text:
Who can that clown be
to be leading such monsters?

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0069_0001.text: Whew! That was a close call.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0069_0002.text:
Had it not been for our Guardian friend's help,
we may have been in trouble.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0069_0003.text:
It has been some time
since I fought with such passion.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0070_0001.text:
We have stopped the Seal of the Sanctuary
from completely breaking, but...

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0070_0002.text:
The revived snowstorm
will prove trouble to these lands.

TEXT_COMPLETE_SUB_QUEST_Q0070_0003.text:
We must go warn the King of Nosgard
of the coming danger.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_10_1.text:
Oho! So that's...! Let me have a closer look at it.
... .... Mm, just as I'd thought...

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_10_2.text:
This is infused with magic. I'll need some help from the witch of the town
if I want to treat it with proper care.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_10_3.text:
If you could bring back something that can handle magic,
I think I'll be able to convert this Ring.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_11_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
I look forward to your performance in the Colosseum.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_13_1.text:
There are a lot of amazing fishing spots in Hasla too, nyan.
I look forward to fishing with you for days to come, nyan!

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_14_1.text: I hope many strong Champions come to reside in Hero Town, soon.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_15_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! The Orchard needs a LOT of workers, okay?
The more, the better! I look forward to working with you, partner!

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_16_1.text:
Thank you.
A shadow still looms over these lands...

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_16_2.text:
Yet the darkness will soon dissolve before our courage,
{PLAYER_NAME}. I am sure of it.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_17_2.text:
Sometimes I'll grant Skills at specially discounted prices,
so do come by often. Okie, sweetie?

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_18_1.text:
In order to inlay Sigils to your Weapons, you must first add 'Slots.'
Make sure to remember that.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_19_1.text: Knowledge and power descended from ancient times...

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_19_2.text:
Acquiring this strength
will be of great help in facing the threats and dangers to come.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_1_1.text:
Don't you just love the taste of freshly baked bread?
Bread also helps Heroes train and become stronger!

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_20_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
I'm glad to see you return safe and sound!

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_21_2.text:
I can think of several circumstances this recipe will prove handy.
Use it wisely and our Heroes will surely benefit.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_22_1.text:
Well done, {PLAYER_NAME}. Battle delegation, used wisely,
will provide you with valuable experience in the future.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_2_1.text:
Weapons can be upgraded too. 
... Well, most of the time, that is.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_3_1.text:
Hasla... It's such a fascinating place, don't you think so?
... I look forward to recording your adventures.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_4_1.text:
I am glad Sera finds it to her liking.
Perhaps you could visit her from time to time and see how she does.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_5_1.text:
I look forward to the day
this room becomes truly yours, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_6_1.text:
How did your training go?
Remember that all Heroes have different methods of fighting.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_6_2.text:
Try to figure out the best way to employ their capabilities
and form teams that will prove most advantageous in battle.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_7_1.text:
Have you met anyone?
There is nothing more reassuring than a trusty companion by your side.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_8_1.text:
You can employ other Captains' Heroes as mercenaries -
one Hero a day for each Captain.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_8_2.text:
If you ever have any trouble making progress on your adventures,
your friends' Heroes may provide valuable assistance.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_9_1.text:
Thank you for helping us again, nya.
Here, I'll give you some shiny gold - it's my favorite thing in the world, nya.

TEXT_COMPLETE_TQ_9_2.text:
Popo and Toto don't stay in one place for too long, nya.
We have many places to go! I hope to see you again, nya!

TEXT_DESERT_FISHERY_DESC.text:
Ich habe gehört, dass in der Oase auch exotische Fische leben, miau!
Es könnte spezielle Fischarten geben, die sich in der Wüste entwickelt haben.
Denkst du, dass wir sie fangen können? Miau!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_10_01.text:
Laertes loves his granddaughter...
but he's failed to understand her properly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_10_02.text:
Can a good knight become a good grandfather,
I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_1_01.text:
Did you hear? Soltar...
That abomination at the Fortress of Souls has finally been vanquished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_1_02.text: R-really? Then is the war over at last?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_1_03.text:
Rumor has it that the one who defeated him
is the descendant of the House of Ferdinand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_1_04.text:
I hear that this descendant trained in foreign lands
in order to prepare for his final battle with Soltar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_1_05.text: Oh... Now that's good to hear!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_1_06.text: Then will he become our new king?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_1_07.text:
Shh! We're serving Lady Rael, remember?
The one who's been fighting all this time and guarding our kingdom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_2_01.text: Are you alright? Why are you in such a hurry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_2_02.text:
Urgent news has arrived from Headquarters.
The Margrave has crowned Lionel as king!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_2_05.text:
You idiot, he's the Soltar's heir
that we've just been talking about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_3_01.text:
This is important news.
I must alert Lady Rael -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_3_02.text:
There's no need.
I already heard the news.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_4_01.text:
Prepare for departure. With the war over,
there's no need to linger here any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_4_03.text:
Y-yes, ma'am! You heard the captain,
get ready to leave!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_6_01.text:
I heard everything. You crowned a nameless knight
who claims himself the descendant of Soltar...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_6_04.text:
It is our troops who have fought against the revived Soul Army
and protected the lands of our kingdom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_6_05.text:
I don't understand. How can you confer the throne to some child
who deserted his country and has no true knowledge of it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_6_06.text:
Valencia needs no king - not any longer.
Even if it does...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_6_07.text:
The throne rightfully belongs to either one of us, Grandfather!
You must withdraw your decision!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_7_01.text:
Rael. Surely you do not think that I refused the throne
for want of skill or support.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_7_02.text:
The sole lot granted to our family was that of protecting the people
of the king who would return one day. No more, no less.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_7_04.text: I will not change my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_7_05.text:
The one and only king is Lord Lionel,
the returned descendant of the House of Ferdinand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_8_01.text:
Rael...
You will do far more important things than ascending to the throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_15_8_03.text:
... I can't, and I won't.
I'll take your leave now, Grandfather.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_10_01.text: You don't get it, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_10_02.text:
I and I alone chose to live my life.
Nobody told me to do any of this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_10_03.text:
When I first started studying, I didn't want to remain in the woods,
the traditional medium of Earth Magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_10_04.text:
I wanted to look to the stars. 
And I did - and I discovered a new type of 'Celestial Magic.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_10_05.text:
I paved my own path, but I could do so only because Professor taught me
the most valuable thing a witch can have: self-confidence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_10_06.text: Of course I have no regrets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_11_01.text:
And even if you've inherited Professor's title,
it still doesn't change the fact that I'm her best student!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_12_02.text:
Ugh, will you stop apologizing?
You're the Witch of the Forest - act like it! Believe in yourself more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_12_03.text: ... Don't tell me - you've never received even the most basic training.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_12_04.text:
... No, I haven't. These powers were born with me,
and I never had the chance to refine them. I fear I am inadequate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_12_05.text:
I will never fill Master Loviatar's shoes in this state.
I - I've never confided in anyone, but perhaps you will understand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_13_01.text: Estelle. If it is not too much trouble...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_13_02.text: Will you impart some of Master Loviatar's knowledge?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_14_02.text: You are the one who were the closest to Master Loviatar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_14_03.text: If I am to truly earn my title as the second Witch of the Forest,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_14_04.text: I must become worthy of it, with both skill and responsibility.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_14_05.text: And I feel that you are the best teacher that I can have.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_15_01.text: ... Huh. Well, you have an eye for true talent, I'll give you that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_15_02.text:
Ugh... I have so much research to do... So many lectures to teach...
I'm a busy person, you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_15_03.text: BUT... I guess I could find the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_16_01.text: Will you truly do all this for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_16_03.text:
And brace yourself - I'm a difficult teacher.
If you want to learn, I'll make sure you learn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_16_04.text: ... It is what I wished for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_17_02.text:
... would be proud to see that she has taught
two such dedicated students.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_17_03.text: When will she return to them, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_1_01.text: Let's see... Hmm, I remember putting it here, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_1_02.text: That's strange, all my files are out of place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_2_02.text: You there. Who are you, and what are you doing in my room?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_3_04.text: You're the second Witch of the Forest, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_4_01.text: Have you been living under a rock?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_4_02.text: I'm Estelle. 'The' Witch of Stars, as people call me these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_4_04.text: Ah, so you're the one who...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_5_01.text:
H-hey, did I say something wrong?
 What's with that face?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_5_04.text: Your professor - she sacrificed herself to save me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_5_05.text:
It's only logical that you, who look after this room in Master's absence,
would have read these records.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_5_06.text: You know what happened in the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_6_01.text: Of course I know. Why are you stating the obvious?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_7_01.text: But this is Professor Loviatar we're talking about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_7_02.text:
I believe... No, I know for a fact
that she'll return some day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_7_03.text:
The only thing we can do in the meantime is hope -
and do more research.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_8_02.text: I'm busy enough as it is, without having to look after you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_8_03.text: Will you stop moping like that? It bothers me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_9_01.text: As you said... You were - you still are Master Loviatar's best student.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_9_02.text: My title as the second Witch of the Forest...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_16_9_04.text: Does it not... upset you, that I have taken what is rightfully yours?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_10_01.text:
Hmm. Beron the genius bear… Like all geniuses, he was
both fascinating and a little egocentric.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_10_02.text:
The 3 other bears in the beginning were also peculiar.
They were roaring at each other as if they were talking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_10_03.text:
Hmm? Oh, silly {PLAYER_NAME}.
They couldn't have been really talking to one another!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_10_04.text:
Energy life form? Mind assimilation?
You must have been dreaming!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_01.text:
Nom nom... Growl... Grr....
Grrrrrr... Greetings, everyone. Has it already been a year?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_02.text:
Ah, I missed you. I hope you did not have too much trouble
with Bera on your pack's journey around the continent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_03.text:
Not at all. Our little pack leader now knows all the roads
and can discern the edible mushrooms from the poisonous ones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_04.text:
She is a hardworking little one, especially for her stature.
Her enthusiasm for everything she sees is endearing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_05.text: I am happy to hear that you enjoyed the year.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_06.text:
As for my own travels… The northeastern reaches of
Nosgard are in chaos, I'm afraid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_07.text:
A rogue penguin acquired ancient knowledge from the
Steamer ruins and formed a mechanized penguin army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_08.text:
Fortunately, an opportune earthquake
brought the penguins' schemes to an early end, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_09.text:
... their leader, a female penguin
who goes by the name of Olga, remains in power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_2_10.text:
We have sent a polar bear of our house
to prevent any unforeseen trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_3_02.text:
The Taebaek Mountains in the east
are also plagued with talk of evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_3_03.text:
Humans driving stakes into the earth to obstruct the
flow of life energy that runs across the continent...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_3_04.text:
Mountain saints suddenly turning belligerent to break the
very peace they protected... I fear war looms on the east.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_3_05.text: Hmm... That is disturbing news indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_3_06.text:
We bears of Nosgard might have acquired
superbear intelligence through our intake of salmon...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_3_07.text:
... but our transition is incomplete. For most of the year we
live as inconsequential beasts with no knowledge, no power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_01.text:
Once we ascend to become pure spiritual energy and
integrate our consciousness together, we will be whole.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_02.text:
I still think that the right time for ascension is this year.
We cannot wait for Bera and Beron forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_04.text:
Bera is family, but she is also a human. All the salmon we
fed her did not help her... I fear she is a lost cause.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_05.text:
Then what about Beron?
He is one of us, is he not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_06.text:
Beron... Yes. That poor child
never took to selenium as we did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_07.text:
Perhaps there are genetic factors that contribute to his
anomaly? Whatever it is, I pity him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_08.text:
For a few years he has been attempting to employ
science to increase his own cognitive functions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_09.text:
His intelligence has yet to fully develop, but he has made
progress. Why do we not wait a little longer for him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_4_10.text: We also have the alternative of revealing the truth to him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_5_01.text: That kid is too proud for his own good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_5_02.text:
Interfering with Beron's path of enlightenment may hinder
the integration process after his own ascension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_5_03.text:
I agree.
Yet waiting in itself cannot be a solution.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_5_04.text:
I say that we continue to observe Bera and Beron, and if
neither shows reasonable hope, we ascend then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_6_02.text:
Then it's decided.
This year's salmon will again be allotted to Beron.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_6_03.text: I do feel rather sorry for that child Bera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_6_04.text:
Our bodies have already ascended to an ethereal state
and are no longer subject to their former physical needs...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_6_05.text: ... but that she continues to fight Beron for our sake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_6_06.text: Despite being human, Bera is a clever girl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_6_07.text:
She may come to realize
the secret of the salmon soon enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_6_08.text:
Shh! Here comes Beron. Everyone, prepare to act
your part as fools. Enter, bear!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_7_01.text:
Hey, idiots!
What's that you're holding, growl?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_7_02.text:
I told you, ALL the salmon in this part of the river
is MINE! Growl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_7_03.text:
Oh, I'm sorry. I've completely forgotten. It is rather hard
to keep track of one's thoughts when they come and go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_7_05.text:
Hrrmph, I'll let you off this one time, growl.
Be careful in the future, growl!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_8_01.text:
Now, then. The time has come to bid farewell
to our superbear intelligence until next autumn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_17_8_02.text:
Hopefully next year, Bera and Beron can jo-uwuh...
Uwuh... Grrrrr...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_01.text:
... Most people claiming that they would 'save' me
attempted to do so, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_02.text:
They maintained that my ghosts
were too wicked, too malevolent...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_03.text:
... and that they were the reason for my suffering.
That it would be 'too late' if I kept them any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_04.text:
And then you come and declare that you can see ghosts
and have enough power to exorcise them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_05.text:
... and that you wish to help me, but will not harm my friends.
How can I believe you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_06.text: The ghosts around you. Do you not deem them your family?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_07.text:
I won't say that they are inherently kind or good spirits.
Unrestrained, they will wreak havoc on both dead and living.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_08.text:
Yet they answer to you.
You can control them - well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_10_09.text:
I see no reason to banish them
and so take them away from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_11_01.text:
... I see.
Then I'll give you a chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_11_03.text:
It may be that you have had some...
experiences similar to mine,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_11_04.text:
but you are different from the others
who approached me with their 'solutions.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_11_05.text: ... Let's see what you have to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_01.text:
Thank you.
With your consent - and only with your consent...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_02.text:
I will ask Great King Yama to ordain you as he did me, so
that you too can use your strength for the good of the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_03.text:
With his official recognition,
you will no longer be alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_04.text:
You could even cross the border to the land of the living if
you wish - together with your spirits, in your current state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_06.text:
...
I need some time to think over this matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_07.text:
If I agree to your offer,
will you be taking me to see King Yama?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_08.text:
That was my original plan. However, he has not been
answering any of my messages...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_12_09.text:
My dreams have been dark of late.
Tsk, I hope I'm not losing my sleep for nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_13_01.text:
Ahem, ahem... Please don't stare at me so.
I understand that you must be disappointed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_13_04.text:
We could ask for help from a Death Messenger who
should know his whereabouts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_14_02.text:
The last Death Messenger I met
was only too eager to send me to the underworld.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_14_03.text:
I only escaped with my life
due to the help of my ghosts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_14_04.text:
Fear not.
This one is different, I promise you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_14_05.text:
She is wiser and more flexible than most, and will only be
too happy to help you with your troubles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_14_06.text:
She also serves King Yama directly,
which will certainly help you in your plight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_14_07.text: She should be arriving any minute now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_15_01.text:
Bihyeongrang! There you are, I've been looking
all ov- Hey!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_16_01.text:
I've been waiting here for you, Korin.
You usually pass through around this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_16_02.text: ... It seems that this is not your first meeting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_16_03.text:
The girl with the ghosts!
You still haven't returned to the land of the living!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_16_04.text:
Wait, first things first.
What are you two doing here, of all places?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_16_05.text: So this is the Death Messenger you were talking about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_16_06.text:
Yes... It seems that this is not your first meeting.
Which is good, as it should facilitate our plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_16_07.text:
Korin, as you can see,
we require some -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_17_01.text:
I know what it is you're going to say
but we really don't have the time now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_17_02.text:
I have an urgent favor to ask of you
while I'm away on business!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_18_02.text:
King Yama himself has decreed 
that I guide a valued guest to the Primal Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_18_03.text:
He usually sends out written edicts for such things… He must
have been in a hurry to give out his orders through a dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_01.text:
... Dreams?
You don't mean... of the Volcano?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_02.text:
Oh, so you received the revelation as well, Bihyeongrang?
Good, so we're on the same page!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_03.text:
We have no time to lose.
I'm running late as it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_04.text:
My dream was not so clear;
it only revealed a vague image of the Volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_05.text:
I had it repeatedly, however, and so thought it a simple nightmare.
It must have been a fragment of the revelation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_06.text:
... Wait.
Then let us accompany you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_07.text: I must speak with the Great King,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_08.text: and won't you prefer a companion or two on the road?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_19_09.text:
Nope, I need people who can WORK in my stead
while I'm away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_1_01.text:
How much farther must we go?
We've been walking all day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_02.text:
You have the experience!
We've been partners for quite some time now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_03.text:
Of course, there are other Death Messengers
who can guide the souls to the underworld...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_04.text:
... but I don't want to risk having that barbaric reaper from the
West dragging away spirits with no regard for their welfare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_05.text: Ugh... Just the thought of that idiot annoys me to no end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_06.text:
Anyway!
You're one of the few men I can trust, Bihyeongrang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_07.text: That's why I really need to ask this favor of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_08.text:
Please look over my district and see if
anyone is upsetting the balance of the realms

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_09.text:
or causing disruptions to the borders,
or if any souls have lost their way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_10.text: It shouldn't be too much trouble for you, I hope.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_21_02.text:
I still think that you should disentangle yourself from the
realm of spirits and keep away from ghosts, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_21_03.text:
... you're not planning on changing your mind
any time soon, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_21_05.text:
Ask as many times as you want, but I have no intentions
whatsoever of parting with my ghosts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_01.text:
Sigh... People these days can be so stubborn!
Then I'll just give you a piece of advice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_02.text:
I'm still uncomfortable
with leaving you behind like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_04.text:
You could accompany me to the Volcano
and help me with my tasks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_05.text:
Bihyeongrang too received his titles
in recognition of his contributions to my work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_23_02.text:
Oh, I can read you like an open book, Bihyeongrang!
I trust that you'll do fine. Just don't end up killing each other!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_23_03.text: Okie? Okie! Then I'll see myself off!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_24_04.text: So... How should we go about doing this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_25_01.text:
It's a busy job, delivering souls to the underworld.
And I had no idea it was so... bureaucratic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_25_02.text:
I'm curious about this 'Great King Yama,' though.
I wonder if we can meet him someday?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_2_02.text:
Yes, you have indeed come a long way.
I apologize for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_3_01.text: ... Are you the one who sent the Vaisravana?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_3_02.text:
Yes. 'A child fathered by a ghost.'
Do you find the phrase familiar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_3_03.text: I am no stranger to your predicament. I wish to help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_4_02.text:
From my childhood, I have been able to sense the 
presence of spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_4_03.text:
Others were not so acceptable of that fact. I had to leave
my motherland to protect my family.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_4_04.text:
You remind me of myself,
when I was young.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_5_01.text:
... I'm not sure whether to take that as a compliment,
seeing that it comes from a complete stranger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_5_02.text:
However - you still seem to order ghosts around
How do you mean to help me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_6_01.text: Ahem... I apologize if I seem intrusive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_6_02.text:
I received the title of Ghost King from the Great King Yama
and have used my powers for the two realms ever since:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_6_03.text:
guiding souls on their long journey to the afterlife,
helping those tortured by evil spirits...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_01.text:
Great King Yama?
... So he really does exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_02.text:
Yes, as someone who has been invited to his palace
in the Kingdom of Yama, I can confirm it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_03.text:
As I was saying, I have been watching you, and your
powers, uncontrolled as they are, harbor great potential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_04.text:
Should you find yourself too weary to linger any longer
in the realm of spirits, there is another path you can take: mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_01.text: ... And how do I know I can trust you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_02.text:
Vaisravana may answer to your call,
but why should I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_03.text:
I did not receive my title
of the Ghost King for nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_04.text:
... Look around you. Listen.
Do you not sense the difference in the air?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_01.text: ... I thought it was strangely quiet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_02.text:
So you were the reason the usually talkative ghosts
have been keeping their tongues.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_03.text:
I may have been underestimating you,
I have to admit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_04.text:
I have no intentions of harming the ghosts by your side.
You have no reason to fear me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_1_01.text:
This must be where Halla saw Hanee Baram last...
But where can she be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_01.text: Hanee Baram, I've been looking everywhere for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_05.text: The wind... carried the scent of a dear old friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_06.text:
It has been decades, and you still haven't forgotten me -
I am thankful for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_08.text: Where have you been? We've missed you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_10.text: I apologize for troubling you with my long absence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_11.text: I have been atoning for my sins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_3_02.text:
The Eungaram I know...
would never do something so bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_3_03.text: But I did. And I have been regretting it ever since.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_02.text: I drove an innocent girl to her death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_04.text:
A rich human, coveting me for his collection of curiosities,
imprisoned me in his birdcage for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_05.text:
I was helpless, as I had lost my powers,
being so far away from my river.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_06.text:
The girl was a maid working at the rich man's mansion.
She was my beacon of hope in those dark times.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_07.text: She had beautiful hair, the color of calm and fresh water.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_09.text:
She talked to me every day, even though
I was trapped in my bird form and could not reply.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_10.text:
For my sake she recounted the smallest details of her day,
the things that interested her in the outside world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_11.text:
Her little stories and smiles
became the only thing I awaited in the rich man's cage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_12.text: I could sing with pure joy before her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_13.text:
One day, the girl gave me a gift of rainbow-colored
pebble, saying that it reminded her of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_14.text:
As fate would have it, she had found it on the banks of my
river. Through the pebble, I recovered some of my magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_16.text: I should have been more careful then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_17.text:
I regained enough of my power to speak once more,
and so I beseeched the girl for my freedom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_18.text:
It was only with her help
that I could escape my cage and return to my river.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_19.text:
I went free. But my disappearance...
The girl had to pay a harsh price in my stead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_20.text: ... So that is why the girl...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_21.text: Yes. For saving my life, she lost hers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_23.text:
I realized too late the gravity of my decision. I asked myself
countless times: what if I had chosen not to leave?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_24.text:
What if I had chosen to stay with the girl a little longer,
respond to her great kindness with my own?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_25.text:
Why had I been so hasty to flee from my cage without so
much as asking the name of the one who had freed me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_26.text:
The girl was my only friend, the one person I lived for. 
Gave her up for freedom that now pales before her memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_28.text:
I isolated myself from everything for many years… Alone
in the cage of my own making, the cage of my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_29.text:
... I can't bear to see you like this, Eungaram.
And neither would the girl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_30.text: ... You have to let her go now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_31.text: I cannot. Her image is engraved too clearly in my mind...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_6_01.text: I'm sorry. I was searching for someone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_7_01.text:
Hair the color of water...
Could it be...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_7_03.text:
No...
I'm hoping for the impossible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_9_01.text: May I have the honor of knowing your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_01.text:
I have not been living under a rock; I'm simply reminding
you that only Guardian Spirits can enter this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_02.text: Weeellll... But... It's - it's Halla's birthday!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_03.text:
And it seems that you two hardly know each other. You
two must have met only a few days before, if not today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_04.text:
Don't you know that strangers are just friends we haven't
met before? We can become friends here at this party!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_05.text:
And do you not remember the tragedy that transpired
when outsiders last invaded our sacred grounds?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_06.text: Our few laws exist for a reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_07.text:
Those were the evil humans who wanted to cause harm in
the first place! Can't you see everyone here is a friend?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_01.text: Erm... It is my birthday... Let's stop fighting, hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_02.text: Yeah, we can't waste our time arguing on a good day like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_03.text: And it's not like all humans are bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_04.text:
The ones who destroyed my forest and Halla's mountains
were humans, were they not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_05.text:
Well... I don't have anything to say to THAT… Bu-ut! I
still think it's unfair to discriminate against all humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_06.text:
What about your special someone - the one who gave
you that pebble you carry around everywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_08.text:
That human girl... was different.
She was like no other human being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_11.text:
And we outnumber humans! Even if - and that's a big 'if' -
she has an ulterior motive, she won't be able to do much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_12.text:
And look at that face! Now that's the face of someone
who can truly enjoy parties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_13_01.text:
Well, then... I suppose it would be all right,
for this day and this day only.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_14_01.text: Happy birthday! Here's your birthday tteok!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_01.text:
I came without delay
as soon as they were out of the steam pot. Whew!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_02.text:
Gather around
and eat up while it's still hot, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_03.text:
Erm... She's my guest of honor. Everyone should be
already acquainted, except for Eungaram and Neulsolgil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_05.text: She may be a human, but she is an old friend of mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_06.text:
When my mountains burned and my powers with them,
and I had nowhere to go,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_07.text:
it was only Malsook and her tteok
that helped me overcome my troubles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_08.text:
If I can't invite a good friend to my own party, what's
the point of living one more year having a party -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_10.text: I do think you all could be more careful, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_16_01.text:
There is... one more guest to arrive...
And I was the one who invited her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_17_02.text:
How is everyone?
I hope you all have been doing well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_01.text: And with Haerang's arrival, we can start the party.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_02.text:
Ooh, so nice to meet you! That energy flowing from you...
I'll be looking forward to your dance moves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_04.text:
Eungaram! It's not everyday we can gather like this. Stop
worrying and enjoy quality time with your friends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_05.text: Come on, a single day of partying won't do anyone any harm! Hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_06.text:
... I suppose that a few exceptions can be made,
as it is Halla's birthday party.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_08.text: Good! Now, as we've ironed out all the wrinkles...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_01.text:
Pant, pant! I seem to have - cough -
underestimated the energy of Guardian Spirits...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_02.text:
Who knew they could be literal party animals?
I've been playing for DAYS!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_03.text: Don't stop the music! Keep on playing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_04.text: I - ugh - need a break! Pant, pant...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_1_02.text:
Hee hee... Thank you for coming.
I'm happy that everyone could come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_1_03.text: And how old are you supposed to be, again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_1_04.text:
Hmm... I haven't kept count, but it's been about 200 years
since I held my first 'birthday' as a conscious Spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_20_01.text: What? You can't stop now! Get back up, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_20_04.text:
What an energetic Mountain Spirit. She doesn't get tired.
I've never recorded a Guardian Spirit's birthday before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_20_05.text:
I guess 'birthdays' don't mean much for them anymore,
except as an excuse for a long overdue gathering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_01.text:
Oh... I've been forgetting how old you were,
with your current physical form...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_02.text: Again? I thought you'd remember after the last time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_03.text: You too, Hanee Baram? Me, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_04.text:
I keep forgetting Halla is not the itty bitty tiger cub
he seems and is, in fact, much, much older than me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_05.text:
Please stay little like this, Halla!
I like you as you are right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_06.text: Oh, stop teasing me. Not on my birthday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_08.text:
Hmm... I agree with Neulsolgil.
You're so little and cute now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_3_01.text:
Anyway! As it is your birthday today, we invited over
some friends! They should be here any minute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_4_01.text: Thank you for inviting me. I am glad that I'm not too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_5_01.text: Am I the last to arrive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_01.text: Who needs some music to jazz up this party~?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_03.text:
The HMA's shining champion - Jeomrye's in the house!
Give me a 'whoop, whoop'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_04.text: HMA? Do you know what those letters are supposed to mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_05.text: Nope, not a clue - but who cares? This is SO MUCH FUN!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_06.text:
By the time I'm done here, nobody will remain standing!
So get ready for a legendary night of hardcore rock!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_01.text: Yeee! Human music is so wild!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_02.text: And she's so good! I knew she wasn't famous for nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_03.text:
This is unacceptable. You cannot simply let humans
enter a sacred forest of a Guardian Spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_04.text: Oh, I wasn't aware there was going to be a problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_05.text:
Apparently, you've been living under a rock. This is THE
most popular haeguem player in all of Hasla right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_01.text:
You called yourself Schild, didn't you?
I can sense the power of a dragon from you, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_02.text:
Oh, me too, Mr. Dragon. Or should I say, Mr. Black Worm?
I can't be compared to such a primitive life form.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_03.text:
... Me, THE incarnation of the Black Dragon, a 'Black
Worm'? I won't fall for your goading.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_04.text:
Oh, I don't mean to fight. I'm just putting into words
what I'm seeing right now with my own #eyes#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_06.text: Calm down, friend. She means no harm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_07.text:
She is simply stating the fact that there is an overwhelming,
unassailable gulf of pure strength between us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_08.text:
You, too? Oh, for the sake of Hasla! What sins have I
committed that I must put up with this kind of treatment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_01.text:
Haha, look at him screaming in frustration.
I change my mind. He entertains me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_02.text: Pius, can I play with him instead?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_03.text:
... He is much bigger than those little creatures you've
been bothering, but take caution not to break him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_04.text: For the first time in my life, I want to go back to school.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_05.text:
As you've found your family or member of the same species
or whatever, I'll be seeing myself back to the Empi--

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_06.text:
Oh, hold up, Mr. Worm. I'm just getting started.
Let's see how durable you mortals are, hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_07.text: G-get away from me! Step back! I-I'm warning you -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_12_01.text:
Sigh... I've been worrying that this would happen for some
time, now. The #Children of the Stars#... have awoken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_12_02.text:
Be careful, {PLAYER_NAME}. They are strangers to this
dimension and the rules that uphold this dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_12_03.text:
The dangers that threaten to destroy Hasla are no longer
restricted to the war between light and darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_1_03.text:
The layers of time, sedimented in our physical bodies in
this lower dimension... are interfering with our thoughts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_1_04.text:
To return to the vast sea of stars...
I must make my choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_01.text:
And he speaks, ladies and gentlemen!
What were you thinking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_02.text: ... Ah, it is nothing of consequence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_04.text:
You've been sitting there for eight hours straight
without even blinking! You scared me back there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_06.text:
It is still hard to adjust to this... constricted flow of
time that upholds your four-dimensional time-space.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_07.text:
Yet I too must adjust, if I am to remain confined within
the limits of this malleable body, stripped of memory -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_08.text:
Yeah, yeah. Let's save the physics lesson for later.
We've finally arrived.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_01.text: ... Yes. I can sense her nearby.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_02.text:
Hey, a 'thank you' would be nice. The #Peaks of Glory#
aren't the most welcoming of places.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_03.text:
Not everyone can sneak past those Roman soldiers
while hiding a slowpoke like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_04.text:
You should thank your lucky stars that it was me
who found you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_05.text:
Yes, thank you, #Gangcheol#. I would have remained in
the hands of the white-steel-wielding humans, otherwise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_06.text:
I will repay your kindness. I swear it on my name -
and the skies of glory beyond.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_07.text:
Hey, I was just messing with you. There's no need for
such a formal thank you between fellow #dragons#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_08.text: Dragons...? No, you are mistaken. My siblings and I -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_5_01.text: Huh? Was that a kid just now? In these mountains?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_5_02.text:
That could be #Schild#. She too should have lost her
memories and may be in danger. I must go to her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_01.text:
Let me go! How dare you touch my wings with your
slimy hands! Almael, shoot down this giant barbarian!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_02.text: Delrien, I'm trapped too, in her other hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_03.text: Waaaah! Daddy, where are you? I need you, Daddy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_04.text:
Haha, what a funny little family! The dad and the
daughter are both helplessly at my mercy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_05.text:
Didn't you see what I did with your dear daddy? He won't
be returning from beyond those mountains any time soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_06.text:
I-I'll get you for this! The blue-haired human and the
Beast King will take revenge for this utter brutality!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_07.text:
Yeah, yeah. Bring on all your unicorn friends
and see if I blink an eye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_03.text: Oh? Pius! What are you doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_04.text:
Is it so strange to seek reunion with one's sole
remaining kinsman in an unfamiliar world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_05.text:
However... What are you doing, Schild? You must be
more compassionate towards those little life forms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_06.text:
Ugh. I may have lost my memories, but I'll bet all my eyes
that you've always been an annoying, patronizing bore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_07.text:
And this inconvenient amnesia doesn't make me any less
smart or badass. Who says 'this' isn't the true me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_08.text:
It's not my fault that they're so tiny
and seem so fun to play with!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_09.text:
Restrain yourself. Remember that we too are 'tiny' compared
to our true form, and will remain so for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_01.text:
What are they talking about? None of what they're saying
has to do anything with me and I don't like it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_02.text:
Shh, Delrien! Keeping our mouths shut
is our best chance at escape!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_03.text: Escape? The Great Fairy Queen has to escape like a -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_05.text: Wow, those fairies are living in their own little world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_01.text: Oh, you take the fun out of everything. Thanks a lot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_02.text:
You there. I'll let you go this one time,
so scram while you have the chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_03.text: Hey! Who do you think you are, you shi---mmbbbubumm!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_04.text:
You idiot - I mean, Your Most Royal Highness!
We have to run while we can! Come ON!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_1_001.text:
So many valuable artifacts and records of our ancestors...
This excavation has also proved to be a success.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_1_002.text:
I know I must be happy,
but something does not feel right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_001.text: Lorelei, you seem worried. What is it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_002.text:
Osiris. You told me that your people
fell to ruin one hundred years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_003.text: Yes, that is the history we have inherited from our ancestors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_004.text:
Had the tragedy happened further in the past,
the descendants of our tribe would have been far fewer than now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_005.text:
And it was also a century ago that
the Goddesses and the Apostles fought the Great War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_006.text:
As the specifics of the War remain veiled to this day,
