Don't worry.
I opened a dimensional rift in town too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_08.text:
... The townspeople are going crazy about it, but
nothing to worry about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_5_09.text:
There's always something happening huh...
Then, we'll be on our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_03.text: I wonder what they'll be up to in their own world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_04.text:
Who knows.
Even I can't tell what happens in other dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_05.text:
But if it's them, they will follow their beliefs and forge
their own paths.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_06.text:
Either way, their stories are theirs alone.
Let's just worry about our own here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_09.text:
Does the #Book of Hasla# really contain everything
that happens?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_ENDING_6_11.text:
W-Would it be okay if I look at it a little bit...
Like to see who my future spouse would be, or...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_1_01.text:
Heh, to think this kind of world existed.
How interesting, the Backyard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_1_02.text:
Hmm.
Looks like it's a space that exists between dimensional warps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_1_03.text:
Moreover, there's a Library of Dimensions here that
records all things...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_2_01.text:
As expected it looks well-guarded.
What a bother. What to do...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_3_01.text:
... HAHAHA!
I just got a good idea!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_01.text:
Greetings, {PLAYER_NAME} and Sera.
Are you on a walk?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_02.text:
Yes, Lednas! The weather is so good today!
Are you on a walk too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_03.text:
Indeed. The sunlight looked too good for me to be
sitting in my office all day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_04.text: Hehe, I wish everyday was as peaceful as today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_05.text:
Agreed. Today feels especially nice.
Almost a little too nice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_4_06.text: Usually something always happens when it's like this, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_5_01.text: ... It seems I spoke too soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_5_02.text:
L-Look over there!
A hole in the sky!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_01.text: P-People are falling from the sky!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_02.text:
Ugh, where are we?
I was definitely just in the Illyria Castle...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_03.text:
Calm down, Frederick.
This doesn't look like Illyria, or even a city at all?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_6_04.text:
Ah, you're right.
What in the world happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_01.text:
Hello.
My name is Lednas. I am the Captain of Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_03.text:
As expected... it seems you came here from
another dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_05.text:
And Hero Town is part of the Grancia Empire, located
in the center of the continent of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_06.text:
Another dimension?
What kind of idioti---

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_07.text:
I mean, besides that lady, no one else seems bothered.
Do things like this just happen here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_08.text: ... Well, it doesn't happen too often.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_09.text:
Visitors from other worlds like you tend to drift through
Hasla every now and then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_10.text:
And every time that happens, we try to help them get back
to their own worlds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_7_11.text: I know someone who can help, would you follow me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_01.text: ... Doesn't sound like a lie she made up on the spot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_02.text:
Lead the way. I don't fully trust you, but staying here
isn't going to do anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_03.text:
Very well. Then, {PLAYER_NAME}, Sera. Let's head over
to the Library of Dimensions with them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_INTRO_8_04.text: I am certain that Pandora is already aware of the situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_1_01.text:
Welcome, {PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas.
You're 5 minutes later than I predicted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_01.text: You were watching as we expected, Pandora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_02.text:
Well, usually when weird things happen in Hasla,
they happen close to you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_03.text: I've been waiting since I felt the dimensional warp.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_2_04.text:
These people are...
Ah, they're here 'again' from that dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_3_01.text:
Is this sleepy-looking lady the one who will save us?
She doesn't look like the reliable type.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_3_02.text:
Hmm. This is your fourth time now,
but of course you don't remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_3_04.text:
Don't worry about it.
It's fine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_01.text:
So... what do we know?
Why is there a dimensional rift this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_02.text:
First... this dimensional rift was caused by #another being#
from your world this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_03.text: I don't know who it is, but it seems they are quite powerful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_04.text: They're the ones in control of his dimensional rift this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_05.text:
So in conclusion, in order for you guys to get back home...
That being is the only way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_06.text:
Would you happen to know anyone from your world who
could possibly be behind this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_4_07.text:
There are tons of bastards who would think things like this.
But on this scale... maybe just one or two of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_5_02.text:
Hmm... Anyway, I've figured out the coordinates of the others
that came over here with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_5_03.text:
You should find and bring them back here. Surely, the pieces
will start falling into place sooner or later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_01.text:
Tch. I don't know who this person thinks they are,
but when I catch them, they're dead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_02.text: Hand over the coordinate. I'll go bring the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_04.text: I, I want to come too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_05.text:
Hmm... Sera, could you let the other Goddesses in the town
know about the current situation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_06.text:
Since we're dealing with a powerful being that can control
this dimensional rift, it's best they be prepared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_6_07.text:
I wanted to go with you...
*Sob,* understood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_01.text:
Lednas, right?
Looks like I owe you one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_02.text:
Don't sweat it.
I'm just fulfilling my duties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_03.text:
... Ah, there's one more thing before you go. Dimensional rifts
can also warp space-time too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_04.text:
That means that though everyone that came here may be from
the same world, they may not be from the #same time#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_05.text:
Even if you know them, they may be completely different from
how you know them. Take care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_7_06.text:
... I'll keep that in mind.
Then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE1_01_8_01.text:
My... they left without even knowing where to go.
{PLAYER_NAME}, let us make haste the follow them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_10_01.text:
Wow, are those Zepp's mechanical soldiers?
Although they look a little different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_10_02.text:
Those are Steamers...
Looks like they came from the past with the rift opening.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_10_03.text:
This is what I meant when I said troublesome things earlier.
Let's take care of these right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_01.text: Oh? These don't look so bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_02.text:
Good timing, I was starting to get restless.
Perfect for a quick workout.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_04.text:
While we're at it, why not place bets on who can
take more of them down?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_11_05.text: Fine by me. I'll go first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_02.text: ... You guys came back faster than I thought you would.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_03.text: Did you find the rest of them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_04.text:
Ah, they're all gathered outside.
I recognized all of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_05.text: But we couldn't find any clues about who's behind all this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_06.text:
All I could figure out was that they came from a time that was
before my #current# time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_1_07.text:
... That shouldn't be possible. There were 13 traces of passage
through the rift... hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_2_01.text:
... New presences are coming through to this world.
This time, three people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_2_03.text:
Unlike the first time, they're scattered throughout Hasla.
What are they after?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_01.text: ... I think I figured out what they want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Sera, Sol Badguy. Please go and bring
back the drifters again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_03.text: But this time, go together with this world's goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_3_04.text:
If it's what I'm thinking... We should be able to uncover 
the real intentions of whoever caused this rift.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_4_01.text:
Looks like you have some sort of plan.
Since I'm not from around here, I'll follow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_4_02.text:
L-Leave it to us!
I'm an apprentice goddess too, so...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_4_03.text: Then... I'll leave it to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_5_02.text: All I remember is trying to chase down that #samurai#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_01.text: Oho, so you were here, as expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_02.text:
There's no doubt about this aura.
It's even stronger seeing you face to face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_04.text: Finding them in such a vast place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_05.text:
Don't say too much of it.
As the Snow Goddess this should be easy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_06.text:
Nah, this is definitely amazing.
I sometimes get lost in my own desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_6_07.text: That's just because you're so stupid!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_01.text:
Huh? Sol Badguy...?
What are you doing in a place like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_02.text: Who are these people next to you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_03.text:
Huh?? Who are you?
You know me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_04.text:
We saw each other at the White House, no?
How rude to forget the person who saved your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_06.text:
Ah, I see. This is what that library meant by
a 「warped space-time」 huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_7_07.text:
Hmm. It seems the me you know is the me
from the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_01.text:
But, the White House?
What would future me be doing there getting saved?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_02.text:
Hmm, well...
It's a bit of a long story...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_03.text: Stop! Let's leave things at that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_04.text: Huh, are spoilers forbidden here or something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_05.text:
From my personal experience... it's better not not
meddle with other time periods.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_06.text:
It's not enough to cause a time paradox, but...
Troublesome things can still happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_08.text:
Seeing you didn't try to run after seeing me,
we must not be on bad terms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_09.text:
We're trying to gather everyone who fell into this dimension
in order to get back to our own world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE2_01_8_11.text:
... Yeah, sure.
There's not much I can do here alone anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_1_02.text: I just remember being sucked in by something...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_2_01.text:
I can't reach anyone from here... I didn't expect much but...
Hmm, so what happened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_02.text:
Stop talking like that. Anyway, to think you were
wandering around in a place like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_03.text:
Are you here to find me? I was lost without a way to contact
anyone and it was rough. Not that it matters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_04.text: Well, I'm in the same position as you in this world right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_05.text:
Is that so... well, whatever.
By the way, who's with you right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_3_06.text:
They're locals here.
I was able to find you thanks to them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_01.text:
Even though I can't see, I can still feel it.
This energy, it's not that of a normal person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_02.text: ... We are goddesses of this world of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_03.text: We're here to help you all get back to your own worlds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_04.text:
It seems like if we can't find out who made this mess then
it'll be impossible for you to return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_05.text:
But do not worry.
{PLAYER_NAME} is looking for a way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}? I'm not sure who that is but
it seems like they are quite trusted around here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_07.text:
Sol Badguy is traveling with them right now.
I think it's okay to trust them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_08.text:
Millia, if that is what you think,
then I have nothing to worry about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_4_09.text: Very well, I'll go with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_03.text:
Shadow Demons...!
{PLAYER_NAME} should've already taken care of them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_04.text:
Were they hiding in the sewers?
But why are they showing up now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_05.text:
I see.
I knew they gave off a similar energy to Eddie's.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_07.text:
Seems they came out feeling a familiar energy.
What a shame, we can't talk in peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE3_01_5_08.text: Since we're in a rush here, let's settle this quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_1_01.text: The bleeding has stopped. Rest easy now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_2_01.text:
Ah! {PLAYER_NAME}!
A, a monster is attacking the goblin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_2_02.text:
My, Sera. You must not judge a book by its cover.
I think that's a person?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_2_05.text:
Oh my~ so different from what I heard about you from
other people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_02.text:
I'll explain what's happening later, but won't you
come with us for now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_03.text: Everyone is gathered in this place called Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_04.text:
I can't go right now.
Patients come first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_3_05.text: By patient you mean... that goblin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_01.text:
Their body structure is different from ours.
We must take extra care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_03.text:
Helping even monsters, you must be a really
kind person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_04.text:
*Sob* I'm sorry I thought you were scary when I first
saw you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_4_05.text: It happens all the time, don't worry about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_01.text:
Kek!!! Oi, human!
Help me out here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_02.text:
This monster of a human here,
He ain't helpin'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_03.text:
I just told him to pay the toll for passin',
but he beat me up and is treating me eh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_5_04.text: He told me to stay calm and he won't even let me go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_01.text: He's saying something... can you guys understand him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_02.text:
How embarrassing. For as long as I've lived...
I can't understand goblin...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_04.text: Sounds like he wants a toll payment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_6_05.text: Faust is treating him right now, what an ungrateful goblin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_7_01.text:
Even I understand 2 languages, what are you guys!
You got it all wrong here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_7_02.text: Ah, ah, someone please help me out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_03.text: I. Protect. The. Monsters. Of. The. Forest. !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_04.text:
Everyone, watch out!
This is a formidable opponent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_05.text:
Hmm~ so this really is a fantasy world.
That's a golem?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_8_06.text:
Yes... it's made of very sturdy rocks, so it's very hard to 
take down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE4_01_9_01.text:
Ya dumb humans better be ready!
Golem! Take it away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_1_01.text:
Oi, librarian! We're back.
What, she ain't here? Where'd she go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_01.text:
As far as I know, Pandora has never left her spot in the
library...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_03.text: D-Do you think she went to the bathroom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_04.text:
Higher beings like her just imitate human habits.
She doesn't need to use the bathroom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_2_05.text:
Instead of creating a misunderstanding, let me show
myself right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_01.text: Nice to meet you. It seems you are {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_02.text:
You're a lot more capable than I thought. I purposely sent you
far away, but you came back quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_03.text:
And... Flame of Corruption and Scales of Juno.
We haven't met yet, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_05.text:
This won't mean much to you but...
My name is #Happy Chaos#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_3_06.text:
The one you've been looking for, the one controlling
this dimensional rift. That's me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_4_02.text:
Let's hold on that conversation for a bit.
My host is waiting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_5_03.text:
You... what are you after?
What are you doing this for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_01.text: I just wanted to read a page of this book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_02.text: Eh? Book? All you have to do for that is ask...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_03.text:
... The book he wants to read, the #Book of Hasla# is
not just any book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_04.text:
It is the ultimate book that has all of this world's past and future
written directly in it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_05.text: Th-that kind of book exists? Who wrote that book?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_6_06.text: I wrote it. Well, I will be writing it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_01.text:
I'm the librarian that records everything about Hasla.
The context of time is irrelevant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_02.text:
That book is to be written in the future,
and it exists within this library.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_03.text:
But... it existing, and reading it 'now' is a completely
different issue.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_04.text:
Because then it will be confirmed that someone will read
what is written in the Book of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_05.text:
For you who came here from another world,
No, to anyone - no one has the right to that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_06.text:
I know that.
That's why I'm here to force it to be seen by me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GG4_STAGE5_01_7_07.text:
If you have a problem with that, try and stop me.
Guardian of this world, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_001.text: I do not see any Goblins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_002.text:
Huh.
Can it be that Longears was wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_003.text:
What? This is the only path!
You know this as well as I do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_1_004.text:
You aren't wrong.
There are definitely traces of Goblin here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_2_002.text: Be careful. It does not seem an ordinary object.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_3_003.text: Everyone, look! There are Goblins beyond this mirror...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_001.text: Fortunately, it seems they can't see us from their side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_002.text:
Wait, Orcbolg.
Look at that Goblin. Isn't that Goblin Lord, the one you spoke of?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_003.text:
Yes.
That is a Goblin Lord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_005.text:
Maybe the Goblins used the mirror somehow
to teleport to that place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_4_009.text: Sigh... I thought you might say that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_001.text: Will we chase after them at once?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_002.text:
No. We don't know our way around the forest,
and we cannot be too sure of our surroundings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_003.text:
And more than anything...
There are too many Goblins right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_004.text:
We are not the Hero
nor are we Platinum Ranks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_5_005.text:
We will not be able to fend off
that many Goblins in the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_7_001.text:
The Goblins of your world indeed sound different from those of Hasla,
for them go commit such atrocities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_7_003.text:
There are good Goblins in our world of Hasla, who live in harmony
with others. You should not be too quick in judging the-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_7_004.text:
Did you see these peaceful Goblins with your own eyes?
I think you are the one who is quick to judge on a mere rumor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_8_001.text:
Haha… I apologize on his behalf. 
He can be a little... strange, sometimes…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_8_003.text:
I understand that the Goblins of your world are dangerous.
I will warn the nearby towns to prepare against any possibility of attack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_INTRO_8_004.text:
Thank you.
We too will prepare the best as we can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_001.text:
Ugh… with this many,
the situation can get tiring very quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_002.text: Milord Goblin Slayer too found it a little overwhelming.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_003.text: I must ask... How did you come all the way here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_1_004.text:
I received a quest to bring you all back.
As an adventurer, I have a responsibility to see all my quests through.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_2_001.text:
Goblin Riders!
Move to the designated location!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_2_002.text:
Don't forget - Wolves will jump to dodge attacks.
Hold until the last moment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_001.text: Good, let's now take care of the rest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_002.text: By the way, Beardcutter is nowhere to be seen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_003.text: Have you already forgotten what he's like?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_4_004.text: Milord Goblin Slayer will have gone to slay more Goblins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_5_001.text: If you have time to chat, come and help us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE2_1_5_002.text:
Hoho, he's right.
Let us quickly defeat these Goblin scum!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_002.text:
I had enough soldiers...
Weapons, Wolves, strategy... Nothing was amiss...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_003.text: How can my plans have failed so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_005.text: But as long as I survive... There will be a next time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_006.text:
I will learn from my mistakes... 
I will do better next time…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_007.text: I will not be outwitted again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_1_009.text:
Fool.
I already know what you are thinking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_1_2_001.text:
You no longer have a home,
and you cannot return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_1_001.text: Hee hee hee... And here you were, so full of yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_1_002.text:
These wounds are nothing. I have suffered the likes of them many times.
But look at yourself at death's door!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_1_003.text:
I will not let you die so easily...
I will make you suffer until you beg for mercy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_2_001.text:
... Hrrmph! You take the fun out of this.
Prey must quiver in fear for their slaughter to be enjoyable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_2_002.text:
I will end you here
and take the first step of my new beginning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_4_002.text:
please protect us, the weak, with the powers
of the earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_5_003.text: I will never... Do anything bad... Ever again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_5_005.text: Forgive me...! Pity me and let me go...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_001.text: Like hell that's going to work…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_002.text:
Lord? How foolish.
You are just a Goblin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_003.text:
Just a filthy... little Goblin.
And as I said before…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_6_004.text: You will die right here, right now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_8_001.text:
Goblin Slayer...!
Your wounds are deep...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_8_003.text:
Please place your gentle hand upon 
this being's wounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_003.text: Please… Please try… to be more careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_004.text:
I'm sorry.
It's because... I trusted you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_005.text:
You…
You really are a helpless person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GOSL_STAGE5_2_9_006.text: But I suppose we can go back now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GRADE_UP_QUEST_0003_2.text:
We need someone with fresh taste!
{PLAYER_NAME}! Do you want to try Promoting a new Hero?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_1_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, excuse me.
There seems to be a letter tucked in your pocket...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_01.text:
Congratulations! You have been chosen to compete in
the 'Glorious Knight Melee' as an honorary member of the 'Steel Knights'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_03.text:
... I can almost see your expression while reading this letter. I apologize
for whacking... I mean, employing some necessary methods of persuasion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_04.text:
B-but! You must admit that you wouldn't have agreed
to participate if I hadn't!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_05.text:
Even if it's only a mock battle, it must be done properly -
with the accurate number of troops in the Empire. Which includes you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_06.text:
Just... play along to my whims this one time, won't you?
And you'll get some good rewards if you win: an emperor's promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_2_07.text:
Then I take it that you are participating.
I will see you soon on the battlefield!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_01.text:
... What did he do this time...
Sigh... I need a holiday...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_02.text:
Oh. Did I say that out loud?
I apologize, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_03.text: It seems... His Majesty... has been up to one of his "good ideas."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_04.text:
I would like to help you return right away, but I fear I too am caught
between a rock and a hard place - the Order needs the subsidies, you see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_05.text:
If it is not too much trouble, could you help our Order
rightfully claim victory in this battle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_3_06.text:
My knights will learn much from fighting together with an honorable
Hero Captain such as yourself, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_4_02.text:
It may be but a mock battle, but I still find it a great honor
to fight by your side, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPA_4_03.text:
I ask for much guidance.
Let us now prepare for battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_1_01.text:
Oh, is that you, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I hadn't been expecting you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_1_02.text: And with such a pretty letter tucked in your pocket...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_1_03.text:
Are you the 'present'
Uncle Alexander mentioned?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_2_01.text:
Congratulations! You have been chosen to compete in
the 'Glorious Knight Melee' as an honorary member of the 'Central Knights'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_01.text:
Uncle can be... unpredictable at times, but he means well.
You must be feeling somewhat bewildered, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_02.text:
I must admit, all the knights were rather taken aback
by Uncle's insistence on this... mock battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_03.text:
... Well, my knights could use some extra training.
Nothing can fool an emperor's eyes, it seems.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_04.text:
As things have come down to this...
I swear on the honor of the Central Order that we will be victorious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_3_05.text:
You will help me, won't you,
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_4_01.text: Huhu, I knew I could trust you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_4_02.text:
It is destined for the Central Order to claim victory -
especially with your help, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPB_4_03.text: Now, shall we begin planning our strategy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_1_02.text:
I-I'm a big fan! Oh, wait. Not now, Gwen...
W-what are you doing here, Captain {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_1_03.text: Oh, and a letter just fell out of your pocket!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_2_01.text:
Congratulations! You have been chosen to compete in
the 'Glorious Knight Melee' as an honorary member of the 'Lion Knights'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_02.text:
I... I understand... His Majesty doesn't trust me,
not yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_03.text:
He thinks that I need your help, {PLAYER_NAME},
in order to fight on equal footing with the other better knights...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_04.text: Ugh... My stomach hurts from all the pressure...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_3_05.text:
I need to do a good job...
If I want to reclaim honor for our Lion Knights...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}... That look in your eyes...
Do you mean to say that you... will trust me, despite everything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_02.text: ... Thank you! And I just learned something from you, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_03.text:
A true knight always tackles her troubles head-on,
no matter how difficult they may seem!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_GROUPC_4_04.text:
I'll do anything to prove my worth
and restore glory to the Lion Knights!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Do you have any questions about the tournament?
You want Knight Tokens? You can have them! But you'll have to find them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_001.text:
Ahem. ... It was my idea to hold this mock tournament.
I thought up of everything - the rules, the restrictions, the rewards...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_002.text:
You've heard already? Hrrmph, you could have shown me some respect
by pretending otherwise. I must say, you wouldn't last too long in court...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_003.text:
Anyway... This contest will help me choose the best Knight Order
of Grancia, and so should be a matter of real pride for my knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_1_004.text:
Winning is a simple matter, however. By the end of the Melee,
whoever holds the most 'Knight Tokens' will be declared victorious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_001.text:
Tokens can be acquired in Scenarios, Dungeons, Raids, 
and the Colosseum - in proportion to the value of the used resources.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_002.text:
Hmm? Why take so much trouble, you ask?
I see that in our friendship you've forgotten that I am an emperor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_003.text:
'Knight Tokens' are symbols of honor and chivalry.
Only knights who overcome strife at their lord's command will earn them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_2_004.text:
While 'chivalry' is something that cannot be easily measured...
The more Tokens a knight has, the better I'll know them to be. Easy, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_001.text:
There are three ways to use 'Knight Tokens.'
The first is to add them to strengthen your own Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_002.text:
But it wouldn't be any fun if that was all, would it? Nothing but tedious,
repetitive work. Therefore, I have prepared a second rule:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_003.text:
You can add 'Knight Tokens' to opponent teams and subtract their score
by that number. Running blindly for first place will make you an easy target.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_004.text:
It doesn't seem too 'knightly,' you say? Not at all. It is quite
the knightly value to be able to eliminate one's rivals and rise to the top.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_3_005.text: I will explain the third and last way of using 'Knight Tokens' next time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_001.text:
Now, for the third and last way of using 'Knight Tokens'! During the Melee,
the three Orders must make me a certain amount of Token 'Offerings.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_002.text:
Come to my 'Castle' to find out how much you have to offer me.
You'll want to check frequently: at the beginning and end of each round.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_003.text:
It does not matter who makes the most Offerings. I will only check the 
total number of offered 'Knight Tokens' to see if it meets the requirement.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_004.text:
Hmm? Rewards for making Offerings? What more could you want
than the honor of serving my Empire? Fine, fine, rewards you will have!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_005.text:
However... If you fail to meet the required number of Tokens, all Orders
will pay for their indolence at the end of that round. I will see to it myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_006.text:
Oh, and while I'll let you know the required number of Offerings, you won't
know how many Tokens each Order has offered until the end of the round.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_4_007.text:
It wouldn't be a proper tournament if the three Orders just... cooperated.
No, not worth watching at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_001.text:
At the end of each round, I will bestow both 'Victory Rewards' and
'Defender's Rewards.' Yes, they will be real rewards: quite the incentive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_002.text:
Round Rewards' are given to all Orders at the end of every round.
The Order that scores first place in each round will receive a better reward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_003.text:
'Defender's Rewards' are, as you can imagine, given to an Order
that succeeds in defending their first place for successive rounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_004.text:
For instance, if your Order is victorious for 3 consecutive rounds,
you will receive a 'Defender's Reward' at the end of Round 3.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_005.text:
But if another Order takes your place in Round 4, your victory in Round 5
will not count towards earning a 'Defender's Reward.' You must start again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_006.text:
You can find out more about each Reward
at the 'Headquarters' of the Order to which you belong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_007.text: Try your best to earn 'Defender's Rewards.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_HELP_5_008.text:
One last thing… only those who get at least 1 Knight Token are rewarded.
 You didn't think I'd reward those who lounge around all day, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_01.text:
Attention! There you are, Captain {PLAYER_NAME}!
I've been looking everywhere for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_02.text:
Ahem. Hear ye! Hear ye!
An imperial order from His Majesty, Emperor Alexander of Grancia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_03.text:
Erm, never mind about the 'hear ye'. His Majesty ordered for this letter
to be read by your eyes and your eyes only.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_1_04.text:
It must be quite important. ...Then I'll be on my way.
Attention!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_01.text:
How are you, {PLAYER_NAME}? It's been some time since you graced
my court with your presence. Have you grown used to life in Impalis?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_02.text:
I write in hopes of gaining your good advice
on a new tournament I will be holding soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_03.text:
It is, of course, to be a confidential matter, and you will come
immediately to my palace after you read this letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_04.text:
Necessity has dictated me to make this letter explode within 30 seconds
of opening... Actually, why don't you just go and save me the trouble

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_2_05.text:
by throwing it away yourself?
I will be waiting, as always, on my throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_01.text:
Welcome to my palace, {PLAYER_NAME}!
It is getting more and more difficult to see your face these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_02.text:
Well... I do suppose the busier you are,
the safer it becomes for the continent of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_04.text:
Is it not... too peaceful these days, in the Empire?
After the war a few years ago, I am finding everything to be a bore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_05.text:
Peace is a much valued asset, of course,
but it does prove rather detrimental to the discipline of my soldiers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_06.text:
And that is not good. What would we do, how would we fight
if another Apostle came invading Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_07.text:
And that is why I have thought up of a remarkable festival
to train my soldiers AND have fun while doing it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_3_08.text: I present to you... The 'Glorious Knight Melee'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_01.text:
Do you not wish to know which Order,
among all the knights of Grancia, is 'the best one'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_02.text:
Glorious duels! Sieges among the most valiant knights in the Empire!
And of course, beautiful uniforms for the Knight Captains!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_03.text:
After a blood-boiling, intense battle, I will decide on the best Knight Order
and bestow them a fortune of rewards!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_04.text:
... Or at least, that was what I'd been planning
before all my ideas were cruelly vetoed by my Knight Captains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_05.text:
The Glorious Knight Melee will only be a mock battle.
Of course, the rewards will be real.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_4_06.text:
Hmm? Why am I telling you all this, you ask?
While you're not even a knight of the Empire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_5_01.text:
...
Sometimes I disapprove of how observant you can be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_01.text: ... The... The Captain is not dead, sire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_02.text:
Of course not. A meager blow like that won't kill off a Hero Captain
who faced countless Apostles and other heinous foes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_03.text: Now, take them away before they wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GREEDWAR_INTRO_6_04.text: And tell the next person waiting outside to come in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_AD_DISCOUNT_KURENAI.text: The smoke in your eyes makes looking at that flyer difficult, nya! As a reward, I'll give a good price for this, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_AD_DISCOUNT_S2_EP1_.text:
Das muss ganz schön anstrengend sein, all diese Bilder und
Texte zu fabrizieren. Nun, das hier bekommst du zum Sonderpreis, maunz!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_KURENAI.text: Greetings, nya! This place is scorching, don't you think, nya? But that means more items are on hot sale, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_S2_EP1_1.text:
Ähem, willkommen – maunz! Mit dieser Kleidung fühle
ich mich wie eine Aristokatze! Ich habe ein paar schicke Dinge hier!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_S2_EP1_2.text:
Willkommen – maunz! Die Spur deiner Abenteuer führt
mich stets zu guten Funden, {PLAYER_NAME}! Hehe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_S2_EP5_1.text:
There's a bunch of stuff I've never seen before!
I can feel great fortune!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DEFAULT_S2_EP5_2.text:
Ahem! What do you say to Popo's new outfit?
You can only get this outfit here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DISCOUNT_KURENAI.text: Jewels, nya?! I'll give you a burning discount, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DISCOUNT_S2_EP1_1.text:
Sind das Juwelen?! Bald bin ich eine echte 
Aristokatze, maunz! Du bekommst Rabatt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_DISCOUNT_S2_EP5_1.text: Jewels!? I like unique stuff, but Jewels are the best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_OUT_KURENAI.text: It's time to leave, nya! See you around, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_OUT_S2_EP1_1.text: Selbst Aristokatzen müssen arbeiten, miau! Nächstes Mal gibt es etwas noch Besseres, maunz!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_OUT_S2_EP1_2.text: Ich muss jetzt weiter nach guter Ware suchen, maunz! Bis später, miaumiau!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_OUT_S2_EP5_1.text:
Popo will look for more interesting items!
See you next time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_OUT_S2_EP5_2.text:
I'll bring lots of interesting items, so
look forward to it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_RESULT_KURENAI.text: Thank you always, {PLAYER_NAME}! You're my best customer through thick and thin, hot and cold, nya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_GYPSI_RESULT_S2_EP1_2.text:
Uahah! Danke für das Gold, miau!
Hier ist dein Kauf, maunz!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HARD_SAINT_0003_0002.text:
Excellent! I had been itching for battle. 
There is something I wish to acquire from the enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HARD_SAINT_0003_0003.text:
You should have fought them enough to know that their armor and shields
are good and sturdy. I could make good use of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HASLAWARS2_EXSHOP.text: Hey, are those Devilish Tokens? Won't you trade them for some junk - erm, I mean treasure I found?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HASLAWARS2_EXSHOPBUY.text: Thank you! I can finally afford something other than bean sprouts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_01.text:
Ugh... My tank's not moving...
Guess she ran out of fuel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_02.text: I can't believe I'm stuck here in the middle of nowhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_03.text:
My soldiers ran off a long time ago, those ingrates... 
What happened to you, Svenja? Why are you so pathetic?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_04.text:
You dedicated your entire life to the empire...
For this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_05.text:
... Ugh... I'm so tired... and hungry.
I can't even remember the last time I ate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_06.text:
Is this the end for me...?
I'm sorry, Mom... Dad... I miss you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_07.text:
Erm, is anyone there?
That's odd, I swear I heard a voice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_08.text:
... Huh? A tank in the middle of the forest?
Let's see now. Huh, nobody seems to be on it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_09.text:
Hmm, I've never seen this particular model before.
Looks new. I could sell off its parts for good money!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_10.text: Okay! I'll go visit Fergus right awa-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_12.text:
Eek! You scared me! Where did you come from?
Why did you crawl out from there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_14.text:
Excuse me~? Can you hear me?
Wait a minute. This uniform...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_16.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Well done on your day's work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_17.text:
I was about to pay you a visit...
It's a good thing you're here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_18.text:
Bridget found a wounded soldier
in Hyro Forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_19.text:
Judging from her uniform, we fear that she may be
a commander of the enemy Neth Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_20.text:
She was found near a tank
of advanced Neth technology...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_21.text:
... which is the reason why I suspect
that she comes with bad intentions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_1_22.text:
I thought I should discuss with you before deciding
what to do. What do you think, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_01.text:
Ouch, my head.
... Where am I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_02.text:
The last thing I remember is running out of oil
and stopping in the forest...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_06.text:
Whew, you surprised me. You know, it's rude to
scream at the person who saved your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_07.text:
W-who are you?!
And tell me where I am!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_08.text:
I'm Bridget,
merchant and shopkeeper of Hero Town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_09.text: Annnnd as fate decreed it, now your guardian angel!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_10.text:
... What?
W-wait. Did you say, 'Hero Town'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_11.text:
THE Hero Town, occupied by {PLAYER_NAME}
and their Heroes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_13.text:
... Oh, no. No, no, no...
I've walked straight into enemy territory...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_14.text:
Hmm? What's the matter?
You've become very pale!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_15.text:
T-thank you for your help. I'll pay you back when
I get the chance, I promise you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_16.text:
I have some urgent business to attend to… I'd be
grateful if you could show me the way out of here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_17.text:
What?!
Where are you going? You can't leave yet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_18.text:
You're still a patient! You need more rest,
and this town is the perfect place for it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_19.text:
?! Take your hands off me!
I have to leave right away -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_21.text:
Lednas?
Oh, and you're here too, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_22.text:
What nice timing!
Our patient's finally awake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_23.text: Fortunately, everyone seems to be alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_25.text: Oh, it seems that you two are already acquainted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_26.text:
Why are you pretending not to know me?
You destroyed my entire tank platoon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_27.text:
Tank platoon… Neth uniform... High-tech tanks…
Everything adds up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_28.text:
... You must be Svenja.
The war criminal of Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_30.text:
Tsk. A wasted opportunity. I could have made so
much money by blackmailing her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_31.text:
I wanted to believe you were acting out of true
altruism this time, Bridget, but I was wrong again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_32.text: As for this patient... Did you not once face {PLAYER_NAME} in the Neth Civil War?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_33.text:
Do you have no recollection of the battle,
{PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_34.text:
… Your expression tells me that you've never
seen her in your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_35.text:
Y-you caused that mess
and you don't remember me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_36.text:
I still have nightmares of you
destroying my troops...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_37.text:
Well, {PLAYER_NAME} did face countless enemies
over the past few years...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_38.text:
It isn't farfetched that they don't remember
the... relatively easier battles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_40.text:
Wait, Svenja! I don't think you're in the position to
be shouting at us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_42.text:
Don't you know how much trouble you caused me?
I had to drag you and your tank all the way to town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_43.text:
... but I also put you in my own bed...
Sacrificed my sleep to take care of you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_45.text:
My time and effort don't come cheaply.
AND your medicine alone cost me one million Gold!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_46.text:
And another five million Gold
for sleeping in MY luxurious, custom-made bed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_48.text: Yes! That's what you owe me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_49.text:
That's not all. if we calculate the massive losses to
my store due to the shortened hours...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_50.text:
W-wait! I still don't understand how or why I owe
you six million Gold...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_51.text:
I'm grateful that you took care of me,
but you're asking for too much...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_52.text:
If I hadn't rescued you, Svenja,
you would have been goblin food by now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_53.text:
Sigh… Although you're a wanted criminal, I wanted
to give you a chance to work at my store.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_54.text:
Shouldn't you be showing more appreciation and
respect towards the person who saved your life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_55.text:
And you're acting so crassly towards the ultimate
VIP of our town, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_56.text:
Do you see how much trouble you have caused me?
Now I have report you to the proper authorities -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_58.text:
I-I wasn't thinking straight!
P-please don't report me...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_59.text:
Huh. Didn't she just admit to planning blackmail
by keeping her hidden from the authorities?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_60.text:
Bridget has a bad habit of trying to make profit out of
any situation. She has no intention of reporting her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_61.text:
However - as for myself, I can't help but be nervous.
Don't forget she's a commander of enemy troops.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_62.text: Is it right to help her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_63.text:
... Of course, with you here, {PLAYER_NAME},
there's no actual reason to worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_64.text:
Y-yeah. I'm not an idiot - I know better than to
face {PLAYER_NAME} twice in battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_66.text:
Then let's head to my shop right away
and start working to pay off your debt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_67.text:
R-right now?
Erm, my body aches all over...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_68.text: So you WANT me to turn you in?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_69.text:
... No, no...
I'll do as you say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_70.text:
Then hurry up and follow me!
There's a lot you have to know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_72.text:
Mm... Let's hope that Bridget
remembers to restrain herself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_2_73.text:
For better or for worse, it looks like the town will
grow even livelier than usual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_01.text:
Good job, Svenja!
We'll have a short break and start again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_02.text:
Oh, I still have a few more shelves I want to clean
up first. I'll join you once I'm finished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_03.text:
Woah... I've been neglecting that part of the storage
for years, and you've almost finished cleaning it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_04.text:
Oh, it was nothing. Everything was in their proper
place; they just needed a little tidying up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_05.text:
And though it's been only a week since you started,
you haven't made a single mistake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_06.text:
I guess this is a piece of cake for an elite of the Neth
Empire who used to command whole armies of tanks?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_08.text: This isn't my first time running a store.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_09.text:
It's been awhile, but I picked up a few skills
that are proving to be helpful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_10.text: Huh? But you're a soldier, Svenja!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_11.text: How come you have experience in shopkeeping?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_12.text: My parents used to own the local grocery store.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_13.text: I was appointed commander during college.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_14.text:
Before that, I would help out at my parents' store
now and then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_15.text:
Most of the time, though,
I only succeeded in making a mess and got scolded.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_16.text:
I see.
Then why did you become a soldier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_17.text:
You could have succeeded your parent's store!
Or started one of your own!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_19.text:
My family used to live in the countryside. All around us
were farms, so our store specialized in farming tools.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_20.text:
After fleeing to the city to escape the war, however,
all our wares became not much more than rubbish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_21.text:
There was a limit to finding new products to sell
or clients to sell them during the war...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_22.text:
One thing led to another, and we had to close down
the store, nearly penniless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_23.text:
Oh... I'm so sorry. That's such a tragic story -
especially for a merchant like me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_24.text:
Oh, no... It's all water under the bridge.
I don't think about it much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_27.text:
There you are, just in time, too!
Today's batch came out great!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_28.text:
I came straight from the oven to -
Huh? Oh, are you the new employee?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_29.text:
Ooh, they do look delicious - even more so than usual!
The smell of fresh bread will draw in more customers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_30.text:
This here is Svenja!
She's helping out with the store for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_31.text:
Svenja, I need to put these on display.
Can you pay Chocolat for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_33.text:
Hello, Svenja! My name's Chocolat.
I run the bakery right next door!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_34.text:
Hello, Chocolat.
... A bakery, you say. So you're a business owner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_35.text:
Oh, I wouldn't claim such a grand title.
I'm just good at baking bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_36.text:
Bridget helps me with the more difficult parts of the
business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_37.text:
My bread is delicious, if I do say so myself.
Won't you try some?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_38.text:
I saved a donut for snack time.
You can have it if you'd like!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_39.text:
Oh? Thank you, but...
I don't have any money on me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_40.text:
That's alright! It's on the house. Anyone who visits
Hero Town should try Chocolat's bread!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_41.text:
So don't worry about the money!
Here, you have to try it while it's still hot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_42.text: Then... I'll take one. Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_44.text:
I've never enjoyed sweet desserts, but this is
exceptional. It melted in my mouth like a cloud...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_45.text:
Hee hee, right? Chocolat's special chocolate donut -
my own special recipe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_46.text:
You made this yourself?
You're exceptionally talented for your age.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_47.text: Hee hee, thank you! There's nothing that makes me happier than seeing someone enjoying my breads!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_48.text:
I'm glad you like it too, Svenja!
I'm thinking of baking apple pie tomorrow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_49.text:
If you're not too busy, please come visit!
I'll serve you a slice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_50.text:
Oh, no. I couldn't possibly...
I don't want to be a burden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_51.text:
You're not a burden! You're right next door, which
means that we're neighbors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_52.text:
And there's nothing more and valuable than the opinions
of the people who try my bread for the first time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_3_53.text:
Then I'll be waiting tomorrow!
Please say hi to Bridget for me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_01.text:
... Sigh...
Even this town is quiet at dawn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_03.text:
Is this our first meeting since my arrival in this town?
Why are you up so late?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_04.text:
Oh. You're very diligent to be patrolling the area
at this time of the night.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_05.text:
Me? I couldn't sleep.
I thought I might take a walk in the moonlight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_06.text:
Oh, you don't have to keep me company...
I can defend myself if I need to, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_07.text:
... Or are you worried that I may run away
if I'm not put under supervision?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_09.text:
I never thought I'd be having a normal conversation
with you, {PLAYER_NAME}. Like ordinary people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_10.text:
Who would've known that the renowned hero of Hasla
would be leading such an ordinary life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_11.text:
You seem so different from 
the monstrous warrior I met on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_12.text:
... In retrospect,
everything was my fault. I have to admit that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_13.text:
Thank you for accepting me into this town,
despite our... strenuous past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_14.text:
Yet I wonder it's okay to buy myself time like this… To
keep running away from the fate that waits for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_15.text:
With a bounty on my head, it's only a matter of time
before these peaceful days come to an end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_16.text:
I'll leave this town one day… But I can't return home.
I've been branded a traitor there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_17.text:
Does a life spent on the run
have any true meaning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_18.text:
... The past few weeks in this town
had me reflecting a lot on my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_19.text:
Bridget, Chocolat...
Everyone was happy with the life they were living.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_20.text:
They were especially proud of their professions...
I think I was even a little envious of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_21.text:
I became a soldier for the money. I had to make a living
after my family circumstances turned for the worse...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_22.text:
I... never lived the life I wanted to live.
... What have I been fighting for...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_23.text:
I've said too much, haven't I?
I meant to thank you, and here I am, making excuses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_24.text:
... What?
I... Well, I didn't mean to sound so awkward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_25.text:
I'm sorry.
I still get nervous in front of you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_26.text:
Well... That's that. Thanks for listening to me, when
I'm sure you're busy enough as it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_27.text:
It's growing late... I should return.
I'll see you tomorrow, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_29.text:
You saw the #traitor# in Hero Town?
But that town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_4_31.text: I will go and judge for myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_01.text:
Ah, {PLAYER_NAME}! There you are.
I bring you good news.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_02.text:
Svenja has succeeded in paying off
Bridget's overcharged -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_03.text: ... erm, I mean, paying off her debts to Bridget.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_04.text:
They will be holding a farewell party this evening before
her departure. They insisted on your attendance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_05.text:
Oh, you'll be attending?
That is good news.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_06.text: Svenja will be happy as we-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_09.text:
G-Greetings. I'm Lyudmilla,
a soldier of Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_10.text:
I'm already acquainted with {PLAYER_NAME}.
They helped me out a great deal some time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_100.text:
I-I don't know where to start… I learned a lot over the
past month I spent here in Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_101.text:
At first, I thought you'd turn me in right away. And yet -
you kept my secret and you were also kind to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_102.text:
... I knew that I didn't deserve your kindness,
but I couldn't help but be happy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_103.text: I wished for this peace to last forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_104.text:
I'd be lying if I said I'm in a hurry to leave...
Now, I wish to stay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_105.text: That's why I want to ask you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_106.text:
... if you could give me a chance to join {PLAYER_NAME}
and become a Hero of Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_108.text:
... All my life,
I let others decide my life for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_109.text:
I did as I was ordered without thinking for myself,
and so caused tragedy wherever I went.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_11.text:
So you've already met {PLAYER_NAME}.
What brings you to Hero Town?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_110.text:
I don't know whether I can use a grand word
like 'atone' for this, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_111.text:
I wish to use my strength to fight by {PLAYER_NAME}'s side -
for all of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_112.text:
If you allow me, that is.
Will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_115.text:
I... I should have known better.
Well, that's alright... I was being too hopeful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_116.text:
Huhu,  thought you were proposing with that big
speech of yours!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_118.text:
Aren't you trying to say that you want to stay with us,
because you like being with us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_119.text:
You don't have to keep making excuses for yourself!
Isn't that right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_12.text:
Oh, I only came to say hello.
I'm not the one who has official business here today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_120.text: I-I... But I really meant it - !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_121.text:
If you were to stay in Hero Town, Svenja...
Your assistance would help us greatly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_125.text:
Yay! Time to change the farewell party
to a welcome-to-Hero-Town party!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_126.text:
Hooray! Everyone was sad that you were going, Svenja.
I'm so happy you'll be staying! Hee hee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_127.text:
From now on,
you're a true Hero of Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_128.text: Here's to new neighbors and friends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_129.text:
Welcome to Hero Town - for good this time,
Svenja.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_13.text:
That would be me.
Call me Miel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_130.text:
Be prepared of heart, however.
A Hero's work is not easy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_131.text: ... Thank you! I promise to do my best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_132.text: Oh, loosen up! You're not in the army anymore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_133.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME}, wait and see.
I'll bring you victory after victory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_134.text: I promise that you won't regret your decision.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_14.text:
I'm an officer of the Department of Supervision, under
Neth Command. I've come here to check something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_15.text: Let me get straight to the point.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_16.text:
We received a report that a wanted criminal
was seen in Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_18.text:
The name's Svenja. Female...
Around the same age as me. Brown hair.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_20.text:
I... I...
I do not think I have seen her anywhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_22.text:
No other young Neth soldier has ever visited
this town since -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_23.text:
... Neth soldier? I don't think I ever mentioned the
criminal being a Neth soldier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_25.text:
Lednas, I'm sorry, but you're blocking the door,
and our customer seems to -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_27.text:
... So the reports were true.
You've run a long way, Svenja.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_29.text:
W-what are you doing here?
Eek -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_31.text:
She's a wanted criminal who has committed heinous
crimes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_32.text:
I don't know why you're letting her hide
in Hero Town, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_33.text: You must hand her over now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_34.text:
... M-Miel.
Please, just give me a moment to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_36.text:
I-I know I've done a terrible thing to you.
But I learned so much ever since I came here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_37.text: Won't you hear me out for a minute?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_38.text:
Ha!
I never knew you could be so polite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_39.text:
Did all those bounty hunters scare you into submission?
Frightening, isn't it, to be hunted for your life?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_40.text:
I should know.
How does it feel to be on the other side of things?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_42.text:
Svenja, what's keeping you -
Hmm? What's going on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_43.text:
Is there a problem?
Everyone looks so serious...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_44.text:
I-it's nothing.
Please go inside, both of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_47.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas...
Is it okay with you if I talk to her in private?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_49.text:
Don't worry.
I don't intend to drag her away without you knowing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_50.text:
I'm only agreeing to listen to what she has to say
because of the villagers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_51.text:
And if she'd been by your side all this time,
{PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_52.text: She really may have learned something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_54.text:
... Then we will leave you two here.
Take all the time you need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_55.text:
... A leopard doesn't change its spots so easily.
In this case, a heartless dog of the industries...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_56.text:
... hiding her crimes and pretending to be a good, ordinary
person. I didn't know you were such a good actor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_57.text:
... The people of this town helped me to change for 
the better. I was confused at first...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_58.text:
But when I saw how everyone here were living their lives
to the fullest, I realized I've been wasting my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_59.text:
I was always in a rush to prove myself to others -
but never stopped to think or decide for myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_60.text:
I've turned over a new leaf. It's a new chapter of
my life. I... know I'm asking a lot of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_61.text: Won't you... give me one last chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_62.text: Why should I? I don't owe you anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_65.text:
I may not know her exact circumstances…
But I don’t think she’s feigning her repentance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_66.text:
… I too hurt many innocent people in the past,
under the order of the Neth industries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_67.text:
Every day was a struggle for survival… That's how I
justified hunting down wizards from other countries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_68.text:
Then I met a special someone...
And he helped me face the demons of my past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_69.text:
I'm the person I am today because I had the
opportunity to reflect on my past crimes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_70.text: ... Maybe Svenja found that opportunity in this town, Miel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_71.text: Are you trying to persuade me to spare her, Lyudmilla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_72.text:
... You know how it is. How difficult it is for the poor
and needy to survive in the Neth Empire...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_73.text: ... Although that can't absolve one of one's sins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_74.text:
Sigh… Fine, fine. I'll let you go this time and this
time only.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_75.text:
Truth to be told, your sudden change of heart
interests me, a little.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_78.text:
I'm only curious about whether you can really change.
And moreover...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_79.text:
I can't stand seeing your stupid face longing to stay in
this town. I won't fight you in this pathetic state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_82.text:
You were always too smart for your own good, Miel.
That's why I never liked you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_83.text:
Yeah, yeah.
I won't be so gracious next time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_84.text:
I hope you'll be in a state to fight back
when I see you again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_85.text:
Now then.
Say goodbye to {PLAYER_NAME} for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_86.text:
... Fine.
I won't let you down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_87.text: Excuse me~ Are you guys done?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_88.text:
Is everything okay, Svenja?
The other girl seemed pretty mad...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_89.text:
I know! What's this all about, anyway?
And just the day before your departure, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_90.text: Maybe I should have let you leave one day sooner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_92.text:
Yes, for now.
I'm not completely forgiven, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_93.text:
You are still here, and that is what matters.
... I feared the worst, for a moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_94.text:
Yes, at least we can still hold the farewell party
without any more problems!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_95.text:
I didn't want to say goodbye
in a situation like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_96.text:
Yeah! I prepared lots of pies and donuts for everyone.
{PLAYER_NAME} said they could come as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_HU_34_5_98.text:
... Truth to be told, I have something to tell all of you,
including {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_HU_34_1.text: ... Sigh... How have things come down to this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_HU_34_2.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}... Meeting you was the last thing
I wanted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_HU_34_3.text:
Welcome to Bridget's Shop. Bridget is out an errand,
so I'll be helping you today. What do you need?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_HU_34_4.text:
... Ah, {PLAYER_NAME}.
What brings you at so late an hour?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_HU_34_5.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, thank you for hearing me out the
other day. I guess... this is goodbye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_34_2.text:
Wow... What a beautiful garden!
I wonder who has been taking such good care of it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_34_3.text:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER_NAME}...!
What brings you here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_34_4.text: Hee hee, welcome, {PLAYER_NAME}! I've been waiting for you to come!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WA_34_5.text:
Eek, {PLAYER_NAME}! Erm...
Is this a bad time? I'm sorry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WI_34_1.text: This place must be... the 'first' Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WI_34_3.text:
Those idiots seem to be present everywhere... And
everywhen. I see this universe was no exception.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_LOVE_WI_34_4.text: ... It might not be so bad, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_02.text:
Haha... Erm, I'm sorry for not remembering sooner.
I'm not so good with names.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_03.text:
What business brings me here, you ask?
W-well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_04.text:
I didn't want to bother you, but...
Do you remember...? All that trouble with Bo, Sweet Pea, and Beanie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_05.text:
You're right. I got into big trouble, 
and I don't think Lord Gordian His Devilship has forgiven me yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_06.text:
I tried to apologize again and make up for my mistake,
but he seems to have disappeared somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_07.text: ... So, as you can see, I'm out of work again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_08.text:
I have nowhere else to go, and Princess Vivian told me
I should wait here while she goes to have a talk with His Devilship...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_09.text:
She assured that you'd understand my situation, {PLAYER_NAME},
and find me a temporary place to stay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_10.text:
Lednas was very nice the whole time I've been here: she gave me
a whole room to myself, with the prettiest view of the flower beds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_11.text:
... Oh! But that's not important!
I - I'll find work again and be gone before you know it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_12.text:
I won't get into any trouble, and I'll be so quiet
that you'll forget I'm even here! I promise...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_1_13.text:
I-I'm sorry for all the trouble I'm causing you, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Please be patient with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_01.text:
I haven't felt this relaxed for a long time.
... I hope I don't get into trouble for trespassing, though...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_03.text:
Well, as nobody seems to be around,
maybe I can take one more look before l leave...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_06.text:
D-did you hear everything?
... Judging by that look on your face, I-I guess you did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_07.text:
Please don't tell the gardener that I was here!
I don't want to be a bother.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_08.text:
... Flowers? Yes, I love them!
Didn't you know? I used to be a florist some time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_09.text:
I love gardening.
It reminds me of the old days...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_10.text:
And it makes me feel at home - 
like I can finally be myself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_11.text: ... Why I've given it up, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_12.text: Erm... Business was bad, and I was forced to close it down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_13.text:
I thought everyone liked flowers.
I'd dreamt of opening a shop that would bring happiness to everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_14.text:
But no one visited, not even once...
They all steered clear of my shop with a frightened look on their faces.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_15.text:
N-no, flowers were perfectly fine!
T-the real problem had to do with the rumors of my past, I guess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_16.text:
All I'd wanted to do was to open a small florist...
I realized too late that a bad reputation can swallow up your true self.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_17.text: Eventually, I went bankrupt and had to close down my flower shop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_18.text:
Afterwards...
I found part-time work as a cashier at D-Mart, but that was about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_20.text:
... This beautiful flower bed brings back many fond memories.
I'm happy to have seen it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_21.text:
... Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}. Will you come and see, too?
This rose here is just about to bloom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_22.text:
The leaves are shaped differently from the other roses,
and the flower bud is notably larger, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_23.text: As far as I know, it's probably not of the local variety.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_24.text:
I can't wait to see what color it will be in full bloom!
I even gave it a name: Rosie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_25.text:
... D-don't look at me like that! Rosie won't grow out of control
like Beanie, Sweet Pea, and Bo! Come back!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_26.text:
Pant, pant... I'm sorry, {PLAYER_NAME}...
I wasted your time again, didn't I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_2_27.text:
I-I'm doing my best to find work!
I wouldn't dream of staying here any longer, so don't worry! I promise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_01.text: It's such a beautiful day - even the flowers seem to be smiling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_02.text:
Have you come to stroll in the garden as well?
Oh, Rosie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_03.text:
The gardener and I are doing our best to look after it.
I'm sure it will bloom soon, under our care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_04.text:
Oh? You were curious about something?
Oh... The rumors I mentioned during our last meeting?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_05.text: I-it's not that important a story, but... if you insist...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_06.text:
As you well know... I have something of a reputation - 
as "Bloody Rose Jack," one of the infamous Elite Four.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_07.text:
The war has been over for some time,
but people are still afraid of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_08.text:
B-but I'm not a bad person, I promise!
I'm nothing like the monster in the rumors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_09.text:
I was simply a normal Dry- I mean, D-Devil.
I was a normal Devil living quietly by herself in the woods...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_10.text:
Well, not exactly by myself.
I had my beloved plants and flowers with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_11.text: Everything changed after I met Lord Gordian, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_12.text:
We didn't exactly meet on good terms.
It was chaotic times on Hell Island...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_13.text:
... and I had to defend myself from unfriendly intruders
whose only intention was to scavenge for valuable plants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_14.text:
Some of them turned out to be Lord Gordian's own soldiers,
a fact I hadn't known at the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_15.text:
Still... We came to an understanding
after fighting out our differences.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_16.text: W-who won? I lost, of course.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_17.text:
Lord Gordian was kind enough to offer me a job fighting for Hell Island.
He said I would be of great help, so I became his soldier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_18.text:
But I was very shy...
as well as self-conscious of my differences.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_19.text:
Lord Gordian presented me with a full suit of armor so that
I could interact more freely with my comrades. I wore it all the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_20.text:
I-I guess others didn't think so highly of my armor, however...
A lot of people seemed to have been intimidated by it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_21.text:
They started calling me 'Bloody Rose Jack'...
Saying that my whip could slice down to the bone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_22.text:
That I drank the blood of my fallen enemies,
leaving behind only a dried-up carcass...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_23.text:
Isn't it horrible? I hated the rumors. I did everything I could to stop them,
but even after the war... people continued to talk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_24.text:
Who'd believe someone so terrible as 'Bloody Rose Jack'
could be a florist? ... No one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_25.text:
... I don't regret anything, though!
It was only through meeting Lord Gordian...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_26.text: ... that I first learned how to live together with other people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_27.text: ... I'm all alone now, though. Just like before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_HEROPASS_WA_34_3_28.text:
