... For all of my people have crossed over to the noble halls
of King Snorri and the old heroes, long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0001.text: For many generations, we, the Tribe of the Winter Wind...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0002.text:
had been protecting the Sanctuary. 
Centuries it had been, with the legend of old guiding us:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0003.text:
'...The Guardian of Utgard fell,
and the Great Storm consumed the city.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0004.text:
'Yet came down the Goddess of Light and sealed the
Being of Ice and Snow within these Sacred Grounds,'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_11_0005.text:
'...bestowing the Winter Wind divine power and four
Guardians to guard the Being and prevent tragedy to come.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0001.text:
Hundreds of years have passed since then.
No descendant of my people remains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0002.text:
Yet a 'jester' has appeared after all these years,
seeking to break the Seal of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0003.text: I do not know his reasons for doing so, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0004.text:
Should the Seal of the Sanctuary break, the Eldest
Wind shall breathe death over these lands once more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0005.text:
The Goddess tells me that only thou, {PLAYER_NAME},
can protect the Sanctuary and save Nosgard from ruin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_12_0006.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I beg of thee:
lend me thy arms and together, let us defeat the jester.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_13_0001.text:
I understand your surprise, {PLAYER_NAME}.
But this is no ordinary clown in our midst.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_13_0002.text: I too thought it a trivial task, at first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_13_0003.text:
So I rushed into battle,
seeking to defeat the villain quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_13_0004.text: Yet I was reminded of my past battle with Nemesis:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_13_0005.text:
No matter how hard I tried, 
all my blows landed only on thin air.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_14_0001.text: ...I had no choice but to flee for my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_14_0002.text:
Only after meeting these friends
did I realize the gravity of the situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_14_0003.text:
I sent you letters requesting your aid, {PLAYER_NAME},
thinking that you would be strong enough to defeat this evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_14_0004.text:
... but you did not come,
and I had no choice but to bring you back myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0001.text:
After your departure, Goddess Dionne,
I fear the Sanctuary has fallen into further danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0002.text:
It seems one of the Guardians
has been tricked into siding with the jester.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0003.text:
Loki now has one of the four Fragments
of the Key to the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0004.text: Guardians? Do you mean the ones trapped in ice?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0005.text:
Yes. Guarding the Sanctuary should be a noble duty
undertaken by the strongest warriors of our people, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0006.text:
When I awoke, I found the last of my warriors dead,
killed by the thieves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0007.text:
Those thieves became the new knights against their will,
cursed by my people with the burden of Guardianship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_15_0008.text:
... The jester must have revoked the power of the Seal
by using the thieves' hatred for their punishment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_16_0001.text: We helped the other three Guardians escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_16_0002.text:
But their curse is keeping them
from leaving the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_16_0003.text:
I helped them hide in a safe place for the time being,
but I'm not sure how long they'll be able to hold up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_17_0001.text:
A Being that has been sealed 
for hundreds of years...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_17_0002.text:
This would be before our time,
the Daughters of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_17_0003.text:
Perhaps... It is an Apostle
that came to these lands before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_17_0004.text:
We can't let it roam free.
{PLAYER_NAME}, let us hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_18_0001.text:
HAW HAW! Scurrying here and there like a mouse…
Don't worry, I'm not gonna eat you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_18_0002.text:
Curses, that clown...
Vernil, Roskva. Are you alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_18_0003.text:
Y-yes, Heim.
Roskva saved my life back there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_18_0004.text:
Hee hee, don't mention it!
But I really would appreciate an explanation at this point.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_18_0005.text:
What's with that clown?
And what are those lumps that have suddenly appeared?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_18_0006.text:
... I' can't say for sure, but... 
Doesn't that laughter sound familiar, somehow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_19_0001.text:
Now, we've wasted enough time as it is!
Won't you be a dear and hand them over to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_19_0002.text: Your fragments for the Key to the Seal!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_19_0003.text:
Hand them over, and I promise to let you go with
every hair on your little heads intact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_19_0004.text:
As if we could trust the monster
who tried to kill us as soon as we woke up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_19_0005.text:
Always full of doubt, Master Heim is!
Forget the past - look to the future!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_19_0006.text:
We may have started on the wrong foot,
but can we not become the best of friends?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_1_0001.text: Is that so... Another fruitless attempt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_1_0002.text: Where could they have gone, the Kalard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_20_0002.text:
Hee hee! Yes, Master Heim!
Everything is rubbish, everything is a lie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_20_0003.text:
For many years have I been tricking humans
for my own pure enjoyment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_20_0004.text: Then one day I came to realize:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_20_0005.text:
All the world's a stage,
and life is but a comedy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_20_0006.text:
And as its master I must direct the ending
to the utmost of my abilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_21_0003.text: The Key Fragment of the Seal...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_22_0002.text:
I always thought long monologues
were a wasted opportunity to get some real business done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_22_0003.text:
So this was your plan all along,
you coward...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_22_0004.text:
HAW HAW! Talk on and on,
but words will never hurt me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_22_0005.text:
Finally... Finally the complete Key
is in my hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_22_0006.text:
Excuse me, I have some matters to attend to.
I hope you have a lovely time with my dear boys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0001.text:
Heh, we're back!
And with a strong ally, no less!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0003.text: It seems we returned in time, thank Snorri.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0005.text:
We just lost all our Key Fragments
to that laughing maniac!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0006.text: What? ... So everything is over, just like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0007.text: ... I should have run when I had the chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0008.text: ... We cannot lose hope - not yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0009.text:
The Key is merely the device
that maintains the force of the Seal in its place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0010.text:
Even after using it,
the Seal should hold together for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0011.text:
If we succeed in preventing the jester
before he breaks the Seal completely...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0012.text:
As heir of the Winter Wind, my Glacial Magic
should restore the Seal to its original form.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_23_0013.text:
Then why are you telling us this right now?
We have no time to lose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_24_0002.text:
He will not let us go without a fight,
won't he?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_24_0003.text:
Then we have no other choice
but to pave our way through.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_24_0005.text:
Bjorn is still our friend and companion.
We will try to persuade him out of his madness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_24_0007.text:
My powers as the heir of the Winter Wind
have weakened with the passing of the ages.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_24_0008.text:
Should the Seal grow too weak,
all our efforts will be in vain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_24_0009.text:
Then we must hurry all the more.
Let us go, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_24_0010.text:
They are formidable foes - 
be careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_2_0001.text:
Dionne! You come at a good time.
I'd greatly appreciate your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_2_0002.text: I assume you've completed your training in Nosgard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_3_0001.text:
Dionne?
What is the meaning of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_3_0003.text:
I never imagined you to ignore a friend in need, Chronos - 
and after all the requests for help I sent you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_3_0004.text: You made me come all the way here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_4_0001.text:
Requests for help? 
My scouts reported nothing of the sort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_4_0002.text:
I sent you letter after letter,
and not once did you bother to reply!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_4_0003.text:
I made sure that your scouts
would deliver them to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_4_0004.text:
You know I would not lie, Dionne.
I would not desert you in time of trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_5_0001.text:
... In retrospect... It has been several months
since I received any news from the Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_5_0002.text: Why didn't I notice this earlier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_5_0005.text:
I apologize. I would explain everything,
but I fear there are urgent matters at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_5_0006.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I must ask you to accompany Dionne
back to Nosgard on your own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_5_0007.text:
I... must see to some business.
May the Goddess alight your path.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_6_0001.text:
Some things never change, eh?
Chronos, always busy with 'urgent matters.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_6_0002.text:
Well, I suppose it hardly matters - I had a request
for your Heroes anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_6_0004.text:
Let's catch up with each other on the way.
Follow me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_7_0001.text:
... Is that so?
You have been through much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_7_0002.text:
The Kalard... I can't imagine them doing such things,
after witnessing their cowardice during the Apostles War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_7_0003.text:
I would not be Dionne, Goddess of the North, if I abandoned
you in such times. I too shall join you after this task.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_7_0004.text:
Hmm, this should be the place where we promised to
meet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0001.text: Huh? What brings us to such ruins, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0002.text: Haha, I forgot to tell you, didn't I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0003.text:
While you journeyed through Trista and the Desert,
I too searched the northern lands of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0004.text:
The remaining consciousness of Nemesis within my soul
reacted to something here, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0005.text:
Such is how I arrived here - the old capital of Nosgard,
the Sacred Grounds of 'Elder Edda.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0006.text:
Hundreds of years ago, an Ancient Being who ravaged
Nosgard with snow was sealed here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0007.text:
... I myself was not witness to such a grand battle.
There were others who told me, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0008.text: I asked them to watch over the Sanctuary in my absence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_8_0009.text: They should be arriving any minute now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0001.text:
Goddess Dionne!
I've been worried sick!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0002.text:
I thought you'd got into trouble on the way back!
Huh? Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0003.text: Hmm, it seems you two are already acquainted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0004.text:
Haha, {PLAYER_NAME} once gave me a helping hand.
Isn't that right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0005.text:
I never imagined you were the Hero Captain
Goddess Dionne told us she would bring back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0006.text:
I hadn't known you were so famous, you know.
Say, how about an autogra--

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0007.text: Oops, I guess this isn't really the time, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_1_9_0008.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, meet Lakias.
It's your first time meeting her, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_1_0001.text:
Bjorn...
Why did you betray us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_1_0002.text: What did that clown offer you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_2_0002.text:
I should be the one asking you:
why are you helping them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_2_0003.text:
Do you forget that we were all forced into becoming
Guardians? Only that binds us to this accursed place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_2_0004.text:
Forced or not, that clown is the bad guy here!
We have to stop him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_2_0005.text:
He's going to kill us all!
Not just us, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_2_0006.text:
Perhaps that is for the best. Dying...
As my daughter did long ago, cursing her lost father!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_3_0001.text: My daughter... fell ill to the sickness of 'Cold Dream.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_3_0002.text:
She lay waiting for me, drifting through deathly dreams...
Until one day, she would have failed to wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_3_0003.text:
I would not know. This curse kept me from returning...
I failed to stay by my daughter's side as she died alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_3_0004.text: What have I done to deserve such a fate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_4_0001.text:
You are like me, all of you.
Our lives burnt to ashes by a curse we did not deserve...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_4_0002.text:
What will change if we do protect the Sanctuary,
as our curse demands of us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_4_0003.text:
We shall only continue to protect these dead lands
for all eternity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_4_0004.text:
A slave to the Goddess,
unable to live or die!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_4_0005.text:
As long as the Seal of the Sanctuary exists,
we can never be free!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_4_0006.text:
I seek only to be freed as soon as I can
and return to my daughter's side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_4_0007.text:
Heim... It is not too late.
Will you not join me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_5_0002.text:
I may have been tricked into this position...
But it was my own greed that led me to my fate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_5_0003.text:
I must keep on resisting to the end.
That is my duty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_5_0004.text:
Yeah, that's right! A true warrior of Nosgard
ends what she's started!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_5_0005.text:
Do you truly wish for us to all die together,
when you speak of freedom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_5_0006.text: I don't like that at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_6_0001.text: If such is your will... Then so be it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_2_6_0002.text:
For your own sake,
I shall free you from your shackles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_10_0001.text:
I am the wind sealed into slavery,
the master of the icy mountains buried under lies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_10_0002.text:
The specter without a body,
tricked into death without death by the sly and vile Cora!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_10_0003.text:
Today I shall recover my body
from under this accursed Seal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_11_0001.text:
Dogs of the lying Goddess!
Cower in fear, for I am Utgard-Loki!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_11_0002.text:
You shall curse the name of Cora
as you lay dying in the snow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_12_0001.text:
I'd thought he was too creepy
to be an ordinary human!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_12_0004.text:
That being seems to be 
a manifest form of the one within the Seal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_12_0005.text:
... I fear it is only a small part
of the immense evil that has awoken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_12_0006.text:
This power...
And to think he hasn't even recovered his physical form!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_12_0007.text:
Even the strength of all my Sisters combined
shall seem paltry in comparison to this... this force.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_13_0001.text: ... Only death shall greet us in idleness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_13_0002.text:
We must warn all of Nosgard
of this danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_13_0003.text:
I shall keep the evil at bay.
Thou must escape to warn the people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_14_0001.text:
No, you must escape.
Protecting the Seal is a job for us Guardians.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_14_0002.text:
And after all...
The three of us have some business with that clown.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_14_0004.text:
We can't leave the confines of the Sanctuary anyway.
Haha - for Nosgard!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_14_0005.text: If I'd known things would end like this....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_14_0006.text:
I wish I'd confessed my feelings to Heim
when I had the chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_15_0001.text:
It is you... It is always you humans, forever hindering me... 
Forever fighting for your lives only to be cut down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_15_0002.text:
Do you truly think you can defeat me
with powers wasted away by time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_16_0003.text:
My powers of the Winter Wind...
have been inherited by thee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_16_0004.text:
And yet so it has been all along! I see now why
the iceberg that enslaved me only melted upon thy arrival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_16_0006.text:
Thou art the last of my people,
the sole descendant of the Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_17_0001.text: B-but... What do I do with these powers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_17_0004.text: I shall guide thee as my heir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_18_0002.text:
It is power that should have been rightfully inherited
by the Guardians of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_18_0003.text: It lay dormant only due to Loki's interference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_18_0004.text:
I'd thought the old Guardians
were rather weak that time we fought, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_18_0005.text:
I guess we received help
without us realizing it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_18_0006.text:
And so what?
My powers have replenished after centuries' slumber.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_18_0007.text:
No longer shall the Seal of the Sanctuary
bind me to subservience!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_18_0008.text:
I shall crush you all
like the bugs you are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_19_0001.text: Indeed - thy strength is great. Greater than I have feared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_19_0002.text:
And yet in thy covetuousness, thou forget
not only the Guardinas stand in resistance before thee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_1_0002.text:
That's enough, Bjorn!
You must stop this madness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_1_0003.text:
Ugh, as much as Mister Bjorn
is confident in his own skills...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_1_0004.text:
He should know better than to fight solo
against a bunch of people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_1_0005.text:
And yet he wishes to die, in the end...
Why is he waging so fruitless a war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_2_0001.text:
Oh, dear. You are so mean
to my dear boys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_2_0002.text:
I see the dogs of the Goddess
have returned with a worthy ally.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_2_0004.text:
Ha, you remind me of a dear old enemy
whom I keep close to my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_2_0005.text:
Jester Loki. 
You'd do well to remember that the Seal remains intact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_2_0006.text:
You may want to watch your mouth
if you wish to keep your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_3_0001.text:
HAW HAW HAW! WATCH MY MOUTH?
I see, I see! I struck a nerve, didn't I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_3_0002.text:
Oh, my deepest apologies,
O Strong One! Forgive me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_4_0001.text:
N-not... Not yet...
I cannot lose... just yet...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_4_0002.text:
I refuse to be bound
by the chains of the Seal again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_4_0005.text:
Time is a precious thing,
and you bought some of it for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_4_0006.text:
You have waited long for your wish...
And I must express my gratitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_5_0001.text:
Say hello to your daughter for me.
Farewell!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_6_0001.text:
Bjorn!
... You monster, what have you done?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_6_0002.text:
... Halt.
The Seal remains intact, and yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_6_0003.text: T-this power... I have felt it before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_6_0004.text:
Ah, the beloved Chieftain!
It has been some time, wouldn't you say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_6_0005.text:
How did you crawl out of the Sanctuary, hmm?
That's a feat in itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_7_0001.text:
Chieftain? Sanctuary?
You... No, it can't be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_7_0002.text:
Ah, you do not recognize me.
Very well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_8_0001.text:
Perhaps you know THIS FACE?
HAW HAW HAW!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_8_0002.text:
... The Great Oracle! 
Then you were the one who...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_8_0004.text:
Tricking the Tribe of the Winter Wind into infighting...
while abandoning their Chief to oblivious solitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_8_0005.text:
Causing an avalanche
to stop the Inheritance of the Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_9_0001.text:
Wandering the northern lands 
and spreading rumors of a 'treasure' of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_9_0002.text:
Using the idiots who were blinded by their greed
to defeat the previous Guardians.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_9_0003.text:
Swallowing tears of frustration
after finding out the Seal had grown no weaker!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_9_0005.text:
... You're that clown?
How can you still be alive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_9_0006.text:
... No mortal can withstand
the passing of time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_3_9_0007.text: Reveal to me thy true self.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_1_0001.text:
My plans...
The centuries I spent in their making...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_1_0002.text: I cannot fall... to a mere human...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_1_0003.text:
I cannot... I do not wish to return to the Seal...
No, no, no...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_2_0002.text:
... I do not sense the Incarnate's aura
from this man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_2_0003.text: It seems that the Incarnate has been successfully sealed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_3_0001.text: Um, I'm not sure how it works in this era, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_3_0002.text:
Doesn't saying something like that just trigger an event
that makes our enemies come back any minute and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_4_0001.text:
BAH! What did I just say?!
What are we going to do now?!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_5_0002.text:
Loki's being still screams
from within the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_5_0003.text:
And yet... There lies a stronger force,
as if...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_6_0001.text:
... As if the entire Sanctuary
is shaking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_6_0003.text:
Collect the Fragments of the Key
and do what you will with that man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_8_0001.text:
Ugh...! The winds are growing strong.
Is everyone alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_8_0002.text: The Sanctuary must have grown too weak...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_8_0003.text: ... to contain Loki's rage from seeping out from its cracks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_8_0004.text:
... To think, the Great Storm that
pushed the old city of Elder Edda into shadows of time

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_8_0005.text:
was merely a manifestation
of that being's rage...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_9_0001.text:
The whole tundra 
seems to be roaring with his fury.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_9_0003.text:
But first we must explain what we have found out
to the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2WB_4_9_0004.text: Let us return to the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_01_01.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}! It's been a while.
It's been very busy helping Chronos with imperial affairs…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_01_02.text:
How are your wounds now, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I'd never seen you with such heavy injuries before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_01_03.text:
I was really worried, but
I'm relieved seeing you back on your feet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_02_01.text:
Prestina! {PLAYER_NAME}! Here you are!
I'd been looking all over for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_02_03.text:
Lorelei sent {PLAYER_NAME} a letter from the Temple of
Illusions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_02_04.text: Maybe a scary Guardian appeared, just like last time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_02_05.text:
That does sound like a problem.
Let's read the letter and see...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_01.text:
Dear everyone - I hope you all are doing well,
especially after the last series of events.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_02.text:
It was thanks to Ellie and {PLAYER_NAME} that we could
safely enter the Temple of Illusions. Once again, thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_03.text:
The Temple is full of history and wisdom -
I daresay it is the discovery of the century!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_04.text:
I'm certain this will lead us to the secrets of the Kingdom, 
but we’ve encountered a slight problem along the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_05.text:
The entrance to the lower floors will not open,
much like the time we first discovered the Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_06.text:
Now my excavating devices are all mangled,
and the crew is losing hope…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_07.text:
I know it's asking a huge favor, but would it be possible for 
you and Ellie to come back here to the Temple again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_03_08.text:
Actually, can you PLEASE come back? Or maybe even just 
Ellie…? Only if she can make it through the desert alone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_04_01.text:
Miss Lorelei... Sure has a one track mind when it comes to
her research, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_04_02.text:
I want to go!
I'm always glad to help somebody!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_04_03.text:
I'm not so sure, Ellie. Why'd this Temple, which even the 
Goddesses of the Desert didn't know about, react to you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_04_04.text:
If... if something sinister really is slumbering
deep within the Temple...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_04_05.text:
Hee hee, but {PLAYER_NAME} will protect us!
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_05_01.text: Sigh... I suppose I could trust {PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_05_02.text:
But please promise me, both of you.
Please stay safe. I always worry for the two of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_OP_05_03.text:
Okie! Don't worry, Prestina, we'll be back very soon!
Let's go, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_01_02.text:
Hey, Ellie! I see you got my letter! How have you guys
been? Are your injuries healed, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_02_01.text:
Hee hee, it's nice to see you too, Anut!
But where are the others...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_02_02.text:
Oh, they're still at the site.
They only came out for a bit to give me their letter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_02_03.text:
Yeah, the gall to use a GODDESS as a mere messenger…
they sure has guts! Haha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_02_04.text:
Oh, right! Since you came all the way here,
won't you look at the things we've discovered so far?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_02_05.text:
You know, as much as I'm the Goddess of the Desert, I 
never realized I knew so little about the history of this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_02_07.text:
Apparently there was a highly civilized kingdom in the 
Desert right here, one hundred years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_02_08.text:
This is an interpretation of the mural Lorelei discovered in 
the Temple, about the Kingdom and its history.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_03_01.text:
The Desert they ruled, the Three Great Kings of sand and
stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_03_02.text:
With wisdom and strength they paved the barren lands
to build a golden kingdom looked upon with awe and fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_03_03.text:
When the great plague of the Apostles covered the land, 
into the Desert came two Goddesses:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_03_04.text:
Ar'rat, the Goddess of Judgment and Fire. And Elise, the
Goddess of the Desert. To the Kings they said,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_03_05.text:
Bring us an army to defeat the shadows in the dark.
Build us a great temple to honor the Merciful Cora.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_04_01.text:
Huh? I thought you were the Goddess of the Desert, Anut.
Who's Elise?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_04_02.text: I was only a Goddess-in-training at that point, silly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_04_03.text:
Elise was my master and former Goddess of the Desert. 
The two Goddesses trained us, the current Elard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_04_04.text:
But... If they were the ones who asked for the building of
this Temple, how come I never heard about it...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_01.text:
Pant... Pant... Whew... Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You arrived earlier than I expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_02.text:
Hey, you could at least act more surprised.
We came as quickly we could!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_03.text:
Excellent, I can now finally enter the… I mean, I'm so glad
you're here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_04.text:
Monsters have started appearing everywhere inside the
Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_05.text:
We were thankfully near the entrance and barely escaped,
but Osiris and the others are still trapped inside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_06.text:
What? Monsters? We never saw any after we opened
the Temple entrance...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_07.text:
Yes. Scarabs we thought were decorations... Mummies 
inside tombs... Perhaps they reacted to something...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_08.text:
U-um, I don't think that's really important right now!
We should be helping the people trapped inside...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST1_06_09.text:
Yeah! Let's hurry, {PLAYER_NAME}! I'm not a Goddess of 
the Desert if I let these monsters do what they want!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_02.text: Yes, it is a relief the same goes for you, Lorelei.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_03.text:
We were afraid you would get injured.
Most of the monsters swarmed toward the entrance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_04.text: Huh? So you guys were okay this whole time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_05.text:
Yes, fortunately. The monsters seemed to be following 
someone's command. Isis wanted to attack one or two...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_06.text: ... but I thought it wiser to leave them alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_07.text:
We thought we were going to be trapped inside for a few of 
days. Good to see you here so soon, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_09.text:
Yet it is rather strange. I wonder why the monsters ignored
you and attacked only the rest of us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_10.text:
Perhaps it has to do with the fact
that we aren't descendants of the Desert Tribe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_01_11.text:
Then what about me? The Goddess of the Desert got 
attacked. Maybe they were just excited to see the outside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST3_02_01.text:
Huh? Did you just hear that?
Something just made a clicking sound...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_01_01.text:
Finally! This is the entrance to the lower levels of the 
Temple! Now, Ellie. Will you try touching that door?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_03_01.text:
This... is the second mural.
I'm certain it wasn't here before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_04_01.text:
The Three Kings of the Desert promised that they would 
fight the Apostles and build a great temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_04_02.text:
The Tribe of Isis, master of the blade, walked out to the 
dunes to defeat the Sandworm with the Goddess Elise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_04_03.text:
The other two tribes finished the Temple of Illusions, and 
Ar'rat bestowed the Kings with the name they deserved.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_05_01.text:
This somewhat explains the story spread out in the wilder-
ness. I cannot believe that it all started from this Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_05_02.text:
This history was recorded in the Ancient Tomes. Then had 
this place been sealed since the fall of the Kingdom...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_06_02.text:
How come it was never known that the Goddess was the 
one who named the Kings? And what about their deaths...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_07_01.text:
In the name of the Three Kings... We punish and we
destroy... Those who seek the secret of Temple...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_07_02.text:
That lion mask... Could it be... Queen Sekhmet?
Wait a minute. I thought she died a long time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_07_03.text:
Oh wow. She could do wonders for our research...
If only I could communicate with her...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH1_ST6_07_04.text:
Focus! She's clearly not in the mood for talking! 
{PLAYER_NAME}, we're gonna need your help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_01_01.text:
I know we established that this Temple is a strange place,
but fighting your ancestors is where I draw the line.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_01_02.text:
... How can one of the Three Great Kings stand guard as
a mere gatekeeper of this Temple?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_01_03.text:
I must find out what happened here.
Lorelei, we must act with haste.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_01_04.text: Leave it to me. Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_02_01.text: {PLAYER_NAME}... Can I... um, can I tell you something?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_02_02.text:
I... I wanted to tell you this ever since we met Camilla...
I was too scared to tell you then...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_02_03.text:
But... When I met Camilla,
I felt the same thing I did when we met Avenir...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_02_04.text:
I know it sounds strange, but maybe.... Maybe Camilla is a
little like me or Avenir... And this Temple...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_02_05.text:
It feels like it's calling me. Does that sound strange?
I'm scared. I sense something terrible in store for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_02_06.text: But... You're going to protect me, right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_02_07.text: Hee hee. Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}! I trust you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_01.text:
Whoa, what's this? How can a sun be shining under-
ground? Is this even possible?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_02.text:
Hmm... I think it may be some sort of artificial light source,
Goddess Anut.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_03.text: And this place... is, in a way, a gigantic, man-made garden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_04.text:
For it to be preserved this well for all these years.... The
technology of the Desert Kingdom truly was remarkable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_05.text: Yes, our people truly worked wonders with sand and stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_06.text:
Neth had to rely on steamer remains to develop technology, 
Grancia only has land to boast of. WE were different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_07.text:
And look where we are now, in comparison to Neth and
Grancia. Not so well off, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_08.text:
Th...that's because of the sudden fall of the Kingdom...
You know as well as I do, Set!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_03_09.text:
Hmm? I knew the ancient Desert Kingdom collapsed 
suddenly, but didn't some of its civilization still remain after?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_04_01.text:
Um, it did all disappear. All technology of the Desert placed 
under the Three Kings' dominion was strictly confidential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_04_02.text:
When they disappeared, the entire civilization was left to 
crumble into... well, sand, without a leader to guide them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_04_03.text:
Funny, isn't it? Reminds one of the saying, 'don't put all
your eggs in one basket.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_04_04.text: ... Yes. That is how the Desert Kingdom fell to ruin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_04_05.text:
The remaining survivors were left to roam the wilderness,
clutching only a fragment of our brilliant civilization.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_04_06.text:
Ever since my childhood, the disappearance of the Three 
Kings haunted me. Why had we been deserted and suffer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_05_01.text:
Yet with your help we're finally discovering the Temple. We 
are closer to reclaiming the lost glory of the Desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_05_02.text:
Now, if we heed the legends passed down to us, the core of 
energy should be at the center of this place. Let's depart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_05_03.text: Yeah, let's get this over with!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST1_05_04.text: Sigh... I really want to go home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_02_01.text:
Though they were named by the Goddess, desperate for 
her attention, the Three Kings started exploiting their tribes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_02_02.text:
The Temple flourished under their blind command,
while its people fell under the toil forced upon them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_02_03.text:
And they did not stop. They sought the forbidden power to 
create a sentry who'd eternally guard the Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_02_04.text:
It was only after the deaths of many that the Guardian,
powerful beyond any human, was finally born.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_02_05.text:
The Three Kings returned to the Goddess with their 
newborn creation and waited for praise to fall from her lips.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_02_06.text:
Yet the Goddess, enraged at their arrogance,
cursed the people of the Desert to wander for all eternity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_02_07.text:
The Temple of Illusions, now a symbol of sin,
was lain to eternal rest buried under the flowing sands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_03_02.text:
How... How can this be...? The Three Kings... Were the
reason our people fell to ruin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_03_03.text:
This cannot be... Our proud ancestors... Our heritage...
Our history...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_04_01.text: Tch... I guess our civilization fell for a good reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_04_02.text:
Set! Do you really want to be sarcastic right now?
Osiris... It has got to be a misunderstanding!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_04_03.text:
No, it is not a misunderstanding!
It was only right that the Desert Tribe perished!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_05_02.text:
I said, Camilla was right! Humans are so fallible!
I didn't want this power, and neither did Avenir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_05_03.text:
The Desert Kingdom?
It shouldn't have existed in the first place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_06_01.text:
I-I'm sorry, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I... I don't want to be used by humans until I die!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_01.text:
Wow. I did NOT expect that outburst...
Hey, {PLAYER_NAME}. You okay there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_02.text:
This is not the time. Who knows what monsters are out
there? We need to bring her back right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_03.text:
What's to worry? She looks plenty capable of defending
herself. Tch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_04.text:
Don't say things like that!
Sigh, I see what you have to constantly deal with, Isis...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_05.text:
Ellie is right. The fall of the Desert Kingdom... was due to 
the greed of our ancestors, whom we praised in ignorance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_06.text:
So our brilliant history...
was nothing but a mirage in the sand, blown to ashes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_07.text: Osiris. Stop your pouting and get up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_09.text:
Even if you wallow like that, nothing will change.
Get up. We haven't found our ancestors' legacy just yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_10.text:
But you saw, Set! You saw what our ancestors did with their 
technology. The sins they hid from their descendants...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_11.text:
And so what? Are you so weak willed that you think you'll
walk down the same path our ancestors did?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_12.text: I know you. And I know you aren't that weak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_07_13.text:
Yes, Osiris. We have to show the impudent girl
that she was wrong to insult us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_08_01.text:
Yes... We must go on, if only to repent for
the sins of our fathers. We have no time to lose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_08_02.text: Okay! Let's go and bring back Ellie safe and sound!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_09_01.text:
I now understand how the Desert Kingdom fell, but... I 
wonder who knew the entire truth to engrave in the murals?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST3_09_02.text:
And... What could be the nature of this 'forbidden magic'
to create such a powerful Guardian? And Ellie's powers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_01_02.text:
What are you doing here? We were worried sick, you
know! ... Is that a person beside you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_01_03.text: How did they get here before us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_01_04.text: That's no ordinary tomb raider, that's for sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_01_05.text:
Surely, you jest, you filthy intruders.
I have been waiting for you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_02_01.text: Huh? {PLAYER_NAME}, do you know this person?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_02_02.text:
Ah. I had forgotten that
I did not introduce myself back when we first met in Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_02_03.text:
I am Jeraphim of the Kalard,
the true heirs of the Great Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_02_05.text:
Heir? Excuse me? The Daughters of Cora are alive
and kicking right in front of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_02_06.text:
The Daughters of Cora? You mean, you brats?
Such ignorance! Ar'rat truly has done well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_03_03.text:
You are fortunate that I am feeling merciful. Usually I 
would eliminate any intruders the moment I sensed them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_04_01.text:
... but I will make a special exception since this girl
asked for it. Live out your pathetic lives in gratitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_04_02.text: Sacrifice? Wait a second! Ellie, what does she mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_04_03.text:
Anut, thank you for worrying about me...
But I don't want to go back anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_04_04.text:
Don't be stupid! Look at her! She's a total stranger!
What are you doing, following her?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_04_05.text:
I... I know everything now. The true role of the Temple of
Illusions, and my role as well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_04_07.text:
…What are you saying?? How could you believe
something like that?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_04_08.text:
Now, if you will excuse us.
Anubisis, take care of the intruders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_05_01.text: Anubisis? That jackal mask... It can't be...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_05_02.text:
It's the last of the Three Kings. 
Or just the King, since he's the only one left now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_05_03.text: Wait. Then is that being... controlling the Three Kings?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_06_01.text:
S-sacrilege?! She's the fake,
I'M the real Goddess here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH2_ST6_06_02.text:
Argh, {PLAYER_NAME}! Let's quickly end this fight and
follow them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_01_01.text: Ahh! Ugh, cough, cough... I-is this sand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_01_02.text:
We're outside the Temple!
Did Ellie just teleport us here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_02_01.text:
Now is not the time to ask questions!
We must hurry back...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_03_02.text:
That kid... just sacrificed herself to save the continent.
Some guts...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_04_03.text:
I received the news from the excavation crew. I heard
there were monsters, and I was worried about Ellie...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_05_01.text:
Erm... Prestina, uh... Well...
Ellie is... below... there. Under the ruins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_06_04.text:
I must apologize, {PLAYER_NAME}. I should have told you
about them before all of this happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_06_05.text:
The Kalard are the Goddesses who refused to fight in the
Apostles War a hundred years ago, and so were banished.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_06_06.text:
That is how I know it. Yet to call themselves the 'true heirs
of Cora'... It seems I am yet unaware of the entire truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_06_07.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I shall return to Impelis
and request for a search party to find Sylunis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_06_08.text:
If she truly inherited the memories of Elanuma,
she may know something that we do not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ED_06_10.text:
Do not blame yourself, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You did the best you could, under the circumstances.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_01_02.text:
Anyway... {PLAYER_NAME}.
She sounded as if she knew you. Have you met before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_01.text:
You met her in the laboratory of Trista,
where she disappeared with the test subjects...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_02.text:
The Cardinal... Who would have known?
I only knew him as a renowned leader of the Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_03.text: Now I understand why Ellie... began to distrust humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_04.text:
But what is this 'Kalard' she keeps mentioning?
What can she be up to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_05.text:
I do not know, but... The situation at hand seems too
suspicious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_06.text:
How can she be controlling our Three Great Kings as 
slaves to her will? What would she mean call us 'intruders'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_07.text:
Almost as if... the Temple belonged to her.
Ugh, I really do not have a good feeling about this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_08.text:
Well, one thing is certain.
Standing around here won't do anyone any good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_09.text: I can't believe I am saying this, but we need to hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_10.text: Yes! And we need to bring back Ellie, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_02_11.text:
We can't leave her to the clutches of someone THAT 
suspicious! Let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_03_01.text: Ahhh! W-what are these things?! C-can they be... People..?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_03.text:
These beings... have multiple mana flow controllers
embedded in their bodies that continuously extract mana...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_04.text:
They modified their bodies to withstand the procedure. The 
instable levels of mana must have caused the mutations...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_05.text: Must have been painful for them when they were alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_06.text:
Surely they wouldn't have... On human beings...!
Then this place must be the -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_07.text:
Yes... This must be the place where they experimented
with the 'forbidden power.' The 'laboratory.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_08.text:
The immense power of the Guardian... must have been
harvested forcibly from these beings. ...It makes me sick.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_09.text:
It seems that this 'forbidden power' was a procedure to
collect mana from human beings and inject it into another.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_04_10.text:
That winged psycho...
What is she going to do to Ellie, bring her to such a place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_05_04.text:
... They are not. The temporary flow of mana through
their controllers must be moving them against their will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_05_06.text:
There is nothing we can do... But to put them out of their
misery.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST1_05_07.text: I'm sorry! We'll make this quick and painless, I promise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_01_01.text:
This place... Could it be where they stored 
the mana collected through the forbidden experiments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_02_01.text:
Look, there's an inscription engraved here! But, the letters 
almost resemble an animal's scratch mark...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_03_01.text:
The tyranny of the Three Kings was at an end. We, praising 
the mercy of the Goddesses, attempted to rush outside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_03_02.text:
But the doors did not open, and… 
Our bodies began to change, twisting and turning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_03_03.text:
We asked the Goddess for salvation. Yet she only coldly
looked back, resolute in her final judgment...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_03_04.text:
It was only as our humanity began to crumble into oblivion
that we realized the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_03_05.text:
The Goddess... Ar'rat had used the Three Kings for the 
forbidden power and was never going to let us out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_03_06.text:
We shall now become monsters in the dark. This is the
fate and curse of our people, the kingdom in the sand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_03_07.text:
May our descendants hear our call and our tragedy.
May the curse of the Three Kings be lifted one day...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_02.text:
It almost sounded as if... Ar'rat almost used the Desert
Tribe to create the forbidden power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_03.text:
No, I heard the same thing. Do you think this was written
by the survivors of the experiments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_04.text:
According to this inscription,
the Three Kings were tricked.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_05.text:
But... Goddess Anut. Why... How could the Goddess
of Judgment have done so...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_06.text:
No... No! It must be a... a misunderstanding.
Ar'rat wouldn't have done anything like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_07.text:
But... It does explain everything.
All of the questions we had ever since we met Jeraphim...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_08.text:
How is Jeraphim controlling the Temple? Why are the Three 
Kings and the Guardian submitting to her will?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_09.text:
I thought it strange ever since I interpreted the murals. The 
Goddess of Judgment maybe had something else in mind?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_10.text:
B-but Ar'rat stayed as the Goddess of the Volcano to fulfill
her task of protecting the Soulstones for a hundred years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_11.text:
She taught Bella as her apprentice.
If she was a traitor, she wouldn't have done all that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_12.text:
I-I can't believe it. I won't believe it! She may have been
Bella's teacher, but she was kind to all of us. Including me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_13.text:
We don't have enough information to jump to conclusions. It 
might have to do with the true 'role' of the Temple...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_14.text:
We must catch up with Jeraphim
if we want to know the truth behind... everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_15.text:
Yes... I can sense a great flow of mana
from the core of the Temple, deep within.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST3_04_16.text: She should be there. Let us hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_01_01.text:
Foolish mortals... 
I gave you a chance to escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_01_02.text:
Then did you think we would just back up and leave? As if!
Give us back Ellie right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_01_03.text:
Give her back? You are mistaken.
She is following me of her own will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_02_01.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, Anut... Please don't try to stop me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_02_02.text: Jeraphim told me. With this, true peace will come to Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_02_03.text: Peace...? Ellie, this Jeraphim is the bad guy here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_02_04.text: No, I am the good - the light, you little fool.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_02_05.text:
Aren't you the one who led the Desert Kingdom to its 
downfall and persuaded them to use the forbidden power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_02_06.text:
What is the true role of the Temple of Illusions?
What justification do you have for all your evil deeds?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. You know, do you not?
The pure fear that comes with darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_02.text: ... and so easily tarnishes those who come in contact with it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_03.text:
Fighting the Apostles for too long, many Goddesses and 
humans could not bear the weight of the shadows,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_04.text:
and became Apostles themselves. Cora, realizing the war 
would never end, gave us the Kalard a command:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_05.text:
to wait for a time when all Apostles were temporarily 
vanquished and eliminate all darkness in these lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_06.text:
Stop lying! The Daughters of Cora would have known
about this! THEY'RE Her daughters, not you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_07.text:
Ha, the pawns that were so easily thrown away
and swallowed up in the darkness?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_08.text:
It is rather pathetic how they insist 
on calling themselves Her daughters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_03_09.text:
Among you, only Ar'rat realized the truth
and came to obey us, the true heirs of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_04_01.text:
Do you mean... that you ordered this Temple built and
destroyed the Desert Kingdom to carry out this command...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_04_02.text:
So you are descendants. Yes, the forbidden power was
used to create beings that could power the Flame of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_04_03.text:
All things must be sacrificed for the greater good. This is
the true moment of light. Everything has been for this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_01.text: Ugh, what's this? I - I can't move!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_02.text: My arms... and my legs! They won't move...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_03.text: Yes... For you have already been marked by darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_04.text:
This is... the Flame of Cora. It is the essence of Cora's
pure will... The essence of light itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_05.text:
We Kalard shall use its power
to burn away all darkness from the lands of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_06.text:
The Temple shall become our prism;
from it our light shall spread to all corners of the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_07.text:
Demons... tarnished humans and Goddesses... They shall
all burn away to leave only the true good, pure as snow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_08.text:
That means... You mean to kill everyone.
This is nothing more than slaughter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_09.text:
J-Jeraphim! {PLAYER_NAME} and their friends - they 
aren't bad people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_10.text: W-why do they need to disappear?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_11.text:
Little girl... Do you not understand? It must be done to 
create a true world of light. A pure peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_12.text:
For they will one day fall and so bring the darkness that
will once more start the war... It is time to end this cycle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_05_14.text: Dammit, Ellie! It's not too late. RUN!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_06_01.text: Huhu... I must thank you all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_06_02.text:
It was due to your efforts 
that I could advance my plan by a hundred years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_06_03.text: Advance your plan...? What is she talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_06_04.text: Your bringing Ellie here, of course.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_06_05.text:
Who would have known that this little girl was a far supe-
rior source of mana than any of our other test subjects?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_07_01.text:
Oho, you stand...
Befitting a Hero who fought El Thalnos and won.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_07_02.text:
How amusing. I shall grant you the honor of fighting me,
{PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_08_01.text: Impressive. I had made sure you would be unable to move...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_08_02.text:
But as long as the Flame of Cora gives me power,
you can do nothing to defeat me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_09_01.text: {PLAYER_NAME}! Dammit, if only I could do something...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_09_02.text:
The time has come to say farewell, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I applaud your efforts, vain as they were.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_01.text: Ellie, what is the meaning of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_02.text:
I-I'm collecting all the mana from the Temple!
I'm not sure how, but... I did the same thing with Avenir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_03.text: I'm going to make it explode!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_04.text:
Why do you rebel against me? Surely you recognize the
greater good. Stop it at once, or I shall force you to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} isn't bad... {PLAYER_NAME} always
protected me and gave me courage...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_07.text: {PLAYER_NAME} is my favorite person in the whole world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_08.text: And so are Prestina, and Chronos, and everyone else!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_10_09.text: I'm going to protect the people I care about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_11_01.text:
You...! Are you so blind as to stop the grand script of
gods for the destiny of the world itself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_11_02.text:
Have you already forgotten the sins of the human race,
the cruelty you experienced under their hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_11_04.text:
I know there are humans in the world
who are nice and good as {PLAYER_NAME} is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_11_05.text: And there are good Demons and monsters, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_11_06.text: I didn't cooperate to hurt people like them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_11_07.text:
I... I refuse to believe it. One hundred years of careful
planning... Ruined by the weakness of a mere girl?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_11_08.text: I shall not allow it! Stop at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_12_02.text: I might not be smart, but I know what's right and wrong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_12_03.text: I had a really good teacher who taught me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_12_04.text: W-what are you doing? No... STOP!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_12_05.text:
Hee hee... {PLAYER_NAME}, thank you for always
protecting me whenever I got into trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_12_06.text: It's my turn to protect everyone now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_13_01.text:
Please tell Prestina that...
I'm really sorry I couldn't say goodbye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CH3_ST6_13_02.text: Thank you for everything - my… hero!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_01_01.text:
Whew! That was close. I had NOT expected her to revive
too. Then again, she did use her healing in our first fight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_02_02.text:
I think so. The Flame of Cora is completely broken,
so she should be unable to revive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_03_02.text:
I... I had known to expect the worst, but...
To see her remains like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_03_03.text:
It seems... that discovering the truth always comes at a
cost. Too great a cost... for her to sacrifice herself...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_04_01.text:
Yet if it were not for her, all the innocent people of Hasla
would have lost their lives not knowing the reason why.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_04_02.text:
She wished us to live our lives fully... for a world in which
there are no more victims of greed and cruelty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_04_03.text:
... Yes. I'll continue to unveil the truth so that her death is
not in vain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_04_04.text:
That will be the best I can do as the Seeker of Truth,
as the prophecy said! It seems it will come true, in a way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_04_05.text:
That's great to hear! I'll work harder
as the Goddess of the Desert, so watch out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ED_04_06.text: You're going to help too, right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_01.text:
Hello, Goddess Anut, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Did you sleep well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_02.text: We did, but I'm worried about Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_03.text:
She hasn't been resting at all since she heard...
about... well, you know, Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_05.text:
We finally made some progress with the entrance of the
Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_06.text:
The entrance of the Temple collapsed due to the impact
of the explosion, but it is still quite intact within.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_07.text:
We have succeeded in paving a path. If we are careful,
we should be able to investigate without any more danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_08.text:
There are still many things inside the Temple we have not
seen, as we had to act with haste in pursuing our enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_09.text:
Should we succeed in excavating the Kingdom's artifacts,
our people shall be able to reclaim some of our lost history.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_10.text:
I decided to stay to help the Desert Tribe as well.
After all, I have some personal research to finish...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_11.text:
And those who seek to continue history
must have a scribe to record it for them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_12.text:
And... There is a more important task at hand
that we wished to tell you about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_13.text:
We are going back to the depths of the Temple
in hopes of finding Ellie's remains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_14.text:
That is why we wished to ask you for your help,
Goddess Anut, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_01_15.text: After all, we are only alive thanks to Ellie's sacrifice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_02_02.text:
That way, we can all say goodbye...
It'll be better for especially Prestina and you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_02_04.text: Ah, but we do have a problem at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_02_05.text:
We have received reports of monsters reviving. It may be
due to the explosion of mana from the Flame of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_02_06.text:
Isis and Set took care of most of the monsters
that came near the entrance,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_02_07.text:
but it is difficult to know what dangers shall be awaiting us
the deeper we venture into the Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_02_08.text:
Dangers? Hrmph! I'd been waiting for my chance to beat
up some monsters anyway!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_02_09.text: We could go in right this minute! Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_03_01.text:
I do not doubt it. Yet we should make some preparations -
I fear neither Lorelei nor I are as strong as you, .

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_03_02.text:
And I do need to prepare more equipment - more exca-
vation tools would come in handy. So would a new journal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP2_CL_ST1_03_03.text: Yes, let's go and get ready, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_10_01.text: The House of Nobles? What's that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_10_02.text:
Most science companies that monopolize the magical engineering
technology of the Empire are owned by noble families.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_10_03.text:
The House of Nobles is an exclusive conglomerate of wealth
created by the strongest of those families. It is, in short, an oligarchy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_10_04.text:
The Neth Empire has given up most of its power to them,
drunk on the immense wealth and luxury they trade for their influence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_10_05.text:
The interim government is much poorer, and so
has no influence within the Empire compared to the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_10_06.text:
It is to my knowledge that Rapture Science and Road Industry
have even privatized some troops originally belonging to the Neth Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_01.text:
... So you know much about how the Empire really works.
Lyudmilla. You said you once worked for Rapture Science, did you not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_02.text:
It's a relief that Rapture Science seems to think me so powerless.
It's just as I planned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_03.text: As you planned? Then the disintegration of the Army...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_04.text:
I hear you have decided to fight against Rapture Science.
The enemy of one's enemy is a potential ally, as they say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_05.text: Yes. It is all a ruse to trick the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_06.text:
You are right, Lyudmilla.
We cannot confront them just yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_07.text:
If we act rashly,
they will only crush us with their immense power and wealth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_11_08.text:
We must lie in wait
for the opportune moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_02.text: Huhu, that is not the case.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_03.text:
I said, it was my plan to 'look' powerless,
not actually remain inadequate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_04.text:
Three years have passed since the war came to an end
and the interim government was established.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_05.text:
Still run rampant inhumane experiments and obstinacy that defies
a harmonious future... It is time we set everything straight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_06.text:
Among the privatized troops are hiding some of my own soldiers.
They have some access to the plans of the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_07.text:
According to one of their recent reports, suspicious activity has been
spotted in the loading ports of the Rapture Science Second Laboratory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_08.text:
It can be easily inferred that the cargo consists of the 'spoils'
brought back by the troops that were stationed at Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_09.text: The one you call Sasquatch should be there as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_12_10.text:
See? I knew we could find him easily!
As expected of a famous person who's on newspapers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_13_01.text:
Rapture Science Second Laboratory... That's the department
in charge of magical engineering weapon development.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_13_02.text: To have been sent to that place... Sasquatch is in grave danger...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_13_03.text:
Huhuhu... Now's the time for my entrance!
You don't have to worry at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_13_04.text: We've already prepared a way to sneak into the premises!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_13_05.text:
What? No, that can't be... The preparation alone would have taken
months. Have you been preparing in advance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_13_06.text:
Yeah, even I can't believe that.
Only a day's passed since we left Nosgard!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_14_01.text:
Well, yes, since we've been planning
the invasion of Rapture Science for a few months now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_14_02.text:
Why else would Goddess Bella and I
be staying in the Neth Empire...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_14_03.text:
Yes, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Didn't I tell you in my letters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_14_04.text:
I came across Stanya near the Primal Volcano
and we needed to see to some business in the Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_15_01.text:
What? You never received my letters?
I sent a lot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_15_02.text:
I did think it a little strange
that you never sent me a reply, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_15_03.text:
I'd thought there was some misunderstanding!
It was pure coincidence that we all met!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_15_04.text:
If Goddess Bella hadn't gone out to see if you'd arrived every single day
for the last few weeks, we would have missed your arrival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_15_05.text:
I-I didn't go out every single day!
And it was just a walk to get some fresh air!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_01.text:
Someone in Grancia is withholding information
on purpose...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_02.text:
I see it really was a coincidence that {PLAYER_NAME}'s mission
and my plans overlapped, but... something seems very suspicious...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_03.text: We'll need to dig into this matter after you return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_04.text:
Hmm? Return? Are we going somewhere?
To the laboratory? Right this instant?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_05.text:
Yes, to Rapture Science Second Laboratory.
Stanya is already waiting for you there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_06.text:
It's time.
The portal will open soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_07.text:
... I didn't know you could open magical portals so easily
anywhere and everywhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_08.text: Wait, so Neth lost the war even when they had technology like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_09.text:
Oh no, not at all. Magic portals can only be opened at certain destinations,
where the mana of the continent is the most dense.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_16_10.text:
As far as I know, it is impossible for individuals to open portals
on their own, through either magic or science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_17_01.text:
It's a success!
It's a portal to the Rapture Science Second Laboratory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_17_03.text:
This is only possible due to the fact that the technology used in
magical engineering originates from another dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_17_04.text:
Excuse me...
Who is this Stanya you keep mentioning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_17_05.text:
Huh? Oh, yeah. I just remembered you didn't receive any of my letters.
You see, Stanya is -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_18_01.text:
Erm, maybe Stanya could introduce herself when we meet her?
The portal is becoming more unstable by the second!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_18_02.text:
What, already? Hurry, {PLAYER_NAME}! If the portal disappears
while we're still in it, there's no telling where we'll end up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_19_02.text:
Dike...
Lend them your courage and hope.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_02.text:
I'd heard that the whole city was demolished due to the war
three years ago... I guess they were all false rumors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_03.text:
They were not. The consequences of the war were great...
The whole Empire almost came to ruin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_04.text:
It was only with the immense power and wealth
of the science conglomerates that dominate the Neth Empire...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_05.text:
... that the Empire managed to rebuild itself
within such a short period of time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_06.text:
It is the same momentum that developed the Empire far beyond
the level of other countries, in a matter of little more than a century.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_07.text:
The basis of such rapid development
is a special technology of the Empire, called 'magical engineering.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_08.text:
Oh, I think I've heard of it.
Engineering directly integrated with magic, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_09.text:
I don't know the exact mechanism, but I know for sure
that all the Neth-made weapons were are with that technology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_1_10.text:
It gave me a lot of inspiration when tinkering with my babies.
Hee hee, maybe I can get my hands on some parts on the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_20_01.text:
Ugh... That was NOT a good ride.
I feel sick...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_20_02.text:
I-it feels... different from a regular magic portal...
It's worth... the research... Blegh -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_21_01.text:
But where's Stanya? She's not here!
Then who opened the portal for us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_21_02.text:
That's strange. Stanya told me that she would be
opening the portal near her own location...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_22_01.text:
Security alert! Security alert! Invaders in the Main Laboratory!
All guards head to Zone EL-30!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_22_02.text:
Ugh, now we're on the run. Again. Why did we make such a fuss
if we were going to be found out the moment we arrived?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_22_03.text:
B-but Stanya said she could cover up for us
so that we wouldn't be discovered...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_22_04.text:
There seems to have been a mistake!
We have to run for the time being!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_22_05.text:
EL-30... That should be about 20 floors underground.
We arrived much closer to the lab's core than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_22_06.text:
We should proceed onwards
and gather information on Sasquatch's whereabouts on the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_22_07.text:
Okay! Let's hurry before
those security guards catch up to us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_23_01.text:
Ack! W-what is this?
There's a person in the glass case!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_23_02.text:
This... looks like a prototype for a magical engineering weapon!
It doesn't seem to be finished!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_23_03.text:
Yeah, it doesn't have all its limbs...
Maybe we could sneak past it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_24_02.text:
I repeat.
All security forces head to Zone EL-30!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_24_03.text:
Stop the infiltrators with the Battleloid modules
until reinforcements arrive!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_24_04.text:
Battleloids... They should all have been disposed after the war
due to ethical issues.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_24_05.text:
I hadn't known they were being used for test subjects
to develop magical engineering weapons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_24_06.text:
Hrrmph. I may not know too much about Battleloids, but it sounds like
mere trickery used by weaklings as a last resort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_24_07.text:
I, Bella, Goddess of the Volcano,
will teach you a lesson on real strength!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_24_08.text:
Go, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Show them what we are made of!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_01.text:
Haha... It is true that magical engineering is the main source
of the Empire's rapid growth and formidable strength,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_02.text:
but you must know that an ugly truth hides within:
the darker side of the same coin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_03.text:
The payment required for such brilliant innovations
were cruel human experiments executed without mercy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_04.text:
Oh, yeah... I think you mentioned
capturing wizards and using them in experiments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_05.text:
Unlike other territories of Hasla, the Neth Empire shows a surprising
deficiency of mana. Almost no children are born with magical powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_06.text:
It is a great setback for the development of a country,
and in order to bridge the gap with other nations,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_07.text:
the Empire had to resort to the fields of science and technology.
But the great potential of magic is hard to ignore...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_08.text:
Since the birth of the nation, there have been many attempts
to gain greater power by fusing magic with technology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_09.text:
In order to gain mana that cannot be found within the Empire, the science
companies decided to abduct wizards from neighboring countries.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_2_10.text:
Mages throughout the continent are being sacrificed to terrible
experiments, being treated as merely an energy source of mana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_01.text:
Oh, wow. And here I've been thinking that
the Neth Empire was only famous for its weapons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_02.text:
A country dominated by a group of mad scientists.
Okay, now this is going to be fun.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_03.text:
I'm guessing that the ordinary citizens
don't know anything about the truth of their country...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_04.text:
but what about you?
How do you know all this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_05.text:
This doesn't seem like the type of information
that's leaked so easily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_06.text:
... I was once a hunter
working for Rapture Science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_07.text:
At their command, I hunted down my victims...
The mages who were on 'the list.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_09.text:
Yes.
He used to be one of my commissioned targets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_10.text:
... But after he saved my life,
I realized the error of my ways.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_11.text:
I ran... I'm still on the run from the Neth Army
to protect him from their clutches.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_12.text:
And here I've been thinking
Sasquatch was just a kid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_13.text:
I'm not seeing it...
What did he do to charm away his kidnapper like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_3_14.text:
I think I read about this somewhere...
It was called something syndrome...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_01.text:
Sasquatch... may deal with the magical powers of snow and ice,
but his heart is warmer than any other person I have known.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_02.text:
To me, he is...
... Uh... I digress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_03.text:
Anyway... I fear for the worst.
It is no good thing to have been captured by the Neth Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_04.text:
... My sins... I have done much wrong.
Capturing innocent human beings and damning them to a painful doom...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_05.text:
Ignoring the terrible truth when it had been staring me in the face
for too long a time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_06.text:
My past has caught up to me...
My cowardice is the only reason I have lost Sasquatch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_07.text:
A lifetime of repentance will not absolve my sins,
but Sasquatch... He does not deserve this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_08.text:
... Let's go.
We don't have much time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_09.text:
Yes, let's get Sasquatch back
before they add another mechanical arm or something onto him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_10.text:
After all, we have {PLAYER_NAME} with us!
The hero who stopped not only the traitor Odin but also the big, bad wolf!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_4_11.text:
Anyway, how long do we have to wait here? I thought Goddess Dionne
said there would be some backup coming for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_5_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! There you are!
You made me wait!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_5_02.text:
Don't you know that when someone tells you to meet them in Edenberg,
it's common sense that you head straight for the Central Square?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_5_03.text: Who's that noisy girl yelling at us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_5_04.text:
N-noisy girl?
Don't you know who I am, you foolish mortal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_01.text:
