I am Bella, Goddess of the Volcano! You blue peanut, 
NOW do you understand the honor of speaking to me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_02.text:
A Goddess... like Dionne, right?
Hmm, she sure lacks class in comparison...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_04.text:
Raven... She's still a Goddess.
Perhaps you shouldn't voice your thoughts... So loudly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_05.text:
Yeah, yeah. We uncivilized Frost Elves don't know a lot about manners.
But - I - call it the virtue of honesty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}... Your companions have become sub-par
compared to the ones you had a few years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_07.text:
Sigh... I suppose it is a Goddess's virtue
to look over human shortcomings for the greater good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_08.text: The others are waiting in the office.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_09.text:
Since it's been some time that we've seen each other,
{PLAYER_NAME}, I thought it would be nice if I came ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_10.text:
... I-I mean, I thought it would be nice OF ME if I deigned to fetch you 
during my walk. I don't have a lot to do, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_6_11.text:
F-follow me!
Everyone should be waiting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_7_01.text:
Yuria, {PLAYER_NAME}'s here.
And... uninvited others as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_7_03.text:
It's been some time since our last meeting,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_7_05.text:
Hee hee, it feels a little strange
to see you outside town!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_7_06.text:
It's our first adventure together
since the incident with Manacar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_8_01.text:
Gasp! I-I think I've seen that person in the papers!
It's Yuria! The temporary Commander of the Neth Empire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_8_02.text:
Ooh, {PLAYER_NAME}! And weren't you on close terms with King Thor
as well? You really do get around, huh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_8_03.text:
Wait, you're more impressed by meeting Yuria
than coming face-to-face with an actual Goddess? Grr... I can't believe it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_8_04.text:
I'm Raven, and this is Lyudmilla!
We came from Nosgard to save Sasquatch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_8_06.text: Sas... Who? What do you mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_8_07.text:
Huh? Oh, I guess you don't know his name!
Let me explain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_9_01.text:
I see. Such turmoil in Nosgard...
You must be upset.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_9_02.text:
It's all over now, and I only tagged along!
Lyudmilla here's the one who's really upset.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_9_03.text:
But look, Lyudmilla!
Finding Sasquatch is going to be easy peasy now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_9_04.text: THE leading Commander of the Neth Empire is going to help us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_9_05.text:
... No.
I fear things will not go our way so easily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_1_9_06.text:
The Commander and her officers are not so well received
by the House of Nobles. They were never 'officially' recognized.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_10_01.text:
Oh, you were here too. Always the impatient and rude student.
Why will you never show me the respect I deserve, Stanya?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_10_02.text:
Respect? Says the 'teacher'
who stole his best student's greatest work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_10_03.text:
Oh, let bygones be bygones.
This is exactly why you couldn't make much of your talent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_01.text:
Now, my dear infiltrators. I know my beloved student probably
talked about me behind my back, but let me introduce myself properly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_02.text:
I am Doctor Stein,
the greatest mind of Mechatronics.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_03.text:
The reason I came out all the way here...
is to thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_04.text:
Thank us...?
Ohh-kay. He's a mad scientist, all right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_05.text:
So you destroyed two of my Battleloids
on the way here, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_06.text: Kee kee kee... You really put the higher-ups on their toes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_07.text:
The final experiment has finally been authorized... Looks like
the Chief Research Officer can't do anything to stop me now, haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_11_08.text:
Guys, I have a feeling
we shouldn't be listening to his speech right now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_12_02.text:
It's a mere prototype. The hardware may be complete, 
but the proper software hadn't been installed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_12_03.text:
How could ordinary human beings and sub-par wizards
ever fuel my greatest invention?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_12_04.text:
The people here at Rapture Science may be clever,
but they're held back by 'moral quandaries.' Boring!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_12_05.text:
Why would you waste all these good resources just to gather some mana
samples? That's why decades have gone by without a breakthrough!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_12_06.text: Science is all about experimentation, not boring observation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_13_01.text:
Ugh! I knew we shouldn't have let the bad guy
take his evil speech to the end!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_13_02.text: That mana exuding from the body... Is that...?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_13_03.text:
Now presenting: the finished Battleloid,
fueled by the strongest wizard at Rapture Science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_13_04.text:
I haven't had the time to make the final tweaks...
but it should be even more powerful with the lack of restrictions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_13_05.text: Will you be able to stop such a monstrosity? It's a question to be tested.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_13_06.text: Kee kee kee.. Now, on with the experiment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_14_01.text: Stein!! You - you old, stupid, idiot of a geezer! Stop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_14_02.text:
You know, for a mad scientist he's very persuasive.
I should have shot him when I had the chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_15_02.text:
The mage encased in that Battleloid may be a Great Witch
of Pumpkin City, reported to have gone missing years ago!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_15_03.text:
According to the records I read up on her,
we have to be careful of those mushrooms!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_15_04.text:
What Celine said. That Battleloid...
It looks far more dangerous than the ones we faced just now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_15_05.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, be careful!
I'll lend you my powers. Don't you dare lose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_15_06.text: And I'm going to help you, too! Let's fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_15_07.text:
If the robot was built using the system I developed,
I should be able to hack it if you buy me the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_1_01.text:
That was stronger than I expected... Even stronger than most Apostles.
Has human technology really advanced this far?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_1_02.text:
The last war provided the Neth scientists an opportunity to gather
actual results of using dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_1_03.text:
But this... This is far too developed.
even considering the recent advancements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_1_04.text:
Almost as if some more advanced species
has intervened with their technology...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_1_05.text:
I found you at last!
There you all were!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_2_02.text:
Haha... Erm, there seems to have been a slight error in setting the
coordinates... about 20 meters from the place I meant to open it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_2_03.text: At least you didn't teleport within the walls - that would have hurt, haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_2_04.text: ... I could teleport your head between the walls right this minute...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_2_05.text: I can't believe I allowed myself to let this idiot lead me into this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_2_07.text:
Oh, hello there!
You must be the accomplices Yuria told me about, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_3_01.text:
I'm Stanya! A robot engineer of Mechatronics. I guess it isn't 
such a good time for introductions, but it's nice to meet you all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_3_02.text:
You're {PLAYER_NAME}, right?
You seem like a dependable guy, just as I was told.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_3_03.text: Oh. Nope, {PLAYER_NAME}'s the one standing over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_4_01.text:
Oh, really? Hmm... I don't know... Seems a bit of a letdown
considering all the praises Goddess Bella sang...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_4_02.text:
I-I never said anything of the sort!
And what about the facilities? Have you found them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_4_03.text:
Of course!
The labs are ahead of us in this direction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_4_04.text:
That old geezer... It's bad enough that he steals all my work,
but he has to go wreak havoc on another dimension!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_4_05.text:
Another dimension... Work... Geezer?
What are you talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_5_01.text:
Oh, I almost forgot the most important thing about me.
Goddess Bella and Celine already know, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_5_02.text:
I... I'm actually from another dimension!
I know this sounds crazy, but I can explain -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_5_03.text: Oh. Okay. Erm, good for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_5_05.text:
Huh? What's with this anticlimactic reaction?
Does it really surprise nobody that I'm not from this world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_5_06.text:
You aren't the only Otherworldian drifting through Hasla.
Really, it's old news.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_6_01.text:
Oh. Well, at least I won't have to explain much, then. You do know that
magical engineering experiments are being held in this laboratory, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_6_02.text:
The person in charge of those experiments
is my old professor, Doctor Stein.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_6_03.text:
... Ugh, even calling him 'my professor' is embarrassing.
He doesn't deserve his title of doctor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_6_04.text:
He's the one who caused this mess, with my research he stole from me.
I chased him here to Hasla to stop him from causing any more trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_6_05.text:
Doctor Stein...?
That's strange, I've never heard of him, not even once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_6_06.text:
If he really is the head of the magical engineering experiments as you say,
he should be quite important.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_01.text:
Only a few people in this dimension are aware of his identity.
It's not so strange you don't know him - he only arrived relatively recently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_02.text:
At first, even I couldn't detect his presence
and was on my way to another dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_03.text:
It was only after I analyzed the magical engineering weapons
that I realized the truth behind this technology...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_04.text:
Magical engineering derives from my research,
which the old geezer stole and then ran away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_05.text:
For some reason, it's progressed at least
a decade's worth of research... I'm not sure how, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_06.text:
'Steamers' are the name of the robot army
that attacked Ancient Nosgard!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_07.text:
Yes, you remember too, don't you, {PLAYER_NAME}? We fought them 
a few years ago in the Ancient Tundra we reached through a portal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_08.text:
It seems that after we beat Nemesis,
the remaining Steamers were collected by the Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_09.text:
According to my master's records, it was around this time
that the Empire began showing signs of unprecedented progress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_10.text:
I'd thought the sudden development rather strange at the time,
but the intervention of Otherworld technology explains everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_7_11.text:
It goes the other way as well - the old geezer's magical engineering
research was rapidly advanced at the hands of the Neth scientists.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_8_01.text:
Hmm. Everything does sound a little far-fetched,
but I suppose I have no choice but to trust you at this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_8_02.text:
Sigh... Well, so that's it. That's my story.
My mission is to find clues that will lead me to the old geezer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_8_03.text:
It's a happy coincidence that Yuria's also trying to reform the country
by pulling down the House of Nobles once and for all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_8_04.text: It's like catching two bugs with one stone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_8_05.text:
And we rescue Sasquatch from a terrible doom, too!
It's catching THREE birds with one stone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_8_06.text:
Oho, there you all were!
I've been looking all over for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_9_01.text:
Stein...! You damned geezer,
all this time you were hiding in this laboratory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_2_9_02.text:
Wait, so that old man was your teacher...?
Hmm, he really does look the part of a mad scientist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_1_02.text:
The system received enough overload with {PLAYER_NAME}'s attacks.
I succeeded in shutting it down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_1_04.text:
I'm not sure. Taking out the batteries
usually stops the power in most machines.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_1_05.text:
Hmm, but all our attacks didn't succeed in breaking it!
Are you sure you can open it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_2_01.text:
That idiot geezer. He was using the same operating system
I developed when I created Sentinel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_2_02.text:
That's the reason why I could open a portal in the laboratory.
And hack the Battleloid as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_2_03.text:
This... cover here... I think I could open it...
if I put some more pressure on it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_3_02.text:
Oh, no! The mana residue is going to explode!
Stanya, duck!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_4_03.text:
Of course...! That's Master Loviatar,
the first Witch of the Forest who disappeared decades ago!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_4_04.text:
I learned in class that she was declared missing after the witches
lost all trace of her... Now I understand! She'd been caught by Neth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_4_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! Don't stand around just staring!
Go and help her up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_02.text:
I-it's an honor, Master Loviatar!
I'm Celine, the thirty-second graduate class of Pumpkin Magic Academy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_03.text:
And this here is {PLAYER_NAME}!
We've come to rescue wizards abducted by the Neth Empire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_04.text:
The thirty-second...? Mm... I see... Many years have... passed...
since I came... here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_05.text:
I am... the Witch of... the Forest... Loviatar...
I am glad... to meet you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_06.text:
Little Witch...
Do you know... Arita...? Is she... safe...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_07.text:
Do you mean the Second Witch of the Forest?
Of course! She's safe and sound in Pumpkin City!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_08.text:
Huhu... I see...
I am... relieved...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_5_09.text:
Didn't you just say that she's been captured for decades?
She doesn't seem to be in a hurry to go free.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_01.text:
No, no... I am ... happy...
I am just tired... have lost... a lot of... mana...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_02.text:
Master Loviatar, is it your health?
Did the scientists experiment on you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_03.text:
Mm... I do not... know... But I will... at least... not lose... my life...
Ludvico... promised me... in our... contract...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_04.text:
Contract...? Do you mean to say
that you were willingly captured by Rapture Science?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_05.text:
Mm... This is going to be... a long story...
but... I am too... sleepy... for the time being...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_06.text:
You mentioned... another wizard...
you came to... save...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_08.text:
When I... woke up... for a short time... I saw him...
Being prepared to... fuel... quite a few... robots... like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_09.text:
What? Ugh... 'Quite a few,' that means more than one, right?
And even one proved to a lot of trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_6_10.text:
We need to catch that man called Stein
before he activates any more Battleloids.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_01.text: What is it? What's wrong with her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_02.text:
She is... asleep!
She seems to be worn down by a great deficiency of mana!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_03.text:
I've seen her condition before. She's not only asleep,
she's also in a temporary coma-like state due to losing her mana essence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_04.text: She may seem fine, but her state is critical.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_05.text:
What should we do? We have to hurry,
but we also can't leave her here like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_06.text:
I'll stay behind and look after Master Loviatar!
I know how to treat emergency cases like hers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_07.text: I'll join you once it's safer to escape with Master Loviatar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_08.text:
But what if the Neth soldiers find you and you're all alone?
Ugh, I'm not leaving you alone like this. I'm going to stay here with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_3_8_09.text:
Huh, you're not so bad for a blue peanut! 
You two, stay safe and wait for us. We'll return very soon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_10_02.text: I'd never thought I would hear that creepy laugh again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_10_03.text:
That's Nemesis!
Did you revive him?! What did you do!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_11_01.text:
E-erm, no, that's just the body frame without the soul!
It's not supposed to move like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_11_02.text:
Body frame or not, why is it here, of all places?!
It should be buried deep beneath the snow fields of Nosgard!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_11_04.text:
Well, erm... The Neth scientists told me that they'd been using it 
for trivialities ever since they discovered it... So it's not really my fault...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_11_05.text:
And wouldn't it be such a waste NOT to use it?
I mean, it's such a powerful source of dark energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_12_01.text:
I may not be an expert on this matter, but...
Even I can see that that dark energy is the main problem here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_12_02.text:
Ugh, why do you ALWAYS do things without considering the
consequences?! What are we going to do now?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_12_03.text:
Oh, erm... I dunno...
I figured maybe it would listen to my orders...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_12_04.text: Nemesis... I mean, NS000! Destroy them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_12_05.text: You old geezer! Stop trying to sneak in an attack order!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_13_02.text:
H-help! {PLAYER_NAME}, did you say your name was?
What are you doing? Get rid of that monster at once! Quick!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_14_02.text:
Sigh... I guess battle's inevitable.
{PLAYER_NAME}, be careful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_14_03.text:
That... thing... isn't the real Nemesis.
It looks like it's only the shell of his former body...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_14_04.text:
But it's absorbing that freak scientist's robots and their mana
to use attacks I've never seen before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_14_05.text:
Grr, it's nothing more than a defective robot created by an old geezer.
I'll hack it in seconds, so don't you guys worry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_14_06.text:
What? The nerve...!
NS000! Show them what you're made of!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_1_02.text:
I'd set it to power levels equivalent of at least two or three Apostles...
So you really are the Hero who saved Hasla, eh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_1_04.text:
Heh, and me as well as {PLAYER_NAME}!
Why do you never update your firmware?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_1_05.text:
Serves you right for stealing my work and using it
without changing a single chip! Your security is next to nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_1_06.text:
Ugh... You doggedly chasing me to this dimension
was not considered in my calculations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_1_07.text:
I thought it would be okay since the scientists of this dimension
wouldn't understand my technology anyway!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_1_08.text:
What? YOUR technology? It's mine - you STOLE it!
And you thought I wouldn't come after you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_2_01.text:
This is beyond my calculations...
But I suppose it's for the best.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_2_02.text:
It will be a good opportunity to showcase my finished masterpiece
to the officials for a new grant!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_2_03.text: Hrrmph, and you think things will go your way so easily?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_2_04.text:
Battleloids, schmattleloids...
Give us everything you've got. We'll crush them all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_3_01.text: Really? Are you sure? Everything I've got?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_4_01.text: You can't send out THIS many! This is cheating!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_4_02.text:
Hee hee hee... Wasn't it you who said
'everything'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_5_01.text:
Sa... Sasquatch!
Sasquatch is trapped in there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_5_02.text:
Hmm? The wizard you're trying to rescue?
... All I see are some spiky strands of hair...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_5_03.text: I know it! It must be Sasquatch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_5_04.text:
Oh, do you know the test subject?
Kee kee kee... A twist of fate, what a touch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_5_05.text:
Kee kee kee... Dance, invaders! Dance!
Muhahahahahaha!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_6_01.text: I... can tell that this isn't going to be easy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_6_02.text:
No... Sasquatch... We were so close...
It's too late...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_6_03.text:
No, it's not too late!
We have to at least try something before we give up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_7_01.text:
I-it's more durable than I thought.
It dissolved my attack!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_7_02.text:
Kee kee kee... Of course! Surely you didn't think to compare
this beauty to the unfinished versions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_7_03.text:
The completed Battleloid has been designed to confront
a special force that's called by the name of 'Cora's powers.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_7_04.text:
It may look similar to its prototypes,
but it's far more advanced!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_8_01.text:
Now, dance for me, you fools!
It's no fun to end the experiment like this! Give me results!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_9_01.text:
... What was that mechanical sound just now?
... Tell me my hearing's not going bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_9_02.text:
Y-yeah, I heard it too.
Where is that sound coming from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_4_9_03.text:
... I've heard that sound before.
Where was it...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_10_01.text: Uwaa! W-what are you? Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_10_02.text:
What! She took the old geezer!
She doesn't seem too friendly... Hold up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_11_01.text:
Code red: infiltrators in the Second Laboratory! Send a report to the HQ!
I repeat! Infiltrators discovered in the Second Laboratory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_11_02.text:
Dammit, and I just had them!
Get out of my way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_12_01.text:
What's the matter? Compared to the Battleloids we fought,
those soldiers aren't worth our time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_12_02.text:
We're in the middle of enemy territory.
More and more reinforcements will come even as we defeat them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_12_03.text: If they surround us, there will be no escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_12_04.text: We need to retreat and join up with Celine and the others for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_12_06.text:
... Lyudmilla's right, Stanya.
Right now we need to escape with that mage over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_12_08.text:
Ugh... Well, if Goddess Bella says so...
Fine, fine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_14_01.text:
Where ARE Celine and Raven, anyway?
They should be around here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_15_01.text:
Goddess Bella, are you alright?
Were you injured, by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_15_02.text:
Mere weaklings won't hurt a mighty Goddess like myself,
but thanks for worrying. ... I just had some things on my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_15_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Did you feel that aura around the cloaked knight we met just now...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_16_01.text: ... I see. I may be mistaken, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_16_02.text: I thought I felt Cora's powers from her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_16_03.text:
But other than us Elard, the only remaining Goddesses
are the Kalard, and they've been banished to the southern continent...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_16_04.text: And for some strange reason, she felt very familiar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_17_01.text: What? Kalards have been invading Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_17_02.text:
Why are you telling me this just now...?
Oh, yeah. Our contact had been cut off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_17_04.text: Oh, there they are! Goddess Bella! Everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_18_01.text:
Where have you been all this time?
Did you not see the Neth soldiers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_18_02.text: Huh? Who's the pretty boy behind you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_18_04.text:
I'm Benjamin, the Chief Research Officer of Rapture Science.
There's no time to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_19_01.text:
Rapture... What? What'd he just say?
The Chief Research Officer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_19_02.text:
What's happening?
You could at least give us a short explanation!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_19_03.text: Ha... haha... Erm, he was like that when we met him, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_19_04.text: But he did say he could help us escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_19_05.text:
Yeah, escape from the living realm, maybe?
How can we trust him? And how did a human open that portal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_19_06.text:
As much as I like explaining things, there's really no time to explain!
Hurry, follow us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_1_02.text:
Oh, no... My masterpiece...
It's - it's all ruined...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_20_01.text:
Huh, I have a feeling everything's going over my head.
Does anyone understand what that man wants with us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_20_02.text: At least, I don't think he wants to hurt us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_20_03.text:
When we ran into the guards back there,
it was that 'Chief Research Officer' who got us out of trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_20_04.text:
Ugh... Fine. BUT you're going to explain everything later.
Let's get out of here for now, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_2_01.text:
Oh, Sasquatch! I found you at last!
I'm so sorry, I'm so late, aren't I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_2_02.text:
Are you alright? Are you hurt?
They didn't add another arm onto you, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_3_01.text: W-what do I do? He's not waking up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_3_02.text:
Shaking him like that will knock him back unconscious.
It looks like he's in a similar state to that of the witch we found.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_3_03.text:
Didn't you explain it yourself? A temporary coma induced by
too much loss of mana. I'm sure Celine can treat him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_3_04.text:
Yes... Yes? Oh, I see...
I... I got carried away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_3_05.text:
Oh... So this was the person you were so bent on rescuing!
Your boyfriend, eh? Now that's romantic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_3_07.text:
Stop trying to act like nothing happened, old geezer.
Did you forget all the things you just did? I mean, I wouldn't be surprised...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_4_01.text:
Erm, I... did? My dear student, surely you can forgive
an old professor for his utterly human shortcomings -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_4_02.text:
Stop with your rambling.
The important thing is - where's Sentinel? Give him back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_4_03.text:
Sentinel? Well, I'm sorry to say
that even I don't know where it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_4_04.text:
When I installed a 'personality chip' stolen... I mean, acquired from
Road Industry, it flew away on its own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_4_05.text:
WHAT? Not only did you steal my greatest invention,
you lost him?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_4_06.text:
I'm never going to forgive you!
That's it, lemme kick your ass once and for all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_4_08.text:
Stanya, come on. We need to find out where the other mages
are being held captive. AND there's going to be time to kick ass later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_5_02.text: Ahhh! Wasn't this thing supposed to be dead?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_5_03.text: There still seems to be a mage captured inside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_5_04.text:
If the machine absorbs any more of their mana,
it'll prove fatal for them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_5_05.text:
Wait a second.
Over there... Something's falling down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_7_02.text:
She defeated it with a single blow! Who is she?
Is she friend or foe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_8_01.text:
Maybe she's one of {PLAYER_NAME}'s friends.
Whoever you are, thanks! That wasn't half bad!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_8_02.text:
Who knew there would be another human
almost as strong as {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3WB_5_8_04.text: Huh? Wait, you're... You're not human -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_01_0001.text:
... For even the lands that lie covered in ice and snow
embrace a beauty that shall not go forgotten;

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_01_0002.text: We, with our heirs, shall protect and flourish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_02_0001.text: You have grown weak, dear brother.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_02_0002.text:
Have you forgotten? Only one's own strength and glory
go untainted in these rough lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_02_0003.text:
Is this poor fate what you sought when you betrayed
the honor of Nosgard, the realm of our ancestors?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_02_0004.text:
Brother... All of Hasla has flocked to Grancia's banner,
united for the common good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_02_0005.text:
We cannot risk the future of our kingdom
for the sake of bygone days!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_03_0002.text:
You still speak of foolishness!
You have only oppressed the people of our land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_03_0003.text:
Ignore the long traditions of our people - and then what?
Become a common civilian of the Empire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_03_0004.text:
I refuse such a life - the life of a dog,
trained to docility by an undeserving master!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_04_0001.text:
Take him away.
And begin the preparations for the coronation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_OP_04_0002.text:
From now on, I, Odin Snorrison,
shall recover the lost glory of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_01_0001.text:
... So the blizzard that destroyed the Old Capital
has revived, come to ruin us all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_01_0002.text: Have we failed to lock Loki back in the Seal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_01_0004.text:
Yet his rage seeps through
the cracks of the weakened Seal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_01_0005.text: The storm seems to be a result of that rage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_02_0001.text:
We cannot help what has already happened.
We must simply find another way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_02_0002.text:
Lakias, perhaps the legends of your people shall guide us
in finding a solution to this predicament.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_02_0004.text:
'... And thus the Guardian of Utgard fell,
and icy winds engulfed the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_02_0005.text:
'Yet the Goddess of Light, with her grace and benevolence,
sealed the Creature of Ice and Snow within the Sanctuary,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_02_0006.text:
'and gave the people of the Winter Wind strength,
along with four Guardians, to protect the bond.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_02_0007.text:
The recovered power of the Guardians shall be able to
restore the weakened Seal to its original state.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_02_0008.text:
Yet... I fear it will take much time. These events being
unprecedented, I cannot know for sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_03_0001.text:
Then let us go to the Capital first.
We must warn King Thor about the Seal of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_03_0002.text:
Hardy the people of the north may be,
but this storm will prove deadly without preparation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_03_0003.text:
And we may find some evidence about the Sanctuary and
Loki in the Capital as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_03_0004.text:
I regret I must ask you to stay here
and restore the Seal, as Lakias said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_04_0001.text:
There is no need for regret, Goddess.
After all - we're bound to the Sanctuary and cannot leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_04_0002.text:
And this clown is still unconscious.
We'll watch over him from here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_04_0003.text:
Without Loki, he seems an ordinary youth...
We have many things to ask him when he wakes up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_05_0001.text: Oh, if you're going to the Capital, I can lead the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_05_0002.text:
The quickest road will be to cut through the village
where I've been staying recently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_05_0003.text: Hmm. Could you guide us then, Sasquatch?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_05_0004.text: We should depart before the storm grows any worse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_06_0001.text:
Erm, this is odd.
I'm sure there was a village around here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_06_0002.text: Maybe we took a wrong turn because of the snow...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_06_0005.text: No, something is headed our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_07_0002.text: Ouch, my back. Is no one hurt? No? That's a relief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_07_0005.text:
Hey, Baldie? It's no time for introductions!
Everyone, run! Monsters are coming this way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_07_0006.text:
Big words for an evil poacher!
And I'm not bald - this is a fashion choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0001.text: These... These are no ordinary creatures!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0002.text:
They are Spirits and other ancient races of snow.
Even in the time of my people, they were only rarely seen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0003.text:
... They emit a strange presence,
much like Loki's pawns.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0004.text: The storm seems to be affecting their temper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0005.text:
Ugh... Did you not hear me? It's no time for a tea party!
You need to run! NOW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0006.text: They're stronger than they seem, you know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0007.text: Don't worry. We've already fought them - and won.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0008.text:
Get behind us. We will protect you,
and you can guide us to the Capital.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST1_08_0009.text:
Just like the old days, eh, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I'll take the left one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_01_0001.text:
Hmm. So that Frost Elf lady is a poacher...
And you, Mr. Wolfgang, came from to capture her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_01_0002.text:
Aye, a very bad poacher indeed.
She killed almost all of my animal friends in this forest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_02_0001.text:
I didn't hunt that much!
Just enough for me to eat and survive the winter!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_02_0002.text: You mean to tell me that you eat a whole deer for one meal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_02_0003.text:
And you mean to tell me I'm some kind of bear?
Of course not! I'm innocent - this is unfair!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_02_0004.text:
Hrrmph, sooner or later we'll find out the truth.
Now stop struggling and come along quietly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_03_0001.text:
Anyway, you folks seem to know something
about those monsters and this strange weather.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_03_0002.text:
Even I, born and raised right here on this mountain,
haven't seen anything like this my whole life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_03_0003.text: Have you any idea what is happening?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_04_0001.text:
Those creatures are ancient beings who lived in harmony
with the people of Nosgard, a long time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_04_0002.text:
It is known that when the Sacred Being of these lands fell
hundreds of years ago, they went into hiding out of fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_04_0003.text:
Yet I do not understand why they have woken enraged.
... Or I can guess, but I do not understand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_04_0004.text:
Do you mean to say that
they seem to be reacting to Loki's rage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_05_0001.text: L-Loki?! How did he get out of the Seal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_05_0002.text:
No - look closely. It walks on four feet, unlike Loki.
It seems to be an ordinary wolf. No need for worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_05_0003.text:
Hmm... You wouldn't normally call a wolf of that big a size
'ordinary'…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_06_0001.text: ... Now there seems to be need for worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_06_0002.text:
A wolf that leads the ancient creatures of snow...
It must be 'Skrymir,' the right arm of the Sacred Being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_06_0003.text:
From its movements I daresay
it wants to keep us from reaching the Capital.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_06_0004.text:
Kah kah kah...
Then we have no choice but to beat it down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST3_06_0005.text:
Let's see who's stronger, eh?
I'll go first, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_01_0002.text: Kah! It puts up a good fight, as I expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_01_0003.text: And yet... I suspect it has lost its fighting spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_01_0004.text: Its attacks felt half-hearted at most.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_01_0005.text:
Why did you block our path?
What do you wish to tell us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_02_0001.text: ... That was below me just now, attempting to talk to a wolf.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_02_0002.text: ... Skrymir does not mean to attack us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_02_0003.text:
Hmm? What do you mean?
Did you not see it lunge at us, baring its teeth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_02_0004.text:
Skrymir, like Loki, is not a physically living thing
but a spiritual being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_02_0005.text:
Upon seeing that you were ready to listen, it attempted to
convey its will to you through direct contact. Or so I think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_03_0001.text: ... A pity, then. I had no wish to kill it for good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_03_0002.text:
It is not dead - for Skrymir is originally a part of the
natural world surrounding us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_03_0003.text:
It may have lost its physical form for the moment,
but it should still be watching us, itself unseen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_03_0004.text:
Well, that's uncomfortable.
Why are these monsters appearing all of a sudden?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_03_0005.text:
I saw some Neth scientists in a nearby forest
a couple of days ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_03_0006.text:
... They probably have something to do with this.
I knew they were up to no good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_04_0001.text: Neth scientists? Wait, is there a village around here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_04_0002.text: Hmm? Yeah, just around that mountain ridge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_04_0003.text: Oh, no... I hadn't expected them to find us this quickly...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0002.text:
Erm... Well... The truth is,
I'm kind of... wanted by the Neth army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0003.text:
And the person who was helping me elude them
should be hiding in that village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0004.text: There's a chance that the soldiers may just pass by...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0005.text:
But with this blizzard and everything,
I should go and check if she's really safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0006.text: Would it not be safer for the rest of us to accompany you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0007.text: Thanks, but I'll be less easily spotted if I go alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0008.text: And you guys need to hurry, remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_05_0009.text:
I'll retrieve my friend and catch up with you.
You should get a head start while it's still safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_06_0001.text: If that is your wish. Be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_06_0002.text:
Okay. Don't get hurt, everyone!
See you in Edda!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_07_0001.text: He said 'a friend,' but perhaps he really means a lover?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_07_0002.text: Haha, young and in love - how sweet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_07_0003.text:
You guys sound like a bunch of grandmas
with an unhealthy interest in their grandson's love life...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_07_0004.text:
Ha, that's funny. 
Enough with the talk - we better get going.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_07_0005.text: Wolfgang. Could you lead the way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH1_ST6_07_0006.text: Haha... O-oh, yes, of course. This way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_01_0001.text: Snorri Edda... Still a desolate neighborhood, I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_01_0002.text:
There is no time to waste.
We must get to the castle at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_01_0003.text:
Hmm, it's been some time since I was last in the Capital.
I think... It was in this direction?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_02_0001.text: Hmm? Did you trip? Why did you suddenly fall over?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_02_0002.text:
Stupid baldie…
I fell because YOU suddenly started moving!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_02_0003.text: Tell me before you start jostl... Huh? What's that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_03_0001.text:
The Einherjar…
What are those lunatics doing here in the Capital?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_03_0002.text:
The Einherjar - do you mean the King's army?
What do you mean, calling them lunatics?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_03_0003.text:
Haven't you heard? Don't know what they were like before,
but they are nothing but bloodthirsty vultures these days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_03_0004.text:
There are rumors that they tortured and killed captives
only so that the civil war would last longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_03_0005.text:
King Thor, pacifist that he is, disagreed with their ways
and banished them from the Capital... Or so I heard…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_04_0001.text:
Halt! Who goes there?
All passersby are required identification!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0001.text:
As I suspected! These are wanted men.
All of you are arrested for treason against the King!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0003.text: We only came to warn the king of the oncoming storm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0004.text:
Dionne and {PLAYER_NAME}.
You are wanted for attempts to overthrow the throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0005.text:
Come to warn the king of the oncoming storm?
Ha! What a far-fetched excuse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0006.text:
Hey now, I'm Wolfgang,
a member of His Majesty's personal guard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0007.text:
Let us meet His Majesty for ourselves.
There seems to be a misunderstanding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0008.text:
Personal guard? Now you assume a false identity!
What evidence do you have of your professed status?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0009.text:
You should have thought to take off your country bumpkin
traditional clothes first, you imposter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0010.text:
Now, if you stay quiet and follow without further resistance,
His Majesty will question the lot of you himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_05_0011.text: If you have anything to say, say it then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_06_0003.text:
... Thor is a wise king.
He will listen to what we have to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_06_0004.text:
If he does not, well...
That is a bridge we shall cross when we come to it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_06_0005.text: For the time being, we should humor them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_08_0001.text: Your Majesty! We have captured the criminals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_09_0001.text:
Where is Thor?
You said you would lead us before the king.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_09_0002.text: And the king stands before you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0001.text: Welcome, Daughter of Cora, and Agent of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0002.text: I am Odin Snorrison, true King of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0003.text:
Snorrison? I'd heard that Thor had a brother.
The leader of a rebellious movement...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0004.text:
I see you've successfully usurped the throne for yourself.
Is it you who also framed us as wanted criminals?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0005.text:
Usurp? Ha!
I only took back what was rightfully mine in the first place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0006.text:
Look at how Nosgard changed
after 'pacifists' and cowards came into power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0007.text:
Drunk on the wealth transfused from the Central Empire,
they've lost their strength and forgetten their heritage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0008.text:
The tribes who suffered the loss of their identity to the
Empire rightfully refused such oppression.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0009.text:
Thor attempted to suppress those who dissented...
Yet the wolves of the north do not succumb to others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0010.text:
The dissenters gathered to my flag,
and I recovered the throne from Thor's foolish hands -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_10_0011.text: As well as the honor of Nosgard, strong and glorious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_11_0001.text:
That is nonsense, and you know it!
To fight divided in these harsh lands will bring death for us all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_11_0002.text:
The age of ruthless war and bloodshed ended long ago!
What do you not understand?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_11_0003.text:
And so what if it has? A new one will begin, as it always does.
And if Alexander stops his deceptive patronage, what then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_11_0004.text:
Do we merely wrangle our hands, ready to starve like abandoned dogs?
To survive, we ourselves must become stronger!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_12_0001.text:
Silence, both of you.
More urgent matters are at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_12_0002.text: This is no ordinary storm that heads for the Capital.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_12_0003.text:
It is an ancient evil,
revived by the rage of an Old Being sealed once more...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_12_0004.text:
... set once more to destroy the capital, as it ravished
Elder Edda once, long ago! We must prepare against it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_12_0005.text:
Odin. No love is lost between us, but...
If you are truly the new king of Nosgard, heed our warning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_12_0006.text:
You must send aid to all corners of Nosgard
and prepare for the oncoming blizzard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_13_0001.text:
... Many rumors I have heard about the so-called 'Goddesses,'
sent by the Central Empire to demand truce from its neighbors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_13_0002.text: That is an unfortunate misunderstanding. We...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0001.text: What is the meaning of this, Odin?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0002.text:
The monsters that have suddenly risen from the ice-capped mountains,
the storm that rages, as we speak, over the entire kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0003.text:
I am not deaf. I have heard the whispers of my people -
that the Goddess has come to punish the king's brother fortreason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0004.text:
It was a good attempt, but do not think for a moment
that Odin Snorrison can be fooled by your tricks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0005.text:
... An ancient evil, you say? Then so be it:
I, King of Nosgard, shall punish those who brought about that evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0006.text:
Foolish human... Taking your anger out at us will do you no good.
What about your people, defenseless against the storm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0008.text:
The strong shall survive,
as they will any storm that may come their way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0009.text:
As our ancestors have done for generations.
The weak shall diminish, and rightfully so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0010.text:
What is more important is that you will sacrifice yourselves
for the sake of my authority over Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_14_0011.text:
Tomorrow afternoon, in the central square -
there you will be burnt at the stake. Do not be late - hahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_15_0002.text: What are you doing, Randgrid? Take them away at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_16_0001.text: ... It seems we've come far enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_17_0003.text:
Since he rose to the throne, he has only been giving us
petty commands, even stopping the search for Captain Freyja.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_17_0004.text: And now he wants us to play along to his little puppet show?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_17_0005.text:
This is a disgrace to the honor of the Einherjar!
Now, let them go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_18_0003.text:
His Majesty gave us orders to imprison you as well
if you showed any signs of betrayal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_19_0001.text: You... You traitors! Back-stabbers, all of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_19_0002.text:
Then come to your deaths - this will be my grave!
Come at me, all of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_20_0001.text:
I can't even... I give up even trying to understand this mess.
What's going to happen to us now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_20_0002.text:
Hmm. Too many soldiers for one warrior to fight...
I guess we're getting one more prison mate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_20_0003.text: Or we could give her a hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_21_0002.text:
What! No human's strong enough to
break iron shackles with their bare hands!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_21_0003.text:
Kah, it's a trivial task.
I only waited until we got far enough from the castle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_21_0004.text: Now, we are going to escape. Will you come with us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_22_0001.text:
Me? Escape? Don't be foolish!
I'll rather die than flee from battle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_22_0002.text:
Don't you ever think to bring down such disgrace
upon me, the fear of Einherjar...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST1_22_0003.text:
Alright, you can continue later, Miss. 
Excuse me - we're a little short on time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_01_0001.text:
Pant... Pant... First assassins, now ballistas. Isn't it weird?
Why use such missile weapons to catch us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_01_0002.text: We would've been better off locked in prison.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_01_0003.text: ... And get burnt to death tomorrow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_01_0004.text: Oh, yeah. I've been forgetting amidst all the chaos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_02_0001.text:
First the Night Ravens, now even the rear guard... 
Normally they wouldn't be assigned to such missions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_02_0002.text: And where can the other troops have gone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_02_0003.text:
Do they have some other important mission they're
carrying out...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_03_0002.text:
Wolfgang! What are you doing here? Hmm?
Goddess Dionne and {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_04_0002.text:
D-do you know how much I worried after you disappeared?!
I looked everywhere for you, Captain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_04_0003.text:
And you come out of nowhere with that blasted Thor?
Like - like you've gone for a walk or something!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_04_0004.text:
This is betrayal, Captain!
Not - not just to me - to all of Einherjar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_06_0001.text:
What did you just say? Betrayal, huh?
You've grown some guts, talking to your Captain like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_06_0002.text: Argh! T-that hurts, Captain! Stop hitting me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_07_0001.text:
... Ahem. Greetings. I am Freyja,
Captain of the Einherjar, the winged army of the North.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_07_0003.text:
Hmm, just like the rumors say:
strength and charisma fit to lead the Einherjar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_07_0004.text: Haha, what are you whispering so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0001.text:
It is good to see you again, Thor.
We worried for you after seeing what happened in the Capital.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0002.text: How did things come to this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0003.text: So you have met my brother.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0004.text:
I am embarrassed to admit that I was imprisoned
in the underground dungeon after losing to him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0005.text:
Yet fortune smiled upon me
and I escaped with Freyja's aid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0006.text:
Captain Freyja? But I thought you hated Thor!
He's against everything Einherjar stands for!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0007.text:
And why would you think that? We have our differences, 
but His Majesty is still the king of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0008.text: Personal values have no place before public matters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_08_0009.text: That's not what you said when you received his last orders...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_09_0001.text:
Ahem. Anyway... Then why the sudden disappearance, Captain?
Without a single word to any one of us...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_10_0001.text: Ah, it seems Odin has sent reinforcements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST4_10_0002.text: Perhaps we should continue after retreating somewhere safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0001.text:
Seems we managed to outrun the hunting party,
but returned right to the heart of the snowstorm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0002.text: Although I'm not sure whether that's a blessing or a curse,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0003.text:
Our pursuers will have some trouble finding us,
since this snowfall is hindering even our own vision.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0004.text:
Sigh... This is not good.
We must seek evidence while eluding the army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0005.text:
Which brings me to the question:
Goddess, why were you being pursued?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0007.text:
We were wrongly accused by Odin
as the evil forces that brought the storm upon Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0008.text:
We explained that it was no ordinary storm
and we had no time to waste, but he did not believe us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0009.text:
As expected of my brother. He means to use you as a means
to silence many voices of resistance rising against him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0010.text:
Odin may have no patience for spells and oracles,
but he'll waste no time in using them if deemed advantageous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0011.text:
The trouble is that this, as you said,
is truly no ordinary storm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_01_0012.text:
For it is a storm of destruction,
summoned by the 'Creature of Ice and Snow.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_02_0002.text:
That is a legend passed down
only among the people of the Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_02_0003.text:
The Einherjar have protected these lands
since the very start of this kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_02_0004.text:
With the Tribe of the Winter Wind gone, we the Einherjar
have the longest history than any other in these lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_02_0005.text:
Many things can be found in the records
passed down only among the chieftains of the Einherjar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_02_0006.text:
Records of you remain among us as well, 
Lakias, Master of Ice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_02_0007.text:
Though I must admit, I had not expected
that a day would come when we would fight side by side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_03_0001.text:
If you knew of everything beforehand, why did you not
choose to protect the Seal of the Sanctuary yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_03_0002.text: If it were not for us, Loki would have escaped his bonds long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_03_0003.text:
As you know, Loki's incarnation has been infiltrating all of
Nosgard, changing its shape while seeking a means to escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_03_0004.text:
We had to be careful to keep the secret
from his knowledge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_03_0005.text:
No other choice was left to us
but to keep our distance from the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_03_0007.text:
... A secret about the weapon that has been left by the Goddess
to kill the sealed Creature of Ice and Snow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_04_0001.text:
This is the spear to slay the Creature of Ice and Snow:
Mistilteinn.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_04_0002.text:
To hide it away from the Incarnate's eyes, it's been
treated as nothing more than a common spear up to now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_04_0003.text:
After sensing the rift in the Seal,
I withdrew from sight to collect the spear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_05_0001.text:
A few days ago, Freyja explained everything to me
and requested to see the Royal Armory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_05_0002.text:
... As you can imagine, I was surprised to hear that
what seems to be a common stick is a weapon of divine power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_05_0003.text:
A common stick it may seem, but no one would have dared
to throw away an item of the Royal Armory. It was the safest place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_05_0004.text:
Immediately after collecting Mistilteinn, however,
Odin and the Einherjar launched a siege on the Capital.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_05_0005.text:
Revealing myself would ensue in my having to explain
the reason I had returned, and the existence of the spear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_05_0006.text:
So I hid from my soldiers' sight and secretly fled with 
King Thor, His Majesty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_05_0007.text: It seems I have underestimated Randgrid's foolishness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_06_0001.text:
A-ahem! But look at this divine light!
I don't know much, but it seems like a great weapon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_06_0002.text: Yes, I too feel the strength of the Goddess radiating from it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_06_0003.text:
This weapon could truly vanquish Loki
once and for all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_08_0001.text:
What was that just now...?
... I felt faint for a moment...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_09_0001.text:
So here you all were gathered: 
losers, fugitives, traitors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_09_0002.text:
I have come to make you a proposal:
give yourselves up before you suffer further dishonor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_09_0003.text: Brother. Now is not the time to be fighting so pettily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_09_0004.text:
We do not have enough time - not only Nosgard
but all of Hasla may fall in danger!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_09_0005.text:
Pettily? Does everything seem so trivial now,
after slaving away for your so-called Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_09_0006.text:
There's nothing more to hear.
Die an honorable death before it is too late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_10_0002.text:
Quickly! Take King Thor His Majesty and escape!
We'll buy you some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_10_0003.text: Only the two of you? It is too dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_10_0004.text:
Who said we're going to martyr ourselves?
We'll run when we get the chance. So go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH2_ST6_10_0005.text: ... Don't get caught. {PLAYER_NAME}, keep Thor safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_01_0001.text: The landscape is different from how I remember it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_01_0002.text:
I feel the presence of hostile foes all around us.
We must be careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_02_0001.text:
Those figures seem familiar...
... My warriors of the Winter Wind...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_02_0002.text:
The cold must have preserved their bodies.
But to see the dead moving like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_02_0003.text: This is Loki's doing. He is attempting to stop us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_02_0004.text:
No... He is attempting to stop my spear
from approaching his true form.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_02_0005.text: He will do everything in his reserve to keep us away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_03_0001.text: Even in death, they suffer so, without rest...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_03_0002.text:
Lakias, step back.
{PLAYER_NAME} and I will take care of this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST1_03_0003.text:
... No. As their chieftain, 
I will ensure they receive the rest they deserve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_01_0001.text:
That is odd.
Since our first confrontation with my warriors,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_01_0002.text:
I noticed that unlike the Creatures of Snow,
I do not feel Loki's presence around them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_01_0003.text: But who else would be seeking to stop us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_01_0004.text:
I'm more worried about the number
of the living dead gathering before us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_01_0005.text: We may see the rising of King Snorri himself, at this rate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_01_0006.text: And the clouds are clearing from the western peaks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_01_0007.text: It's only a matter of time before Odin's men find us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_02_0001.text: Yes, I know we have to hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_02_0002.text:
We should be getting close. Yet the lay of the land
has changed... I cannot find the entrance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_02_0003.text:
HAW HAW!! You've returned!
Here I am, here I am!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_03_0001.text: ... I know that voice. Is that...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_04_0001.text:
Ah, welcome, welcome!
I thought I would starve to death before you returned!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_04_0002.text:
The Guardians seem to be getting along fine
without food, and I can't hunt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_04_0003.text: Excuse me, do you have anything to eat?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_05_0001.text: Loki...! How dare you reveal yourself before us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_05_0002.text:
Cough, cough! W-wait!
I'm the human version! The human Loki!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_05_0003.text: Eh...? Ah! The youth of the Frost Wolf Tribe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_05_0004.text: I apologize - I acted out of instinct.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_05_0005.text:
Haw haw! It's completely alright!
I understand, very much so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_05_0006.text:
I don't have a clear memory of the past hundred years...
But some habits have stuck to me without my knowing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_05_0007.text:
This odd laugh, for instance,
seems to have no intention of stopping! Haw haw!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0001.text:
I fear we do not have enough time.
How is the Seal? Are the Guardians safe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0002.text:
Ah... The Seal! I cannot be too sure,
but they say it is becoming more stable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0003.text:
The fury from within the Seal is 
becoming stronger, for sure...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0004.text:
But the Guardians are doing their best,
so I trust the weather will lighten up soon, haw haw!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0005.text: It is no use to continue the struggle like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0006.text:
The Seal is incomplete...
Once broken, it will easily break again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0007.text: We must put an end to everything, before it is too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0009.text: You there, which is the way to the Sanctuary?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0010.text:
Oh, turn left at that pine tree
and you can't miss it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_06_0011.text: Thank you. We must hurry now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST4_07_0001.text:
Excuse me...
I asked if you had anything to eat...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0001.text: {PLAYER_NAME}, Goddess Dionne! You've returned at last.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0002.text:
We were worried for you - the storm is growing worse.
Did you find what you sought in the Capital?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0003.text:
No - we failed, 
and were framed as traitors of the kingdom instead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0004.text:
The only path that remains before us
is to stop the blizzard ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0005.text:
Then you'll be relieved to know that
Loki's struggles are at an end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0006.text: We will be able to stabilize the Seal soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0007.text:
Kill Loki, and the storm will stop at once.
There is no need for so much trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_01_0008.text: That's a foolish suggestion. ... Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_02_0001.text:
Greetings. 
I have heard much about you from Goddess Dionne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_02_0002.text: I am Thor Snorrison. This is Freyja.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_02_0003.text: Snorrison? As in the royal line?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_02_0004.text: Wow, we hadn't been expecting such royal company.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_03_0001.text: Guardians of the Sanctuary, your role ends here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_03_0002.text:
This is 'Mistilteinn,' 
the spear that will pierce the heart of the wolf.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_03_0003.text:
It is a divine weapon,
bestowed by the Goddess herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_04_0001.text: Yes, it emits a similar strength as to that of the Sanctuary...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_04_0002.text: So you can really kill Loki with that thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_04_0003.text: Yes. By piercing the Seal with this spear...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_04_0004.text: The storm shall stop, and Nosgard shall return to light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_05_0001.text:
That feeling again…
Perhaps I wasn't mistaken the first time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_05_0002.text:
It feels almost as if...
A part of my soul is struggling against that light...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_06_0001.text: Now, as we cannot waste any more time, we must...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0003.text:
Do you wish to kill Loki, who has already been sealed
and is starting to calm down?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0005.text: If Loki dies, we'll become free, won't we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0007.text: Is it truly right to slay the 'Creature of Snow and Ice'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0008.text:
In the forest on the way to the city,
we met the ancient wolf 'Skrymir.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0009.text: I cannot know for sure, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0010.text: I feel that Loki may not be a being of evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0011.text:
If we can put an end to the storm without further deaths,
I feel that we must stop here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0012.text: Lakias, how can you say that when you've faced him before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_07_0014.text: You're not jailed to the Sanctuary like us, is that it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_08_0002.text:
We Guardians have been chained to
the Seal of the Goddess against our will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_08_0003.text:
It is a curse more than a blessing,
and I would do anything to get out of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_08_0004.text:
But this is nothing more than a blind attempt.
We can't be sure that Loki can actually be killed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_09_0001.text:
...You have all been exposed too long 
to the poison of this earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_09_0002.text:
Do you mean to doubt the will of the Goddess,
and advocate the evil that destroyed Elder Edda?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_09_0003.text:
All the conditions have been fulfilled.
Only now can the wolf be slayed and peace be recovered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_09_0004.text: If such is your wish, then so be it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_09_0005.text:
If you think your trivial duty so important,
then keep to it as you will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_10_0001.text: ... But I will not show mercy to those who hinder me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_11_0001.text: Is everyone done with their foolish resistance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_11_0004.text: How can you remain unaffected by our powers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_11_0005.text:
Isn't it obvious? I am the keeper of the will of the Goddess.
Anything born of her divinity cannot touch me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_11_0006.text:
We've wasted some time with this foolishness...
But now I can complete my task.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_12_0002.text: I hadn't expected for you to deflect even 'Mistilteinn.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_12_0003.text: I see now why Jeraphim failed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_12_0004.text: Jeraphim...? I've heard that name before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_13_0001.text: The Kalard that you fought in the Temple of Illusions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_13_0002.text: And you think that weapon is made out of 'Cora's Flame'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_13_0003.text:
I thought that had been buried deep underground
when the Temple collapsed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_13_0004.text: I knew that you would prove to be my greatest obstacle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_13_0005.text:
Well, as things have turned out this way...
I have no choice but to be... a little sincere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_14_0002.text: You... are not Freyja. State your name and purpose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_14_0003.text:
How disappointing.
If you had only submitted to my illusions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_14_0004.text:
You could have received a painless salvation
in blissful ignorance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_14_0005.text: I am Gullveig, Goddess of Truth, one of the Kalard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_14_0006.text:
I come to cleanse these lands of darkness 
with the truth of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_15_0003.text:
Huhu... Freyja?
She has long become a part of this tundra.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_15_0004.text: You... You villain! I'll kill you, right here and right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_16_0002.text:
Kill me? 
Oh, Randgrid, that's no way to speak to your captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_16_0003.text:
But then again, you did love me so,
like a sister or a mother you never had.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_16_0004.text:
It is thanks to you that I could so easily induce
the betrayal of the Einherjar and their cooperation to Odin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_16_0005.text:
Stop it... Stop looking like my captain
and speaking like you know me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_17_0001.text: Kalard... {PLAYER_NAME} told me about you lot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_17_0002.text: The true heirs of Cora - is that what you're calling yourselves?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_17_0003.text:
Do you think you can be forgiven 
for all the evil you commit under Cora's name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_17_0005.text:
And how should a defiled imperfection like you
know anything of our intentions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_17_0006.text:
Those who harbor darkness in their hearts
will never know the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_18_0001.text: Kah, those are big words for cowards who refused to fight in the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_18_0002.text:
I may not know of your 'true intentions,'
but I will not let things go your way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_18_0003.text: And I'll get revenge for my captain...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_18_0004.text: So it is you who are at the heart of all this trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_18_0005.text:
I shall have you pay for the pain you have caused
to me and my people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_19_0002.text: How can a mere human hold so strong a power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_19_0003.text:
... Ah. I remember.
It was you who discovered her first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_19_0004.text: Huhu... Now I understand. Now I understand everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_20_0001.text: What, again?! She keeps healing herself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_20_0002.text: So the dog without its master continues to bite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_20_0003.text:
I've been suppressing my power as to keep the Seal intact,
but I see now that I can't be so generous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_20_0004.text: I must deal with you first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_21_0002.text: Stop your foolish resistance. This is the end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_22_0001.text: Don't be so... arrogant...! You must get through me first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_23_0002.text: Don't get in my way, Guardian.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_23_0003.text:
I still have a use for you,
so sit down and watch in obedience.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_23_0004.text: A use...? And what use would that be for a Guardian?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_23_0005.text: If you mean to kill Loki, what use are we Guardians?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_23_0006.text: The Seal must keep intact until the end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_23_0007.text:
To kill Loki, the power of the Seal keeping the Sanctuary intact
must be turned into that of destruction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_23_0008.text:
Of course, the surrounding area will be completely devastated, but...
Seeing its current state, I suppose it won't matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_24_0001.text: The Sanctuary... You seek to destroy Elder Edda?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_24_0002.text: This is no ordinary ruin. You know that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_24_0003.text:
This is the land where for hundreds of years, our ancestors
have sacrificed themselves to protect the Goddess's will!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_24_0004.text:
It is a necessary sacrifice
to cleanse this continent of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_24_0005.text: Why don't you understand that it's an honor for you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_25_0002.text:
I can understand now why 'Skrymir' wanted to stop us
and all of the tundra reacted to Loki's rage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_26_0001.text: Heim, Vernil, Roskva. Hand me your keys - I ask you to trust me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_26_0004.text: I'm not really sure what's going to happen, but let's do it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_27_0001.text: What foolishness are you planning? Surely you do not...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_27_0002.text:
Stop feigning ignorance.
You know what I am about to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_27_0003.text: I shall break the Seal and free Loki from his binds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_27_0004.text: ... Ugh! Stop it! Stop it right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_28_0001.text:
The power that has been sustaining the Seal
is starting to disperse...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_28_0002.text: Do you have any idea what you have just done?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_28_0003.text:
You have refused the guidance of light
to keep true to some petty tradition!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_28_0004.text: It is not too late. Restore the Seal at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_28_0006.text: For I have passed on my power to Sasquatch, my heir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_29_0001.text: Then the Seal... It is too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_30_0001.text: Then there is no other way... but to retreat...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_30_0002.text:
... Someday, you will pay for 
upsetting the great plan of the Kalard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_31_0002.text:
It seems she could not confront Loki
without the power of the Seal to help her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_31_0003.text: ... And I must say, good riddance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_31_0004.text:
Kah kah kah! Good of you to say so, Lakias!
Good riddance, indeed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_31_0005.text: But Loki will run free soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_31_0006.text: The Seal is broken... We'll have to fight him, now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_31_0008.text: If my predictions are correct, there will be no need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_32_0001.text: The Being of Ice and Snow... Loki of Utgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_33_0001.text: Lakias, Chieftain of the Tribe of Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_33_0002.text:
Well, well... I had not expected for us
to meet again like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_34_0001.text:
Forgive us for our past ignorance,
O Sacred Being of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_34_0002.text:
What, have you finally come to your senses?
Huhu, I suppose I can forgi-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_34_0004.text:
Wait, really?
The bad guy turns out to be the true master of Nosgard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_35_0001.text: ... Yeah, yeah. I don't like how things turned out, either.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_35_0002.text:
Can't believe the ones who freed me are the ones
who fought and locked me up in the first place...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_35_0003.text:
Is it too late to start over
and act the part of the fearful, dignified being that I am?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_36_0001.text:
Lakias? What is happening?
Does this mean there is no need to fight him anymore?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_36_0002.text: ... The storm of destruction, as it is called, never existed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_36_0003.text:
The storm was only the embodiment of Loki's rage
at having been sealed away in the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_37_0001.text: ... Why are you staring at me like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_37_0002.text:
I have a lot to say too. You locked me up for hundreds of years
after being fed lies from the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_37_0003.text:
There's no use in blaming others now,
is there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_37_0004.text:
If you really want someone to blame,
you can blame that damned Cora!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_38_0002.text: It's worse that he's not entirely wrong.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_38_0004.text:
... You know what, just call me Loki.
You've seen me at my worst already.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_38_0005.text: ... Loki. Now that you are free, what will you do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_38_0006.text:
I have been absent from my rightful place for a long time...
The veins of these lands have gone awry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP3_CH3_ST6_38_0007.text: To heal these lands, I will soon fall back asleep.
