was implicated in the onset of the War of the Holy City...
Then the Cardinal is certainly suspicious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_020.text: You have a keen mind, Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_021.text:
The business of Trista is the Musketeers' lot - yet I would
have you keep safe. The kingdom is not what it used to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_022.text:
I fear you must find the laboratory on your own,
as we ourselves are tied up in this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_023.text:
It-it's okay!
I'll try to remember as hard as I can!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_024.text:
Then shall we go separate ways for the time being?
Little miss, I am sure that you will remember everything soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_025.text:
We will come find you, should you find yourself needing aid.
There are a few of my men throughout the city. They will know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_027.text:
If we learn anything about the Cardinal,
we will let you know at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_028.text:
Please be careful of the Shadow Roses.
To this date, no one has returned from their dungeons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_029.text: If need be, do not hesitate to use force to escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_001.text:
We have found them.
Permission to kill fully authorized.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_002.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
I'm afraid we must "use force," as D'Artagnan said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_003.text:
I-I'll use force!
You can escape first, and I'll follow you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_005.text: (You ask Ellie what she is going to do.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_006.text:
Um, I'll do it! Use force!
But.. Could you tell me what "force" is and how you use it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_008.text:
Haha… Ellie, {PLAYER_NAME} will show you
what it means to "use force."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_009.text: Should we step back for the time being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_001.text:
Oh…! So… "using force" means…
hitting someone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_002.text:
I… I really want to learn and be helpful...
But hitting people is scary, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_003.text:
You are right. Hitting people is a scary business.
Sometimes, however, it is necessary to defend what you love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_004.text:
You must always remember this difference
so that you may use your powers for good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_005.text: I… I'm still not very sure…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_006.text:
…but I know {PLAYER_NAME} is good!
Always saving me from trouble...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_007.text: I want to become like you, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_009.text:
Do you think I could become like you? Even someone like me?
I don't know anything, and I'm no help to anyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_010.text:
(You offer to become Ellie's "teacher"
and help train her.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_011.text:
Really?!
Thank you! I'll do my best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0019_001.text:
What business do you have? No one is allowed to pass
while the Order of the Shadow Rose executes justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0019_002.text: B-but this is the way we have to go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0019_003.text:
Ah, it is the felons. Good, we will execute them here.
It will be easier than taking them to the execution grounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_002.text:
Demons...
Demons wearing the mask of humanity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_004.text:
Who is this heretical wrench?
What have the guards been doing to let her through?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_005.text:
Cease your clamoring!
The Cardinal shall judge the sinner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_006.text: His Eminence the Cardinal is coming!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_008.text:
Demons, stealing His Majesty's authority in his illness
to tyrannize the innocent people of our kingdom…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_009.text:
The vilest of sins. Worry no more, my beloved people.
I shall protect you from the clutches of the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_001.text:
I fear there are still other demons hiding in the shadows…
Yet our work is finished here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_002.text: This child is under our care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_003.text:
She has done no wrong.
We will take her with us, if you are done here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_004.text:
You cannot.
Who is to say that this child is not a sinner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_005.text:
If she was but an innocent child,
she would not have swooned as my light purged the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_006.text:
You do not understand. She has an illness -
how would you know that it was light that affected her so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_007.text:
Hmm… Then I must ask you this.
How much do you know about this child?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_009.text:
For I sense this child's true nature.
A great evil, lurking amidst her apparent innocence...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_010.text:
The demons under the guise of the Order of the Shadow Rose
would be mere flies, in comparison.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_011.text:
Would you not call this child, who masked herself and 
rebelled before even the Goddess' light, the true demon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_012.text:
Did she not see through the Shadow Roses' true nature
when no one else did?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_013.text:
One could even say… she is the demons' true master,
able to control them to her will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_014.text:
You lie. I don't believe you.
{PLAYER_NAME}, let's go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_015.text:
Your Highness!
Should we pursue them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_017.text:
To flee with a child that I myself judged as a demon…
They too share the sin of revolting against the Goddess' light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_018.text:
Heaven's Cavalry, I shall entrust the matter
of the demon-controlling child and her worshippers in your hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_019.text:
They are devils in human disguise, and a great threat to
our people of Trista. I authorize all means of execution.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_020.text:
We vow to fulfill our duty
under the Goddess' name!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_021.text:
Two birds with one stone…
This too…is divine will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_001.text:
First demons,
now the Heaven's Cavalry…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_002.text:
How have things come to this?
And when will Ellie wake up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_003.text: (You think it will be wiser to go find D'Artagnan and Rochefort.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_004.text:
Yes. We need their help.
They should also know of the Cardinal's plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_003.text:
Prestina. {PLAYER_NAME}?
H-huh? Have I fainted again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_004.text:
Yes.
I was worried that you would not wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_005.text:
(You ask Ellie whether she knows something
about the Order of the Shadow Rose.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_006.text: The Order of the Shadow Rose…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_007.text:
How did you know they were demons, Ellie?
We're under suspicion of being in league with them now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_008.text:
Demons? Did I say something…?
I-I don't remember anything…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_009.text:
(The conversation is growing too long.
You warn the others that they cannot stay too long in one place.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_010.text: You are right. They could be looking for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_011.text: (W-what did I do now…? Who am I…?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_003.text:
Fortunately not. We're the Leopard Girls.
We came under Sir Rochefort's orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_004.text:
He tells you that the city district of Trista is dangerous.
He will come and find you while you hide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_006.text:
There is a secret hiding place underground,
in the sewers of the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_007.text:
It can be accessed through the drains at the edges of the city.
Sir Rochefort advises you to hide there for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_008.text:
We will.
But what about you…? Are you safe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_010.text:
Don't worry about us.
We'll show them the strength of the Desert wildlands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_011.text:
I give you my blessing.
Ellie, {PLAYER_NAME}. Let's go at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_002.text:
Huhu. Three years go by so quickly.
How have you been, Prestina?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_003.text:
You're the same as ever, Maria.
And Roland - you seem to have gotten quite buff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_004.text: Haha. It has been a while, Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_005.text:
Your hair is much prettier down like this, Prestina.
While Goddess Chronos is, and always will be, herself…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_006.text:
She's so pretty, sparkling like stars...
And she smells really nice…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_007.text:
Oh, she's adorable.
What is your name, little girl?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_008.text:
Her name is Ellie.
We are taking care of her for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_009.text: But how did you find us here…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_010.text: I have business with the Musketeers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_011.text:
Saintess, be careful.
I sense a presence close by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_013.text:
They are Ratmen. They had disappeared after the Apostle War,
but it seems they had been living in Trista's sewers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_014.text: But why are they armed so…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_017.text:
Erm… Uh, hi!
Um, yes, I'm a human… And my name's Ellie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_019.text: The Captain's not gonna like this…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_020.text:
…Then we should get rid of them
before he catches a whiff of their scent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_021.text:
…It seems they are hostile towards us,
for some reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_022.text: I shall take care of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_023.text:
Wait. Roland and Maria, you shall not participate in battle.
You have your roles in the Order to think of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_024.text:
Crossing the border undercover and waging war in foreign territory
is not the wisest course of action, I must say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_025.text:
Yes... Goddess Chronos is the Chancellor of Grancia,
and Maria and Roland are renowned figures within the Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_026.text:
That only leaves Prestina and {PLAYER_NAME}!
It seems that we will be in their debt, Roland!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_027.text: Ahem… It seems I must forfeit this particular battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_028.text:
It is your chance to boast of your prowess, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I hope it has not tarnished with time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_001.text:
T-these humans are strong…!
Scary-squeak, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_002.text:
You there! Don't squeak like a damn amateur!
Hrrmph. We fall back for now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_003.text: I see that you have all met.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_004.text:
I fear this is not the banquet hall we would like to be dining in.
Although it does seem to resemble {PLAYER_NAME}'s chambers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_005.text:
Everyone…
Demons have revealed their presence in Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_006.text:
This may be our chance to find out more about demon mutation,
perhaps our greatest ever since the Neth War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_008.text:
Have you been researching demons ever since the War?
I didn't know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_009.text:
(You mention that the Cardinal has accused Ellie
of being the demons' master.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_010.text: This poor innocent girl? Surely not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_011.text: I see what he is planning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_012.text:
And yet our dear citizens and the Heaven's Cavalry
trust his words to every last syllable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_013.text:
He has trained our people well,
that Cardinal. There is nothing to be done at this point.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_014.text:
We couldn't prove Ellie's innocence.
After all, we ourselves do not know who she is, exactly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_015.text:
That is of little concern. 
For we are close to unveiling the truth of demonic mutation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_016.text: How is that so, if I may ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_017.text: I saw the Order of the Shadow Roses on my way here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_018.text:
They seem to be using the same tarnished energy
we have been researching these last three years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_019.text:
Yes… Yes. I remember more clearly now.
I had been distracted with escaping, but… I felt the similarities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_021.text:
Yet it will not be easy to reveal the Cardinal's crimes
as long as the people of Trista trust him for what he is not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_022.text:
I fear that the power of blind faith…
can prove to be stronger than anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_023.text:
We need irrefutable evidence
that would turn the tide against the Cardinal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_024.text:
I will go back to Hellad's laboratory.
There may be evidence that the Cardinal had relations with Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_025.text: Yes, that seems a good plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_026.text: And we will go and shake down the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_027.text:
Oh, don't be so barbaric, Roland!
It's not "shaking down," per se... It's investigating.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_028.text:
Saintess, please see to it that he is not overeager
and rush into mistakes, as he did in the Tower of Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_029.text: T-that was three years ago, Rochefort!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_030.text:
Then let us move quickly. We must gather evidence
before the demons hide back into the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_031.text:
Yes, yes. This it the most exciting it has been
for quite some time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_032.text:
Good, 
then we will go search the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_033.text:
O-okay!
Then what should I do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_036.text:
Goddess of the Forest, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You must remember the reason you have come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_037.text:
We will take care of the demons.
Hide here for the time being. It is not safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_040.text:
Haha, of course.
But beware of the Ratmen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_041.text:
They are rather… too unrefined to appreciate visitors.
Once they were not as hostile as they are now, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_042.text: … Well. I suppose it is time to take our leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_001.text:
Ratmen again.
They are curiously hostile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_002.text:
We need to stay here in the sewers for some time.
Should we attempt to negotiate with them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_005.text:
They… used to be good, kind people.
But their hearts are… now full of hatred and pain… Fury…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_006.text:
A hatred that… refuses all reason…
that knows no bounds…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I…
I am afraid for Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_002.text:
She seems a normal child, but at times…
I do not understand her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_003.text:
Who is she? What is she?
What does she know to talk of such matters as if…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_004.text:
(You answer that you too don't know for sure,
but you're certain that she isn't a bad person.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_005.text:
Yes. I think that too.
However… Neither is she a normal child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_006.text:
She… sees through people to their true forms.
So it was with the Shadow Roses, the Ratmen…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_007.text:
And I know that it is dangerous…
to use a power of which even its holder is unaware.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_008.text:
I wish to help Ellie,
until she comes to know the truth about herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_010.text: It is a relief that you are here, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_003.text:
What do you mean…?
Ellie is sleeping beside…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_005.text:
(You reply that 
Ellie was already gone by the time you had woken up.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_006.text:
The Ratmen are hostile, and the sewers dark and winding.
We must find her as quickly as we can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_008.text:
Yes. Rochefort advised us to stay in one place…
but it cannot be helped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_001.text:
… {PLAYER_NAME}.
Do you not feel another presence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_002.text: It seems someone is following us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_003.text:
(You observe that it doesn't seem to be
a demon or a trained soldier.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_005.text:
However… If it's neither a Shadow Rose
or a Heaven's Cavalry, who could be following us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_006.text:
…Oh my.
Do you think we could do that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_007.text:
I suppose it is all for the best.
We are in enemy grounds, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_008.text:
I'm afraid I'm not experienced in such matters. 
I will entrust this particular plan to your hands, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_001.text:
Oh, your plan has succeeded after all, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I was a little worried when you wanted me to become the bait…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_002.text:
Hmm? Now that I take a closer look, this Ratman seems…
rather - and I do not mean any offence - cute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_004.text: (You ask why he is following you.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_006.text:
Us? Bad humans?
Why do you think so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_008.text: (You ask the Ratman how he knows Ellie.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_009.text:
I'm never gonna tell-squeak!
Ellie is my friend to protect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_010.text:
(That Ratman may be the one
who has taken Ellie, you tell Prestina.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_011.text: Yes, I think so too. Let's go after him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_012.text:
(You ask Prestina how they can find the Ratman,
when they have already lost him.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_015.text:
Hee hee… I planted a small seed in the Ratman's fur
while he was distracted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_016.text:
It contains a spark of my power, and I can detect it well enough.
Now, it's time for us to catch the mouse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_003.text:
They're traitors who ran 'cuz they thought they were better
than the rest of us! The lot of them! We'll make them pay!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_004.text: Kiiirrr…. They'll be…. Kiiiiirrr… Just like me…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_005.text:
Wait. It seems like someone is inside…
Let me see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_007.text:
You bad rats!
Go back! Stop bothering us-squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_008.text:
Hey, fella. Shut up if you don't want a knock on your head.
We have orders to bring you in the best condition possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_009.text:
Squeak! You think I'm gonna be scared?
I'm not going to shut up! I'm not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_010.text:
What a bother.
Let's just kill him and get it over with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_011.text:
All my pleasure.
I'll do it quick.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_001.text:
Are you alright?
Oh, my name is Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_004.text: I'm pleased to make your acquaintance, Rata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_006.text:
I'm grateful that you saved me,
but I'm not going to tell you anything about Ellie, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_007.text:
I know you're going to do bad experiments on her!
Well, not anymore! You won't hurt her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_008.text:
What? Not at all! We too are here to protect Ellie.
Can you tell her where she is? How is she now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_009.text: … She was worse when I first met her, squeak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_010.text:
She was in pain… talking nonsense like a madman, ya know.
Talking about the… experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_011.text:
Me, I don't like humans, humans don't like me.
I didn't want to be a part of this, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_012.text:
Ellie's different, ya know? 
Squeak… She's not scared of me…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_013.text:
Always saying she's sorry for some stupid thing…
Even when she's the one in pain…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_014.text:
What've you done to her, you psychos!
She's the only good human I've met!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_015.text:
Rata… We are here to put a stop to those experiments
once and for all, and so alleviate Ellie's wounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_017.text:
Oh, good morning. I had such a good dream.
And the voices of the children… I don't hear them as much now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_019.text:
Ellie!
You shouldn't have run off like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_020.text:
I-I...
Someone was calling me, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_021.text:
Ellie, hurry!
You have to go now-squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_023.text:
…Angry Warrats are coming.
Many of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_024.text:
We can't fight them.
We have to run if we want to live, squeak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_025.text:
I-I don't know what to do.
Do we need to leave this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_027.text:
…All I know is that once we're dead,
we won't be able to run even if we want to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_028.text:
Rata, about the other Ratmen…
They were not as hostile as they are now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_029.text:
Some were changed into horrifying forms…
I need to know the reason behind their sudden enmity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_030.text: And what're you gonna do when you find out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_031.text:
We will give you our protection.
I only ask for your cooperation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_032.text:
Yes, Rata!
Prestina and {PLAYER_NAME} know… They know…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_034.text:
….Okay. If Ellie says so...I'm still not sure about this,
but I guess I need your help in protecting my village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_035.text: Yes. And we will protect Ellie as well. Together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_001.text: Well, the place seems cleared up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_002.text:
You took care of that many fighters?
I guess you really are strong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_004.text:
Fine. I keep promises too, squeak.
What do you wanna know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_005.text:
The Ratmen… Since when and why did they
become hostile to humans? And to the others, like yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_007.text:
I'm a traveling merchant by trade, so I lived outside-squeak.
Things were like this when I returned, so I ran away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_008.text:
Mm… Someone else could explain better.
Wait here, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_009.text:
Grandfather Triva!
These are the humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_010.text:
Yes… Squeak… So you are curious
about the reason the Ratmen changed…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_011.text:
It is because of you humans… Squeak…
One hundred years ago, and now… It is the same…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_012.text:
Humans… Always so keen on despising us,
unwilling to acknowledge our existence…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_013.text:
They built a giant pipe at the end of the sewers…
And filled our dwellings with the filth of the outside world…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_014.text:
And not just ordinary filth…
But the remains of a strange, unclean mana…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_015.text:
The Ratmen who came in contact… with that mana…
were changed, and… earned strange powers in return…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_016.text:
Yet the problem… squeak… is that
the Ratmen… wanted to use these powers…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_017.text:
The other Ratmen who escaped with us…
were those who refused to be changed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_018.text:
Now I finally understand
their loathing of humans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_019.text:
I-I may not know much,
but I know that that's not right!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_020.text:
They do not understand… that their brutality...
is no different from the cruelty of humans…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_022.text:
It would be best to… squeak… destroy all the mana filth…
but as its source comes from human territory…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_023.text:
There is… a captain of the corrupted Ratmen…
Rudrat…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_024.text:
If you stop him…squeak…
No Ratman will be changed against their will…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_025.text:
Rudrat… squeak…
seeks to change all the Ratmen…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_026.text:
I see… Triva, Rata.
I fear that we can't help you and the village for too long

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_027.text:
but if we find this Rudrat you speak of,
we will make sure to stop him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_028.text:
Thank you… You remind me… squeak… of old times…
when humans and Ratmen… lived in peace…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_029.text:
But they are bygone times…
Where will you go, now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_030.text:
We have no clear destination.
We are trying to recover this child's - Ellie's memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_031.text:
P-Prestina.
I just remembered where we should go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_032.text:
The children of the laboratory… They're calling me.
They're begging for help… I can hear them crying…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_034.text:
I'm not very sure… But…
I can feel that we need to go in this direction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_035.text:
(You also think that they should go 
in the direction Ellie pointed.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_036.text:
Yes, let's hurry!
Then, thank you, Rata, Grandfather Triva -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_001.text:
W-wait!
Take me with you, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_003.text:
You humans don't even know your way around the sewers.
And Ellie could get herself lost, or hurt, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_004.text:
Well, it's a Ratman's honor!
I can't just sit around waiting for humans, right? Squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_005.text: Okay! I'd be happy if you came with us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_006.text: (You say that it's okay to follow them.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_001.text:
Now that I think about it, how did you come here?
Most humans don't even know the existence of these sewers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_002.text:
Ah, well… There was a small problem overhead.
We are… um, hiding for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_004.text:
Haha.
Do you really think Ellie is capable of a crime?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_005.text:
Well. I guess if you're with Ellie…
Huh. I guess not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_006.text:
What are you talking about?
Can I learn how to do it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_007.text: I don't think you need to, Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_002.text:
Ellie, are you alright?
You do not seem well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_003.text:
The children… They are calling for me even more loudly.
My… my head hurts, Prestina…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_004.text:
Shh, shh…
We will save the children soon. All of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_005.text: Ellie. Are you sure we need to go this way, squeak?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_008.text:
… It's the hairs of the Mutarats. 
And I smell the stench of mana filth as well… Squeak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_009.text:
There should be many of them ahead of us.
Think you're strong enough for them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_010.text: (You don't know, but you say there's no other way.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_001.text:
It feels… different here, in this part of the sewers.
Almost as if the walls themselves are listening for intruders...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_002.text:
We're doomed. Squeak!
This - this is a rat trap!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_004.text:
Not a literal one, Ellie.
What is it, Rata?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_005.text:
Our path leads right to the 
headquarters of the corrupted Ratmen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_006.text:
We’re dead-center in enemy grounds.
We're like mice trapped in a cage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_007.text:
You guys may be strong,
but I know you won't be that strong…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_008.text: This may be for the best.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_010.text: We promised to help you, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_011.text:
Don't be stupid! These aren't your ordinary Ratmen.
They're clever and use weird powers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_012.text:
Even if you're strong,
you're in their home territory. This isn't gonna work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_013.text:
The strength of the enemy
cannot defy our mission, nor deter our path.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_014.text:
Cora herself taught that it is your own will that is important, 
as well as knowing your true path and the reason for its being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_016.text:
Fine, fine. Let's go, squeak! I guess Majerius the hero
didn't earn his Golden Grain sitting on his tush!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_017.text:
After all, my senses as the best merchant in the Ratman Village
are giving me the green light to go with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_001.text:
Okay. Now that it's all settled, I'll go ahead
and scout the road. Wait here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_005.text:
Betraying our tribe by refusing the power to protect our people,
and now bringing filthy humans all the way to our territory?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_006.text: Death is the only fitting punishment for this scoundrel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_007.text:
You… must be Rudrat.
The Captain of the corrupted Ratmen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_008.text: So you have heard of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_010.text:
Now...
I would so like to grab your necks and break them, one by one…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_011.text:
… but the deaths of one or two humans
won't settle the score. Oh no, it won't.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_012.text:
Do you see this broken body of mine? You humans did this to me.
If I loathed you before… I thank you now for my new strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_013.text:
With this strength you humans have given me, 
I will wage war and destroy everything precious to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_014.text:
I only hope you live to see the day.
If you can escape these sewers with your lives, that is… Kiiikiikiii…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_015.text: (You ask Prestina to heal Rata before it is too late.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_016.text: Yes… I must see to Rata right away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_017.text:
Prestina…
Rata isn't moving. Why isn't he…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_018.text:
He's still breathing.
Step aside, Ellie. I need to heal him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_020.text:
Are you alright…?
This wound… is too deep for even my powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_026.text:
(Rata is critically injured.
You suggest that they rest for the time being.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_001.text:
Rata needs more rest, but…
We cannot stay here any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_002.text: (You ask Rata what he will do.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_004.text:
I healed you best as I can under these circumstances,
but your wound is deep. It may fester if not treated properly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_006.text:
If you do not wish to accompany us any further,
we will respect your wishes, Rata. You did well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_007.text:
I… I don't know, squeak…
It's just… really hard to move my feet…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_008.text:
You did enough, Rata.
Please don't push yourself to harm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_009.text:
We will definitely stop Rudrat
before war breaks out between Ratmen and humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_010.text:
Yes… I believe in you guys...
Don't die or I won't forgive you, okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0040_011.text:
Rata!
I'll come find you after I save the children, okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0041_001.text:
How annoying, these humans. 
Like mosquitoes, the vermin they are… Kiikiii.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0041_002.text: You-you hurt Rata! I'll never forgive you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0041_003.text: Kiikiit, I've decided what to do with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0041_004.text:
Your mutilated corpses should be perfect 
to throw into the city square of Trista and declare war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0041_005.text:
Don't you think it the best signal for the coming bloodshed?
You should consider it an honor that I'm using your bodies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0041_006.text: I won't let you harm any of us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0042_001.text:
(You warn Prestina that the enemy numbers
are growing by the minute.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0042_002.text:
Kiiikiiikii! Yes, yes, thanks to you humans!
Your filth, your waste, they give us infinite power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0042_003.text:
We still have lots of games left for you -
it won't be any fun if you tire out now, little mice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0042_006.text:
Hahaha! 
Heroes always arrive fashionably late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0042_007.text:
Your radio transmitter won't work anymore!
I've chewed through all the lines - both red AND blue, ha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0042_008.text:
Kiikiiit!!! You traitor!
I'll kill you once and for all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_001.text:
Kiikiit… You damn humans! Hiding behind your masks,
when you send us all your dirty filth to deal with!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_002.text:
You are right. Humans do have an evil side to them. 
Yet this does not justify any of your crimes, to us and your people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_003.text:
Your corruption of all these Ratmen…
You did this on your own. No human forced it upon you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_004.text:
So you preach because you think you won, woman!
Don't lie to yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_005.text:
You know as well as me that as long as you humans are around,
we'll be here in the shadows, too. Kiiikiiikiiit!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_009.text:
Hrrmph! I told you, didn't I?
It's a Ratman's honor that we take care of our own problems!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_010.text:
Haha, of course.
You're just like Lord Majerius of legends, Rata!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_011.text:
Well… Ahem… You may be pushing it,
but I'll accept it anyway. Ahem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_014.text:
Yes… I know now.
It was a… very big building… abandoned for years…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_015.text:
Nobody came to that place… But inside…
So many children just like me… And machines… Magic…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_016.text:
He' continued his experiments…
because he… wanted to create a Goddess...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_017.text:
… I see what this is all about.
So it is always like this… The human desire for divine power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_018.text: (Let's go into the laboratory, you say.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_019.text:
Okay, I'll climb up the pipes
and make a hole you can go through. Squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_020.text:
Rata, are you truly coming with us?
None of us knows what lies ahead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_021.text:
Of course! Think you can get rid of me now?
No, sir! And I still have a job to do as a Ratman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_022.text:
Our problem's never going to end until we stop 
the bad humans from throwing away filth into the sewers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0043_023.text:
You speak the truth.
Thank you, Rata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_001.text:
What, a human!
Sorry for the intrusion there, squeak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_002.text:
Hey, you guys should apologize too.
Manners maketh mouse, haven't you heard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_004.text:
W-we've come to save you!
Come on, let's get out of here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_006.text:
B-because this is a scary place!
We don't belong here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_007.text:
A scary place? I do belong here.
Don't you like my world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_008.text: My world…? What do you mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_009.text:
My name is Avenir. I am the God born of this place.
This is my world. It is as I will it to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_011.text:
You are humans.
I never saw a human save for Father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_012.text:
Warm bodies…
Thinking, moving, communicating with one another so freely…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_014.text:
Who are you?
You are… different. You feel.. Familiar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_015.text:
I… I'm Ellie. I escaped from this place.
Do you know me? Have you seen me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_016.text:
No. You do not understand.
This familiarity… There is a connection… between us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_018.text:
I am… still incomplete.
Father said… I cannot leave without his permission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0044_019.text:
We never met today, got that?
Goodbye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_001.text: Well, well, well. Look who we have here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_002.text:
I never did expect much from the demons,
but the Heaven's Cavalry I had specially trained… How surprising.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_003.text:
That child, too… I thought her a failure.
I seem to have judged wrong, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_004.text:
Perhaps she could have been...
A perfect God as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_005.text:
Your mask as a beloved Cardinal is no more.
What is it that you seek?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_006.text:
Do you truly wish to fool your people
and bring destruction onto Trista?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_007.text:
Oh, you misunderstand me.
I am the true servant to the Goddess, the throne and its people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_008.text:
I may have… used other means for the greater good,
but are people ever very interested in the truth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_009.text:
You say you are a servant to the Goddess, and yet you use
demonic power to rule. Elanuma would grieve, if she saw you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_010.text:
Elanuma? Hahaha!
I have no fear for the disapproval of unworthy gods.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_011.text:
And you call yourself
a member of the Order of the Goddess…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_012.text:
Elanuma is a Goddess already long dead and bygone.
She exists only in stories, old, useless - forgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_013.text:
The Goddess I serve is another. A new God of my own creation,
who will bring new power to the human race!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_015.text:
Of course, it was an impossible task on my own.
This would not have succeeded if not for…her... aid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_016.text:
I myself only put the…
finishing touches to her work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_017.text:
I admit it was not easy to find a body
capable of accepting a God's great power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_018.text:
I was blessed to receive many subjects in my endeavor. And now:
the true God is born, out of hundreds, thousands of imperfections.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_019.text:
I may not have met a lot of humans,
but even I know that you're the worst one, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_020.text:
You blaspheme against the creator of your new God.
Yet I am merciful - I will forgive you for your ignorance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_021.text:
I will take that child, however.
Her abilities… shall be put good use.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_022.text:
My God will be happy to receive
such a fine offering. Haha…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_023.text: (You demand that the Cardinal bring back Ellie.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_024.text:
I have no wish to further speak with you.
Prepare to receive the rising of the new God of humanity, instead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_025.text:
Now then…My God, my Avenir.
Take them away, with your grace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_027.text:
(Rescuing Ellie is your foremost priority.
You urgently turn to Prestina and Rata.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_029.text:
Ellie is…
Why can I never protect anyone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_030.text: (You ask Rata what he is doing.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_031.text:
What do you mean, what am I doing?
I'm looking for Ellie, of course!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_032.text:
Sniff, sniff… It's faint, but I'm picking up on something.
I think I can find out the general direction she's been taken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_033.text:
Is that so, Rata?
Can we really find Ellie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0045_034.text:
Sniff, sniff… Maybe, maybe not. We need to follow the trail first.
But the nose of a Ratman tends to be accurate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0046_002.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}… That… that…
That machine is absorbing Ellie's magic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0046_003.text:
(You suggest destroying the machine
and saving Ellie.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0046_004.text:
I'll go and see if there's a way
to stop that machine, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_001.text:
P-Prestina…
I… I had such a strange dream…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_002.text:
My body felt so heavy…
I was… sinking somewhere deep down…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_003.text:
And… something came into my body…
This… power, and… that… girl…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_004.text:
The girl who called herself… A god…
She… spoke to me…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_005.text:
You're safe, Ellie! What a relief…
But… I wonder what that was.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_006.text: And the god's voice that Ellie has supposedly heard…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_007.text:
(Could it be? Could Ellie use the mana flowing within
the Palace as well? You suggest to Prestina this idea.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_008.text:
Perhaps so.
The Cardinal spoke of Ellie as if she too could be a potential God…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0047_009.text:
Are you gonna wait for the world to save itself?
My butt hurts from all this sitting around, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0048_001.text:
Oh, oh… You are foolish indeed to come asking for your own deaths.
Stealing the offerings to my God is serious offense indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0048_002.text:
Your faith… is misplaced.
You cannot serve a god created of your own desire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0048_003.text:
And who is to judge that desire?
Surely not your dead "god," who lets evil fester in this world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0048_004.text:
Humans cannot define evil. It is not our place!
Much less a madman like you -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0048_005.text:
Madman? Madman? 
You speak rashly to the creator of humanity's God.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0048_006.text:
Perhaps it would be better to witness the rising for yourself.
Meet… your new God.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0048_007.text:
My God, my Avenir…
Show God's wrath to these pagans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_001.text:
W-what is that girl? None of our attacks are working!
Can she really be a god? Squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_002.text:
(You notice that she is continuously absorbing
great amounts of mana. You cannot defeat her like this.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_003.text: That mana… Is there nothing to be done?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_006.text:
I… I think I can do something similar to Avenir.
She told me, in my dream…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_007.text:
I'm not sure what mana is, but if I can…
just steal away that power…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_010.text:
But I want to help!
Let me help you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_011.text:
…Alright, Ellie. But you must promise us
to let us protect you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0049_012.text: Okay! I trust that you'll protect me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_001.text:
Father… My… power…
I, I am a God… Why is that girl…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_002.text:
Do not hide, Cardinal.
It is time to repent, o 'Father.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_003.text:
What is the matter, Avenir?
Will you sit still while your father falls in danger?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_005.text:
Hahaha! Well done, Avenir.
You have captured the pagans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_006.text:
Will you… will you truly throw away that child
who looks upon you as a father?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_007.text:
A God… must be a complete being.
And I see that she has not reached that perfection, yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_008.text:
I have no use for incomplete gods. 
Perhaps as material for the perfect God, but no more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_011.text:
Now… Avenir. Why are you so silent?
You must have enough mana to at least speak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_013.text:
This is my last order.
After my departure, self-destruct and destroy this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_015.text:
Overload all the mana circuits,
and destroy the laboratory and the pagans with it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_016.text:
Father…
But… My world… and I….

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_017.text:
Silence, Avenir. As long as I am alive.
I can always make another you again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_020.text:
You are…?
Oh, you possess the same power as "her."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_021.text:
I am her greatest supporter.
It was I who, in both Neth and the Holy City, had -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_022.text: I know what you have done, filthy mortal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_023.text:
W-what…
She--she will never… forgive you for this…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_024.text:
How foolish and meaningless,
the demise of a pawn who knew not that he was a pawn...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_025.text:
You are not a god, human. You were never a god.
It is time you stop this charade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_027.text:
Can you not feel it?
I am a true Goddess, not an imperfect imitation of one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_029.text:
Another… Goddess…?
There can't be any more Elards!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_030.text:
Foolish girl.
Do you truly think there are only the Elards remaining?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_031.text:
That is no matter.
I have business elsewhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_032.text:
I will not let these children be sacrificed here.
I will take them with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0050_033.text:
Ave…Avenir… I, I'm sorry…
I came to help, but… I couldn't help anyone…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_001.text:
Do we really need to meet in this unpleasant place?
I have other halls ready for the occasion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_002.text:
Hrrmph, I find "this unpleasant place" very comfortable,
thank you very much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_003.text:
Well. I do suppose a Ratman in the city at this time
will cause some surprise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_005.text: No one is severely hurt, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_006.text:
I was surprised, Goddess. We had acquired proof 
of the Cardinal's crimes, only to discover you had disappeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_007.text:
Whoever thought that you would already be engaged in battle?
You would have been dead by now, if we had not found you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_008.text:
Perhaps we would have.
We are all indebted to the four of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_009.text: (You ask about what is happening in Trista.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_010.text:
Fortunately, we discovered evidence in Hellad's laboratory
that the Cardinal had been using demonic influences.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_011.text:
We have sent them to the Heaven's Cavalry and the Order. 
The Saintess quashed all opposition that arose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_013.text:
Oh, Roland.
You can't just force people to express their gratitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_014.text:
The Cardinal's death…
How was it announced?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_015.text:
I had it known that he had lusted after the power of demons,
but met his death after failing to control them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_016.text:
We too are unsure of the truth, as of yet.
There is not much to reveal, I fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_017.text: Then what is going to happen to Trista, squeak?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_018.text:
Everybody is in uproar. I fear there may be several revolts
before the end. We have met with His Majesty, but..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_019.text:
I'm afraid I can't tell you much at this point,
as it is confidential information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_020.text: Heehee. That is why I decided to stay here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_022.text:
After all, the Cardinal was still a member of the Order.
We have a responsibility to help the kingdom of Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_023.text:
I will stay as the temporary Cardinal until Trista recovers its peace.
A certain ally in the royal family will be helping, luckily!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_024.text:
Yes… She has been working with us
in opposition to the Cardinal. You can trust her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_025.text:
I too wish to help, but I must return to my own duties.
Thank you, everyone. May Cora bless your endeavors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_027.text:
Rata! Thank you for everything.
I'll come see you again, okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_029.text:
Yes! You're the first friend
that I made in my whole life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_030.text:
Hrrmph. I wanted to go on adventures after this whole mess…
Like the Girl of the Golden Grain and Majerius…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_031.text: I never knew you were so interested in hero stories, Rata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_033.text:
Majerius…? Golden Grain?
Sometimes you talk about such difficult things, Rata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_034.text: Heehee. Humans don't have to know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0051_035.text: Then I guess I'll see you around. Squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_001.text:
… So I see. I cannot approve of your rashness - 
but your courage must be lauded. You have gone through much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_002.text:
Yes…
There are still many problems yet to be solved, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_003.text:
The being who called herself a Goddess…
And the children she took with her…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_004.text:
That being….
No. I shall look into the matter before we discuss it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_005.text:
What about that child? Where will she stay?
She still seems unsure of her own identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_007.text: No, I know who I am!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_008.text:
My name is Ellie!
And I'm {PLAYER_NAME}'s student, and I'm still learning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_009.text:
T-this is me, myself as I am right now!
Right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_010.text:
Oho, {PLAYER_NAME}'s student… I see.
Then I shall entrust Ellie to you, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_013.text:
Hooray! I knew it, I like {PLAYER_NAME} the best!
Oh… {PLAYER_NAME} is my… darling! Yeah!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_014.text: … Where did she learn that word...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0052_015.text:
Rochefort… is not a very good influence.
Haha, I trust you will do good with Ellie, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0001.text:
Where could it be…?
Only with it could I…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0002.text:
Oh, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I trust you have heard the news from Saintess Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0002_1.text:
… I believe I know now. That brutal assailant…
should be my half-brother Cain, shame of the house of Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0002_2.text:
The brother I remember in Cain… was selfish and ambitious.
His capacities only drove him to destructive ends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0002_3.text:
After Cain lost the throne to Abel,
he made a contract with a demon. I pray he has not returned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0002_4.text:
I ask you to see if it is really Cain, this unnamed assailant.
If it is… I shall slay him, for the good of our kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003.text:
As the last heir to the throne, I have claimed responsibility
to the affairs of state, in hopes of settling this turmoil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_11.text:
…Prestina, {PLAYER_NAME}…
I feel sorry for this man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_12.text:
Can't we take him
where he wants to go…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_16.text: After all those years… here I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_2.text:
To be found unconscious in the middle of the city...
Who could he be? What could he be seeking?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_4.text: I do not think he can speak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_5.text:
This man… He is sad… and angry…
I, I can feel him. What he is feeling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_6.text: Do you think… you can find out who he is, Ellie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_7.text:
I, I don't know…
I just feel an immense sadness from him…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0003_9.text:
He-he's very angry. And… he wants something.
He wants to go somewhere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0004.text:
Perhaps it should only be expected in these times, but…
There have been strange rumors as of late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0004_4.text:
He's gone… Yet something about his demeanor bothers me.
Should we follow him, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0004_6.text:
I think he went this way...
Huh? Who's that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005.text:
There is talk of a mysterious assailant, whose appearance
results in the disappearance of another. Please look into this matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
there is too much mana in the air.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_10.text:
…! That… is the royal crest of Trista!
How is it here? It was nowhere to be found within the palace!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_2.text:
We must calm him down!
This is too dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_3.text:
That was close.
It's fortunate that no one is hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_4.text:
… But it seems that.. 
He has left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_6.text:
It's the royal crest of Trista…
Lord Abel must have dropped it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_7.text:
…Let's return this to Ibelin.
I do not think this is ours to do as we will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_8.text:
You've returned. We too have finished
our investigation on the mysterious assailant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0005_9.text:
Fortunately, those "murdered" by the assailant were not
ordinary citizens, but demons in the guise of the Shadow Roses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0006.text:
You return more quickly than I expected.
What have you found?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0006_1.text:
Are you the mercenary troupe
under {PLAYER_NAME}'s command? Indeed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0006_2.text:
I heard about you from the Adventurers' Guild - 
that you are the best to be found in the kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0006_3.text:
I need to find someone.
He has a hat just like mine, and a lovely mustache.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0006_4.text: He was last seen in the Forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0006_6.text:
What? He wasn't in his right mind? Ugh, my fool of a husband
always manages to make trouble for himself…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0007.text:
Do you mean to say that you saw the assailant 
murdering someone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0007_1.text:
Yes, he's my husband, the person I'm looking for.
This isn't the first time he has gone missing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0007_2.text:
We as a couple are adventurers by trade, 
but my husband hasn't had the best of luck up to now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0007_3.text:
He's always getting himself into trouble of some sort.
This time, he touched this cursed artifact he shouldn't have...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0007_4.text:
Please take me to my husband.
I'll bring him back myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0007_5.text:
It seems that my husband will have to rest at home for awhile.
I'll have to work part-time jobs for some time…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0007_6.text:
Wait. Won't you consider hiring me as a mercenary?
I have much experience in adventuring, you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008.text:
If there was a witness, I fear they are not false rumors.
Yet… A brutal assailant… That calls someone to mind…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_1.text:
Is this the chambers of whom they call the strongest hero in Hasla?
Hrrmph, it isn't as,,, filthy as I expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_10.text:
No… It is not the curse I lament.
For the short moment his eyes met mine, I could feel it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_11.text:
That burning of the soul, brilliant even in the darkness…
Yes, he is in love with another. Someone who is not me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_12.text: And he was to be the love of my life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_2.text:
I am the heir of the renowned house of Le Bouer,
Demianne le Bouer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_3.text:
No, you may not call me by my name.
It is Lady le Bouer to you, commoner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_4.text:
I have deigned to visit you in your chambers to make a request.
My affections have found a certain man,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_5.text:
who appears only in the shadows. Yet he appears to be under
some evil spell, and my heart weeps for him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_6.text:
I have learned magic in order to rescue him.
I am certain that we shall be betrothed very soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_7.text:
Now, take me to him - 
the love of my life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_8.text: How… how could my spells not work?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0008_9.text:
His curse was a great one.
No one could have lifted it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0009_1.text:
I cannot retreat like this.
At the very least, I must see for myself who this woman is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0009_2.text:
If she is truly worthy of him, and if their love is true,
I will give them my blessing and leave forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0009_4.text:
…! I felt it!
That woman we just met… She is the one!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_1.text: And yet - they are the very definition of "tragic lovers."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_2.text:
I only wonder how they have come under
such a horrible curse, torn apart from each other

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_3.text:
when even a glimpse at their eyes
reveals the depth of their love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_4.text:
He may not be my own, but I wish to do him good.
If only they could meet each other once more…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_5.text: Can we not bring them back together?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_6.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, why don't we go see
if we can help them? I too feel rather sorry for these lovers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_8.text:
I hope they are happy, for my sake. 
May they receive the blessing of the noble house of Le Bouer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0010_9.text:
Hrrmph. To accept a little sadness for the sake of another...
Do you not think this is true "noblesse oblige"?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_10.text: Thank you for the information, Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_11.text:
It seems more possible that it was the Cardinal who had
Hellad's Book of Magic in his possession. Let's go see Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_2.text:
How have you been?
I too have been quite busy as of late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_3.text:
The kingdom of Trista has much faith in the Order of the Goddess,
however, and most are willing to follow my lead without hesitation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_4.text:
Oh, yes. 
I had a request to make, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_5.text:
While reforming the troupes of Heaven's Cavalry,
we found several soldiers missing from their posts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_6.text: Could you go look for their whereabouts?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_7.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Prestina.
It seems that there is a bigger problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_8.text:
According to the soldiers, the Cardinal himself converted
the members of the Shadow Rose into demons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0011_9.text:
These two only survived
because they fled before their turn came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0012_1.text:
The Cardinal? 
The Book of Magic in his possession?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0012_2.text:
Indeed... The Cardinal and Hellad had been associates.
He could have stolen the Book from her in the ensuing turmoil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0012_3.text:
The Book of Magic should be lying somewhere.
We must retrieve it before it is abused by another.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0012_4.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Prestina.
Go and bring back the Book of Magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0012_5.text:
Are these the remnants of the Book of Magic?
Well done. Deciphering it will take time, but is possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0012_6.text:
Goddess Chronos,
we seem to have another problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_1.text:
There have been people found showing the same signs of 
corruption as those once converted by Sylunis in the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_10.text:
I could not believe it myself at first…
But the fragment you have brought me proves clear evidence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_11.text:
And if the Cardinal had continued Hellad's experiments
after receiving her Book of Magic…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_12.text:
He must have succeeded, to an extent,
seeing there are copies of the work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_13.text:
We must track down the remaining artificial Soulstones
and find out where and why they have spread.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_14.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Prestina.
I will entrust to you this mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_2.text:
Hmm… With no Soulstones or El Thalnos to abuse
the Darkness... someone could be using the Book of Magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_3.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, Prestina,
look into those showing symptoms of corruption.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_4.text: I will decipher this book in the meantime.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_5.text:
You discovered Soulstone fragments from the corrupted?
Give it to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_6.text:
Hm... Could Hellad have been aiming for this all these years…?
It also corresponds with my interpretation of her Book…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_7.text:
I shall be brief.
This Soulstone fragment is artificial. It is not real.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0013_9.text:
Most of Hellad's Book is devoted to the conversion of demons.
Yet it also speaks of the creation of artificial Soulstones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. 
Do you remember the Ratman Enthusiast we met in the sewers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_10.text:
The Darkness of the artificial Soulstones…will spread by water
and continue to corrupt people around the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_11.text:
It seems that we have work to do, {PLAYER_NAME}.
For the people of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_2.text:
When I paid her a visit to check for late symptoms,
she recounted to me what she could remember...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_3.text:
And she spoke of another being in the sewers,
another human who seemed affected by similar symptoms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_4.text:
She says he was a strange man, seemingly afraid 
of many things, including the Cardinal and the sewers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_5.text:
Do you see it, {PLAYER_NAME}?
He may provide the essential piece in our puzzle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_7.text:
The mutation of the Ratmen, the suddenly corrupted people...
Everything has been explained.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_8.text: Everything was due to the Cardinal's pride and madness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0014_9.text:
Fortunately, the Soulstones themselves cannot be abused
as they were failures in the making, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0015_1.text:
I am a Vampire Hunter. Do not ask for my name.
The initial 'P'… is enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0015_2.text:
Oh, I don't kill.
I only hunt.. Vampires. And their hearts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0015_3.text:
I'm going to properly confess this time,
with a beautiful present that will surely capture his heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0015_4.text:
Hence my request: bring me some fresh tomatoes.
Why tomatoes, you ask? Some vampires like them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0015_5.text:
Good, these tomatoes are just as fresh as fresh blood.
No vampire could refuse these.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_1.text:
No, no. I need a present that has more impact,
that gives a bigger "whomp" to the heart…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_2.text:
I heard rumors that vampires like garlic.
I need special garlic that even vampires can eat!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_3.text:
I hear the Goblin Head in the forest is not only strong,
but also a great glutton.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_4.text: Don't you think he would have some special garlic?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_5.text:
…Have you brought the garlic?
It's too late, though… He refused my confession…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_6.text:
He thought I was pathetic for not being strong enough
to confess to him on my own… Boohoohoo…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_7.text:
… Maybe what I lacked wasn't gifts... but strength.
I'll train and become a great hunter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0016_8.text:
And then I'll go and confess again, and I won't fail.
…Hey, won't you accept me into your troupe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0017_1.text:
Hello, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I am a beekeeper who collects and sells honey from the forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0017_2.text:
The recent increase in the number of goblins, however,
have been preventing me from collecting honey as of late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0017_3.text:
If I do not collect enough honey to sell on the market,
my children would have nothing to eat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0017_4.text:
Please drive out the goblins from my side of the forest
so that I can collect my honey in peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0017_5.text:
Thank you.
I'll bring back some honey as a token of my gratitude!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0017_6.text:
What?
My beehives were all destroyed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0018_1.text:
I found my beehives, but they had been destroyed by the goblins.
They had even taken all the royal jelly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0018_2.text: At this rate, I don't think I can stay in this forest any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0018_3.text:
Could you bring back the royal jelly
that those goblins have stolen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0018_4.text:
I need it if I want to make
the forest a stable habitat for my bees.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0018_5.text:
I returned the royal jelly to my bees,
but it'll be some time until I can start beekeeping again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0018_6.text:
I have a final request to ask you:
could I work as a mercenary in your troupe in the meantime?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0018_8.text:
Thank you.
Then I'll see you back at the camp.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0019_1.text:
My tree friends, whom I knew from their time of acorns,
are in pain-oom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0019_2.text:
The goblins are cutting them down
to make their catapults and weapons-oom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0019_3.text:
I ask of you:
punish the catapult goblins who hurt my friends-oom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0019_4.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Yet I have lost everything-oom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0019_5.text: Whyyyy, yooouuu saaaay? Do yoooouu not seeee...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0019_6.text:
I have lost my beard-oom.
My lovely beard!! My beard!!-oom!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0020_1.text:
A strange Elf tried to eat my bark
in the forest today-oom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0020_2.text:
I tried to run away-oom.
She kept chasing me-oom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0020_3.text:
I had no choice but to fight-oom.
But I lost my lovely beard in the fight-oom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0020_4.text:
I kept my bark…-oom.
Yet today I lost my spirit and soul-oom…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0020_7.text: Thank you-tree! It is a lovely mask-oom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0020_8.text:
I have lost my beard-oom, but this mask is good-oom.
I shall stay with you-oom, my newfound friend-oom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_1.text:
No birds can I hunt any more -
An ethical problem, they call it -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_10.text:
I have no use for weak prey -
New prey I shall seek -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_2.text:
Yet I cannot forget-
The ecstasy of the hunt -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_3.text:
It was only through hunting-
that I could find the meaning of my existence-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_4.text:
Hunters who cannot hunt
lose, in the end, their will to live-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_6.text:
And so I thought, in the forest,
there are a lot of goblins, a lot of goblins to hunt -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_7.text:
Bring me the goblins-
I wish- to feel- again - the ecstasy-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0021_9.text:
Goblins are slow -
They bring no life to the hunt-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_10.text:
Did you send them away - away,
{PLAYER_NAME} -?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_11.text:
Must I find another prey to hunt, 
to hunt-?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_12.text:
I shall find a strong opponent 
in YOUR troupe, your troupe -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_2.text:
A monster called Ratman -
It seems stronger than Goblins -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_3.text: Ratmen will be my next prey -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_5.text:
The hunter only feels alive-
when the hunted is strong, a worthy prey -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_6.text:
I only hope that Ratmen are strong enough,
strong enough for me -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0022_9.text:
But why are there no Ratmen,
no Ratmen to be seen-?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0023_1.text:
Hello. You haven't forgotten about me, have you?
Yes, it's THE Demianne le Bouer, of the noble house of Le Bouer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0023_2.text:
How have you been?
I… have been dressing my wounds of unrequited love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0023_3.text:
And my conclusion is that
love comes and goes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0023_4.text:
I must find a new "true love."
One that is much better than the old one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0023_5.text:
Now, you will go with me and see
if there is an eligible candidate for the new love of my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0023_6.text:
Hmm… There is not a single person
for whom I feel a spark of attraction…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0024_1.text:
It's too early to give up.
He may be hiding in the shadows, away from plain sight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0024_2.text:
Now, let's go search for my true love
in these dangerous-looking alleyways!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0024_3.text:
Oh… It was dangerous just now, wasn't it?
Thank you for saving me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0024_4.text:
Wait… What is this feeling…
It can't be…! I… I have feelings for…{PLAYER_NAME}…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0024_6.text:
I realize it now. How could I have been so blind?
My true love had been by my side for all this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0024_7.text:
If it is you, {PLAYER_NAME}, love would transcend all boundaries
of class, age, gender…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0024_8.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}… Won't you accept my heart?
I will be waiting at the camp for your reply.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0025_1.text:
Heya! I'm the Flaming Ninja…I mean, Flamey Ninja!
Heh, I changed my title recently, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0025_2.text:
Anyway, I came here to learn magic.
A ninja learning magic, you say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0025_3.text:
Anything that Stormy Ninja can do, I can do. 
… But I don't have enough time to train.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0025_4.text:
So I came here to ask you for equipment
that may help train magic as quickly as possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0025_5.text:
I hear the Heaven's Cavalry know of a way
to control mana as they wish…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0025_6.text: Well, good! I guess I should start training!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0026_2.text:
Hmm… It can't be me.
It should be type of magic that's the problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0026_3.text:
Yeah… Now that I think about it, it's silly for me,
a lone wolf of the wild, to be learning something like light magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0026_4.text:
I need something… darker… cooler…
Magic just like me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0026_6.text:
Wait, it looks like the magicians in {PLAYER_NAME}'s party
are stronger than the demons who used dark magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0026_7.text:
Okay, it's decided!
I'm going to learn magic as your mercenary from now on!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0026_8.text: Sorry, you don't have a say in this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0027_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, have you ever met a soldier of
the Heaven's Cavalry during your adventures?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0027_3.text:
Ooh, just as I thought! Then could I ask you a favo...
Oh, yeah. Let me introduce myself first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0027_4.text:
I am a craftsman of toy guns. 
You see, I have this model in my mind…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0027_5.text: I need a sample of a gun the Heaven's Cavalry uses, for reference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0027_6.text:
It is my dream to create the best toy gun in the history
of toy guns. Would you acquire for me that gun?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0027_8.text:
So this is the gun of the Heaven's Cavalry…! Thank you!
With this reference, I'm sure I can make the best model ever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME},
could I make one more request?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_10.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, please let me join
your Hero Troupe as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_11.text:
I would do anything to be able to make 
more guns like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_2.text:
I was looking over my model,
when one imperfection caught my eye…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_3.text:
Its shape! Its beauty is lacking - 
See, the line needs to come down like this…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_4.text:
That's why I need a decorative piece
to attach to this part of the gun.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_6.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Now, if you attach this part like this…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_7.text:
Voila!
I've created the toy gun of dreams!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_8.text:
Huh? Why are there real bullets coming out?
I'm sure I made a toy gun, not a real one...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0028_9.text:
But this! This is the REAL deal!
I'm not going to waste my time on toy guns any longer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0029_1.text:
There are still rumors of the Order of the Shadow Rose
lurking in the shadows of the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0029_2.text:
The villagers are cowering in fear,
still remembering their tyrannical rule.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0029_3.text:
I ask for your help in scouting the city district
so that they may sleep in peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0029_5.text:
Alas.
I fear that they are plotting mischief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0030_1.text:
I have been pursuing the Shadow Roses
on my own for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0030_2.text:
The remnants of their Order meet regularly, 
for what I fear to be attempts of revolt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0030_3.text:
My premonition warns me of great danger…
I will inform you of the time and location of the meetings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0030_4.text:
Please defeat the last of the Order of the Shadow Rose
before they put the city in greater turmoil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0030_6.text: Did you see what they were up to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0030_8.text:
A ritual…?
I must look more into the matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0031_2.text:
The rituals that you saw
must have been those to summon the Shadowdemons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0031_3.text:
It seems that there had been more left of the Shadow Roses
than those we had defeated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0031_4.text:
The people are in danger.
Go and stop the Shadowdemons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0031_5.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}!
I am eternally grateful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0031_6.text:
There may be more Shadowdemons remaining.
I shall go and scout the district.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_1.text:
… I hear that you accept any request
that comes your way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_2.text:
I have one of my own.
I am looking for my companion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_3.text:
She has gone on a quest of her own to help a girl…
who turned out to be a friend of ghosts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_4.text:
I heard that one particularly mischievous ghost
has possessed my companion's body,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_5.text:
and no news has been heard from her ever since.
I fear some misfortune may have befallen her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_6.text: Will you find my companion for my sake?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_8.text:
A possession, you say…
Don't ghosts usually like dark places?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0032_9.text:
Have you not found her?
Well - I have collected information on my own as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_1.text:
I met a much renowned alchemist
who professes to know much about spirits and ghosts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_2.text:
He says that ghosts and spirits are
drawn to places with a strong aura.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_3.text: Could there be any such places nearby?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_4.text:
Thank you for rescuing my companion!
She seems to have recovered her senses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_5.text: I have more words to say other than those of gratitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_6.text:
I was inspired by the steadfast attitude you displayed
in carrying out your requests, big and small.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_7.text:
My companion and I wish to join your mercenary group.
We are former soldiers. You will not find our skills lacking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0033_9.text: Mm. I will not let you down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0034_1.text:
A plague virus has made it into the city.
Everyone is in chaos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0034_2.text:
The plague must not spread any further than this.
Will you find its source and stop further outbreaks?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0034_4.text:
Thank you, {PLAYER_NAME}. At the very least,
we don't have to worry about further outbreaks…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0034_5.text: Now I can concentrate on making a cure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0035_1.text:
The plague has mutated,
and the vaccine is not working.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0035_2.text:
I need a pure sample of the plague virus
in order to create a new vaccine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0035_3.text: Please bring back samples of the virus from the sewers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0035_6.text:
With these samples, 
I should be able to make a new vaccine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0036_1.text:
The leftover mana in the Palace
are seeping out to the city!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0036_2.text:
There's no knowing to what effects they will have
I need to investigate further.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0036_3.text:
Will you defeat the mana mass
and bring back its fragments for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0036_5.text: Oho, so this is the mana fragment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0036_6.text:
It's composed of a curious material…!
I'll let you know after I conduct some research!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0037_1.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, the fragment that you brought me
last time did not have enough mana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0037_2.text:
I could not conduct proper research.
Could you bring back another mana-infused object?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0037_3.text:
I must, and I will! …find out the properties of this mana,
once and for all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0037_5.text:
Hmm… The mana here shows different properties
than that of the fragment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SUB_Q0037_6.text:
Two different alignments of mana from one location…
How interesting! It's fascinating!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_002.text:
They confessed that they could not remember anything.
The darkness of the Apostles must have affected their memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_EPIC_QUEST_9_007.text:
Tell me as soon as you finish your preparations.
We shall start out at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_5_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Has it been, what, a hundred years? It is good to see you again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_5_002.text:
Ah! Yes, yes. I have a reason
for searching you out as soon as I came to my senses again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_5_003.text:
I hear there are many who have witnessed my 'shadow' in the Desert.
The shadow of myself as I was when I had lost my mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_5_004.text:
I hear it is quite strong.
Do you have any wish to fight it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SAINT_QUEST_START_5_005.text: As I thought. It should prove to be good training.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_1.text:
Ah, a chest.
Give me a moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_10.text:
And it's just from those chests 
that we can get additional smoke grenades!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_11.text:
…That is rather odd, now that I think about it.
Why are the grenades hidden in these chests?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_12.text:
They were supplied by our secret associate,
so we do not know the exact details, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_13.text:
I hear that that is the only way to smuggle them in 
under the watchful eyes of the Shadow Roses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_14.text:
They are a strange group, the Shadow Rose.
No one knows how they acquired such strong members so quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SELECT_S2_EP1_CH2_3_1_15.text:
From what I hear from our associate, the abilities of each
