she said she learned it all from her older sister.
That thanks to her, she always found work fun and engaging.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_041.text:
She said that her heart races thinking about that
older sister, out in the big world, doing amazing things.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_042.text: I’m not that amazing of an older sister...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_044.text: I didn’t know she thought like that.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_045.text:
I’m sure she’s waiting for you. For you to come back and
teach her all sorts of things and to be together.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_047.text:
I miss PoPo, too.
But I’m still...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_048.text:
Yeah, I’m not saying to meet her right away.
But whenever you’re ready, let me know.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_049.text: If you want I can set up a meeting.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_050.text:
Hmph, wait a minute.
Why are you meddling in our sister affairs?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_051.text: I just want to help you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_054.text:
Why?
Who do you think you are!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_057.text:
Ne-never mind!! Don’t say more!
Just take this ticket and go! Hmph!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_058.text:
This is free just this once!!
Since I was gonna throw it away anyway!!! Got it!?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_060.text:
I’m busy! Super busy!
I’m off to work!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_062.text: I didn’t even get to say thanks for this valuable ticket.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_063.text: You don’t need to be that shy about it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_064.text:
Ah, but this...
is expired. I can’t use it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_001_6_065.text: I should keep this a secret from Nene, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_001.text:
Of course you came, {player_name}! Hehehe!
I knew you would.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_002.text:
Party preparations are all done, we just need to
rehearse. Will you play the role of my partner?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_003.text:
Wait, what? Partner?
You’re telling me you want me to play Achilles?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_004.text:
Yes~ Exactly!
Let’s practice our entrance!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_005.text:
Ah-ha? Wait, seeing your expression...
Is it that?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_006.text:
You wanted to become my “real fiancé,” but
since a role is where it ends, you must be devastated...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_007.text:
Still, at least you got to play the understudy.
That’s still a great honor, is it not? Hehe!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_009.text:
So, in that spirit, could you lend me your arm?
We need to link arms before entering.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_010.text: If I knew it was this, I wouldn’t have come...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_011.text:
Come on, now~
Embarrassment is but a moment! Ohoho!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_013.text:
I grab your arm gently, like this,
and now, we walk this carpet, walking in step with each other.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_014.text:
One step~ One step~
Just match my speed and rhythm~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_016.text: I don’t know why I’m doing this.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_017.text:
You’re doing very well. Now, as we enter, we are going to
look left and right, and wave our hands.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_018.text:
Greeting the people who attended~
Our love receives blessings~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_019.text:
Ohoho! Oh, right right right, when I saw “we”
I mean Achilles and I, you know that, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_020.text:
Even though at this moment I’m walking the carpet with
you, {player_name}, and not Achilles~ sigh...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_021.text:
...
Now that I think about it, why hasn’t Achilles come yet?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_024.text:
Generally speaking, it’s difficult for people who do
grand things to handle every little thing.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_026.text:
...
Mmhm, seeing your expression, I can tell what you’re thinking.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_027.text:
You’re holding back because you’re worried
I’ll be hurt, aren’t you?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_028.text:
It doesn’t make sense, to leave such a beauty.
What is someone steals me away?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_029.text:
Although, if they don’t have a heart as strong as
Achilles’s, they couldn’t even dream of succeeding.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_031.text:
Yes, I know, {player_name}. Even though you too
do grand things, that you rushed to my side to help me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_032.text:
I’m suffering on my own like this because I’m not
Achilles’s top priority, right?...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_034.text: Is this engagement the right thing for me to do?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_036.text:
{player_name}, if it were you... I trust that you’ll
tell me honestly what I should do.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_039.text: You should have a little more faith in Achilles.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_040.text:
You arrived at this decision just now without even
discussing anything with Achilles first.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_041.text:
Since we still don’t know how Achilles
currently feels about you,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_042.text: I think you should trust him and have a conversation.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_043.text:
I see... OK, thank you. I knew you really
treasure me. I’m touched.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_044.text:
I was worried you’d take advantage of this opportunity
to try and convince me to rethink our engagement...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_045.text:
I think... in this state, it may
have been possible to sway me a little! Hehe

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_046.text:
No, no. I truly wish for you to
be happy with Achilles.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_047.text:
OK, you’re saying... seeing me happy
together with Achilles...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_048.text: is the same as your happiness, right? I understand...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_049.text:
Not really, but sure.
So please be happy with him.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_050.text: You poor, sweet man... thank you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_051.text:
Briseis! Are you here? I’m a little late.
I was taking care of some stuff for Hera.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_053.text:
Zeus? What’s he doing here? I didn’t even call him...
Unless... You too, Zeus?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_054.text:
No, Achilles couldn’t make it due to some unavoidable
circumstances, so he sent me to help you instead.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_055.text:
Oh, and did you receive the roses
he sent last time?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_057.text: Yes. Roses. Did you not receive them?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_058.text:
Hasla... then, the person who sent those roses...
Was Achilles?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_059.text:
Of course. The engagement party was upon us, and
he didn’t seem to have much planned.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_060.text:
I mentioned that if I were a man, such things
would be basic for my lady...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_062.text:
Oh, right. Achilles picked them himself!
After much painstaking deliberation.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_063.text:
He said he was too shy and couldn’t bring himself
to give them to you directly.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_064.text:
But, knowing his personality, you know it’s quite a big
deal that he managed to do even that, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_065.text:
Oh ho... you’re right.
Achilles... a bouquet... for me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_066.text:
Wait, but... what’s the urgent matter that’s come up?
Or...has my love found himself in trouble?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_067.text:
Oh~ He saw Athena riding a horse and said he wanted to
win. He fell off his horse, but it’s not a big deal.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_068.text:
What? Fell off his horse?
Oh heavens! Achilles, my love!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_069.text: I must go to him at once!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_070.text: What about the engagement party preparations...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_071.text:
My fiancé is injured and might be crying out for me,
what use is preparing for a party?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_073.text: Achilles!! Wait for me, my love! I’ll be there soon!!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_076.text:
Gone at the speed of lightning.
But, {player_name}, why were you here?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_002_6_077.text:
Good question...
I would also like to know...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_002.text: Kumori’s in a bad mood now!!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_003.text:
Let’s eat cake, Kumori.
It’s a sweet cake!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_004.text:
Come on, it’s your birthday today...
Let’s blow out the candles and have fun, hmm?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_006.text: I’m gonna cover the whole world in rain!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_007.text:
Eek... Ku-Kumori... Look at this...
It’s bubbles... so pretty, right? Hehe...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_008.text:
Let’s play with lightning, Kumori~
You like shiny things~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_010.text:
Don’t try to cheer me up like a baby!
It makes me feel bad! Waaah!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_013.text:
What do we do...
We’re not enough...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_019.text: I think I can figure out what’s going on.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_020.text:
Yeah? Sorry to bother you when you’re so busy.
But you can see why we did, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_021.text:
Do something!
At this rate, Kumori might turn into a ghoul~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_022.text:
What?... {player_name} how are you here?
I told you not to come!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_024.text:
I thought you weren’t coming? Why’d you come?
Do you finally want to play with me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_025.text:
Yes, I’m sorry, Kumori.
When you said it was your birthday, I thought you were joking.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_026.text:
Here, take this.
I brought plenty of cakes.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_027.text:
I even defeated the Boss really quickly,
so I could come congratulate you on your birthday.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_028.text:
Hmph... whatever.
I wanted cakes before, not now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_029.text:
I don’t really feel like eating them right now.
Can’t you tell?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_030.text: Ok then. Let’s eat them later if you feel like it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_031.text:
What about a present? You didn’t come
empty-handed, did you?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_033.text:
Are you dumb?
A gift I don’t want, isn’t a gift at all!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_034.text:
{player_name}, you just gave me that
because you wanted to!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_035.text: Isn’t that what a gift is?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_037.text:
... I guess you’re right.
What do you want to receive as a gift?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_039.text: If I tell you, can you give it to me right away?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_041.text:
Then, promise me you will.
Whatever it is.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_042.text:
OK, I promise.
What do you want to receive?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_043.text: I want to be an adult.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_044.text: Huh? That’s now something I can do.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_045.text:
You promised!
Are you gonna break your promise again?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_046.text:
That’s not possible.
Pick something else.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_047.text: Then you really have to keep this one.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_049.text:
If I call you, you have to come right away!
No matter what!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_050.text:
If I call you, you have to come, and if I tell you to
go, pretend like you’re going, but don’t actually go!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_053.text:
Mmm... that’s a bit... It’s not like I can just come
whenever I want... I have responsibilities, too...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_054.text: Mmm, mmm... Captain... just nod your head.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_055.text: {player_name}, please just say you got it... please...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_057.text: Do you got it or not? Answer me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_063.text:
Moving forward, if you lie or
say bad things, you can’t use the Summon Ticket.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_064.text:
If you promise to meet this, I’ll give you the present
you want. What do you say?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_065.text: Oooh... That {player_name} would give me conditions...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_066.text: There’s nothing I can do if you don’t like it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_067.text: Ugh... if it means you’ll play... with Kumori...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_071.text:
I guess... I could... specially...
use pretty words...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_072.text:
Wow~ Now touch pinkies and seal the pinky promise!
And we’ll be the witnesses of this promise.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_074.text:
Now, Kumori.
Link pinkies, it’s a promise.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_003_6_076.text:
Good~
Now shall we restart your birthday party?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_003.text:
!
You really broke down my door!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_004.text: You told me to do whatever I wante-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_007.text:
Yes.
Ashley gave me these, saying it’s a new product!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_008.text:
They just finished cooking to perfection,
I was just about to take a bite!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_009.text: That means you haven’t had any yet!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_010.text:
There’s still a chance, Captain!
Put down the chopsticks!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_011.text:
I can’t!
I’ve already smelled the noodles!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_016.text: If you get any closer, I’ll drink the broth!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_017.text:
Aargh! No, please! Anything but that!
Do you know how much sodium and flavoring is in the broth?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_018.text:
If sodium levels go up in your vessels,
blood flow rate rises, which increases blood pressure!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_019.text:
The chances of a stroke, cardiovascular,
coronary heart disease, osteoporosis, and cancer all increase!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_020.text: It doesn’t matter! Don’t come any closer!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_022.text:
If you do that,
I’ll present you Hell Squats and 3L of water.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_025.text:
What’s this? It seems like you’d rather suffer
from high blood pressure than do squats?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_026.text:
Do you want to do squats?
Answer me, Captain!!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_031.text: Let go! I said let go!!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_037.text: Sorry. There was a momentary lapse of reason on my end.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_038.text: Is the noodle broth... really hot?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_039.text:
In this very moment...
I can’t feel how hot the broth is.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_040.text:
It won’t do to have you get burned.
Look here, a solution.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_042.text: I’m ashamed to suddenly show you this side of me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_043.text: Do you have some clothes I could change into, Captain...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_044.text:
Uh, yeah, hang on.
I’m not sure I have anything that’s your size.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_045.text: Just give me anything, it doesn’t matter.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_046.text:
Hmm, I don’t really have anything I could give you.
Do you want to wear this, at least?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_050.text: Could you turn around so I can change?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_052.text:
Mmm... anyway... thanks to you blocking it with your
body, you kept me from eating instant noodles. Haha...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_055.text: Are you really gonna make me do this, Captain?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_056.text:
I was born very small and frail,
and had to sweat blood to gain an average physique.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_057.text:
But you could probably get away with
just a little bit of effort...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_058.text: Please at least do the bare minimum...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_059.text: I’m saying this for your own good...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_060.text:
Whew... I’ll be off for today, then.
Being in front of you in this form makes me want to cry.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_062.text: I’m sorry, I was too complacent.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_063.text: I’ll actually make an effort from now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_064.text: So please feel a little better.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_069.text:
Argh! If you use a transformation spell while wearing
my clothes you’ll stretch them out!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_070.text:
Muahahah!!!!
You spilled noodle broth on mine, so let’s call it even.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_071.text:
OK, then.
Since you promised, shall we start working out?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_074.text:
Let’s commence with home workouts from Hell!!!
Muahaahahahah!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_004_6_075.text:
Eergh, I hate this~!
I take back what I just said!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_002.text: Whew, I knew you’d be near a convenience store.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_003.text:
{player_name}?
I was just about to answer you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_004.text:
How did you know where I was?
Do you have super powers?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_006.text:
More importantly, what is the thing you said
you invested in?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_008.text:
What? Royal Beans?
Wait... is this mound... Royal Beans?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_009.text:
Yes! Take a look at this bright exterior.
I heard it’s a rare bean only offered to elf royalty.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_010.text: I bought this very valuable bean at a very good price!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_011.text:
Hang on... hold on. You’re telling me you took out
a loan and bought Royal Beans?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_013.text:
Since it’s a rare item that sells for a very high price,
once everything sells, I should turn a profit!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_014.text:
This is the freaking best!
An easy life is the best life~!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_015.text:
No... Sigh...
Where did you learn that phrase...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_016.text:
From a regular at the convenience store.
They use the phrase often.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_018.text: Uh-oh, is freaking a bad word?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_019.text:
No, it’s not that...
It’s true Royal Beans are a demanding and rare variety, but

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_020.text:
not long ago,
A friend named Linné researched and shared a method of cultivation.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_021.text: So they don’t fetch as high a price anymore.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_022.text: Whaat?! Does that mean I’ve been scammed again?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_023.text:
Yeah. Do you remember what the person who sold them
to you looked like, or anything else about them?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_024.text:
She was cloaked, so I don’t remember her appearance.
But, I do remember she had a very bright, female voice.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_025.text:
What do I do...
If I don’t pay back this loan, I signed a contract saying I’ll work for free for 10 years.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_026.text:
The conman tricked me into signing, saying
it was necessary documentation...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_027.text:
They also told me to just keep in mind that
the interest is 500%.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_028.text:
What? The situation has really gotten worse.
Ha, let’s first think of a way to pay back the money.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_029.text:
What do I do? If I sell these beans as they are,
I won’t even be able to make back the money I spent, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_030.text: Yeah, not like this you won’t.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_031.text:
Then what if I plant them using that cultivation method
you mentioned earlier, and increase the amount I have?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_032.text: It’s a decent idea, but it would take a while.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_033.text:
Did you say interest is 500%? I think you’re going to
owe a lot more than the initial amount...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_034.text:
Uh... I don’t want to labor for 10 years...
I’d rather just eat these and die. I need some bean recipes.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_035.text:
I do know a few tasty recipes...
Oh, what am I saying.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_036.text:
Don’t escape reality. Let’s try my idea. We’re going to
can these and sell them to the Grancia military.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_037.text: I’ll look for someone to be in charge of delivery,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_038.text:
Ashley, you ask your boss at the convenience store about
putting you in touch with food processing companies.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_039.text:
Then, you should be able to make back at least a little
bit of the initial amount.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_041.text:
It feels like I am always finding myself more and
more indebted to you, {player_name}.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_042.text:
I don’t know what I would have done if you weren’t here,
{player_name}... I’m so thankful for you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_043.text: Thank me after we figure this business out.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_044.text:
Next time, please make sure to discuss with someone
before making any decisions, OK?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_005_6_046.text:
Yes, of course. I pinky promise~
Thank you, my trustworthy problem-solver, {player_name}!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_001.text:
Ah, ah, I see.
You’re here, {player_name}!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_002.text:
I knew you’d come, so
I’ve done all the prep for the stew broth.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_005.text:
You need to learn~! Come on!
Roll back your sleeves!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_006.text:
I’ll first teach you about draining the blood
from the meat!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_008.text:
Hmm? What.
You haven’t changed your mind, have you?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_009.text:
No, no. I came to tell you I have no intention of taking
over your stew restaurant.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_010.text:
Oh, is that so?
That’s a pity.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_011.text:
I thought it would be perfectly suited for you, Captain
{player_name}. What a shame~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_012.text: Sigh~ What should I do now...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_013.text:
It’s beyond my power to keep
running this place on my own.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_014.text:
And I can’t bear to keep turning away my regulars coming
in to buy five-colored songpyeon empty-handed...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_015.text:
And what about my new creation, ‘stir-fried seasoned
tteok,’ that hasn’t even seen the light of day yet...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_016.text: Sigh... is there no way to please everybody?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_017.text: Can’t you just hire a lot of employees?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_018.text:
It’s not that I haven’t tried that,
everyone just quits after a few days because it’s too hard.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_019.text:
No one’s lasted. I mean, it’s definitely not for people
with just average stamina.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_020.text:
Hmm~ Is there no worker out there,
in good physical health, that I could hire~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_021.text:
{player_name}~ I know you can’t take the restaurant
off my hands, but could you at least help me out?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_022.text:
Of course.
Since I’m here, I’ll help you out today.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_028.text:
Oh no, you dropped all the blood!
What am I gonna do with you~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_029.text:
Bring stuff to clean this up with!
It’s over there!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_033.text:
Aigoo! You broke all the pots!
Are you alright???

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_034.text:
You know what...
Just stay still, that’s how you can help me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_038.text:
No, no!
What is all this ruckus!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_040.text:
What’s this? {player_name}?
Why are you wearing kimchi juice!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_041.text:
Halla... what brings you here?
As you can see, I had a bit of an accident.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_042.text:
I asked for some help around the kitchen,
and now we’re in this pickle.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_043.text: Whew, when are we gonna clean all this up?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_044.text: Hmm, I think I can help with this situation!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_045.text:
How will frail little you help?
I’m worried about you making a bigger mess.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_046.text:
Pooey, such harsh words,
I’m not that weak.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_047.text: However, you do make a good point...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_048.text:
This mess does seem a bit big for me to
clean up by myself! Hehe...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_049.text:
Phew, but of course. Better to die than suffer! Everyone
move out of the way! I’ll do it myself.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_051.text: My friend, Sansami, will lend a hand!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_052.text:
Sansami?
Erm... Sansami is going to help?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_053.text:
Yes! That’s right!
Sansami has an amazing skill!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_056.text: I have a favor to ask.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_057.text:
Yes! Don’t worry, Captain {player_name},
how about you just worry about cleaning yourself up?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_058.text:
Alright, alright.
You go wash up and get some rest~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_059.text:
Thanks for coming. Let me take care of this and I’ll
message you some other time!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_060.text:
OK...
I’m sorry I couldn’t be of help.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_061.text:
No, no. It was enough that you cared~
Get home safe~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_062.text:
Sansami, please do your best.
I’m off, then.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_065.text: ‘I Want To Know This’ is on.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_067.text: Hello, reporting for ‘I Want To Know This.’

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_068.text:
In today’s broadcast, the amazing secrets of a
mysterious stew restaurant that makes even blind eyes sparkle!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_069.text:
OK, the place we’ve arrived at is that magic
stew restaurant.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_070.text:
As you can see, this restaurant has a constant
stream of bustling customers.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_071.text:
The long waiting line,
it looks to be well over 90 li.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_073.text: Oh my goodness? Everyone, look over there!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_074.text:
It’s wild ginseng... and they’re moving!
One, two, three... huh? There are so many I can’t count them!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_075.text: How are they moving in such orderly fashion?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_076.text: Ah-ha! Everyone! Look above the yard!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_077.text:
A ginseng, one that looks different from the others is
standing above the yard, leading the other ginsengs!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_079.text:
Huh? That person seems to be the owner of this
establishment.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_081.text:
Even the ginsengs, who were bustling about,
are saluting the owner in unison?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_082.text:
I will conduct an interview with the owner in
just a moment!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_083.text:
Hello! It seems you’re very busy, but could we
have a short interview?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_084.text:
Huh? Sure!
Sansami! I’m counting on you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_085.text:
Then, shall we go over there for a moment?
What do you want to know? Go ahead and ask now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_086.text:
Judging from the people outside, you have a lot of
customers! What’s the secret to your successful business?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_087.text:
Secret? Hmm... secret... Well...
I haven’t really thought about it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_088.text:
People say that after eating this, they feel full and
warm. A surge of energy courses through them all day.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_089.text:
Adventurers come in and get energy to go back out
there-- well, they seem admirable, and I feel grateful.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_090.text:
Maybe that’s why. Because I think of it as food that
will go into the belly of admirable people,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_091.text:
so I just pour ingredients in there,
and give them mounds of rice.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_092.text:
I see.
Maybe the secret is your generous heart.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_093.text:
Rumor has it your stew opens the eyes of blind people
and crippled people get up and dance. Is this true?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_094.text:
I’m not sure if it’s real or not. But I do have less
wrinkles and my hair is simply oozing with luster.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_095.text:
I think... and this is a secret.
Come closer for a second...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_097.text:
Those ginsengs over there... their ‘talent’... in the
stew... That’s all I can say.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_098.text: Do you kind of understand what I’m getting at?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_099.text: Oh ho... yes, I think I do.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_100.text:
I heard this used to be a tteok restaurant.
Do you not sell tteok at all anymore?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_101.text:
Tteok! No, no!
Aigoo, of course! I should say this since I’m on the air!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_102.text:
40-year-old tradition, Malsook’s tteok!
Is on sale again~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_103.text:
The tteok shop next to the stew restaurant is the
original. So, stop by after your meal for some dessert~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_104.text:
Our specialties are soybean injeolmi and
five-colored songpyeon~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_105.text:
From the knowledge we gained from running a stew
restaurant, I’ve come up with new items for tteok, too~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_106.text: Could you give us some examples?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_107.text:
It’s my new ‘stir-fried seasoned tteok,’ with gochujang
and starch syrup~ Stew comes as a side. Try it

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_108.text:
Oh~ stir-fried seasoned tteok, I can’t wait to try some.
I think I’ll pop by after this interview.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_109.text:
Thank you for doing this interview even though
you’re so busy.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_111.text: Yes, do you have anything else you’d like to say?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_112.text:
Since I’m going on air... can I record a message for
someone? I’ve always wanted to do something like this!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_113.text: Sure~ Please give us a short message.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_114.text:
Hmm...
{player_name}! It’s me! I’m on TV~~ Are you watching~~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_115.text:
You said before that you like this program, right~~?
I remember~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_116.text:
Um, I think you stick around because I play So Yeon Ha
for you when you’re having a hard time~~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_117.text: I’m thankful for all the help you given me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_118.text:
Come by and try some stir-fried seasoned tteok
when you have the time!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_119.text:
It’s spicy, and I’ll serve you up a delicious plate!
Come visit~~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_120.text:
Thanks for the interview. This concludes the interview.
Signing out for ‘I Want To Know This’ for today.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_121.text:
Seems like everything’s been resolved well.
I should text her to say I enjoyed the episode.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_006_6_122.text:
Actually, should I just head over there now?
I could tell her in person and try the new dish.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_001.text:
Ha! Captain {player_name}!
What took you so long!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_002.text:
It’s a good thing I didn’t hold my breath
waiting for you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_004.text: Fine. You’re here, that’s what matters!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_006.text: We made up, you see, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_007.text: So please, give me some stew now!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_010.text:
To start, 3 bowls of oxblood soup and one bowl of
pork and rice soup!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_011.text:
You know it won’t do to have my oxblood soup go cold,
so bring them out one bowl at a time! No pauses!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_012.text: I got it, you two better not fight today!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_013.text: And don’t go around bothering other tables!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_014.text:
Alright, alright! I got it so hurry!
Oh, and lots of kimchi, ok?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_016.text: Get your own kimchi from now on!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_017.text:
You know I can’t go in the kitchen!
Gimmie!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_019.text:
Gimmie!
It’s all thanks to me that you’re doing so well!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_020.text:
Oh, and since I came with Captain {player_name},
I want that special toryeom treatment!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_021.text:
Aigoo you’re such a nuisance!!
Just eat it like a normal person!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_023.text: She talks like that, but she’s really nice to me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_025.text:
You don’t even know what toryeom is?
You have so much to learn.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_026.text:
It’s when you ladle broth over rice repeatedly
to warm it up.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_027.text: Why would you do all that?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_028.text:
Ha, as if you’d understand even if I told you!
Just trust me and try it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_030.text:
I toryeom-ed it, so hurry up and eat and get outta here!
Not that it even matters, such a bother.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_032.text:
Hurry, try some, {player_name}.
It’s pork and rice soup.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_033.text:
Even though the oxblood soup is super rich here,
starting off with the pork n rice isn’t bad, either.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_038.text: Ok, fine, it’s yummy. Bon appétit!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_040.text: If you’ve tried the broth as is,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_041.text: try it after adding some kimchi in!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_044.text: What are you doing to someone else’s food?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_045.text: This really enhances the flavor of the kimchi!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_046.text: Argh, I liked the flavor as it was!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_047.text:
Trust me, this kills!
Just trust me one time!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_048.text: Kills what?! Arghh!!! Don’t stick your spoon in my face!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_051.text:
Sigh... I guess there’s no use fighting it.
Just this once.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_054.text: What the... Why is it good?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_056.text: I told you it was foolproof!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_059.text: Now you mix it with some of this oxblood soup...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_061.text: I told you I don’t like oxblood soup!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_063.text: If you mix it like this,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_064.text: there’s no way it doesn’t end up tasty!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_065.text: What have you just mixed into my stew!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_067.text: Ahh! That’s it! I can’t stand it anymore!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_068.text: I’m not eating it! I won’t!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_069.text: Uh, you really aren’t going to eat it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_070.text:
Fine! Do you know how valuable this is? It’s your loss
if you don’t eat something this delicious! Not mine!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_072.text:
Give it here, I’m gonna eat it all!
Tasteless fool!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_073.text: This isn’t a delicacy! It’s a disgrace!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_075.text:
Hey! I told you doofuses to not pick up the bowls and
start fighting, didn’t I?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_007_6_077.text:
If you’re going to constantly come in here and fight,
you can both get out!!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_002.text:
This copycatting rascal! Of course he would be here!
Hey you! Let’s you and me have a chat!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_003.text:
Aigoo, you cutie! You came!
I’ve heard a lot about you from Auntie Malsook!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_004.text:
Do you want a bowl of stew? This here Uncle
will treat you to one.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_005.text:
You insolent fool!
Who are you saying is my uncle?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_006.text: I’m your elder, so show me some respect!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_007.text:
Ahahaha! Would you look at this adorable fellow!
A very cute child, indeed! I like your vigor!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_008.text: You... you fool! Don’t pinch my cheek! Yeowww!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_009.text: Aigoo, sorry, sorry. I didn’t pinch you that hard.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_010.text:
Oh, {player_name}, you came too?
Auntie! Three bowls of stew here, please!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_011.text:
Ugh, why have you lot gathered here again?
I’m so tired of it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_012.text:
Err... everyone stop! Eyes on me.
I came because I have something critical to ask!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_014.text:
Malsook!
Decide, right now, is it me or Anton?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_015.text:
What kind of nonsense is this, I’m busy!
If you’re going to spout nonsense, get out of here!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_016.text: If you don’t decide, I’m taking Sansami back.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_018.text: Sigh, why are you putting me on the spot like this!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_019.text: Is it me or Anton? Answer! Hmm?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_020.text:
Uhh, I can’t answer this! You both annoy the heck out of
me! I like Captain {player_name} the best! Got it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_022.text:
Uh... hmm?
That answer wasn’t part of my plans...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_023.text:
What about you then, Captain?
And you can’t answer with Malsook!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_026.text: That’s not allowed! You’re a traitor, Captain!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_028.text:
Then... the person who likes me the most here is...
is there truly no one? Sniff...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_029.text:
I hate all of you!! Eungaram was right when he said
humans can’t be trusted! Waah~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_030.text:
Ah~ This stings my pride a little.
Hey, little boy, how about we team up instead of fighting?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_031.text:
It’s so rude that Auntie and Captain are treating us
this way. Don’t you think?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_032.text:
Hmm... how rude!
I’ve been stabbed by my own sword!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_033.text: Ha~ Yeah, they don’t know the value of people.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_034.text:
How much money have I made you, Auntie~
You always just tell me to stuff it and get out! It hurts me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_035.text: Hoo... she said that to me, too!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_037.text:
You too, Captain~ I told you I would treat you. You
didn’t eat it without complaint once! You’re too cruel.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_038.text: Hoo... he did that to me, too!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_040.text:
They don’t even know the value of the people who follow
them! Do you think those people have no feelings?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_041.text: I’m tired of you saying you’re busy!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_042.text:
Yeah...! It’s all true!
You and I have the same thoughts!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_043.text: Right! I guess we understand each other!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_044.text:
My goodness, what are you two doing?
There are people here!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_046.text:
Yeah, you butt out, Auntie!
The men are having a sincere conversation.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_047.text:
You... I thought you were just some outsider who was
taking what was mine, but you’re quite alright!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_048.text:
Muahaha! An outsider? Then, what are you, a native?
You little scoundrel! Noogie! Wahaha!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_049.text:
Waah~! Stop!!! I told you I’m your elder! Why won’t you
listen to me~ And here I thought you’re an OK guy~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_050.text:
Huh? Hohoho~ Sorry. You’re just too cute. Do I look like
a child? Why do you think you’re my elder?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_051.text:
I, Anton, may look like this, but I’m 34 years old!
So? Are you still going to claim you’re my elder?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_052.text:
Anton you scoundrel! I’ve lived a good 6 times more than
you! You new born baby! Stop acting up!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_053.text:
Huh?? Six times??
Why you~~ This little rascal is a little bluffer! Haha!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_054.text:
Halla is right.
He looks like a little baby now but,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_055.text: even just 20 years ago, he was a shaggy mountain tiger.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_056.text:
Huh? You mean he’s not a child?
Ohho~ It’s hard to believe but since you say so, I’ll suppose it’s true.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_057.text:
Although, it’s not something unfathomable to an immortal
such as myself. You, child, must be similar to me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_058.text: I keep telling you I’m not a child!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_059.text:
Oh right, since you are my elder, I should show proper
decorum. I’m sorry about the noogie earlier, sir!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_062.text: Yes! Treat me as a brother!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_064.text:
Coming to ‘Han’ all by myself as I did, I had no proper
friends other than Auntie Malsook, you see.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_065.text:
But now that I have you, I feel supported!
Now, to celebrate us becoming best buddies, let’s have a bowl!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_066.text:
Sure, let’s have a bowl.
Malsook! Stew, please!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_068.text: A spoon for my new big bro!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_071.text:
Huh? You’re going to feed me? Wait! Remove this spoon!
I can feed myself!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_072.text: Come on~ Don’t be like that~ Now ahh~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_073.text:
Uh... umm... who let you...! Nom... Into someone’s mouth
just as you please... nom... ooh... It’s tasty...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_074.text:
Ahaha! I’m glad you eat well!
Now the broth too~ Slurp it~ Good!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_076.text: Ahaha! Is it to your taste?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_077.text:
Uh... yeah... It’s a very deep flavor! What do you mix
into your stew...? Are you not going to share...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_078.text:
Kha~~~ You’re curious about this? You have discernment.
I’ll mix this up for you, too. It’ll be fantastic!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_079.text: Yes... make it for me, too, child.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_080.text:
Yes, brother, so this is~~~~
You add this and mix it~~~~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_083.text:
Whew, so rowdy. How’d they become friends? What a twist!
Those two will probably be regulars now. I can tell.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_084.text:
...
Still, it looks like everything’s been resolved well?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_085.text:
Yeah~ Better than them going at it. Sigh! You must be
exhausted, {player_name}, always caught between them.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_087.text:
Hey~ {player_name}! Aren’t you eating? Eat with us.
You’re a little insolent but I’ll let you join.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_008_6_088.text:
Yeah, Captain is insolent, but hurry and sit down!
It’s not tasty when it cools!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_001.text:
Ouch! Let go of that!
It took ages to style it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_003.text:
What are you even talking about?
You’re so rude!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_006.text:
You cursed me to have my appendix burst, didn't you?!
I know everything!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_007.text:
What are you saying out of the blue?
I heard from others many times, but are you truly so rude?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_008.text: Bubble tea tastes good. Yum yum.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_009.text:
Meri, you were here too.
Don't just stay quiet, do something...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_010.text:
Hmph, why should I?
Aren’t you here to help, {player_name}? You do something about it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_011.text:
Whew, okay, that’s enough!
No violence! You two, stop it now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_012.text: Let go of me! I’m going to take her appendix off!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_013.text:
Let go of my hair! You shouldn't exert yourself like
this, especially after surgery!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_014.text:
Look at this one, pretending to be concerned. How
pathetic. Think you can get away with this?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_015.text: I've always disliked those creepy people from Ryu.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_016.text:
They pretend to be innocent on the outside
and never really show what they’re thinking inside.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_017.text:
Goodness, making such a discriminatory remark about
a specific country!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_018.text:
Things like that should never be made public!
You should always be cautious about your words and actions!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_028.text: What is that, Meri? Why do you...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_032.text:
Well...
You went around saying you were the second Cano...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_033.text:
There is only one Cano...
You’re a fake, and you’re degrading Cano...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_034.text:
W- what?
You put a curse on me for that reason?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_035.text:
Yes, but I regretted it.
I shouldn’t have cursed you to have your appendix burst.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_036.text: Oh, so you felt sorry after it happened?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_037.text:
No.
Cano went to see you because you were hospitalized.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_038.text:
How dare you receive care from Cano.
That’s unforgivable.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_039.text:
What?! Cano did come to see me, but I didn’t receive
any care! I didn’t even ask her to come?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_040.text:
I can’t believe you went so far as to put a curse on me
for such a reason?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_041.text:
You’re done. I’ll make sure you can’t sing. I’ll destroy
you so you’ll never be called Cano’s friend again!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_042.text:
Hmph, bring it on! I was tired putting little curses on
you, anyway. Let’s finish it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_044.text:
Oh, don’t worry, {player_name}.
I have taken measures!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_046.text:
Oh, the journalist is here!
I’m right here!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_047.text:
Oh, you're here. I’ve come after receiving a tip-off.
I'm a reporter from ‘I Want to Know This.’

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_048.text:
Would you like to do a short interview on the topic of
#"The Artist After the On-Air Sign Goes Off”#?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_050.text:
Yes, of course! When we're not on air, we enjoy drinking
bubble tea together and having casual conversations.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_051.text:
Yuna here, Meri, Cano, and Uzume, which is myself!
We’re the bubble tea time members.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_052.text:
The three of us were having a small party
to celebrate Yuna’s discharge from the hospital.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_053.text:
Okay. “4 bubble tea members.” Sounds awesome! If you
work together as a team, the fans would love it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_054.text:
Oh! That’s something we should discuss. But if the fans
want to see it, it might be possible, right? Hehe.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_055.text:
Great. Thank you.
I hope to see that happen one day!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_056.text:
Before we conclude the interview, I kindly request a
commemorative photo. Say cheese!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_060.text: *whispers* We’ll have the duel another time...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_009_6_061.text: *whispers* That’s what I wanted. You’re dead, Meri...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_002.text:
Whew... Why are you here?
Don’t try and stop me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_003.text: This is the only way to make big money.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_004.text:
What’s gotten into you?
Why do you need money?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_005.text:
Because I need to purchase this agency. This is the
fastest way to gain control of the management.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_007.text:
I’m really going to do it.
Managing for Cano.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_008.text:
I’m all qualified, but don’t have money.
Hm... Do you have some money to invest, {player_name}?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_009.text:
If you're talking about buying such a big company
with money, no.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_010.text:
You don’t need to run away.
I wasn't expecting anything from you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_011.text:
Yes. It would be more meaningful if I bought the company
with my money and did what I want.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_012.text:
Are you serious?
Management wasn’t where your dream was, I suppose.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_013.text:
My dream? Cano is my only dream. Management is just
a means. Here, take a look.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_015.text: CNB 1st Class, Hasla’s international cuisine, barista and pastry, nutritionist, beautician, skincare specialist, colorist, office automation industrial engineer, wallpapering technician, jewelry appraiser, photography technician,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_016.text: nursing, sports massage therapist, rehabilitation therapist, motorcycle license, four-wheel carriage driving license, bulldozer operating technician, aircraft operation license, and recently obtained financial planner certification, and more.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_018.text:
CaNo Band Test 1st Class.
It's an official test to verify if you know everything about the band.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_019.text:
Of course, I’ll get a perfect score. Plus, I'm secretly
on the question-setting committee.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_020.text: What about cuisine? You like cooking?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_023.text: I can’t feed Cano with bad and unhealthy food.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_025.text:
If Cano moves, you can't just leave wallpapering
to a stranger, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_027.text:
Talking to you is exhausting
because I have to explain everything.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_028.text:
The beautician license is required in case Cano's makeup
artist goes missing, and someone needs to step in.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_029.text:
Rehabilitation therapy and nursing certifications are
there in case Cano’s health declines.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_030.text:
Different driver's licenses just in case Cano's driver
has a sudden schedule issue.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_031.text:
So you’re saying you got all of the licenses for Cano,
even if you don’t know when you’ll need them?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_032.text:
Let’s say that’s true, but what about bulldozer
and aircraft licenses?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_033.text:
Aircraft are used for military purposes only, right?
Is it to prepare for war or something?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_034.text:
If you get fans, you get haters.
I might just get rid of all of...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_035.text: Woah, woah! Okay, I got it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_036.text:
You got all the licenses just for Cano,
not knowing you’d actually use them?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_037.text:
Yes.
Now I’ll buy this company and give Cano wings.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_038.text:
Cano should have no trouble reaching great heights with
such talent. I’m the only one who can and nurture it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_039.text:
Going these lengths outside your day job... I think it
may be possible for you to really buy the company.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_040.text:
Isn’t that obvious? I wouldn’t have started if it was
going to be all talk.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_041.text:
Well, if you like Cano that much,
why don’t you try getting closer to her instead?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_042.text: It’s a lot easier that way, isn’t it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_043.text:
You know, it's not just about fulfilling my own desires.
I want to make Cano the biggest star in Hasla.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_044.text:
It's not some petty desire to get close to Cano
and monopolize her for myself.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_045.text:
Alright, back to the point. Just tell me how to vote for
the Hero Town popularity contest, okay?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_046.text:
Whew.. Okay, okay.
Where should we start?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_010_6_047.text:
From beginning to end.
You’re not going home until I fully understand it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_001.text:
Mmm... are you here?
I was waiting...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_002.text: Where did I put the gold again...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_003.text:
Uh, did you forget where you put it? There’s no rush so
you can just give it to me once you find it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_004.text:
Oookay, later, slowly... 
You said you’re hungry, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_005.text: Yes, I haven’t had anything to eat since breakfast.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_006.text:
That worked out well, I happen to have a lot of
#experimental food# at home... hoohoo...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_007.text:
Ah... no... umm... there’s a lot of yummy food.
Have some since you’re here.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_008.text:
Oh, what’s the occasion? You used to just eat mint
chocolate because you were too lazy for all of this.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_009.text:
Ahh... I’ve been testing cooking alchemy recently.
You just put cooked ingredients into a jar and voila...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_010.text: Ta-da~~ I meant it when I said a lot.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_011.text:
Oh, that really is a lot. Good timing, too, I was
starting to feel peckish. It smells good, too. Looks good.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_012.text:
Mm... really? I guess appearance is a pass...
Good, I’ll keep making this from now on... now taste it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_013.text:
?
Thanks for the food. Now then...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_014.text:
Mmm...?
Uhh the taste of this...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_015.text:
What is it? Does it taste awful? Are you cursing me for
calling you to my home under the guise of food?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_016.text:
Ah... no, it’s not that bad...
It’s a little strange, but edible.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_017.text:
Strange?
I copied the alchemy book exactly.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_018.text:
Mmm... if it doesn’t taste good, don’t eat it...
I can just feed it to my clones #nom nom#...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_019.text:
... No, it’s not NOT tasty.
Don’t worry about it. But what went in it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_022.text:
Mmm... best you don’t know...
It’s just healthy things.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_023.text: It does taste healthy... Thanks for the food.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_025.text:
I’m done eating! It’s been a while since
I ate so much! Thanks.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_026.text:
Are you done eating?
Then, try something else.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_027.text:
My most #ambitious work#... It’s Dragon Soup,
simmered a long time with mystical water.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_029.text: If you can’t eat it, I can just feed it to a dog...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_030.text:
Ahh, ok, ok! But... won’t you eat some with me?
It’s a little much to eat by myself, plus it’s a little weird.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_031.text: I don’t eat food unless it’s been thoroughly checked...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_033.text:
Ah... what I meant was, before you came,
I already had a cup of mint chocolate, so I’m full.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_034.text:
A cup? That’s not much.
Hasn’t it almost been digested by now?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_035.text:
Ah umm... I have a very small stomach...
That’ll last me like two days...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_036.text:
Ah... I’m also full. Then, shall I teach you how to
use your Oztalk device while we digest?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_037.text:
You have to eat it now to really taste it... If you’re
really too full, I’ll throw it in the pumpkin patch...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_038.text:
No, I think I can eat it.
I’ll eat it so don’t throw it out.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_039.text: Really? Do you really think you can eat it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_040.text:
If you can’t eat it my plans will be ruined...
I mean I would be sad...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_042.text:
OK, now I’m really full, haha. I can’t eat anymore.
Thanks for all the food.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_043.text:
Hehe, I guess this one’s a pass since you finished it...
Wait here, I’ll bring out the next experiment...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_044.text:
Where are you going, Vesper? I’m a little nervous.
Why do you keep calling them ‘experiments?’

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_045.text:
Vesper?
Are you going to the kitchen?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_046.text:
Hello, Vesper?
No, please. Don’t come out with anything...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_047.text:
It’s time for dessert!
It’s improved fruit I grew with magic.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_048.text:
Vesper, I’m really too full to eat anymore.
I have no space left in my stomach.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_049.text:
Fruits are mostly water, so if you chew them
they’ll fit.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_050.text: Ugh, no. There’s no space for even water.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_051.text: You can’t stop. You need to finish this.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_052.text:
Now this is really weird. You’re not feeding me this
because you want to, you’re scheming something.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_053.text: Wh-why would I do that? I want to feed you...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_054.text:
Then, I’ll take it home.
I need to head home anyway.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_055.text:
Huh? You’re leaving already? Why don’t you stay here
the night, eat breakfast tomorrow, then leave?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_056.text: There are still so many things waiting for you to taste!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_057.text:
There’s still a mountain of food left
that you have to eat.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_058.text: And you haven’t received your gold yet.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_059.text:
Now, hurry and eat. Taste it and tell me if it’s
something a human could eat!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_060.text:
Uuh, oh... misery... why me... Let’s just call it even
because of all the food, please just let me go home...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_062.text:
No. I don’t want to... I don’t want more...
I can’t have more!!! Take it away!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_064.text:
Wait... what’s this paper?
Is the reason why you fed me so much...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_066.text:
Aw... you figured me out...
I really wanted to beat Shasha this time...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_067.text:
Since I got caught anyway, taste the fruit and
rate the taste...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_011_6_068.text: Aahh, no! I don’t want more!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_001.text:
I had my suspicions, but it is really you,
{player_name}. It’s an honor to meet you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_003.text: Are you here for the transaction?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_005.text:
Yes? COUGH COUGH. Ah yes, I am. Hahaha... That’s my
online name. Yes. Let me apologize first.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_006.text:
I sincerely apologize! I was very sick that I
couldn’t answer your messages.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_008.text:
Yes yes, you’re right.
I was really on the brink of death. Whew~

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_009.text:
If you don't believe me, want to go to the hospital
where I was admitted and have the doctor there confirm it?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_010.text:
The doctor may be off by now, but I think if we go and
explain the situation, he might come out again.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_011.text: I feel somewhat uneasy but will let it go.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_012.text:
Whew, thank you very much.
Just like your reputation, you have a broad understanding.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_013.text: I knew it. It’s very kind of you, {player_name}.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_014.text:
Since I brought the item, how about we forget about the
past and proceed with a fresh, clear transaction?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_015.text:
Show me the item first. I’ve had some negative
experiences with you, so I can’t fully trust you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_016.text:
Oh yes, of course. It's only natural and proper.
Here it is. The discontinued Hades’ Ring, correct?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_017.text:
Is it really real?
I heard that there are often fakes, so please let me look closely.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_018.text:
You’re very meticulous.
Here is the warranty, so please have a look.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_019.text:
Check the dates and serial number. You know the
product’s been discontinued and it’s hard to get.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_020.text:
Hm, so it is real.
Good. I made the payment, so give it to me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_021.text:
Yes, then there are no further issues between us.
Correct?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_022.text: I received the item, so yes.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_023.text: Oh, by any chance, are there still any markers left?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_025.text: Hm? You said you were selling markers.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_026.text:
Oh, is that so? I think you’ve got the wrong seller.
I’ve decided to focus on my main job,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_027.text:
so I won’t do second-hand transactions anymore.
Please keep that in mind~!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_028.text: I’m a bit busy, so I’ll be on my way!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_029.text:
...
I’ve got the wrong seller? It’s not possible.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_031.text: How did it work, Secretary Golden?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_032.text:
Whew, Boss.
I quickly handed over the item and left!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_033.text:
I had no idea that the annoying buyer
was really Captain {player_name}!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_034.text:
It could’ve become such a hassle.
{player_name} is way more nitpicky than I thought.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_035.text:
If they kept digging into my identity, it’d be a real
headache. I confirmed the deposit. That was close!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_036.text:
Yes, I’m relieved that it’s been resolved when it
could still be covered up.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_037.text:
Nice job, Golden.
And you returned with the ring, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_038.text:
Huh? No... I gave it to them exactly as it was.
...It wasn’t a counterfeit?!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_039.text:
Uh-what?! But that was REAL!
You should’ve pretended to give it and then taken it back!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_040.text:
Ah! I did not know, sir.
I thought it was just an intricately crafted replica.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_041.text:
That’s a limited edition! Very expensive!
I only have one myself!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_042.text:
I have to keep using it as bait,
so take responsibility and bring it back immediately.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_043.text:
Huh? How am I supposed to retrieve something that I
already sold... And, from Captain {player_name}, of all people...?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_044.text:
Secretary Golden... You’ve really grown lately, haven’t
you? Trying to argue against me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_045.text:
Enough with the empty words and bring it back by any
means! Got it? Answer me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_047.text:
Maybe it's time for me to quit since it’s getting
messy here...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_012_6_049.text:
N, no, sir! Yes, Boss!! Alright then... I’m off! Take a
good rest in the meantime and I’ll be right back!!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_002.text:
It won’t take long...
I-I’ll do my best to not trouble you...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_003.text: Why are you acting so shy now...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_004.text:
T-that...
It’s still hard for me to talk to someone in person...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_005.text: You can go back inside Ku-Klip if you’re struggling.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_006.text:
No!
I want this test to be done accurately.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_007.text: I’d imagine it won’t make that big of a difference...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_009.text: But being inside Ku-Klip might block signal.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_010.text: I can endure this! I need accurate test results!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_011.text: ...If it wasn’t for you, {player_name}, I’d never be able to do this.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_012.text: Oh? You seem to really trust me now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_013.text:
Not really trust... it’s more a consequence.
{player_name} knows my real face. I can make use of it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_014.text: Oh, but don’t misunderstand. I DO trust you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_015.text: You are such an innocent person, Ozma.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_017.text:
I’ll send you a message.
Lean towards the device, here.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_022.text: You are right in front of me. Why are you texting me?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_023.text: I want to stop talking as much as I can...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_024.text: You really make things harder for yourself.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_025.text: Well, it doesn’t matter. I’ll walk around.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_026.text: Oh, and take this measuring device.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_027.text: Okay. How far should I go?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_028.text: Up to that boulder over there.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_031.text: I sent you a message. See if you received it!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_033.text:
Great! The test is done!
Good work! I’m leaving now!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_035.text:
Wait! Ozma!
Why are you getting on Ku-Klip?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_036.text: Because we are done with the testing!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_037.text: You promised to eat lunch with me after!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_038.text:
T-that...
I’m sorry, but I’m not ready for that!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_040.text: You need to be ‘ready’ to eat lunch with a friend?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_041.text: Ku-Klip requires nothing but wild animals and oil.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_043.text:
Captain {player_name}.
I’m grateful that you offered to buy me lunch!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_044.text:
Alright. I guess you
aren’t ready to eat at a busy restaurant yet.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_045.text: One day, we will eat at the same table.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_048.text:
I know you still have social anxiety.
I guess I was giving you a hard time.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_050.text: I feel guilty since you put it like that...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_051.text:
I’m really sorry.
But I will keep my promise... one day.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_052.text:
In a future where I overcome my anxiety,
I want to walk these streets with you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_014_6_053.text: We are going to eat all sorts of food when that happens!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_002.text:
Yichui, get ahold of yourself. Why are you laughing
like a villain from a low budget movie?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_006.text:
Stop lying.
I can tell you’re not okay.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_007.text:
Your skin is pale and you’re laughing all creepy.
You’re not your usual self.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_009.text: So please tell me I look fine.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_010.text: Tell me everything is going to be alright...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_011.text: See? You know yourself that there’s a problem.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_012.text: Okay then, Yichui, let me ask you a question.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_013.text: After you told me you’re craving carrots,

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_016.text: And... you still want to eat carrots, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_018.text: Then how about we try and eat a carrot?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_019.text:
Maybe you’ll feel better once you stop fighting
your urges to eat carrots.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_023.text: I’m scared that I might lose myself if I eat it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_025.text: This flame has been with me ever since I was born.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_026.text: It could even be a disease or a curse...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_027.text: I believed that one day, it’ll disappear on its own.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_028.text: My hair even turned blue because of it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_029.text: Something is changing inside of me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_030.text:
I studied hard to get accepted into a good university.
So that I can find a solution.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_031.text:
Then one day, I stopped all together.
I tried forgetting about it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_032.text: Then BAM! All of these things suddenly hit me!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_034.text: Estelle is currently looking for a way to help me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_035.text: She’s trying to find out what would happen...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_037.text: When do you think she’d be done with her research?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_038.text: She needs to follow standard research protocol.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_039.text: It’ll take at least a month for her to finish.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_041.text: Of course. This flame is a rare phenomenon after all.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_042.text: But... you’re going to suffer until Estelle is done.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_043.text: I’ll probably get used to it...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_044.text: Thoughts like that will only worsen your condition.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_046.text:
Professor Estelle did tell me...
that I should just try eating a carrot.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_047.text: That is definitely the fastest method.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_048.text:
But you’re too scared, right?
You’ve been avoiding carrots all together.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_049.text: Yeah. I’m sure the rabbit king has a sinister agenda.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_050.text: Just thinking about it taking over my body...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_052.text:
Well, I can never force you.
You seem sincerely scared.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_053.text: But... I still think you should try eating a carrot.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_055.text: That rabbit spirit always fought alongside you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_056.text: It can’t talk, and it’s super fat, but it was an ally.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_057.text: And it always looked like it was trying to protect you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_058.text: A parasite always tries to keep its host alive you know.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_059.text: I think you’re really overthinking it now...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_060.text:
It always protected you, and you used its powers.
I don’t think it’ll try to harm you so suddenly.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_061.text:
Let’s trust it.
You’re suffering way too much as is.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_063.text:
Great!
So where can we find a carrot...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_064.text: It’s inside the fridge over there.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_065.text: There’s even juice and cake here...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_066.text: But eating a raw carrot might be the better idea.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_067.text: Woah... just holding the carrot is driving me crazy!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_069.text:
{player_name}. If I go nuts after eating this carrot,
please hold me down!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_070.text: Even if you have to be forceful with me...!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_072.text: I might hop around everywhere roaring like a rabbit!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_075.text: Jeez, you’re just devouring that thing.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_079.text:
It taste like dirt...
It’s kind of... bitter.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_084.text:
I was in such a rush to eat it...
that I forgot to wipe off the dirt on it... ptooey.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_085.text:
But even with that considered, it still tastes bad!
I never want to eat it again!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_088.text:
You successfully persuaded the idiot to eat a carrot.
Thank you, {player_name}.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_089.text: She wouldn’t listen when I tell her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_090.text:
But seeing her reaction to the carrot,
I came to a conclusion.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_091.text: So she had to eat it for you to find the cause?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_092.text:
That’s right.
Research without experimentation is meaningless.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_093.text: Yichui is a very rare case.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_094.text: She’s unique - too unique. So I had troubles researching.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_095.text:
But seeing her reaction... The rabbit spirit
inside her was just worried about her health.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_096.text: So it forces me to eat carrots?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_097.text: It was the only way for it to communicate with you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_098.text:
Yichui.
You’ve been eating nothing but ramen lately, right?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_100.text: You can get sick with that kind of diet.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_101.text:
The rabbit inside you was simply worried about you.
It tried to force you to move.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_102.text:
But since the rabbit does not know about human food,
it made you crave the only food it knows: carrots.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_103.text: It was sending you a message. To eat healthier.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_104.text: Then why was I fearing the rain? Why did my body ache?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_105.text: I keep telling you. It’s all in your head.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_106.text: You assumed all your problems come from the same cause.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_107.text: Eating nothing but ramen was the real cause.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_110.text: Do you still want to eat carrots?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_111.text:
No... it left a nasty taste in my mouth.
I will never eat another one, ever again.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_112.text:
Then problem solved.
Take better care of yourself.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_113.text:
Of course, we’ll need to continue to study the rabbit’s
behavior. But please stop fussing about it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_117.text: But we’ll never know when that rabbit is really thinking.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_118.text: But aren't you guys actually close?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_119.text:
So when something like this happens again,
try to think about it in a positive way.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_120.text: You’re right... I shouldn’t have doubted it like that.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_121.text:
Thank you for your help, {player_name}.
I couldn’t have done this without you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_122.text: No need to thank me... I didn’t actually do anything...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_124.text:
She was too scared to do anything by herself. If it
wasn't for you, {player_name}, she would be struggling even now.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_125.text:
Thanks to you, I started seeing the rabbit...
the flame inside me differently.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_015_6_126.text:
I should learn to rely on others more.
Can I see you when things like this happen again?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_005.text: So... why did you ask me to come here?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_006.text:
The thing is...
The kids aren’t listening to me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_007.text: They are complaining why I’m stopping them.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_008.text: Kids tend to not listen to adults.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_010.text:
Perhaps, the kids are acting this way because
they noticed how lonely I was feeling recently.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_012.text: Maybe if I showed them that I have friends, they’d stop.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_013.text: ...But the truth is, I don’t have a lot of friends.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_014.text:
If the kids see me hanging out with a friend, maybe
they’ll stop trying to hook me up with Sir Uriel.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_015.text: {player_name}. Can you be that friend for me today?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_016.text:
Doesn’t sound hard.
Okay, I’ll help.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_018.text: But I need you to be a “close” friend.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_019.text:
Two friends that knew each other for a long time.
Do you understand?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_020.text: Do we have to take it that far?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_021.text:
The kids are... very smart.
We have to go all in to make them fall for it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_022.text: I guess we don’t have a choice then.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_023.text:
Teacher!
Who is that next to you?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_024.text:
Oh, kids!
This here is captain-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_025.text:
Hey, wait!
We are friends. You shouldn’t sound so formal!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_027.text:
This here is my friend!
A friend I knew for a long time!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_028.text:
Hello everyone! I’m Thehyss’s friend.
I heard a lot about you guys from her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_030.text: Teacher. Aren’t you underestimating us a little?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_031.text: How much did she pay you to act like her friend?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_032.text: ...Okay, these kids aren’t your average kids.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_035.text:
Guys, teacher sounds very sincere...
Let’s act like we trust her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_037.text: Why are you suddenly introducing us to your “friend”?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_039.text:
Thehyss.
At this rate, I don’t think your plan will work.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_040.text: Let’s just tell them the truth.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_042.text:
These kids are precious to you, aren’t they?
You shouldn’t lie to them.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_043.text: I don’t want to lie to them-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_044.text:
I know. And recently,
you had concerns regarding your social life.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_045.text: I know it’s embarrassing to have no friends.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_047.text: But do you really need to lie about that to the kids?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_049.text: We don’t need to hide the truth from our family.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_050.text: So... let’s tell them the truth.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_052.text:
Sorry kids.
I brought this person to try and convince you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_054.text:
You guys were planning something very dangerous.
I know it’s for me, but why take it that far?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_055.text:
Survival of the fittest! The strong takes from the weak!
You are the one who taught us this!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_056.text: Okay, the teacher seems problematic, too...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_057.text: I only wanted to raise the children to be strong.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_058.text: Teacher doesn’t have any friends because of us!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_059.text: She’s always too busy taking care of us!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_060.text: We’ll help her, even if it means to go against the Order!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_061.text: Kids! Don’t say things like that!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_062.text: They do seem like nice kids.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_063.text:
Don’t worry about Thehyss.
She’s not as lonely as you make it out to be.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_065.text:
No! Teacher is lonely and sad!
She wasted her whole like raising us!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_066.text:
No, {player_name} is right.
I’m not unhappy. I don’t need your help.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_067.text: My boss, Uriel is always helping me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_068.text: And my friend Luicilla is always looking out for me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_069.text: Even {player_name} came running to help me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_070.text:
And most importantly.
You guys are always here for me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_072.text: It’s true I don’t have many friends.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_073.text:
But that doesn’t mean I’m unhappy.
I’m very happy that you guys are here for me.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_074.text:
Children, you heard the teacher.
Let’s drop the weapons.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_075.text:
I ask of you.
I don’t want to see you guys get hurt.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_077.text: You know everything so the surprise is ruined any way.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_078.text: I would’ve died of a heart attack with this surprise!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_079.text: Then we’ll prepare a different gift! See ya!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_080.text: Okay! Make sure it’s a NORMAL gift!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_081.text:
...and {player_name}.
Thank you so much for your help.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_082.text:
I didn’t do anything.
You are the one who persuaded them.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_083.text: I wouldn’t have gotten the courage to speak up.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_084.text:
When you told me I shouldn’t lie to the children,
it made me open my eyes.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_085.text: I just saw them as simple kids.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_087.text: They are kids to my eyes.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_088.text:
But you needn’t worry anymore.
I’ll make sure they’re not up to anything.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_016_6_089.text:
If you need my help, don’t hesitate to call me.
And make sure to invite me to your party!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_003.text: He said he couldn’t come because he’s too busy.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_004.text: He did give me some tools to help Charlotte.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_006.text: He’s always busy. Don’t think too much on it.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_007.text: But he should’ve dropped by for sure.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_009.text: He’s a very busy man, I’ll wait.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_010.text:
Anyways, we need to help Charlotte.
So what did Faust give you?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_012.text: Bring it close to her heart, and it’ll awaken her beast.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_013.text: Okay, I’ll do it right away-

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_014.text: Hey, you’re a were-beast as well. It’s dangerous.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_015.text: I’ll bring it over to Charlotte.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_016.text:
You’re right!
Okay then, thank you.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_018.text: It’s not a big injury. You shouldn’t have come.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_019.text: Take this and place it over your heart.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_021.text: A tool that transforms you into a chihuahua.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_022.text: I don’t need that! Get out!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_024.text:
Charlotte.
With this, we can fix your leg.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_025.text:
I see...
If I transform, my legs will heal.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_026.text:
I guess it’s a great method to use in an emergency.
Although I hate transforming...

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_027.text: Where did you even get this anyway?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_028.text:
Faust gave it to us!
He’s very knowledgeable about curses and medicine!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_029.text: Faust gave me these chains as well!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_030.text:
He’s a man who studies various curses and magic.
It’ll be effective, for sure.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_031.text: I won’t force you if you don’t want to transform.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_032.text:
I can’t keep my fans waiting.
But ONLY Fenrir can see my transformation.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_033.text: I don’t mind... are you shy?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_034.text:
It’s not a problem of being shy...
I just hate showing my transformation to people.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_036.text: But Fenrir is also a were-beast, so I don’t mind her.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_037.text:
She’s also a beast like me. I’m sure she won’t laugh
at me when I transform into a chihuahua.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_039.text:
I knew it.
You’re a good friend Fenrir.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_041.text: I’ll take good care of you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_042.text: I’m helplessly weak when I turn into a chihuahua.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_043.text: Then this red stone... I place it on... UGH!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_045.text:
Don’t look this way!
Charlotte, go inside this basket.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_046.text:
How’s your leg?
Is it feeling better?

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_047.text: Okay, seeing you shake it, I think it’s fully healed.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_050.text: I’ll never let other people see you!

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_051.text:
Don’t worry Charlotte.
I’ll hide you from the others.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_052.text:
Charlotte was just a stalker.
But now, you guys are best friends.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_055.text: All the villagers and the heroes from Hero Town, too.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_056.text: I used to wake up always feeling lonely.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_057.text: Now I have friends I can count on.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_058.text: Sometimes I imagine myself as a normal human being.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_059.text: You’re already living the life of one.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_061.text: There’s nothing special about being human.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_062.text: We eat, sleep, laugh, and cry.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_063.text: Get along with people and worry for our friends.

TEXT_DATE_TALK_017_6_064.text:
