I will occupy the gates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH1_ST6_12_03.text:
Although we felled Caeneus,
the rest of the Cobalt Knights are still fighting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_01_01.text:
Nyah! This here is the Palace Garden!
This is my favorite place in the whole castle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_01_02.text:
What a pretty garden!
It’s like Prestina’s forest but with a different charm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_01_03.text: Hmm? What is that burn mark over there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_01_04.text:
Oh you see it? It’s a big area with many trees!
Perfect for testing new bombs!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_01_06.text: So... why did you bring us here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_01_07.text:
I asked you for the whereabouts of
Victoria or the Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_01_09.text:
Oh my, Sera.
You’ve grown so tall!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_02_02.text: Lady Sera, it’s been so long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_02_04.text:
Lednas, I heard you were also
attacked by Leon at Edenburg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_02_07.text:
With that said, we ended up separating
when we arrived in Impelis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_02_08.text:
Fortunately, I ran into
the Musketeers of Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_02_09.text: Hmph! I’m the one that found this person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_02_10.text:
I never forget the face of a beautiful lady...
and her scent, even if I’ve seen her just once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_02_12.text:
When we need a search dog,
we’ll use you instead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_02.text:
I heard the story.
That Leon and Maria betrayed us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_03.text:
... To tell you the truth,
it wasn’t completely unexpected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_04.text:
The fact that Maria tried dominating Trista
during the chaos caused by Cardinal Orcus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_05.text:
The information I gathered while chasing Cain
also made me doubt the Central Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_06.text:
All of this happened because of the Kalards.
Whatever it takes, I will return everything back to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_07.text:
I was once Maria’s assistant.
I will join you in your quest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_08.text:
So... the knights occupying the palace
will soon arrive here at the garden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_10.text:
As I said before, I’m trying to find the Kalard
responsible for brainwashing everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_11.text:
The Palace Mage Prydwen
led us here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_12.text:
Oh? The famous Palace Mage of Grancia...
is this young lady here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_13.text:
My spies were complaining about her...
“Prydwen won’t come out of her lab,” they would say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_15.text:
A well-renowned scientist once said
that the best of them stay rooted and focused!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_16.text:
You might have been a good scientist,
but I don’t think you made a good Palace Mage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_17.text: You betrayed Grancia to join {PLAYER_NAME} afterall.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_18.text: Nyah...? D-do you have a problem with that?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_19.text:
Of course not. But there’s a saying.
“Once a traitor, always a traitor.”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_03_20.text:
If you betray us,
I, Allegro Assai, will personally punish you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_04_01.text:
Don’t threaten me! I won’t do such a thing!
Please put your scary sword away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_04_03.text:
She’s definitely a chaotic person,
but she doesn’t carry any ill intent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_04_05.text:
Anyways, back to the conversation.
Why did you bring us here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_04_06.text:
There is a #hidden passage# nearby.
I found it while testing some bombs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_04_07.text:
I think the king made this passage
to leave the palace once in a while in secret.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_04_08.text:
The passage can also be used
the other way around. To sneak people in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_04_09.text:
That makes a lot of sense.
Emperor Alexander is known for having an itchy feet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_01.text:
We will guide the alliance troops
rallying outside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_02.text:
There are Elards and Sacred Beings
that haven’t arrived yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_03.text:
You mean my brothers? I shall follow.
... It’s been years since I saw them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_04.text: Yama, you’re going to follow me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_05.text:
That’s strange.
I thought you’d never leave Sera’s side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_06.text:
As you’ve felt from the outside,
Cora’s powers envelop this entire castle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_07.text:
From the outside, no one will know we’re here.
I’ll have to guide them in person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_08.text:
And besides...
{PLAYER_NAME} is here after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_09.text:
In a way,
you can say this is the safest place in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_10.text:
... That sounds mighty strange as we’re at war.
But at the same time, you have a point.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_05_11.text:
It won’t be long.
Please take care of Sera, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_06_01.text:
Ok then...
will you kindly lead the way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_06_03.text:
The hidden passage is right over that corner!
Where the people are walking through!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_06_04.text:
Wait, people are casually walking through it?!
How is this a “hidden” passage?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_06_05.text: ... My, my. I’ve run into some familiar faces.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_01.text:
I heard the gates were breached.
You’ve already made it this far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_02.text:
I’m not exactly thrilled to see you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I hoped our meeting at the Volcano would be our last.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_04.text:
Oh, Roland.
You look like you’re in good hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_05.text:
Are you getting along with your new friends?
You were always such a curt guy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_06.text:
Thanks to you, sure.
You are as frivolous as usual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_07.text:
Oren, Marin, and Sigrun...
Did they all really join the Kalards?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_08.text:
You all fought against the darkness as Chrona heroes.
Do you really find this just?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_09.text: Dalton. You didn’t see the revelation of the true light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_10.text:
In order to prevent the darkness from spreading,
we need to erase all traces of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_13.text:
Lednas, as old friends,
I will give you a chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_07_14.text: Please step down and join us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} put their own life on the line
to fight for Hasla, and I stood by their side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_02.text:
As an ordinary human, I can’t exactly tell
which path is just.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_03.text: I will simply follow my instincts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_05.text:
Following one’s own instincts can have
devastating results. It’s happened to me before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_06.text:
Never will I make such a mistake.
If you refuse the light, I shall cut you down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_07.text:
Sera, don’t you think they’re crossing the line?
You should say something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_08.text:
Once affected by Lethe’s powers,
nothing can persuade them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_09.text:
All that they can comprehend
is the “truth” told by Lethe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_10.text:
I suppose I also acted like that before...
I’m sorry, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_11.text:
What?! Like “that”?! Are you referring to me?
You dare mock me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_12.text:
Leon. Weren’t you told not to lay your hands on them?
Leave this to the Steel Knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_13.text: Our duty... is to go after the traitor, Arart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_08_15.text:
They’ve arrived.
Let’s fall back, Maria.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_09_02.text:
Hahaha! You backed away saying no.
Now you’re telling the truth. I like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST1_09_03.text:
Hahaha. Okay, time to go to work.
Darling, lead the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_01.text:
As expected from an elite force of Grancia,
 the #Steel Knights#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_03.text:
The Lion Knights we faced back at Trista
were just as formidable...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_04.text:
There are so many skilled warriors here in Grancia.
As expected from such a powerful empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_06.text:
Lednas, is something wrong?
Why the long face?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_07.text:
... I’m concered with what Sigruna said.
 “Our Duty,” she said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_08.text: If there are brainwashed Chrona Heroes here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_09.text: Does that mean that the Kalard, Arart, is here in Impelis?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_11.text:
I followed her tracks all the way to the Primal Volcano.
But it was all a deception.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_12.text:
But why would Arart be here in Impelis?
Isn’t she against all that follow Cora?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_01_13.text:
Nyah... what are you two blabbering about?
Let’s first find some place safe for a chit chat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_02_04.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
So you were already in Impelis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_01.text:
Prestina!
I missed you so much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_02.text:
Sera!
You were safe... I’m glad...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_03.text:
Do you know how worried I was?
You didn’t contact me even once...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_05.text:
It’s okay Sera.
I’m just glad you’re back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_06.text:
I heard of your true identity, Sera.
I still can’t believe it! You’re such a crybaby!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_07.text:
You still feel like the apprentice goddess
that I used to teach.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_09.text:
... Hehe. Many things changed, and yet,
you guys still respect and care for each other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_10.text:
Sera. No, Goddess #Hasla#.
It’s good to see you again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_12.text:
My informants told me that you two
were captured and restrained at the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_13.text: Did you guys escape on your own?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_14.text:
She’s not here at the moment, but thanks to Archon,
we were able to escape without trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_15.text:
Oh, and I forgot to introduce you.
This is Schula of the #Iron Hand# Workshop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_17.text:
Ehem. I thought you forgot about me.
It’s nice meeting you all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_18.text:
You are the famous blacksmith that created
the most powerful weapons in Grancia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_19.text:
That bradamante on your hip...
You must be the aspiring Galahad, Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_20.text: It’s an honor to meet you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_21.text:
Schula was once a Palace Knight
with the title #Emperor’s Advisor#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_22.text:
It isn’t a well-known fact,
so I assumed she was safe from the Kalards’ influence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_23.text:
Whenever Schula came to advise the emperor, she used
a hidden passage... I didn’t expect to find you here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_24.text:
As expected from Goddess Chronos.
Your abilities are unmatched.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_25.text:
Putting that aside, I heard from Archon.
That the Kalards are controlling Alexander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_26.text:
Yes. However, our alliances from all over Hasla
are supporting us in the quest to take them out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_27.text:
If we slay the Kalard controlling Alexander,
everything will return to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_28.text:
Hmm...
Are you sure about that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_03_30.text:
Nyah! Look there!
Something is flying over to us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_04_02.text:
And the Daughter of Cora.
The #Heroes# of the Holy City War are gathered here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_02.text:
And...
the Lion Knight Captain, Gwen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_03.text:
Hmm? The captain I remember was a
stale old man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_04.text: I think you got the wrong person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_05.text:
A year ago, Gwen managed to pull #Elanuma’s Holy Blade#.
Shortly after, she became the new captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_06.text: You really need to keep yourself updated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_07.text:
The Holy Blade of Elanuma! The Chrona Heroes
challenged to pull it, but no one managed to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_08.text: Gwen became the wielder of that blade?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_09.text: I can feel Elanuma’s light emanating from that blade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_10.text:
Wait, Elanuma’s powers and memory
were succeeded to Sylunis, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_11.text:
If we explain the situation to her,
she might help us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_05_12.text:
I... doubt that.
She is glaring at us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST3_06_01.text:
The enemy of the Lion Knights...
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_02_01.text: You used to work on my armor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_02_02.text:
You were once called the Emperor’s Advisor...
Why did you turn your back against him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_02_03.text:
When a student wanders astray,
it’s an advisor’s duty to bring him back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_02_04.text:
Alexander is walking the wrong path.
I’m sure you have realized that by now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_02_05.text:
You helped restore Elandia.
I’m sure you know how gruesome war can be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_02_06.text:
That I know very well.
That’s more the reason I can’t forgive {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_03_01.text: Well, aren’t you a bit too mean.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_03_02.text:
You had faith in Elanuma. You used to seek salvation
and follow the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_03_03.text: The blade you are carrying must be sobbing in sorrow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_04_02.text:
I’m a warrior that unrooted the blade
of a goddess of lies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_04_05.text:
Sylunis. That corrupt goddess
took the memories and powers of Elanuma.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_04_07.text:
She took the Soul Stones
and tried spreading evil throughout Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_04_08.text:
Thanks to her, the ‘Lion Knights’ were put in a difficult
situation. We had to clear the misunderstanding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_04_09.text:
Why did you let Sylunis put dirt all over
Elanuma’s name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_04_10.text:
... My friend who is no longer with us,
thought nothing but peace for Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_04_11.text: I cannot say that I’m against the decisions that she made.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_05_01.text:
Cora’s daughter, Chronos. And {PLAYER_NAME}.
You have sided with the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST5_05_02.text: ... I shall slay you in the name of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_03.text:
The entity that led Sylunis to do evil
is the same entity controlling Alexander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_04.text:
In order to rid the land of all darkness, she planned to
gather the Soul Stones in one place and destroy them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_05.text:
She could’ve easily said she was being controlled.
But Sylunis... didn’t make excuses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_06.text:
She fought fiercely in the
war at Elandia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_07.text:
When she inherited the memories of Elanuma,
she looked for ways to reveal the truth, alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_08.text: Won’t you give her a chance Gwen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_09.text:
Even if I hear that...
I...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_01_10.text:
I’m disappointed, Gwen.
To be shaken by those words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_02.text:
I see you’ve come looking for the hidden passage
used by the Emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_03.text:
I should’ve destroyed this passage
when I had the chance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_04.text:
Nyah... Y-you already knew about
this passage...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_06.text:
How dare you betray the Emperor.
He took you in and saved your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_07.text:
You are so shameless.
Once captured, you will face severe consequences.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_08.text:
Nyah! You got it wrong!
I was threatened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_09.text:
Wrong? It doesn’t matter what happened.
Right now, you stand beside our enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_10.text:
Prydwen, you guided our enemy.
And Gwen, you’ve fallen to their lies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_02_11.text: Once this war is over, you two will face judgment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_03_01.text:
Are you really the famed valiant knight
of Alexander?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_03_02.text:
Nevermind Prydwen - but how can you say such
a thing to Gwen? She risked her life for your cause.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_03_04.text:
So, Gwen.
What are you going to do now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_03_05.text:
Hmph... I will fight until the end.
To restore the Lion Knights...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_03_06.text:
That’s reckless!
You’re too injured to fight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_03_07.text: Are you really willing to fight to the death?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_04_01.text:
You are “acting”.
Is it because there are many people here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_04_02.text:
Schula, why are you whispering?
And... acting?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_04_03.text:
Schula... even if you figured it out,
you should’ve just went along with it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_04_04.text:
I fed her and trained her when she was just a child.
It’s hilarious to see her act so valiant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_04_05.text:
Sshh! I told you not to say those things
in front of others!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_04_06.text:
Hmm... I feel a presence
beyond the nearby garden trees.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_05_01.text:
Joan of Arc. You tried protecting Gwen from
the surveyors looking for defects, weren’t you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_05_02.text:
We are wanted criminals under
Grancia laws.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_05_03.text: If the surveyors saw Gwen getting persuaded...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_05_04.text:
Gwen and the Lion Knights
would’ve been banished from Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_05_05.text:
*Sigh* You’re absolutely correct.
The Green Apple scouts are always watching you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_05_06.text:
Personally, I do not want to fight {PLAYER_NAME}.
But I have no choice...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_05_08.text:
Gwen. You did a fine job.
Leave the rest to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_06_01.text:
So now, we know each other’s situation.
Let’s get down to business, shall we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_01.text:
Ugh... all my men have fallen.
I guess this is as far as I go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_02.text: Joan of Arc. Surrender and join {PLAYER_NAME} in his quest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_03.text:
Alexander is treading down the wrong path.
It’s not smart to stay aboard a sinking boat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_04.text:
I’m a knight that has sworn an oath to Grancia.
I cannot do such a dishonorable act.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_05.text:
No matter how stubborn
and close-minded Alexander may be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_06.text:
I cannot abandon my nation and her people.
That’s why I raised my blade against you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_07.text:
I understand.
I guess there’s no other way around it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_08.text:
To hear you say such a thing.
I see you’ve become accustomed to humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_07_09.text:
How unfortunate... I wanted to work with you more.
Maybe, at a later time, I can join you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_01.text:
The battle seems to be over.
Are they the people you were looking for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_02.text:
Yes, Nottingham.
Thank you for guiding me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_05.text:
Am I dreaming?
Maybe even Sera returning is just all in my head?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_06.text:
Wah! No Prestina!
I’m right here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_07.text:
This is how we meet again, Prestina.
I didn’t have a chance to convey my messages to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_08.text:
I’m Galatea, an Ancient Sacred Being.
I have borrowed Ellie’s body to channel my voice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_09.text:
You aren’t Ellie...?
You “borrowed” her body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_10.text:
But how?
Ellie is at the bottom of the Temple of Illusions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_12.text:
I’m sure you’re confused.
But now’s not the time to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_08_14.text:
Ellie is alive.
And she will return to you in time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_02.text:
The mother of all that is living, Hasla.
I heard you go by ‘Sera’ now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_03.text:
Yeah... it’s been a while.
Actually I don’t think it’s been that long...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_04.text:
Oh, when we met in ‘Heaven’
while you were an ‘executor’?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_05.text:
I never imagined that mother
would take such a form.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_06.text:
Uh... both you and I are in the body
of a small girl, so stop calling me mother...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_08.text:
Galatea,
who is this man beside you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_09.text:
This is Nottingham.
He used to be Vice Commander of the Green Apples.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_09_10.text: He led me and my brothers here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_01.text:
The Vice Commander of the Green Apples?
I’ve heard a rumor about him...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_02.text: It wasn’t a good rumor, was it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_03.text: Sorry, I shouldn’t have said that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_04.text:
I was waiting for an opportunity to smite
Alexander and his puppet, Robin Hood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_05.text:
So I rushed here as soon as I heard
that you’ve breached the castle gates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_06.text:
We arrived all thanks to you.
Thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_07.text:
So what are you going to do
about the knight captains here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_08.text: Do we just leave them be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_09.text:
We cannot. We are at war.
We don’t know what’s going to happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_10.text:
I guess I have no choice. I will take them
to my workshop and look after them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_11.text:
Then the Musketeers
will escort you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_12.text:
We will protect you.
No matter what happens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_13.text:
Getting escorted by such a gentleman
at my ripe old age.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_14.text:
Age is nothing but a number.
All ladies deserve my respect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_15.text:
Especially the ladies with a kind heart!
Let’s go, I will protect you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_16.text:
Hahaha! How romantic.
Are all men in Trista like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_10_18.text: Ehem... then I leave Gwen and Joan of Arc to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_01.text:
Oh my, I got carried away.
Okay ma’am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_03.text:
When this is all over,
please tell Alexander to visit me at my workshop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_04.text: I’m going to give him some brutal advising.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_06.text: As for me, I will bring the rest of my brothers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_07.text:
They are waiting outside,
as we weren’t aware of what’s happening here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_08.text:
You guys are done talking, right? Follow me.
I will guide you to the Throne Room.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_09.text:
Nyah! I’m the guide!
Don’t order us around!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_10.text: Is that so? Then you should lead the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_11.text:
Do you know any other path than
the secret passage being guarded by the Steel Knights?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_13.text:
*Sigh*
Stop wasting my time and follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH2_ST6_11_14.text:
Then I will be the watcher!
I’ll stick to the back and keep watch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_01_02.text:
Nyah...
My position as a guide is threatened...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_01_03.text:
It’s nothing special. When I submitted
my household’s secrets to the Green Apples,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_01_04.text:
I kept a couple of secrets to myself. Including
the whereabouts of some secret passages.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_01_05.text:
I used to feel guilty about it.
But how ironic that now I’m using it for justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_01_06.text:
Anyways, not even the Green Apples know
about this passage. Let’s hurry...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_01_07.text:
Don’t know what, Nottingham?
We kept the passage open to catch mice like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_01.text:
Robin Hood!
How did you know about this passage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_02.text:
Nottingham, I never fully trusted you.
I never trusted your family.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_03.text:
When you submitted your secrets, I captured
and tortured the other nobles to verify its legitimacy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_04.text:
What? My father was amongst them!
How could you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_05.text:
You can never be too sure
when working to rid the corruption within Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_06.text:
Even if my deeds taint my heart in darkness,
if it can help the future generations, I’m willing to do them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_07.text:
You are mad.
Is that what Alexander told you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_09.text:
The Emperor made a noble decision
for the future of the empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_02_10.text: I’m simply following in his steps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_03_01.text:
Robin Hood. The Kalards are using Alexander
to achieve their evil goal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_03_02.text:
Following Cora’s “Light” isn’t something
that is for the people of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_03_04.text:
I, too, am aware that following Cora
isn’t meant for #everyone# in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_03_06.text:
I wasted too much time here.
I’ll be seeing you later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_03_07.text:
Down this path, you will be welcomed by countless
traps and Central Knight troops.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_03.text:
Mother!!
It’s so nice to see you again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_04.text:
I, Loki, am moved to tears! My emotions are
raging like a storm! I think I’m going to throw up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_05.text:
You sure know how to fuss.
I don’t remember you were like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_06.text:
Huh? I’m just now realizing...
Where’s Habaek?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_07.text:
That fatty was too big to fit into
this building!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_08.text:
And he had the audacity to say that he’ll only speak
to us through the Shaman of Water. So we left him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_09.text:
And with the help of Sylunis and Aubrey,
we rallied up our allies and surrounded the castle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_10.text:
And {PLAYER_NAME} marched in here
and defeated the Cobalt and Steel Knight Captains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_11.text:
Just give me an order, mother.
I will turn this castle to ash.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_12.text:
Ash? No!
You don’t have to take it that far.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_13.text:
We simply need to defeat the Kalard controlling
Alexander and ask him to stop the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_14.text:
For those who are outside...
Can you please wait for us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_15.text:
Okay, mother.
We’ll do as you say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_16.text:
Huh? Hey! You said you won’t even speak to us
without that blue-haired lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_17.text:
... Then I guess we continue on our quest.
Prydwen, can you lead the way for us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_18.text:
Nyah?! Lead these monsters?!
No! Make Nottingham do it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_19.text:
No. Robin Hood likely planted traps in the passages
that I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_20.text:
You should be the one to guide us.
You did well before. You’re our guide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_22.text: Yes. We acknowledge you as our guide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST1_05_23.text:
... Then follow me. I will lead you to a path
that does not reek of danger!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_01_01.text:
Ugh... I knew I couldn’t hold you back for long...
But I didn’t expect you to be this powerful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_01_02.text:
This is as far as I go.
I surrender, do as you wish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_01_04.text:
What is that relieved look on your face?!
You think you can just surrender?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_01_06.text: Why are you so angry, Nottingham?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_01_07.text:
This is your best chance to avenge your father.
I can barely even stand. Do as you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_02_01.text:
How odd... you attacked us persistently
with traps and ambushes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_02_02.text:
But when it came down to a duel to the death,
you fell with a zero chance of winning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_02_03.text:
I heard you recently received a ‘title’ from Alexander.
Did you want an honorable death?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_02_04.text:
I’m neither a knight or a noble.
I have no honor to protect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_02_05.text:
As I’ve said before, I only follow orders.
The path of justice set by Alexander...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_02_06.text:
I was a tool for his ambition - and a good one at that.
I was given a title as a result.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_03_01.text:
I was in charge of ‘removing’ people who interfered
in the interest of the Grancia Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_03_02.text:
I realized we were walking down the wrong path.
But there was no turning back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_03_03.text:
I hurt so many people, yet I was praised as a noble.
And still, I felt empty inside.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_03_04.text: Everything’s finally coming to an end...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_04_01.text: This leaves a bitter taste in my mouth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_04_02.text: The man I once adored and respected was such a coward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_04_03.text:
You forced all your dirty deeds on your henchmen,
and now you find peace through death?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_04_04.text:
Uhm... Nottingham, he’s not dead yet.
He just passed out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_04_06.text: Good. I’ll carry him and heal him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_04_07.text:
Robin Hood, I will not allow you to die
until you pay for your sins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_05_03.text:
And...
Hasla, the master of this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_05_04.text:
I am Victoria, the captain
of the Central Knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_05_05.text:
The master of this land...?
So you know about Sera’s true identity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_05_06.text:
After the disappearance of Morgan, the next likely heir,
you became the only true royal remaining.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_05_07.text:
I was sure that Alexander shared some information
regarding the Kalards with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_05_08.text:
... As you’ve said, I knew that Alexander
was secretly communicating with the Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_05_09.text:
I knew the truth.
I also knew the Kalards’ plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_02.text:
You remained quiet despite knowing the truth?
Why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_03.text: ... I guess we can talk about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_04.text:
The truth has been revealed.
And you have arrived here at the palace after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_05.text:
But with that said, I came to warn you.
Danger lurks ahead of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_06.text:
What? We’re so close to the Throne Room now.
No threat of danger will deter us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_07.text:
The central hall is infested with Robin Hood’s traps
and the Palace Mage’s bombs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_08.text:
The only safe path to the Throne Room
is by going around through the Guest’s Room.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_09.text:
But again, that path is also guarded
by the Central Knights, which includes me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_10.text:
It’ll be a better choice to challenge me and my knights
than to risk your life on some measly traps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_11.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
I do not want to fight you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_06_12.text:
But it’s the duty of a royal to fight against
the empire’s enemy until the very end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_07_01.text:
The Palace Mage’s bombs?
What does a mage have anything to do with bombs?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_07_02.text: Nyah! Everything! Explosions are a form of art!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_07_03.text:
Oh, right. You were the Palace Mage.
Do you think she was telling us the truth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_07_04.text: Nyah... I did leave behind heaps of bombs at my lab...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_07_05.text: If they found it, they might’ve taken it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_07_06.text:
So Victoria was telling us the truth?
Why would she warn us of the traps?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_08_01.text:
I’m not too sure...
She looked very determined.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_08_02.text:
Maybe it has something to do with what Caeneus said.
“The next step of war.”

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_08_03.text:
...Whatever the cause, I don’t think it’d be smart
for us to put our full trust in her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_08_04.text:
I will stay behind and interrogate Robin Hood.
I’ll find out if there really are traps ahead of us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST4_08_05.text:
Thank you Nottingham.
As for us, we’ll follow Victoria’s tracks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_01_01.text:
With this, you’ve defeated all the Knight Orders
of Grancia, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_01_02.text:
How does it feel to hold the fate of Grancia
in your hands?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_01_03.text:
Victoria.
Did you forget who started this war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_02_01.text:
I don’t resent you.
As a matter of fact, we deserve it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_02_02.text:
Our Empire threatened the true master of Hasla
and made a deal with the Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_03_01.text:
We do not wish to bring ruin to Grancia.
Isn’t that obvious?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_03_02.text:
I don’t think so. There are many
suspicious things about you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_03_04.text:
You appear out of nowhere at the outskirts of Grancia.
Then you start influencing everyone surrounding you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_03_05.text:
The appearance of a hero that can tap into the
power of the Goddesses to fight the Apostles...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_04_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Alexander always kept an eye on you.
Kalards or not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_04_02.text:
Your friends who became corrupt from the darkness
brought despair all throughout Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_04_03.text:
The #Light of Cora# on the other hand,
gave us hope. It was proof of Cora’s existence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_05_01.text:
The ‘path of light’ that Cora walks
isn’t a path of justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_05_02.text:
You cannot simply divide all living beings in Hasla
by ‘dark’ and ‘light’.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_01.text:
That’s why I stood against you.
I wanted to test your resolve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_02.text:
Had you fell to my blade,
you wouldn’t have made it to the Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_03.text:
Stop the nonsense.
You’re just siding with the stronger force.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_04.text:
As a royal, as the shield of the Emperor,
I made a resolution to protect the people of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_05.text:
Even if Impelis is destroyed and in ruin, we can always
rebuild the palace as long as the people are safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_06.text:
Victoria...
The “next step” that you told Caeneus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_07.text:
You were talking about the events that would occur
after Cora and I settle our affairs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_08.text:
Sera, if you really are the true master of this land,
please prove it to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_09.text:
So that all people of Hasla
can worship you without doubt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_10.text:
I... I will try my best.
But don’t worry too much about me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST5_06_11.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} is with me!
I’m sure everything will be alright!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_01_01.text:
The sounds of battle have ceased.
Are you here, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_02_03.text:
I should’ve known when Arart
went out of her way to point you out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_02_04.text:
I was very surprised to find out
that you are the master of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_03_01.text:
Lednas,
did you decide to side with {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_03_03.text:
You gave me a powerful offer,
but I chose to follow my instincts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_03_05.text:
As a knight of Grancia,
it’d be a lie to say I’m not disappointed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_03_06.text:
But you needn’t apologize
for doing what you think is right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_03_07.text:
That’s the reason why I regard you so highly.
It’s the reason I recommended you as the next Galahad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_01.text:
Oh cut your praises.
You’re stealing the words right out of my mouth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_03.text:
You needn’t apologize Lednas
for doing what you think is right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_06.text: Kekeke... I’m just messing with you. A joke.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_07.text:
Stop your blabbering.
It’s time to end this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_08.text:
Chronos.
You needn’t be so rude all the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_09.text: A leader should always wear a smile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_10.text:
Alexander. Your judgment is impaired
by the Kalards’ influence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_11.text:
Wake up! Use Sera’s powers to shake it off!
Join the side of justice before it’s too late...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_13.text:
I take it back!
You really are funny!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_04_14.text:
Did you think that I was doing ‘evil’
because I was brainwashed by the Kalards?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_02.text:
When I was young, I had a lot of interest in the
history between the Goddesses and the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_03.text:
At the time, I was the only one
who questioned the century-long conflict.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_04.text:
Then I found out why
when I heard the truth from Arart at the Mystic Sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_05.text:
I was born with an immunity
to Lethe’s ability.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_06.text:
Arart wanted me dead; I was an unpredictable variable
to her plans. But I offered cooperation instead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_07.text:
I promised to aid her in her plans
if she made Grancia the most powerful empire in Hasla,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_08.text:
If that’s the truth,
you stayed silent despite knowing the Kalards’ plans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_09.text:
To rid Hasla of all darkness...
You must’ve known that called for a massive genocide!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_10.text:
Of course I knew.
But it won’t affect Grancia much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_11.text:
The Grancia Empire worshipped the Goddesses from the
beginning. There are no traces of darkness here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_12.text: More so, the ‘dangerous’ demons down south will perish...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_13.text:
Nations that border ours will lose strength.
It’ll be a good opportunity to expand our borders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_14.text:
Are you out of your mind?!
Alexander!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_15.text: Out of my mind? Who cares!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_05_16.text:
Is it wrong for an emperor to
make decisions for his empire?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_01.text: I do not care who is just; you or the Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_02.text:
Those that have fallen to your blade
fought for their own form of justice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_03.text:
If only they were stronger...
Hasla would surely look different than now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_04.text:
I accepted Cora’s Light for Grancia.
I accepted it to stand victorious at the end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_05.text:
Sera, do you have the rights to criticize me?
You were once defeated by Cora and lost your purpose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_06.text: ... My memories still haven’t fully returned to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_07.text:
Yet, I don’t believe you would do such a thing
for your own personal desires.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_06_08.text: ...But you will still have to pay the price.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_07_01.text: ... Of course. Of course I do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_08_02.text:
The Central Empire that I spent years building...
It all ends here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_08_03.text:
I’m sorry to speak so forwardly, emperor,
but Grancia will be fine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_08_04.text:
This nation houses some of the most loyal
citizens I have ever seen. They will rebuild the empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_08_05.text:
...Is that so? My work to rid of all entities
that threaten my empire... was it all in vain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_08_06.text:
I seem to have arrived at a good time.
How is everyone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_01.text:
Arart...?! How did you get in here?
Aren’t you being chased by the Chrona Heroes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_03.text:
You know of Lethe’s powers,
why are you acting surprised?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_04.text: You would’ve fooled me had I not known.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_05.text:
What are you talking about?
You guys weren’t working together?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_06.text: You aren’t the only ones betrayed by Alexander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_07.text: This man used my help to grow his empire...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_08.text:
But through the #saintess# of the Chrona Heroes,
he contacted Cora and sold me out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_09.text: And now, I’m being chased by the Executor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_10.text:
I guess you can’t expect anything less from
the mighty emperor of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_12.text:
Don’t blame yourself.
You did your best.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_09_13.text:
You simply lacked strength.
That’s the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_10_01.text:
I will show you the #truth of this world#.
You deserve it for entertaining me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_11_02.text:
No.
But... he may or may not wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_11_03.text:
If you are capable,
you should check yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_12_02.text:
I’ll skip the introductions,
as we’ve acquainted each other before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_12_03.text:
You aren’t powerless beings
that are controlled by Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_12_04.text:
You have overcome all hardships
to come stand before me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_12_05.text: We are beings of equal! How long I waited!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_12_06.text: You can actually speak freely of what’s on your mind!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_13_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. You’ve been chosen by Hasla.
Are you the one I was waiting years for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_14_01.text:
Are you... really planning to end everything here?
You won’t be able to take it back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_14_02.text:
Of course.
I don’t have enough time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_14_03.text: This is the moment I was waiting for.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_15_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. Sera.
The champion and the master of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_15_02.text:
Prove your mettle to me,
the Goddess of Judgment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_15_03.text:
If you fail,
you will be stripped of your freedom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_16_01.text:
You’ve improved...
since the last time I saw you at Edenburg.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_17_01.text:
You meet the minimum requirements.
This is wonderful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_17_02.text:
It’s time to wake up from your dream...
It’s time to face the truth of this world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_17_04.text: I will wait for you at the other side of the dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_18_01.text:
She’s gone...
Was that an illusion?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_19_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}... with this, you and your allies have been granted
permission to enter the #Precautionary Dream#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_19_04.text:
It’s a realm that Arart and I created to mask the truth
while you were asleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_19_05.text:
A realm that masks the truth...?
Is this ‘realm’ blocking Cora’s gaze?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_20_02.text:
My powers can brainwash people...
but that’s not all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_20_03.text:
I can pull memories out of people..
and make them forget about it, like it was just a dream...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_20_04.text:
Those lost memories, the ‘truth’,
are sent to the Precautionary Dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_20_05.text:
Arart’s physical form blocks the entrance of that dream,
and prevents other deities from glancing through.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_20_06.text:
Now, you will head into that said dream
and hear the #truth of this world# from Arart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_21_01.text: This is the path to the Precautionary Dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_21_02.text:
...{PLAYER_NAME}.
This is your last chance to give up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_21_03.text:
Once you hear the truth from Arart,
you won’t be able to turn back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CH3_ST6_22_01.text:
...You seem to have made up your mind.
Very well. You may enter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_01_03.text:
I wanted you to recover and muster your strength to
face the chaos ahead...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_01_04.text:
But you became even stronger when you shared it with
others... You transcendent beings are so unpredictable...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_02_02.text: Was your plan to share your strength with Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_02_03.text: To defend Hasla and its people from the outside world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_02_04.text:
...The Flame of Cora...
its purpose isn’t to eradicate the darkness from Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_02_05.text:
It is a weapon to be held by the people of Hasla...
To defend themselves from the outside world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_02_06.text:
The Forbidden Power... The Heavenly Science...
Magical Engineering... All of them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_03_01.text:
All I did for Hasla...
is now in vain because of you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_04_01.text:
But... at the same time, I’m...
happy about your decision.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_04_02.text:
Strength gained from sacrifice
will eventually crumble and rot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_05_02.text:
Recover your name...
Reclaim your lost glory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_05_04.text:
Break the barrier Cora set on Hasla...
destroy it and seek true freedom...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_06_03.text:
This realm was created using every drop
of mine and Lethe’s powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_06_05.text:
This realm will collapse...
alongside Lithe and I...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_06_06.text:
It’s a shame...
I wanted to witness your rise as Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_06_08.text:
Some day... in the distant future...
I will fulfill your wishes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_06_10.text:
Of course.
My soul... its home is by your side...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_08_01.text:
The truth that Arart revealed to us...
It’s shockingly frightening...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_08_02.text: But it also gave us hope.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_08_03.text:
The outside world... isn’t just filled with evil.
It is a war fought by two sides.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_09_01.text:
Hehe... as Hasla,
I want to become a goddess that you all can rely on...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_09_02.text:
But in front of {PLAYER_NAME},
I still just feel like an apprentice goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_09_03.text:
I’m nervous and scared,
but I’m sure everything will turn out alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_09_04.text:
Our friends... and the experience we gained from
our adventures. They will greatly help us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_10_01.text:
Our journey has been a long one...
but there’s still much more to come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_10_02.text: I’m sure we can do it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ED_10_03.text:
I look forward to
continue working with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_01_01.text:
Nyah?! This is the castle gate!
Why are we back here?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_01_02.text:
We are already inside the realm.
It’s similar to Gullveig’s illusions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_01_03.text:
Except this realm is built entirely
on forgotten ‘truths’.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_01_04.text:
From here,
please go back to the Emperor’s Quarters #again#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_01_05.text: Arart is waiting for you there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_02_01.text:
I’m hearing voices in my head!
How fascinating.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_02_02.text:
Does that mean we need to defeat
the same people that we defeated from before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_02_05.text:
As I’ve said before, the #shadows# of this realm
are made of lost memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_02_06.text:
Stories of knights and their war are often exaggerated
when spoken. So you will face even stronger foes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_02_07.text:
And the Chrona Heroes that were after Arart
are also trapped in this realm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_02_08.text: So, no. You won’t face the “same” opponents again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_02_11.text: You idiot! Show some respect to Chronos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_03_02.text:
I heard you were locked away in the dungeons of Impelis.
I’m glad you’re okay!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_03_03.text:
Dionne! And even the Elards...
How did you get inside this realm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_03_05.text:
Of course not!
We are just a bit late, that’s all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_03_06.text:
A strange dimensional door opened up,
so I rushed in after you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_04_01.text:
The dimensional door was open?
What happened Lethe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_04_02.text:
There’s no point in hiding the truth
now that Arart’s illusion has been defeated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_04_03.text: Anyone can enter the Precautionary Dream now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_04_04.text: You aren’t concerned about anyone else but {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_04_05.text:
I can’t tell whether you’re being
rude or respectful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_04_06.text:
...When the truth is revealed,
their powers will mean nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_05_01.text: It’s quite difficult to stay at pace with {PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_05_02.text:
Augh, should I be angry
or be understanding?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_05_03.text:
You should be angry, of course!
How dare she say our powers mean nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_05_04.text:
...Now’s not the time for quarrel.
Look ahead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_06_02.text:
If the shadow of Caeneus
is guarding the castle gate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_06_03.text:
It will be a difficult journey
to reach the emperor’s quarters again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_07_01.text:
We already defeated them once.
It won’t be hard to do it again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_07_03.text:
Wait so... If I meet myself... Do I have to stop...
myself from blowing up my masterpiece?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_1_07_04.text: Why do you sound so broken?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_01_03.text:
It was just a shadow of Caeneus,
yet it was a powerful opponent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_01_04.text:
I feel as though the shadow
was just as strong as Caeneus himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_01_05.text:
I feel the same way.
In fact, I think the shadow was stronger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_01_06.text:
Prydwen’s shadow
was also really powerful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_01_07.text: I never want to fight and defeat myself, ever again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_01_08.text:
You call them shadows?
How interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_01.text: One moment I was trailing Arart...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_02.text:
Then suddenly,
I started going around in circles, in an endless loop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_03.text:
This strange place
must be some kind of realm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_05.text:
You needn’t worry about us,
Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_08.text:
Yes. The moment we stepped into this realm,
our memories returned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_09.text:
This must be a realm created
by the Kalards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_10.text:
Lethe calls this place the #Precautionary Dream#.
It is built of “forgotten truths”.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_11.text: That ability of hers also seems to come from this realm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_12.text:
How fortunate!
I’m glad you’re okay, Maria!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_13.text: Are you finally siding with us again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_16.text:
We’re now free from Lethe...
But the memories of our wrongdoings are still with us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_02_17.text:
We... are sinners that traumatized the people
of Trista and Elandia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_03_02.text:
Do you think the people of Trista
will feel the same way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_03_03.text:
I will need to pay for my sins...
with my own life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_03_04.text: Nyah? Life? Did I hear that right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_03_05.text:
Humans act so smart, but sometimes,
they make the most stupid and weird decisions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_04_01.text:
Quiet, beast.
Are you insulting Maria?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_04_02.text:
No, I really do think it’s stupid.
What’s the point of killing yourself in guilt?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_04_03.text:
If you really are sorry, go help them in person.
Help them recover the damages.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_04_04.text: That would be way more productive, don’t you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_04_06.text:
Is that really our Prydwen?
I’m so confused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_04_08.text:
Your death will be meaningless.
You should instead devote your life to help the people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_04_09.text:
Please do not judge my decision.
You are not my bodyguard anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_05_01.text:
I can’t accept this!
You can’t just end it like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_05_02.text: You will have to kill me first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_05_03.text:
...You’ve really changed, Strawberry Pie.
How can you say something so... bad?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_05_05.text:
Right back at you!
You are the one that started it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_05_06.text:
Don’t get in my way!
Hey Cutie, get her out of the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_05_08.text: I won’t let you do this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_06_02.text:
Uhm... Maria sure does
give strange nicknames to people...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST1_2_06_03.text: Oh darn, what am I doing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_01_02.text:
Maria and Roland...
Have they fallen...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_01_03.text:
They were the weakest of the bunch...
*Murmur*

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_02.text:
I’m so sorry, lady Sera.
And the rest of the goddesses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_04.text: ...It seems like you’re no longer brainwashed, Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_05.text:
I know I was being controlled...
But even still, what I did was terribly wrong...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_06.text:
I will live the rest of my life
repenting for the sins I’ve committed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_07.text: Well, you were quite mean, Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_08.text: You said some awful things to me, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_09.text:
Oh...? Really?
Can you tell me in detail about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_11.text:
Jeez, Leon.
You really need to watch what you say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_12.text: I shot them, too, but they don’t seem to mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_02_13.text: Sigruna... I don’t think that’s something to brag about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_03.text: Do you remember what happened at Elandia?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_04.text:
We jumped a century
and fought against the darkness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_05.text:
But in the final moment, it was you who gathered the
Will of Cora to defeat El Thalnos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_06.text:
You are the Chosen Warrior of Light,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_07.text:
That title once belonged to me...
It was the reason of my existence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_08.text:
I was overwhelmed by jealously 
whenever I saw you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_09.text:
...I needed to overcome that emotion.
I had to accept it and use it to improve myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_10.text:
It was my own lack of self-control
that soured our close relationship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_03_11.text:
I brought upon despair and chaos
to Hasla... I’m truly sorry...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_01.text:
I won’t question your sins.
You won’t be punished for what Lethe did to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_02.text:
We all share a common goal, after all.
We are friends who joined arms to protect Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_03.text:
But we will still need to apologize
to the civilians that were harmed because of us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_05.text:
Then Leon...
we’re friends again, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_06.text:
Sera, the thing is...
there’s something that I need to do first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_08.text:
...{PLAYER_NAME}!
I have a favor to ask you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_09.text:
I’m no longer under Lethe’s influence!
But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_10.text:
Just once...
can I challenge you to a duel?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_04_11.text:
I have to do this
to clear my head!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_05_02.text: Y-you can refuse my challenge if you don’t want to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_05_03.text:
And in truth, I’m in no position
to ask you for something like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_06_01.text:
Heh...{PLAYER_NAME}.
Thank you for accepting my challenge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_07_02.text:
You’ve grown even stronger!
I’m no match for you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_07_03.text:
You are so close, yet so far.
You are way ahead of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_08_01.text:
But... It’s not bad
to have such a powerful rival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_08_02.text:
Okay, I’ve made up my mind.
Thank you for the duel, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_09_01.text:
Huh? I should apologize to Sera...?
Oh right!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_09_03.text:
You said so much mean things to me!
And I even apologized first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_09_04.text:
You completely ignored me
to have a friendly duel with {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_10_01.text:
But... since it’s Leon,
I will forgive you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_10_02.text:
I’m sorry Sera.
I completely forgot...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_10_04.text:
First, the cake you promised to buy me 3 years ago.
It comes with interest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_10_05.text:
Huh? When did I promise that?
I told you I’d buy you cake?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_10_06.text:
What’s this?
I guess Leon doesn’t want my forgiveness...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_11_01.text: N-no! Of course I’ll buy you cake!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_11_02.text:
Hmph!
When this is all over,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_11_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, you are also coming with me
for a dessert tour at Impelis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_11_04.text:
That actually sounds... awesome!
Can I come, too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST2_12_01.text:
Of course! When this is all over,
I will empty my savings and buy you all cake!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_01.text:
I... I’ve done countless terrible things to shape Grancia
into what it is today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_02.text:
I made excuses after excuses...
But now, the feeling of regret is finally catching up to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_03.text: Is this the truth that the Kalards kept away from me...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_04.text:
What Arart said... that I was immune to Lethe’s powers
...was a lie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_05.text:
I’m just an ordinary human being after all.
I don’t have that kind of special power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_06.text: You are the Emperor of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_07.text:
You fought for the throne.
You took the crown with your own two hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_08.text: You are not an ordinary human being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_09.text: How can you be so sure?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_10.text:
I was just a puppet of the Kalards.
I walked a path that they created.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_01_12.text:
When you decided to follow the Kalards, were you deluded
into thinking you made the decision yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_03_03.text:
You started a massive war
that endangered everyone in Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_03_04.text:
And despite all the evil things you’ve done,
you survived!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_03_05.text:
How indecent! How can I even call myself emperor?
I’m a fool!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_03_06.text: I need to pay for my sins... with my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_03_07.text:
No!
Don’t say such a thing, uncle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_02.text: I came to take the crown.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_04.text: I came to take the crown!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_05.text:
You... wish to inherit the crown...?
And the sins and the burden it carries?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_07.text:
I didn’t ask for your opinion.
It’s my decision.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_08.text:
Grancia... can’t fall yet.
I won’t stand it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_09.text:
To repent for what we’ve done to {PLAYER_NAME}
and the people of Hasla...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_10.text:
Grancia will need to become the center of Hasla.
A place of refuge for the people once the fight is over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_05_11.text:
And in order to do that, I need to be crowned.
I need to be the emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_01.text:
...Are you saying that until you inherit the crown,
I should live?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_02.text:
I hope you live
even after the coronation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_03.text:
I’d hate for the people to think I assassinated my own
uncle to take the crown.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_04.text: You... you wish for me to live? Despite what I’ve done?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_05.text:
That’s right. Not as a nephew,
but as the captain of the Central Knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_06.text:
I’m a knight that swore her loyalty to you.
So please...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_08.text:
That is your duty as a royal.
That is the responsibility of Alexander, the Emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_10.text: That’s something I’ve always scolded you about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_11.text:
Yes. You’ve said that to me
countless number of times.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_13.text:
...I did raise you well.
I’m glad you grew up to be such a fine person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_15.text:
I’m sorry, Leon.
My emotions got the best of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_17.text:
I’m in the same position.
I need to repent for what I’ve done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_06_19.text:
Once this is all over,
I will take full responsibility for what I’ve done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_07_02.text:
I have a lot of work to do.
I will need to fix this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_02.text:
Lethe?
Why is she laying unconscious on the ground?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_03.text:
Is that the first thing you notice?
You really are a strange goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_04.text:
She was fine just moments ago!
Of course I notice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_05.text:
The Lethe you met at Hasla
is just an illusion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_06.text:
The ‘Precautionary Dream’ is a realm that was created
by using all of mine and Lethe’s Kalard powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_07.text: The Lethe you see now is all that is left of her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_09.text:
How treacherous...!
You sacrifice even your own friend?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_10.text: That is none of your concern.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_11.text:
You came here to hear
the #truth of this world#, did you not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_12.text:
...The history of this land... the truth...
The very thing you were hiding from us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_13.text:
It seems like a better idea to just defeat you
and unleash the stolen memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_08_15.text:
If you can manage to even lay
a finger on me, that is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_09_03.text:
My body feels so heavy...
What’s happening?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_09_04.text:
I’ve never felt something like this before...
What is this pressure?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_01.text:
...Our goddess powers...
We’ve been stripped of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_02.text:
Ku. I feel it too.
The Nemesis inside me is screeching...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_03.text:
Is this what Lethe meant when she said
our powers will mean nothing when confronting Arart?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_04.text: How did she block the ‘Will of Cora’?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_05.text:
‘The Will of Cora’. That’s a funny name.
The power of light has no master.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_06.text:
That name makes it sound like
Cora is the only one who can control light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_07.text: Have you never thought it strange?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_08.text:
You were abandoned by Cora,
yet, you still have the ‘Will of Cora’.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_10.text:
The Will of Cora that you were granted...
is of my own power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_11.text:
It didn’t feel any different to the real thing,
don’t you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_12.text:
You believed that you were the last goddesses.
The few that inherited the Will of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_13.text: But that is all a lie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_14.text:
In the #outside world#, there are countless beings
of light fighting against the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_15.text:
Cora is a coward. A loser that fled the war
through the Crevice of Dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_17.text:
she confined the land from the outside world,
to create her own utopia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_18.text: This is the #truth of this world#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_20.text:
Yes, Sera.
Let me refresh your memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_21.text:
YOU were the original master of this land.
YOU were defeated and banished by Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_22.text:
YOU were once a higher being.
YOU had the potential to become a transcendent being!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_23.text: You were a victim of violence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_24.text: Recover your strength and take your revenge!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_10_25.text:
That is the reason I made this realm!
To hide you from Cora!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_11_02.text:
Even though your memories haven’t fully returned,
you carry such immense power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_11_03.text:
You will be able to hold your ground against
the #transcendent# beings of the outside world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_11_04.text:
...What would happen to my friends
if I destroy Cora?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_11_05.text: Friends? Do you mean the Elards that accompany you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_11_06.text:
...If a tree falls, its fruits will follow.
They, too, will be destroyed alongside Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_12_01.text: Augh! My body is overflowing with energy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_12_02.text: Is Sera sharing her powers with us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_12_04.text:
I shared my powers as Hasla
to my friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_12_05.text:
With this,
they’re just as powerful as I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_12_07.text:
You won’t stand a chance against Cora
and the other transcendent beings!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_13_01.text:
I don’t care! Whatever you’re asking me to do,
I doubt I can do it alone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_13_02.text:
I’m just an apprentice goddess after all!
All I can cast is #Novice Shield#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_13_03.text:
They’re much better than me
at utilizing the power of the goddess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_14_02.text:
So Arart was the one that bestowed us with our powers?
No matter, let’s kick her butt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_14_03.text:
Uhm... if that was your purpose, you should’ve shared
your powers with {PLAYER_NAME}... Why us...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_14_04.text:
Oh stop complaining Aubrey.
Doesn’t it feel great? This power is awesome!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_14_05.text:
You will need to defeat me
if you want to lay your hands on Sera, Arart!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_15_02.text:
I revealed the truth to you,
and you respond with this nonsense?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_15_03.text:
If this is your answer, fine!
I will crush you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP6_CL_ST3_15_04.text: Go back to living as puppets!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. It’s you.
... I know why you are here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_02.text:
You want to know why
I left Hero Town all so suddenly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_04.text:
After that battle in Elandia,
I was in a state of great confusion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_05.text:
The memory Elanuma left me with...
it had me question my calling as a goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_06.text:
As you know, Kalard and #Daughter of Cora# are both
beings from outside of Hasla just as the Apostles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_07.text:
Centuries of memories of the battle of Light and Darkness
were as miserable as they were old.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_08.text: In that memory, Elanuma was in agony.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_09.text:
Darkness of the Apostles is surely
an evil that corrupts anything around it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_10.text:
But she was always against Cora’s way of
destroying all the victims of the Darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_11.text:
Eventually, Elanuma’s memories ended
at the battle against Destalos,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_12.text: but I know all too well what happened afterwards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_13.text:
All of us, including myself, who were consumed
by the Darkness of the Apostles, collapsed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_15.text:
I always thought you were a pawn of #Kalard#,
created to fulfill Cora’s will to destroy Elard,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_16.text: who was consumed by the Darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_17.text:
So, I left Hero Town,
to find a way to protect everyone from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_18.text:
...In retrospect, it was all for nothing,
thanks to my hasty conclusion...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_1_19.text:
I don’t have any excuses.
I apologize for my lack of faith, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_01.text:
After leaving Hero Town,
I would go to libraries or ruins in the countryside

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_02.text:
to find traces of the unknown 'ancient guardian deity,’
that I saw in the memory of Elanuma.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_03.text:
But for some reason,
a lot of records were missing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_04.text:
Somewhat similar to how the history before the Apostles’
War had been wiped from everyone’s memory...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_05.text:
But I did manage to find some books without covers,
and documents in abandoned ruins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_06.text:
They were the #Legend of the Oracle of Water#
and the legend of the #Legend of Primal Flames#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_07.text:
I couldn’t help but notice that you were deeply involved
in the most recent case concerning the Legend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_08.text:
And so I made my way to the Primal Volcano,
where I met #Chantico#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_09.text:
Well, I guess it’s more accurate to say, Chantico
swallowed me upon my arrival at the volcano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_11.text:
A gigantic lizard jumped out from the ground
and swallowed me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_12.text:
I woke up at the heart of the Primal Volcano.
Just thinking about it still gives me chills...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_13.text:
Chantico was about to kill me mistaking me for Kalard,
but we were able to clear up the misunderstanding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_14.text: ...It wasn’t that she took my word for it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_15.text:
But I guess she thought it wasn't possible for Cora’s
pawn to possess the aura of both Light and Darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_16.text:
Anyway, after clearing up the misunderstanding,
she enlightened me on many truths.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SILUNIS_S2_EP5_WB_2_17.text:
I wish I could get to the details, but we'd better take
care of what’s under our nose first.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_01.text:
Good, good!
We made a ton of money today!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_02.text:
There are still many antiques buried at the Orchard!
The auction will continue to be a success!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_03.text: Many nobles of Hasla are coming to attend the auction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_04.text:
The auction was a major success!
At this rate, I’ll be able to retire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_05.text:
Yes! Haha! This is great!
I’m so lucky and rich!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_06.text:
This is all thanks to my precious Orchard, haha!
The Orchard made me rich!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_07.text: There’s no reason for me to dig up soil now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_1_08.text: Yeah! Forget about the Orchard! Who cares!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_01.text: ...That’s it for the report, Miss Bridget.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_02.text:
Kekeke... Good work.
Everything is going to plan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_03.text: Do you think Lenny will end up selling the Orchard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_04.text:
Of course! She’s blinded by money!
She doesn’t even care about the Orchard anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_05.text: Just one more push. We need to tempt her a little more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_06.text:
I’ll persuade her to sell the Orchard to “improve”
the auction. Trust me, he’ll sell it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_07.text: Then, the Orchard will be ours! Kuhahahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_08.text:
When you told me to bury the #Palencian Treasure#
at the Orchard in secret, I was confused.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_09.text:
I can’t believe you had such a schem- I mean, plan!
You’re truly amazing, Miss Bridget.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_10.text:
There’s no point in keeping treasure that can’t
generate revenue! This is an investment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_11.text:
Treasure can be sold for fast profit.
But the #value of Lenny’s Orchard# is limitless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_12.text:
Lenny has no idea how valuable her Orchard really is.
It generates so much high-quality fruits every day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_13.text:
It also has magical #plant nourishing supplements#
and #rare saplings#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_14.text: Now THAT is what I call REAL treasure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_15.text:
Once I get my hands on that Orchard and fully develop it,
it’ll generate endless money!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_16.text:
I don’t feel happy about cheating Lenny,
but we’ll make more money out of it than her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_17.text:
We did make her rich with the treasure.
We needn’t feel bad for her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_19.text:
If Lenny persisted on keeping her Orchard,
I wouldn’t have pushed her to sell it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_SQ_AUCTION_END_2_20.text:
