TEXT_TALK_001_5_D011.text: Are you saying you don’t really care, meow!?

TEXT_TALK_001_5_D013.text:
Since you don’t need them,
I’m just gonna toss them in the trash!

TEXT_TALK_001_5_D014.text: Throw them away? What a waste.

TEXT_TALK_001_5_D015.text: There’s no one to use them, they’ll just take up space!

TEXT_TALK_001_5_D017.text: Hmph, you’re gonna use them, aren’t you?

TEXT_TALK_001_5_D018.text:
You’re coming? See, this is how you should’ve
responded from the beginning!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D002.text: I have something to ask you.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D006.text:
Hang on, wait a second.
Whew~ Let me talk first!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D007.text:
I can clearly see in your eyes
how nervous you were to message me.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D008.text:
I’m sure even now you can’t control how much your hands
and feet are shaking. I know~ I can feel it.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D009.text:
?
Um, I think there’s been some...

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D010.text:
Shh! You don’t need to explain~
I already know!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D011.text:
I know~ This dignity! This aura!
It’d be weird if you didn’t fall in love with me, wouldn’t it?

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D012.text:
You just fell prey to your instincts, is all!
There’s no need to be embarrassed~ hehehe!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D015.text:
Look at you. Hahah. How adorable.
Pretending to not know what I’m talking about!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D016.text:
Anyway, I understand you messaging me like this
because you’re in love with me.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D017.text: But, alas! I am already betrothed to another.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D018.text: Inside of me... there is only one!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D019.text: So, please, don’t try to get any closer to me.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D021.text: I’m done speaking now, you may leave.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D023.text:
I see you give up quite easily. Hmm~ Achilles clings
harder in times like this. Hohoho!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D024.text:
How persistent. But not surprising,
since the opponent *is* you. Hohoho!

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D026.text: If you’re done talking, I’d like to speak.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D027.text:
You poor fool~ I cannot hear your pleas,
no matter what you say.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D028.text:
It’s about work.
Could you put me in contact with your grandfather?

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D030.text:
Are you implying that it doesn’t matter to you,
as long as they bear even the slightest resemblance to me?

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D032.text:
I have some business to conduct with your grandfather.
But I have no way of contacting him directly.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D033.text: And absolutely no idea where he is.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D034.text:
Of course not.
It’s not easy to gain a private audience with him.

TEXT_TALK_002_1_D035.text:
Tsk tsk, this is the only time
I’m going to accept this poor excuse.

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D002.text:
I’ll send over one of my grandpapa’s men,
you may discuss whatever you need with him.

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D003.text: I was just gonna ask for that, thank you.

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D004.text:
I see you were deliberating all day long,
wondering when to message me! haha

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D007.text:
I see that’s how it is.
I knew you’d be like that~ haha!

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D008.text:
...
When do you think we can meet?

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D009.text:
Sigh~ you poor thing.
I keep telling you! We cannot meet!

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D011.text:
Oh~ Talk to his man first.
I’ve alerted them, extra quickly for you...

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D012.text:
Wait, hold on a second.
I’m... getting a weird feeling...!

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D014.text:
You’re not...
You meeting my grandpapa isn’t some excuse, is it?!

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D015.text: A false pretense so you have an excuse to talk to me?!

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D017.text:
Oh ho ho~ Would you look at that!
I can feel your red cheeks from all the way over here!

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D018.text:
Whew~
I’ll say this in advance,

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D019.text:
in the future, when you contact me again, I prefer you make
it clear if it’s business or personal.

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D024.text:
I see you can’t bring yourself to be honest
I completely understand~

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D025.text:
OK then, you’ve made a promise!
What a good cutie, so obedient!

TEXT_TALK_002_2_D026.text:
Then, I trust my heart has been made clear.
I’m busy planning my engagement party, so toodaloo!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D002.text:
You really are something, you know that?
It’s one thing to be persistent, but this! This is... !

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D003.text:
I didn’t want to be this cold-hearted,
but you leave me no choice!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D004.text:
You know what my grandpapa does, don’t you?
If you keep this up, I’ll tell him everything.

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D008.text: I’m a little taken aback by this sudden behavior.

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D009.text:
If you don’t explain to me in detail
what’s happening, I can’t understand you.

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D011.text:
You’ve recently been meeting up with
Athena quite often, haven’t you?

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D012.text: We have something we’re investigating together...

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D013.text:
Quiet! Recently she has been
mentioning and complimenting you quite often.

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D015.text:
Yes! Why do you think she goes out of her way
to come find me just to speak highly of you?

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D017.text:
Do you take me for a fool!? Hmph!
Obviously you have asked her to do that!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D020.text: Yes! Because you’re not NOT that!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D021.text:
No matter how much you want me~
There are just some things you can’t manhandle your way into!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D022.text: Hmph, I keep telling you I’m not.

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D023.text: Hmm, and I keep telling you you’re not, not!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D027.text:
Either way, as long as I, Briseis, am onto you!
Your devious little plan won’t work!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D028.text:
Hmm, I won’t go so far as to stop you
from having rose-colored dreams about me!

TEXT_TALK_002_3_D029.text:
But! Those are only dreams! Keep them there!
Like a gentleman! Hmph!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D001.text:
Briseis, can we meet for just a second?
I think we should resolve this face-to-face.

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D003.text: Sigh~ How many times do I have to tell you to stop this?

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D004.text: Let’s meet the three of us: you, me, and Athena.

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D005.text: We need to clear up this misunderstanding.

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D006.text:
There’s nothing to resolve.
I’m telling you I understand everything~

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D007.text:
Not that, your grandfather keeps
sending assassins in the middle of the night.

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D008.text:
Oh, that old man!
I told him there was no need for that!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D011.text: A meeting with the three of us.

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D012.text:
Oh~ that.
OK, then. Where shall we meet?

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D014.text: Hyro Forest? At this dark time?

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D015.text: Oh, Athena will take care of th-

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D018.text: I was *this* close to falling for it!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D019.text: I’m getting that buzzing sensation again!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D023.text:
You were trying to lure me into a false sense of
security, by saying let’s meet with Athena,

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D024.text: and then you were going to leave Athena out of it!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D026.text: Were thinking of meeting in a dark forest!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D027.text: Hah! As if I wouldn’t figure it out! Hahah!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D028.text:
Sigh... I don’t know what to do anymore.
Think whatever you want...

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D029.text:
Just as I suspected!
I won’t blame you for being devious!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D030.text: If anything, it’s my fault for being so beautiful!

TEXT_TALK_002_4_D031.text:
Sigh... a woman such as myself, a thorny rose.
Don’t get closer, you’ll only hurt yourself!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D003.text: Is this your answer to our last conversation?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D005.text:
Did you not send me roses
because I am a thorny rose?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D006.text:
It means even if you get pricked by thorns and have
blood dripping down your arm, you can’t give up on me~

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D008.text:
Why can you not answer?
Tell me~

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D010.text:
I’ve told you multiples times
that your heart cannot reach me.

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D011.text:
That cannot be avoided, since you keep up
your futile efforts to woo me! Hehehe!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D014.text:
I, too, feel hopeless and suffocated,
for I cannot reciprocate.

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D015.text: I’m telling you, I’m really not...

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D016.text: What do I have to do for you to believe me?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D017.text:
I’m really not!
I’ll stake my Heroes and all my savings on it!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D021.text:
I’m already so gorgeous... am I going to also have
the land’s greatest Heroes and be super rich?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D022.text:
Achilles, you lucky man! Hahah! He’ll soon be the fiancé
of a very beautiful, very influential woman!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D023.text:
Hnng~ Why are you already thinking of taking
all my money, I’m telling you I’m not!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D024.text:
What on Hasla do I have to do
to get you to believe me?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D025.text:
Hmm, let’s see.
I’m not sure.

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D026.text:
Pff, anyway...
The engagement party is tomorrow.

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D027.text:
Where has Achilles gone?
We have to prepare for the engagement party...

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D028.text:
Gasp! Have you...
gone mad with jealousy and...?!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D030.text:
Do you want me to find him and bring him to you?
Will you believe me then?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D031.text:
I’m just kidding~ It’s a joke~
I’m sure Achilles will be here tomorrow.

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D032.text: If he doesn’t show up, my grandpapa won’t let it slide~ So he can’t have run away~ hohoho!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D033.text:
For the first time in my life,
I feel bad for Achilles.

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D034.text:
Are you free, by any chance?
If so, please come help me.

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D036.text:
It’s because it’s a really urgent situation~
And didn’t I introduce you to my grandpapa?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D037.text:
I couldn’t think of anyone else to call on such short
notice. You understand, don’t you? Hehe!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D038.text:
What makes you think I’d go?
Just imagine the things I’d hear!

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D039.text:
Since it’s the love of your life asking for a favor,
I’m sure you’ll come, right?

TEXT_TALK_002_5_D040.text:
... Sigh...
It’s useless talking to you.

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D003.text:
You were home alone, weren’t you?
Since you’re a loner.

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D005.text:
Sooo! Today! I, Kumori, am giving you a special
chance to come visit my house!

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D006.text: Make sure you come with Rei and Thalia~

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D007.text: Let’s play all night the four of us! How about it? Hehe!

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D008.text:
Oh, and you know I won’t let you in empty-handed, right?
Bring cakes! Looots of them!

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D011.text:
What? Have you finally lost it? How could you
reject Kumori’s invitation?

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D012.text:
I’m busy today, I can’t. And you need to ask
Rei and Thalia about their opinion, too.

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D013.text: I’ll go next time when our schedules match.

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D014.text:
What? What’s got you busy?
You don’t even do anything!

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D015.text: The gracious Kumori will play with the has-nothing-to-do you!

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D016.text: Mm, thanks for the invite, but next time.

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D023.text:
I don’t know yet.
Stay calm for now.

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D024.text: Hnng nngg~ Don’t be like that!

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D025.text: Can’t you come right now? Immediately right now!

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D026.text: I’ll show you something super exciting, as a special prize.

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D027.text:
Come with the girls.
Hmm? Hm? Hmm? Hhhhmmm?

TEXT_TALK_003_1_D028.text: Don’t you wanna see it? Aren’t you curious?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D002.text: Why did you go playing with them without Kumori?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D003.text: Is your brain so bad you forgot about Kumori?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D005.text: We weren’t playing, the adults had a meeting to discuss some stuff.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D007.text:
We discussed things that kids like Kumori
shouldn’t hear, OK?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D009.text:
No?
If it wasn’t why did you exclude me?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D010.text:
Yeah?
How great could it be? Hmph!

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D011.text:
It wasn’t so much that you shouldn’t hear it,
we just had to talk about something very seriously.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D013.text:
Is there something more important than Kumori?
But Kumori is the most important!

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D014.text:
Is Kumori just some unimportant
kid to you, Captain?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D015.text:
... That’s not it.
But you are a kid.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D016.text: What? So you’re gonna keep excluding Kumori?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D018.text:
If you keep this up,
Kumori will be very sad!

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D020.text: Kumori should never have been born!

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D021.text:
Captain, you were gonna hang me from the tree because
I’m bothering you, weren’t you?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D022.text: You were thinking that right now, right Captain?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D024.text: Oh my Hasla, is that true?!

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D026.text: Why would I think something like that.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D027.text:
Kumori is important.
I’m sorry if I made you sad.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D028.text: But we didn’t play without you or anything, so don’t worry.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D031.text:
Kumori?
Are you still very sad?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D035.text: Are you trying to cheer me up, Captain?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D036.text: Hehe, this is all a lie!

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D037.text: What, did you think I’d be sad cuz you didn’t play with me?

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D039.text:
What? It was a joke?
I was worried.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D040.text: You shouldn’t make fun of adults.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D041.text:
What’re you gonna do about it, pfff
You don’t even really seem like an adult.

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D042.text: That’s what you get for hogging people. Neener neener =P

TEXT_TALK_003_2_D043.text: I’m telling you we weren’t playing...

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D002.text: When are you gonna play with me?

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D005.text: I’m gonna make it rain every day until you come!

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D006.text:
People are gonna get sick and crops are gonna rot
cuz it’s gonna rain every day, got it?

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D007.text: It’ll be your fault if everyone gets sick.

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D008.text: It’s because you said you’d come but didn’t.

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D010.text: Are you really gonna do that?

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D012.text:
Kumori does what she says she’ll do!
She’s not just words like you, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D015.text:
I don’t care if you do or not~
What’re you gonna do about it~

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D016.text:
Don’t do that.
If you keep that up,

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D017.text: If I keep it up, what~

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D019.text:
You can’t act so rude to adults.
You’ll get scolded.

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D021.text: Ppff~ You’re not even a scary adult! Try it!

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D023.text:
If you keep acting like that you’re really gonna get in
trouble. I’m not just saying that.

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D024.text:
Yeah?~ Why don’t you come here and scold me then?
Or are you... chicken??

TEXT_TALK_003_3_D025.text:
You can’t even do anything in person~
Stop pretending to be strong~ puahaha!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D010.text:
Captain... Kumori’s house is on fire...
Kumori’s so hot... help...

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D014.text:
First, get to a safe location. Luckily, Lednas said
she’s nearby so just hang on!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D015.text: Lednas is gonna arrive before me!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D016.text: Captain... I don’t really like her...

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D017.text: Now’s not the time to complain about that stuff!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D018.text: Blergh... I think it’s too late for Kumori...

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D019.text:
Captain... if only you had... read it a little sooner...
Kumori might’ve been OK...

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D021.text:
Don’t give up, just hang tight until
someone goes to save you!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D022.text:
Captain... make sure... to play with Kumori
in the... next life... Good... bye...

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D031.text: Oh, did you think a fire was a big deal for Kumori?

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D032.text:
If there’s a fire, I can just make it rain to put it
out. You didn’t even know that?

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D034.text:
You don’t even know that?
And you’re an adult.

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D036.text: Since you’re not answering, it’s true!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D038.text:
Nuh-uh~
You’re bad for making me lie! Repent!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D039.text: I told you, it’s bad to make fun of adults.

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D040.text: Adult this, adult that! Always adults adults adults!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D041.text:
There isn’t even anything great about being an adult!
Pfft!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D043.text: Tut! You’re really gonna be in a lot of trouble.

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D045.text:
I’m the one being treated unfairly.
You should be the one to get scolded!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D046.text: You never even play with me cuz I’m a kid!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D047.text: Sigh... let’s just not talk about this.

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D048.text:
Here we go again!
You always say that when you’re at a disadvantage.

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D049.text: You don’t even answer. It’s not fair!!

TEXT_TALK_003_4_D050.text: I want to be an adult too!

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D001.text: Captain, today I’ll give you the honor of playing with me.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D002.text: Bring lots of sweet chocolates and cakes.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D003.text:
I called the girls, too!
Only slowpoke Captain is missing.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D004.text: We’ll play all night so hurry and get here! Hehe!

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D005.text: Hey you, Captain! Answer! You’re coming, right?

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D016.text: Half of half of half of half...

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D017.text:
Sorry, I’m a little busy right now.
Can I text you later?

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D019.text:
Why are you always busy!
You’re not even that busy!

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D020.text:
Sorry, I’m in the middle of forming my war team. I gotta
go. I’ll contact you as soon as I’m done.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D021.text: Oh, you could just do that and come over.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D022.text: Will Hasla fall to ruins if you don’t do that?

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D024.text:
Aren’t you overestimating your importance?
You’re just a captain!

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D025.text:
Compared to Kumori, you’re not even important at all.
Hmph~

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D028.text:
What, is it because you’re clumsy?
If you can’t use your brain or your body, what can you do?

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D030.text:
Stop messing around. I have to go now.
Have fun with the girls~

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D032.text:
You’re really gonna be like this?
You always say you’re busy.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D033.text: What kind of adult doesn’t keep their promises?

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D034.text: I’m doing something important, please understand.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D035.text:
Forget it, don’t come.
I don’t want to play with you anymore.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D036.text:
Sigh... Kumori. I understand you want to play,
but you can’t talk to adults like that.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D037.text:
If you don’t speak nicely,
I’m never going to play with you.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D041.text:
I’m gonna hurry and get a year older,
and call you however I like!

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D042.text: I’m gonna say all sorts of bad things!

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D044.text: I hope the Boss gives you what for!

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D045.text:
... OK, have fun with the girls.
I’ll talk to you next time.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D048.text:
Um, excuse me... Captain... Hello... It’s Thalia...
Ho-how have you been?...

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D049.text:
U-um, if you’re not busy, I was wondering
if we could talk for a moment...

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D050.text:
Stop messing around.
I’m not gonna answer now.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D051.text: There are 16 Heroes waiting for me because you.

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D052.text:
Eep! Aahh!! I’m sorry! You’re busy! But it’s really
not a prank, it’s really me... really...

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D053.text:
Can you hear me out... Rei and I have gotten together
to plan a birthday party for Kumori...

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D054.text: But Kumori’s in a bad mood because you’re not here,

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D055.text:
so she’s laying on the ground, making a mess
with rain clouds everywhere...

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D056.text:
I-if she keeps this up, the whole town might
get flooded with tears...

TEXT_TALK_003_5_D057.text:
W-we’ll do our best to cheer her up for now, but...
p-please stop by when you can.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D002.text:
Is something the matter these days?
Why do you look so weak?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D004.text:
That’s impossible!
You were so strong before!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D005.text:
Pick a fight?!
I’m saying this because I’m worried.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D007.text:
Now that I think about it,
I haven’t had much energy lately.
And I get tired easily.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D009.text: See! I knew that was it!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D010.text: How many hours do you sleep a week?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D011.text:
I’m not sure... including all my naps...
Maybe around 3 hours?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D012.text:
How can that be!
You’re not sleeping enough!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D014.text:
Who has time to eat.
I just grab what I can when I can.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D015.text: Dear Hasla, don’t you know how important food is?!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D018.text:
I run around all day along,
so when I get home I feel like Jell-O...

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D019.text: Ah! My my... What a pity!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D020.text: Oh, thanks for worrying that much about me...

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D021.text: But it’s my job, so it’s OK.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D022.text:
It’s not OK.
You said you run around?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D023.text:
That’s cardio. You’ll lose muscle.
Next time, walk, don’t run.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D025.text:
Anyway, the gist is: sleep, exercise, food.
You’re not doing any of these properly, right?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D027.text:
Ah! Unacceptable! No!
You can’t keep living like this!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D028.text: What use is it to just take care of Hasla!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D029.text:
If you don’t take care of yourself,
later you’ll be of no use to anyone!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D033.text: You’re not taking care of it yourself at all!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D034.text: Let’s work on our stamina together, starting today!

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D038.text:
I was just about to eat some pizza. How about we start
right after I eat this?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D040.text:
Let me just eat this.
Chocolat made it for me.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D041.text:
She’ll understand.
She’s more serious than anyone about improving one’s health.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D042.text:
No, I still can’t do it.
Throwing away food gets you a one-way ticket to Hell.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D044.text:
I asked Thanatos before,
and he said it’s not true.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D045.text: When did you ask him that?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D046.text:
I saw him for a second when I was bench pressing and
the weight fell on me... anyway, he said so.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D047.text:
You were fluttering between life and death...
And that’s what you asked him?

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D048.text:
Yes. I even asked him if he feeds you all the food
you’ve thrown away, and he said no.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D049.text:
Anyway, don’t worry about that and from this moment on,
you’ll be eating chicken breast instead of pizza.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D050.text:
Ha... there’s no hole for me to escape through.
OK, I got it.

TEXT_TALK_004_1_D051.text:
Good thinking!
Now then, today! We start training!!!

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D002.text:
I myself had 100g of chicken breast and sweet potato,
and a salad to have an energy-filled day.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D003.text:
Why’d you eat so little?
If you wanna bulk, I hear
you need to eat a lot.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D004.text:
Ah-ha, I have a weak digestive system,
so I can’t eat too much at once.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D005.text:
This is 1st breakfast,
and I’m going to eat 2nd breakfast later.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D006.text: 2nd breakfast? How many do you eat?

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D007.text:
Until 1st lunch, so...
until Nth breakfast.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D008.text: Send me your meals of today, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D010.text: What? What did you just say?

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D011.text: What? I think I heard wrong? You’re kidding, right?

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D013.text:
I got it as a gift,
so I have to eat it.
It’s only polite to the person who gave it to me.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D014.text:
You’re on a diet.
Did you not alert the people around you?

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D015.text:
If you had,
this wouldn’t be happening right now.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D016.text: Do I really need to go that far?

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D019.text:
You must tell people.
Look, your diet is already crumbling!

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D020.text:
Still...
It’s not that big a deal
if I eat one meal like this.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D021.text:
Wrong! With that kind of wishy-washy attitude
you’ll never accomplish anything!

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D022.text:
Are you gonna keep living with
that hunk of meat for a body?

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D024.text:
OK, OK, fine. I don’t have a lot of time today,
so I’ll just eat whatever, but tomorrow...

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D025.text:
No!
Not having enough time is an excuse!

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D026.text:
It takes 2 minutes to heat up chicken breast!
And 2 minutes to put it away!

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D027.text: It’s faster than heating up instant noodles!

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D030.text:
At least you’ve realized it now.
You know this is all for you, right?

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D031.text:
Now you’re using me as an excuse? Coward.
Go on then, show me your willpower.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D032.text:
Anyway, then, I’ll take
it that you understood.

TEXT_TALK_004_2_D033.text: Send me pics of you doing 3 sets of lower body workouts!

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D003.text: Captain, have you worked out today?

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D009.text:
You’re full of jokes today.
I assume you have lots of time on your hands.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D010.text: When are you going to workout?

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D012.text:
You’re thinking about it? Ah~ you’re wondering whether
you should do lower or upper body today, aren’t you?

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D013.text: What’s with that lukewarm, wishy-washy answer?

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D014.text:
I was gonna go work out later but,
Neulsolgil suddenly
contacted me.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D015.text:
There’s apparently a birthday party... It’s been so long
since I’ve been to one, so I think I have to go.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D017.text:
A birthday party?
Is that more important than exercise?

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D018.text:
It’s the tiger patron saint, Halla’s birthday.
I couldn’t go last year either, and that’s kept bothering me.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D019.text:
He’s a companion that’s been through thick and thin with
me, the least I could do is go to his birthday.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D020.text:
Hmm... No. While sad occasions shouldn’t be skipped,
missing an occasional celebration is alright.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D022.text:
Birthdays come around every year
and it’s not like he’s going anywhere, right?

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D023.text:
If it’s the tiger patron saint,
he can wait until next year.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D024.text:
Apparently it’s his something hundredth birthday,
although no one knows for sure.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D026.text:
Maybe that’s true, but
I should at least see him and say hi...

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D027.text:
Captain! Have you already forgotten
your great mission to protect Hasla?

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D029.text:
Now’s not the time to go to a birthday party
and make nice!

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D030.text:
If he’s truly your friend, he’ll cheer you on, waiting
for you to recover your stamina!

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D031.text:
Stop with this wimpy nonsense, and immediately head
to the gym! Don’t forget to send proof!

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D032.text:
Ugh, fine, fine.
I’m going, I’m going~ You dictator.

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D033.text: I can see why he was top dog in school. Whew...

TEXT_TALK_004_3_D034.text: I’m saying this all for your own good.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D005.text:
I’m at the gym now.
I don’t see you?

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D009.text:
If you’re not busy, let’s go to the gym together.
I’ll check your form.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D010.text: I thought you’d just worked out?

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D011.text: For you, I can workout twice.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D012.text: Are you sure this is for me?

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D013.text:
Now that I think about it,
I think you just want to go twice.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D014.text:
Overexertion can lead to muscle loss.
For you, I’ll even risk muscle loss.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D015.text:
OK, OK.
I got it, you can stop now~

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D018.text:
I need to get some rest,
I’ve been running around all day, battling.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D020.text:
That’s cardio.
I’m pretty sure I’ve already told you...

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D021.text:
Hm? Did you?
Huh? So are you counting it like I worked out?

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D022.text:
No.
Since you ran, you have to work out even harder.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D023.text: I told you, you can lose muscle if you do cardio.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D024.text:
What you need now,
is muscle!!!

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D025.text:
OK, I got it...
But I really am so tired from fighting all day.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D026.text:
I’ll go after I rest just a little.
Rest is also a part of working out, isn’t it?

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D027.text:
That’s... true.
But you rest for too long.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D028.text: And you make the excuse that you’re tired too often.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D029.text: Other hero units battle that much on a regular basis,

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D030.text:
and they even carve time out to
train both their minds and bodies!

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D031.text: As captain, you should set more of an example!

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D033.text: Friends? Exercise is meant to be isolation.

TEXT_TALK_004_4_D036.text:
OK! I got it! I’ll go to the gym.
Now please stop!!!

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D004.text: At home and I still haven’t worked out yet.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D006.text:
Why didn’t you send proof
of your work out last time?

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D007.text: Have you forgotten your promise to me?

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D009.text:
Don’t apologize.
Just don’t do things you have to apologize for.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D010.text:
If I’m not this tough on you,
you don’t do anything!

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D012.text: But to take very drastic measures.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D013.text:
What is it. I don’t know what it is,
but I’m gonna have to refuse.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D014.text:
No, today. For sure.
Without fail. By all means. At any cost.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D016.text:
Let’s do some home workouts.
I’ll go to your house.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D017.text:
No, no, don’t come.
I’m out!

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D018.text: I’m pretty sure you just said you’re at home.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D020.text:
I didn’t see you, though?
Leave your house.

TEXT_TALK_004_5_D025.text:
If you don’t open the door,
I’ll have to break it down.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D002.text: I am Lady Russell Ashley Brillian III, at your service.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D003.text:
The message you sent me
was my very first one~

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D005.text:
Yes~ thanks to you~
Have you been well?

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D006.text: Oh, is it not what you imagined?

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D007.text:
Victoria gave me this device
as a present~!

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D008.text:
In that time, I’ve caused quite the ruckus, but I’m glad
because I don’t think Ms. Victoria hates me.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D009.text:
It seems like you’re finding much use for the device.
Good for not breaking it.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D010.text:
Oh my, of course.
I couldn’t hide my surprise either.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D011.text:
When I received this gift, with racing heart,
as I hurriedly unwrapped the gift,

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D012.text:
what I did was
I dropped it into some instant noodles~

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D013.text:
I was sure it was ruined,
so I fished it out, eyes closed,

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D015.text:
Even in such a situation, this device shone brightly,
showing us it was alive and well.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D018.text: T’was a sign it was working well~

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D019.text:
Shall I saw, I once again saw,
Ku-Klip’s technical skills.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D020.text:
In any case, I’m really glad
that I’m able to converse with you often
thanks to this.

TEXT_TALK_005_1_D021.text:
I’ll be sure to occasionally send you updates~
Then, goodby...

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D002.text:
I am contacting you because there is something
I wish to discuss with you.

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D003.text: Could you take a look at this picture for a moment?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D010.text:
Ah, dang it...
Could you keep this a secret please?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D012.text: What do you wish to discuss?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D014.text: Someone named Nene said she’d find a good job for me

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D015.text: so I was thinking of going.

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D016.text:
Since I have caused so much
trouble for you all,

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D017.text:
in order to pay everyone back, I have
no choice but to work my tail off...

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D018.text:
The witch who cursed me, as soon as I figure out
who it was... I’m gonna take a spear and...

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D021.text: Why am I speaking in such a manner?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D022.text: Do you think it’s from the griminess of life?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D025.text:
I think I need to have a little siesta,
cool my head a bit...

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D026.text:
Kind Captain...
It was of course the right choice to talk to you.

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D028.text: Do you know what job Nene has lined up for you?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D030.text: I have only heard that it is far away indeed.

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D031.text:
From what I hear,
it’s outside of Hasla.

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D032.text:
Oh? Do you mean to say it’s a different space,
outside of Hasla?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D033.text: If that’s the case, it complicates things a smidge...

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D034.text: Right... I mean you have family.

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D035.text: Do you think they’ll have convenience stores there?

TEXT_TALK_005_2_D039.text: I think I need to think on it a little bit more.

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D005.text: The job opportunity Nene has offered. I’m grateful, but

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D006.text:
I have come to the conclusion that it is dangerous to
rashly go to an unknown world that doesn’t have convenience stores.

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D007.text:
Instead, I shall begin working part-time at a
convenience store I frequent quite often!

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D009.text:
A Hasla without my instant noodle friend
is no fun for me, either.

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D012.text: I forgot the real reason I messaged you!

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D013.text:
There’s a new instant noodle called
‘Flaming Hot Fried Noodles.’

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D015.text: I thought of you as soon as the new noodles came out!

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D016.text:
I’m currently eating a little,
and it really is deliciously spicy...

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D019.text:
It’s a distinguished flavor that
releases all anger from the body.

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D021.text: It is about time it will be delivered.

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D025.text: The Flaming Hot Fried Noodles have arrived but...!

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D029.text:
A mistake!
I’ve gone and ordered
1000 boxes!

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D031.text:
The delivered boxes have completely
filled up the convenience store!!

TEXT_TALK_005_3_D032.text: Ashley, there’s no more room to mo...!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D002.text:
Those 100 boxes that I bought
from the 1,000 boxes last time...

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D003.text: I probably can’t get a refund for them, right?...

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D004.text: It’s so spicy my stomach hurts...

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D007.text:
So I can’t...
I see you’re working very diligently...

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D008.text: Ah, but it’s fortunate you messaged me when you did!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D009.text:
How is it that you message me whenever
I’m in a sticky situation, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D011.text: Well, this time, it truly is a big deal.

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D012.text: Ye-es? Why did you stop talking?

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D013.text: Is there any chance you could lend me a million gold?

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D014.text:
I’m afraid I only own convenience store
mileage points, and no cash...

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D016.text: The thing is... I got blackmailed!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D017.text: My mother has been kidnapped by an evil witch,

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D018.text:
and she said she wouldn’t let her go
unless I give her money immediately!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D019.text:
And the only person who immediately
came to mind was you...!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D022.text:
Eeek?! It’s not that... This time it’s a matter of life
or death for my mother! I will for sure repay this favor!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D023.text:
Eeekk! Are you serious?
I knew you would come through for me!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D024.text:
Lednas said she was nearby,
so I’ll message her first.

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D025.text: Let’s figure out the emergency with that first.

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D026.text:
Where did the witch tell you to go?
I’ll head over there soon, too.

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D027.text: No! It’s enough that you’re lending me the money,

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D028.text:
I couldn’t ask you to lend me your valuable
time as well.

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D029.text:
I, Russell Ashley Brillian III,
will handle the rescue of my mother
with my own strength!

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D033.text:
If you’re really that worried, could you take
over my shift while I’m gone?

TEXT_TALK_005_4_D034.text:
Part-time shift at a convenience store?
Alright, go on then.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D002.text: Ah, Ashley! I was waiting for your text.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D005.text: I have something I need to tell you.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D007.text: Ah, but you still need to hear it.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D008.text: Could you take a few deep breaths as you listen?

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D010.text: My mother is safe and sound.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D012.text:
But, the problem is...
She was safe and sound from the very beginning.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D013.text: She’s so fine I could cry.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D015.text:
So what happened is, after I went to the drop off
location and left the money,

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D016.text:
I got a text from my mother asking when
I was coming home.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D017.text: That’s when I realized something was wrong,

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D018.text: but by then it was already too late.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D022.text: But don’t worry, I’ll pay you back your million gold.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D024.text: No, I already took out a loan to pay you back!

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D026.text:
To be exact... it’s an investment to earn money
so I can pay off my debt! Don’t worry.

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D028.text: What are you saying?? I’m getting even more worried...

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D029.text: I’m going to make a lot of profit quickly,

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D030.text:
and I’ll be sure to pay you back, so just be
a little patient, won’t you?

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D031.text:
I’m sure I’ll make a much greater profit
than the amount I borrowed!

TEXT_TALK_005_5_D032.text:
Umm, this doesn’t feel good...
Where are you? Let’s meet up.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D001.text:
Look at this, Captain.
Will you listen to what I have to say?

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D002.text: There’s something suffocating the life out of me.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D005.text: I’ve only sold rice cakes until now.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D006.text:
The weather’s been getting a little colder and I tried
to get some adventurers to come in and thaw off a bit

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D007.text:
So I added stew
to the seasonal menu.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D009.text:
Yeah~ I did,
but that was the beginning of tragedy.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D012.text:
Do you know Anton, or whatever his name is?
The fellow with blue eyes and white face~

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D013.text:
That man came over and ate 3 bowls of stew, not leaving
behind a single drop of broth.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D016.text:
Listen a little bit more.
I’m not done with the story~

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D017.text:
Anyway, so then he
started saying he wrote some book about ‘Authority on Stew’ or other...

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D018.text:
And what would you know, there were some people who
had bought and read that book?

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D019.text:
There should be a few people coming in after
reading that book~

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D020.text: But they all came looking for stew!

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D023.text:
You frustrating person~
Who asked for a solution?

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D026.text:
Ugh, I’m not sad.
I feel like I’m going to explode from frustration~~

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D027.text:
That Anton fellow, saying that this stew restaurant was
doing well because of him or other~

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D028.text:
Calling himself the spokesperson~
Asking for more kimchi while saying all this.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D029.text: He sure can put it away, too... Anyway...

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D030.text: I see. I guess your stew is really yummy.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D031.text:
Well, that much is easy enough to just kind of guess...
No, no...

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D033.text: Is that my restaurant isn’t a stew restaurant!!

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D034.text: Dangit...~~ I have a rice cake establishment~~~

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D035.text:
I keep running out of rice I set aside to make tteok.
Everyone keeps adding extra bowls of rice.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D036.text: Do you see why I’m feeling so trapped?

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D037.text: After hearing about it, I do understand.

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D038.text:
Speak of the devil...
Anton’s here again, again~ Ugh I’m so sick of him!

TEXT_TALK_006_1_D039.text: Look at him, ordering stew again! Again! Stop coming~~~

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D001.text:
Is this right?
I’m so sad.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D002.text: Is it because of Anton again?

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D005.text:
You know they say love can be born out of hatred.
I find myself fond of him now.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D006.text:
The more I see him, the cuter his face looks.
Now I find myself sad if he doesn’t come.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D007.text: Is that so? That’s good news.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D009.text:
Sigh, I signed up for Oztalk
to start tteok deliveries.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D010.text:
But the only messages I’ve received today
have been stew orders!

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D011.text: Why would you order stew for delivery!

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D012.text:
It’s a long-established custom that stew!
Is all about the temperature!

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D013.text:
A bowl of piping hot stew,
with steam rising up,

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D014.text:
that you have to blow a spoonful at a time,
with kimchi on top and taking a bite. That’s the real deal.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D015.text:
What kind of stew is stew that’s gotten cold en route~
If you’re gonna eat it like that, don’t eat it at all~

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D017.text: That’s not what I’m saying~ The situation is what it is~

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D020.text:
But, I can’t turn down the order
just for that.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D022.text: Hey~ How could I do that.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D023.text:
Imagine how much the people who order it
want to eat it...

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D024.text: Who am I to turn them away.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D025.text:
If you stop and think about it, I think you’re
a really caring person.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D027.text:
Anyway, Captain.
You need to help me out.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D028.text: How do you need me to help?

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D029.text: I need a part-timer to help out. Will you do it?

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D032.text: Hoho, will you really help me?

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D033.text:
I’m kidding. But do you know anyone who could do it?
Someone light on their feet and amiable.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D034.text:
How about Anton or whatever his name is?
He already basically
lives there.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D037.text: Why not? Did he turn you down?

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D038.text: Of course not. I haven’t even asked him~

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D039.text:
Hear me out.
What happened before was that

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D040.text:
He suddenly started asking about the secret to the taste
of the broth, and came barging into the kitchen.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D041.text:
When he saw raw seonji,
what did he do besides passing out on the spot.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D042.text: Since that day, he can’t even go near the kitchen.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D044.text: Ah! I’ve thought of someone who might be a good fit.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D046.text:
and he has a lot of part-time experience, and a good
personality, so I think he’d adapt really quickly.

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D047.text: Yeah?? I knew I was right to ask you!

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D048.text:
Tell that friend, Jack, that things are really busy so
to just come right over to my house and start working!

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D049.text: Right away? You’re not gonna interview him?

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D050.text:
Interview?~~ Why would I do that.
When you’re the reference!

TEXT_TALK_006_2_D051.text:
If it’s someone you recommend,
of course I’m gonna trust them!

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D003.text: Is there something else the matter now?

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D004.text: Those good-for-nothings have slashed my store ratings!

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D005.text: Don’t stuff your faces if it’s not tasty.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D006.text:
They eat every last bite,
then go around spreading weird rumors. Ha.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D010.text:
That friend you recommended, he’s very amiable and
works well and has a lot of passion...

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D011.text:
and he works hard for little money.
He was really good but...

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D013.text: But I think maybe this isn’t the job for him.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D014.text: Unfortunately, I’m going to have to return him to you.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D018.text:
I know he worked really hard, which is why I’m
so hesitant to say anything but...

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D019.text:
Whew... you need to know why.
Keep this close to the vest, OK?

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D020.text: OK, I’ll keep it to myself.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D021.text:
That Jack... the first few days he was a quick-learner
and was really good with the customers...

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D022.text:
so I started teaching him about the kitchen,
not just deliveries or serving.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D024.text:
He suddenly started talking about going vegan and how a
plant-based diet is in. Then he started using soy!

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D025.text:
Soy meat in stew? What nonsense.
That should never happen.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D027.text: So I gave him a stern talking to about that.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D028.text:
That while his intentions were good,
the life force of stew is in its richly flavored meat broth.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D030.text:
So I thought he understood~~
People can have a lapse in judgement, could happen to anyone~

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D031.text:
Wait, did you say he wasn’t a human?
Anyway, that’s not important,

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D032.text:
next he tried to deepen the flavor of the meat,
with demon meat from who knows where,
in my stew~

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D033.text:
Sure! You can experiment.
But then he actually served that to customers~

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D034.text:
And of course they were taken aback by meat they’d never
tasted or felt the texture of before in their lives~~

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D035.text: So they reported it to the Consumer Protection Board~~

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D036.text:
Saying this establishment sold food containing
an unidentified meat~

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D038.text: Sigh... do you understand the situation?

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D039.text:
Since he was trying to do something but
it just happened to not work out, I didn’t reprimand him.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D040.text: I told him that I was closing shop to research tteok

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D041.text: so I won’t be needing any extra hands for awhile.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D042.text:
And I really am thinking of doing that,
given what’s been going on.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D043.text: You’re going to rest for a bit?

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D044.text:
Yeah. Just taking a breather,
since I’ve taken a tumble anyway.

TEXT_TALK_006_3_D045.text:
Anyway, this secret is between you and me~
Keep that in mind when you’re telling your story.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D003.text:
I meant to tell you, but
I’ve been so busy it slipped my mind!

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D004.text:
I closed shop for a while
and have been really focused on making tteok!

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D005.text: Using techniques I figured out while selling stew,

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D007.text:
Oh? Congratulations.
Are you selling tteok again?

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D009.text:
So, for days and nights, I was
perfecting stir-fried seasoned tteok.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D010.text:
But, was it because the savory aroma
of the tteok was wafting through the bricks?

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D011.text: People were gathered outside my door,

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D012.text: knocking and knocking, asking when I was going to open.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D013.text:
I was wondering what was going on,
so I opened the door, right?

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D016.text:
I thought they were asking for tteok.
But they were asking me to sell them stew!

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D017.text:
I told them to go back,
because I closed the stew business.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D018.text:
My my my, they said they couldn’t leave,
and just laid on the ground right there.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D019.text:
Some of them were saying they came from faaaaaar away,
staying up all night a couple days to come eat this?

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D020.text:
And that, until I gave them stew,
they wouldn’t budge an inch.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D023.text:
Huh, have you just your whole life been fooled?
I didn’t detect a smidge of deceit.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D024.text:
So I told them that they’d have to go a quarter of a day
because I didn’t have any stew prepared

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D025.text: and they said it was OK? Can you believe it?

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D026.text:
So, without a choice,
I had to make some stew and serve them.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D027.text:
Then, guess what happened.
They cried while eating it. And clapped, too.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D028.text:
They said, “Is this what it means to be
Hachelin certified”

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D029.text: Captain, do you know what Hachelin is?

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D031.text: You do? It must be something famous.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D032.text: Right? I’m not really sure what it is, either.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D033.text:
Anyway, they said my restaurant had a Hachelin
or whatever and people were gathering all across Hasla.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D034.text:
So what else could I do...
I re-opened the shop.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D035.text:
How could I turn them away when they came from
so far away.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D036.text:
Since it was a dish I had added to
warm up weary adventurers,

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D037.text:
I may as well fill up the bellies of
those who have come from far away.

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D039.text: I guess I’m blessed when it comes to work!

TEXT_TALK_006_4_D041.text:
Whew! It’s about time that customers will start
pouring in.

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D002.text: What’s the matter? Is there a problem?

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D003.text:
I slept 2 hours
and the rest of the time, I was swept up in stew.

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D004.text: If things stay this way, I’ll die before my time~

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D006.text:
Not empty platitudes.
Give me practical help.

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D007.text:
Mm, it’s nothing. I just briefly saw my
forefathers yesterday.

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D008.text: Don’t just say it, actually save me!

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D009.text: The only one I can trust is you, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D011.text:
Let’s cut to the chase,
won’t you take my stew restaurant off my hands?

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D012.text: I see it’s now officially a stew restaurant...

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D014.text: I just want to sell tteok.

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D015.text:
My main job is making tteok,
not stew~!

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D016.text: So how about it? Will you do it?

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D018.text:
What do you mean no~ It’s fine, just try it~ It’s just
hard at first, but you’ll see there’s nothing to it.

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D019.text:
Come on~ What’re you thinking so hard about~ If you mess
up, you can just close. It’s not that big a deal.

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D020.text: Anyway, so I’m going to assume you’ll take it!

TEXT_TALK_006_5_D021.text:
I’ll teach you how to make the signature broth,
so hurry and run over!

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D002.text:
It’s me, Anton.
How have you been?

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D005.text: Straight to business? Where’s the love?

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D006.text: About the sunscreen you recommended last time.

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D007.text:
You know, the one you said you use when you go
to Nosgard.

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D008.text: I tried it, and it’s pretty nice!

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D009.text:
Thanks to you, I can go out to get food even late
at night!

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D010.text: And speaking of, let’s grab some food sometime!

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D011.text: I’ll treat you to a big meal!

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D014.text: Lunch? I have to take a nap then, though.

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D018.text:
My my, are you still growing?
You truly are an adult of the new world.

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D019.text:
Tsk, then how about in the morning?
Before the sun rises.

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D020.text: I have a hard time digesting breakfast.

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D021.text:
Tsk tsk, have you gotten old already?
What use are you!

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D022.text:
Opportunities like this are rare and far in between!
Hmph!

TEXT_TALK_007_1_D024.text:
But we haven’t eaten together yet,
how can we say we did?

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D001.text:
Captain. Have you forgotten you said you’d
grab a meal with me?

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D002.text:
I’ve been waiting and waiting, at this rate
I would rather die!

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D004.text: Then, what? Do your bones break if you message me first?

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D005.text:
You youngin’~ Don’t be like that! If you’re already
forgetting things, that’s a serious problem!

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D006.text: This time let’s really grab a meal together.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D009.text: Spicy stir-fried pork... that’s a good choice.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D010.text: Pork cutlet... that’s a good choice.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D012.text: If you look at it from a nutrition perspective,

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D013.text:
a hot hot bowl of hearty stew is really the best
in many ways.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D018.text:
Hm? Judging by your response, I see you’ve only tried
a weak imitation. 9 out of 10 places serve imitations.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D019.text:
Oh ho, you haven’t had stew?
Tut, you’ve lived an empty life.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D020.text: Your life, is divided by the moment

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D021.text: you try “real” stew, and every moment before that.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D022.text:
You, Captain,
have not yet
truly lived life!

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D023.text: You must be truly grateful to have met me.

TEXT_TALK_007_2_D024.text: I have much to teach you!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D003.text:
There’s a stew restaurant that’s the absolute best in
the world, with a 40-year-long tradition. Come out!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D006.text: It’s raining! It’s the perfect opportunity!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D007.text:
Huh? You already knew about it?
Then I don’t need to keep talking your ears off about it.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D008.text:
Hurry and get your butt over to Malsook’s stew
restaurant!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D009.text: I’m pretty sure it’s a tteok shop.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D011.text:
It’s still a tteok shop.
The stew is a side dish.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D012.text: You must free yourself from that way of thinking.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D013.text: The real star of that place is the *stew*.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D014.text:
Ms. Malsook’s oxblood soup is
art itself.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D015.text: I can eat it every day and not tire of it!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D017.text: Tut tut, it’s food, not blood.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D018.text:
Hey! Don’t talk back to me!
The depth of flavor is 40 years old.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D021.text:
What? I don’t even need to take a close look to know
your tastes are shallow. I’ll show you a new world.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D022.text:
What? There is no “next!”
Do you think it’s your decision?

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D024.text:
Tsk tsk, your elder is speaking.
It’s impolite to reject.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D025.text: Where did you learn such boorish behavior.

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D027.text: Don’t make me say it twice!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D029.text: What? There won’t ever be another chance like this!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D030.text:
There are currently droves of foodies who come out
on expeditions to Hasla to taste the food I recommend!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D031.text:
Tsk tsk, and you, not even knowing how thankful
you should be!

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D032.text: Pff... I don’t really like stew...

TEXT_TALK_007_3_D033.text:
Oh ho!! I’ll change your mind if I have to tear your
mind down one bit at a time!!

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D004.text: Oh! Seeing as you’re answering, I assume you’re safe!

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D005.text: Oh! Seeing your response, I see you’re fine!

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D007.text: I got a little too worked up that day and

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D008.text: that’s why that happened. I’m sorry.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D010.text:
Yeah but that doesn’t mean you had to hit me
on the head with a stone pot.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D012.text:
I repeatedly said that I would
treat you to a bowl of stew,

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D013.text: but you just went ahead and ordered ‘stir-fried rice cakes!’

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D014.text:
I can’t pick what
I’m going to eat?

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D015.text: Oh you irritating person! That’s not the point!

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D016.text: Since I’m paying for it with my money,

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D017.text: you have to eat what I pick!

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D021.text: Why did you have to provoke me!

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D023.text: You did text me to say sorry, right?

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D026.text:
Listen~ If you had just eaten stew,
this never would have happened~

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D027.text: Anyway! Don’t make the same mistake next time! Period!

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D029.text: I’m just saying, it takes two to tango.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D030.text: Hey hey hey now, why are you drawing such a harsh line?

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D031.text:
You know,
it’s not like I was comfortable during that time.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D032.text: Because of the blood you splattered.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D033.text:
From when feeble old me
passed out backwards.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D034.text:
I got an earful from
Auntie Malsook.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D035.text:
She said something about having to clean up a giant
mess or something.

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D036.text: She said that if I didn’t apologize to you properly,

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D037.text: she wouldn’t give me anymore stew so...

TEXT_TALK_007_4_D039.text:
Anyway, I’ve apologized
so make sure you tell her! Got it?

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D003.text: Have you yet to contact Auntie Malsook?

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D004.text:
She still isn’t giving
me any stew!

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D005.text: I’m asking if you didn’t tell her that I apologized.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D007.text: My stew is in your hands!

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D010.text:
How could you forget something like this?!
Do you want me to starve?

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D011.text:
What? Are you saying you did it on purpose?
Are you a psycho?

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D012.text: I’m feeling a sick, so I’ve just been sleeping.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D013.text:
I have a bit of a headache too... maybe because
I got hit on the head.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D015.text: So, are you moaning and groaning at home?

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D016.text:
Not quite that bad,
just resting at home.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D017.text:
You need to make sure you eat well when you’re sick,
have you eaten?

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D019.text:
If you’re going to eat instant noodles, why not pay
extra for stew? Nutrition is important when you’re sick.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D020.text:
If you’re going to eat porridge,
you may as well eat stew.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D021.text: Polish off a hot bowl of broth,

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D023.text: and before you know it, you’ll be healed.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D024.text:
Did you hear about that person whose incurable disease
was cured by Malsook’s stew?

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D025.text: Malsook’s never mentioned anything like that...

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D026.text:
Because, she doesn’t need to. She has guests pouring
out of every crevice.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D028.text: I’ll treat you to some stew!

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D029.text: I wanna stay at home and rest.

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D031.text:
How will you do grand things as a Hero
if your body is so weak!

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D032.text: Come out at once! Let’s invigorate your body!

TEXT_TALK_007_5_D033.text: Ha... you’re persistent. Just this once.

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D005.text: Listen to what I have to say~

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D008.text: I think there’s some cocky fellow

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D009.text: running around, pretending to be me.

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D010.text: People say that he and I are alike,

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D011.text: but I have no idea what they’re talking about!

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D014.text: Do you know who he is?

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D015.text:
Do you... Do you also think we’re alike?!
You better not~

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D017.text: Anyway, it’s some blonde haired fellow

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D018.text:
walking around, pretending to be me,
and it’s making me very sad.

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D019.text:
Sniff sniff... I’m gonna eat some of Malsook’s tteok
as a pick-me-up.

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D020.text: OK, enjoy your treat and feel better.

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D021.text: I will! Thanks for listening to me, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_008_1_D022.text: Let’s go to Malsook’s tteok shop together someday!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D002.text: Don’t you go to Malsook’s Place!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D003.text: Never ever ever ever ever go!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D005.text:
Don’t make jokes~!
I’m being serious!!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D006.text: So the thing is what happened it~

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D007.text: Malsook’s Place has lost sight of where they’re from!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D008.text: As you know, Malsook’s Place quite the storied place!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D009.text:
But recently,
tradition has taken a backseat,

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D011.text: and unholy stews that have absolutely no history!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D012.text:
All while letting their original, chewy, glutinous
five-colored songpyeon fall into oblivion!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D013.text:
A tteok shop that sells stews, and not a tteok
in sight, hah!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D014.text:
How can it be that the tables have turned so much?
Ha, tsk tsk!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D015.text:
In cases like this, the regulars need to stop going
for Malsook to regain her senses, don’t you think?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D017.text: Yes! I knew you would get it!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D018.text:
My, my! If everyone praises you, how do you keep hold
of your own head? That’s what happened to Malsook!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D019.text: But, aren’t you and Malsook close?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D020.text: I thought she was more than just a regular shop owner.

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D021.text: Do you really need to go that far?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D022.text: You are correct. Malsook and I go back 20 years.

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D023.text:
However, this Malsook of now is not the warm Malsook
I’ve known for the past 20 years.

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D024.text: She’s changed, I tell you, changed.

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D025.text:
Now she and I are not friends, or anything else.
So it’s irrelevant.

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D026.text: Hm? Has she done something wrong?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D029.text:
Not at all.
Things have just changed.

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D034.text:
Instead of deciding to distance yourself on your own,
why don’t you try talking to her?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D036.text: She’s the one who distanced herself from me first!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D037.text:
If anyone was unfairly distanced from,
it was me!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D038.text:
If anyone wants to talk it out
with the other party, it’s me!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D041.text: But because of all the stew customers storming in,

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D042.text: we couldn’t get a word in, and I shuffled my way home!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D043.text:
Ah-ha, I see~
So that’s why you were telling me to not eat stew?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D045.text:
All that talk about tradition and whatnot
was all an excuse!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D046.text: We’re not friends anymore because of her stupid stew!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D047.text:
So help me ruin her stew business, won’t you Captain?
Hmm?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D048.text: You can’t do that~ That’s not the right way to fix this~

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D049.text:
Rushing in blindly to ruin her stew sales
is not going to resolve this~

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D050.text:
How about helping her out since she’s so busy, and
trying to have a conversation that way~

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D051.text: Me? You want me to help with work?

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D052.text: I... I’ve never even stepped foot inside a kitchen.

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D053.text: This is your chance to do so! You got this!

TEXT_TALK_008_2_D054.text: Hm... you think so? Alright then! I’ll give it a try!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D002.text:
Malsook only hangs out with empty-headed
stew-worshippers now.

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D004.text:
Did our plan of helping her out and talking to her
not work out?

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D005.text:
Mmm... so the thing is, I was of absolutely
no help in the kitchen,

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D006.text: if anything, I just made a mess,

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D007.text:
so I instead lent her my pet ginseng, Sansami,
to help out.

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D008.text: Thanks to me, her restaurant’s doing even better.

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D009.text:
Malsook’s even busier,
but I thought she would at least come thank me...

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D010.text: Has she ever heard of gratitude?!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D011.text: It’s as if I don’t even exist to her!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D012.text: Can you believe how poorly she’s treating me?

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D014.text: Really! There’s no one as ungrateful as her!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D018.text:
Malsook needs to feel my absence to remember
how important I am!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D019.text:
So I’ve decided from now on, to only hang out
with Han deities!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D020.text:
I’ve already made plans to have fun parties in the
Forest of Spirits.

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D022.text: Yes! So just be aware of that!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D023.text: Just on the off chance that perhaps

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D025.text: looks for me, tell her to not bother! Hmph!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D027.text: Uh... it loses its full effect if I say it myself!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D028.text: Hmph... disgraceful people have no name!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D029.text:
But you said before that you don’t like hanging out
with the Han deities.

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D031.text: Don’t go around spreading lies, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D033.text:
That was just... Hanee Baram is just a little hard
to deal with,

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D034.text:
Neulsolgil is a little draining to be around
for too long,

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D035.text:
and Eungaram only talks about his first love and I can’t
get to know him and it’s very frustrating!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D036.text:
Are you saying it’s difficult because they’re all
older than you?

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D037.text:
Not that it’s difficult... ah-hem.
Anyways!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D038.text: Just be aware of that, and if *someone* asks, make sure!

TEXT_TALK_008_3_D039.text:
MAKE SURE you tell her!
Do you understand, Captain?

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D002.text:
So are you telling me you didn’t tell her,
even though I asked you to?!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D004.text: Waahh~ A disgrace! Why didn’t you?!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D005.text: Don’t change the subject! Why didn’t you tell her?!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D007.text: You said to tell her if someone “asked.”

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D010.text: that no one asked about my whereabouts, am I correct?

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D015.text:
So impertinent that she didn’t even notice
that I was gone!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D017.text:
I thought you were going to only hang out with Han
deities? Have you already decided to return?

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D018.text: So annoying and impertinent! So I came back down~~

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D025.text: Do you know what she said to me?

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D028.text:
She said, she called me ‘The Three Pretty Boy
Brothers of the East!’

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D031.text: I can’t bear saying it with my own mouth!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D032.text: She said we were the prettiest men of Han!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D035.text: she added some undeserving copycat jerk

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D036.text: and made us the three brothers~~

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D038.text:
Whenever she ties me together with whoever,
without any thought, like that...

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D039.text: it drives me up the wall!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D040.text: Well, that’s part of Neulsolgil’s charm.

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D041.text: I don’t know, I don’t know.

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D042.text: But she’s my superior, so I can’t say anything to her.

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D043.text: Honestly, I’m not exactly a looker!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D045.text:
No, I mean that I’m not some pretty boy, I’m definitely
more of a charming guy.

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D046.text:
Before my form changed to this, I was a very impressive
man, simply oozing manliness from every pore.

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D047.text:
I see... interesting. Did you come down because of what
Neulsolgil said about you being a pretty boy?

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D048.text:
No, not because of that.
She kept saying we should

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D049.text:
invite that outsider and all hang out together, so Garam
said he didn’t like people and left in a huff.

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D050.text:
And I couldn’t bear the thought of being on the same
level as that jerk, so I came down!!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D051.text: Really? I guess the party’s completely over, then.

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D052.text: No, the more annoying thing is

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D053.text:
that even though Garam and I left,
the party didn’t cool off at all. Waah~

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D055.text: Anyways, I’m never going to see “her” again!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D056.text:
So now you’re going to refer to Neulsolgil as “her”
as well, now?

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D057.text: I dunno~ Disgraceful people have no name!!

TEXT_TALK_008_4_D058.text: I hate everyone and everything~ Waaah~!

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D001.text: Captain, you’re all I have left now~

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D004.text:
Why does everyone think of that blondie
when they see me?

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D006.text: Did someone else say you guys look alike?

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D008.text: What do that insolent fool and I have in common!

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D010.text:
and he looks like he’d topple over
if you look at him wrong,

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D011.text: and people think he looks like me?!

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D014.text: Oh ho? What’s with your reaction?!

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D015.text: Right? We don’t look alike at all, right?

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D016.text: Malsook is always looking for him, too~

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D017.text: Neulsolgil is always looking for him~

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D019.text: You’re not gonna be like that, right Captain?

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D020.text: If you act like that, I’ll have no one left.

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D022.text: I knew it~ You’re the only one for me, Captain~

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D023.text:
Captain are you really gonna be like that?! Wahhh~
So mean! Tell me it isn’t so~

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D024.text:
In any case, that scoundrel is responsible
for all of this.

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D025.text: After he appeared, I haven’t had a moment’s peace.

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D027.text: I’m going to go find him and show him who’s boss!

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D029.text: I need a captain to be on my side.

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D031.text: Waah~~~~ Are you really gonna be like this~~~~

TEXT_TALK_008_5_D032.text:
OK, OK, I got it.
I’ll go with you, OK?

TEXT_TALK_009_1_D013.text: Where is your common sense...... ahh...

TEXT_TALK_009_1_D023.text:
Oh you think your appendix is bursting?
OK, where are you? I’ll head over now!

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D004.text:
You don’t have anything to do? Good. Let’s hang out,
I’m bored.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D005.text:
Yes, thanks to you.
You’re quite useful.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D006.text: I really almost died that day~

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D008.text:
They say you can’t even find dog poop when you want to
make medicine with it,

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D009.text: and I had no one to ask for help.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D010.text: Ah~ “Is this how I go?” is what I was thinking.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D012.text: Exactly. It’d be a shame to die like that~

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D013.text: It’s true. You don’t believe me?

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D015.text: Do you know how many kilos an appendix weighs?

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D016.text: Kilos? It’s probably not even many grams.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D018.text:
I was hoping I’d lose weight since I got
my appendix removed.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D020.text: Ha but it really makes no sense.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D022.text:
The production team was on vacation
so they weren’t here,

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D023.text: and I was finally resting by myself

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D024.text:
How could something like this pick exactly
a day like that?

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D026.text: wanted to screw me over, and

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D031.text: I thought about it a lot while lying down,

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D032.text: and there have been a few really unlucky days, OK?

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D033.text:
Like I’d get stomach problems on days I’m wearing
clothing that’s hard to take off.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D034.text:
Or I’d hit every red light on days I overslept and
had to film.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D035.text: Or I’d get a giant pimple on days I had a photo shoot.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D036.text:
But the important thing is that whenever that happened,
I got a bad feeling and shivers down my spine.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D040.text: Do you want to disappear without a trace?

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D042.text: But it really sounds a bit crazy.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D044.text:
You just wait until I’m fully recovered from my surgery,
you’re dead meat.

TEXT_TALK_009_2_D047.text:
I might look like this right now, I am a celebrity, so
keep my stomach issues and acne a secret, OK?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D001.text: Ha, when am I getting discharged?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D002.text: I have to go beat you to a pulp ASAP~

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D004.text: You’re gonna answer with just a question mark?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D005.text: Ah~ So you play with me.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D013.text: Is no one going to visit you in the hospital?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D015.text: I don’t have any friends though?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D018.text: Is the production team still on vacation?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D021.text: They’ve been back for who knows how long

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D022.text: and I haven’t seen a single trace of them.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D023.text: Now that I think about it, it’s a disgrace,

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D024.text: I took in a bunch of Tom, Dick, and Harrys

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D025.text: who can’t match a beat to save their lives,

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D026.text: fed them, clothed them, gave them a place to sleep,

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D028.text:
And they haven’t just not visited me,
they’ve ghosted me!

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D029.text: I’ve forgiven a lot~ this whole time. Hmm?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D031.text: What do you mean there is. Whose side are you on?!

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D032.text: Ah, don’t try and stop me! Harumph.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D037.text: Yes... that’s how it all makes sense.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D039.text: Don’t just keep it to yourself, share with me.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D040.text: I’m talking about my appendix bursting.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D044.text:
It’s a common phrase “My appendix burst,” but if your
appendix really burst, you’d die.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D045.text:
If harmful bacteria seeps into the appendix from the
peritoneum, you’d die from peritonitis or poisoning...

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D046.text:
The typical situation where the appendix bursts is when
appendicitis occurs, and appendicitis is...

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D048.text:
Can you not tell what’s important now?
Is it so difficult reading the context?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D049.text: Anyway, having a close call with my appendix bursting,

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D050.text: and things like mega pimples and other stuff.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D051.text:
Why such things happened in the first place
is what’s important.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D052.text: What about them? Are appendix and pimples related?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D055.text:
Seems like the production team
conspired among themselves

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D056.text: to take some kind of revenge on me.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D059.text: Do you think this is part of the script?

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D064.text: Why is she here again? It’s so annoying.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D067.text: Ah, pretending to be so friendly and kind.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D069.text:
She definitely came to embarrass me, seeing me lying
down with no makeup on. I’m 100% sure.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D070.text: I can’t wait to expose the truth about her.

TEXT_TALK_009_3_D071.text:
Ugh. I’ll contact you again.
Just wait for it.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D003.text: What do you think? It hurts.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D004.text:
Oh, don’t come. Let’s just chat on Oztalk.
It’s more fun.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D005.text:
I’m sick,
but they won’t leave me alone.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D006.text: Phew, being a celebrity is hard work.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D008.text: You got famous all of a sudden?

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D009.text: You said no one came to visit and it was so boring.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D011.text:
I’m Yuna, a rising star.
Are you kidding me?

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D013.text: Seems like the fans heard the news just now.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D014.text: They're sending dolls and flowers like crazy.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D015.text: I was so busy taking photos. Phew.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D016.text: The production team also came with fruit baskets,

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D017.text: made a fuss and then left.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D020.text: Did they go without casting a curse this time?

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D022.text: What curse? Stop mocking our production team.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D027.text: The reason I couldn’t make it last time

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D028.text: was because I ended up being hospitalized,

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D029.text: and the sudden cancellation of the plans

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D033.text:
I checked all of the CCTV footage, accommodation,
vehicles,

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D034.text: their messengers, diaries, and so on... Ahem, and...

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D035.text:
I’m convinced the production team had absolutely no time
to cast any curses.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D038.text:
Now that we know they are innocent,
it's a win-win situation. Anyway!

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D039.text:
So, to sum it up! The production team is
not the culprit.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D041.text: Yeah, stop talking and just agree.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D042.text: So, I came up with a new hypothesis.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D048.text: What do you think that means?

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D051.text: Ha ha. It’s not you, of course.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D053.text: who would benefit the most if I fall

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D054.text: while trying to hinder my progress.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D056.text:
Are you silly? Meri and I have completely
different positions.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D057.text:
Are you silly? That person is already above me, though I
don’t want to admit it.

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D058.text: What would they gain if I were to fall?

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D064.text:
Be honest with me. You are doing this because you don’t
know either, right?

TEXT_TALK_009_4_D065.text: Find out by tomorrow! Well then, bye.

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D003.text: I told you to find out the culprit!

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D004.text: What?! You need a scolding, right?

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D009.text: Okay. If you really have no clue,

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D015.text: Do you get the idea now?

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D019.text: Uzume? The Uzume I know wouldn’t do such a thing.

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D021.text: You’re more naive than I thought.

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D022.text: That’s what “putting on a character” is all about.

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D023.text:
Come to think of it, in every position where I was
supposed to be cast, Uzume was always there, right?

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D024.text: She wants to take my place.

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D027.text:
Because I’m cuter, fresher, have perfect rhythm,
and sing better.

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D029.text: There are curse spells in that country, right?

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D030.text: So I'm sure the culprit is Uzume!

TEXT_TALK_009_5_D044.text: I’m going to cut off her appendix.

TEXT_TALK_010_1_D005.text: Yeah? I knew I found the right person.

TEXT_TALK_010_1_D011.text: Hmph. I didn’t ask for your opinion.

TEXT_TALK_010_1_D012.text: Just shut up and listen. Simple as that.

TEXT_TALK_010_1_D013.text: Then you’ll keep my secrets from today.

TEXT_TALK_010_1_D015.text: Do not disclose what I say.

TEXT_TALK_010_1_D024.text: I’m not asking for your thoughts.

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D001.text: I secretly came to Cano’s fan meeting,

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D005.text:
What’s the agency doing?
They should’ve made announcements.
Fans must be worried.

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D007.text:
Are you stupid?
I just said I came here in secret.

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D008.text: What. A fan came to a fan meeting.

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D010.text: But you’re a popstar, too, Meri.

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D011.text:
Cano’s fans would recognize you,
wouldn’t they?

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D012.text: Cano is missing now. Don’t ask too many questions.

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D013.text: Do you think I’m so careless and forgot such problems?

TEXT_TALK_010_2_D014.text:
